《法界之心》大灵岩寺四十九天闭关纪实

The Heart of the Dharma Realm · Part II: Like the Moon, A Record of a Forty-Nine-Day Retreat at Dalingyan Temple

四十九天闭关日记

A Diary of a Forty-Nine-Day Retreat

元旦，丁一鸣有三天假期，他谢绝了朋友们一起出去旅游的邀请，吃过早餐，就进入书房，他想趁这三几天时间看看吴爱真的修行日记，郑美琴昨天晚上已在翻阅，并说有所触动。

On New Year's Day, Ding Yiming had three days off. He declined his friends' invitation to go on a trip together and went into his study after breakfast. He wanted to use these few days to read Wu Aizhen's spiritual practice diaries. Zheng Meiqin had begun reading them the previous evening and said that they had deeply moved her.

丁一鸣翻开了第一本《大灵岩寺四十九天闭关纪实》，认真地看起来。

Ding Yiming opened the first volume, A Record of a Forty-Nine-Day Retreat at Dalingyan Temple, and began reading attentively.

THE RETREAT JOURNAL · 01

三月十二日

March 12

九点整，客堂师父在香炉里先点燃了檀香粉，大家全部退出关房院门。

At exactly nine o'clock, the monk in charge of the reception hall lit sandalwood powder in the incense burner, and everyone withdrew beyond the entrance to the retreat courtyard.

寺院主持把前面点好的香炉摆在大门口，然后手拿一块檀木放在前额，停了几秒钟，将檀木插入香炉中。

The abbot placed the already-burning incense burner at the entrance, then took a piece of sandalwood, held it against his forehead for several seconds, and inserted it into the burner.

我也拿三块檀木，依样画瓢放在前额，依次插入那块檀木前面，而后跪地磕三个头，入关的简单仪式就举行完了。

I, too, took three pieces of sandalwood and imitated his actions, holding them against my forehead before placing them one by one in front of his offering. Then I knelt and bowed three times, completing the simple ceremony for entering retreat.

然后我与大家示意便走入关房，门咔得一声关上了，上锁、贴封条，闭关开始了。

I signaled goodbye to everyone and entered the retreat quarters. The door clicked shut, was locked, and was sealed. My retreat had begun.

从早上八点左右，陆续有几只喜鹊飞来鸣叫。

Starting at around eight that morning, several magpies arrived one after another, calling out from nearby.

在北方喜鹊是报喜的，也算是对我入关的祝贺吧。

In northern China, magpies are traditionally regarded as harbingers of good fortune, so perhaps their calls were a way of congratulating me on entering retreat.

我在打坐中，看到韦陀菩萨正在空中清场，手拿杵，周围八百里之内现祥光，很多动物纷纷离去。

While meditating, I saw Bodhisattva Weituo clearing the area in the sky, holding his vajra staff. Auspicious light appeared across an area extending eight hundred liin every direction, and many animals began to depart.

我笑着说：“不需要它们搬家吧？”

I smiled and said, “Surely they don't need to move house, do they?”

韦陀说：“是有的动物承受不了你禅定中的光芒。”

Weituo replied, “Some animals cannot withstand the radiance of your meditative absorption.”

随之，在我前方空中出现了两只飞舞的彩凤，两只飞舞的凤凰之间又现出一座宝塔。

Then two colorful phoenixes appeared in the sky before me, dancing through the air, and a jeweled pagoda materialized between them.

阿弥陀佛和大势至菩萨同时在空中显现，我便上前作礼，阿弥陀佛送我一只带八宝的项圈，大势至菩萨将手中如意放在我禅床前的桌子上，与弥陀一起隐去。

Amitabha Buddha and Mahasthamaprapta Bodhisattva appeared in the sky together. I stepped forward and bowed respectfully. Amitabha Buddha gave me a necklace adorned with the Eight Auspicious Treasures, while Mahasthamaprapta placed the wish-fulfilling scepter he held on the table in front of my meditation couch. Then both disappeared from sight.

随之有天女散花。

Afterward, celestial maidens scattered flowers from above.

上午打坐，起坐后看上师的书。

I meditated in the morning and read my teacher's books after rising from the cushion.

在闭关期间，我每天只日中一餐。

During the retreat, I ate only one meal a day, at noon.

中午寺院是十一点开饭。

Lunch was served at the temple at eleven o'clock.

饭毕，收拾碗筷，又看书到二点钟。

After eating, I cleaned up the dishes and continued reading until two o'clock.

休息了一个小时，又看书、打坐到晚八点半。

After resting for an hour, I resumed reading and meditation until eight-thirty in the evening.

在定中见朗公（朗公系佛图澄的弟子，为泰山大灵岩寺的开山鼻祖。

In meditation, I saw Master Langgong, a disciple of Fotucheng and the founding patriarch of Dalingyan Temple on Mount Tai.

佛图澄为晋·后赵时期西域高僧,时以神通著称于世）化金麒麟从门入并说：“我将为你护关四十九天。”

Fotucheng was a distinguished monk from the Western Regions who lived during the Jin and Later Zhao periods and was renowned in his time for his miraculous powers. In the vision, Master Langgong transformed into a golden qilin, entered through the door, and said, “I will protect your retreat for forty-nine days.”

我表示感激，他说：“我曾化现此寺，深知现在众生难度、佛法难弘，菩萨来此闭关，也是全寺僧众的福报，愿菩萨早圆圣果，福荫众生。”

I expressed my gratitude. He said, “I once manifested at this temple and know well how difficult it is to guide sentient beings today and how challenging it is to spread the Buddha's Dharma. A bodhisattva undertaking retreat here is also a blessing for the entire monastic community. May the bodhisattva swiftly attain the sacred fruit and bring blessings to all sentient beings.”

又谈了一些寺院的过去历史，说完后，从门告辞而出，身上隐约有余光，龙角和尾巴特别清晰。

He went on to tell me more about the temple's history. When he had finished, he took his leave through the door. A faint radiance lingered around his body, and his dragon horns and tail were especially distinct.

THE RETREAT JOURNAL · 02

三月十三日

March 13

早六点起床，四十分钟动功。

I rose at six in the morning and practiced dynamic qigong for forty minutes.

天很冷，水管冻，流不出水。

The weather was bitterly cold. The water pipes had frozen, and no water would flow.

上午打坐，在定中为一只冰蚕和龟做了超度。

I meditated in the morning and, while in a state of absorption, performed a ritual of spiritual deliverance for an ice silkworm and a turtle.

九点四十分开始阅读经书。

At 9:40 a.m., I began reading Buddhist scriptures.

下午三点开始修习宝瓶气九次。

At three in the afternoon, I began practicing vase breathing nine times.

第一次：听到腹腔丹炉或宝瓶里呼呼风生，内视随风起火；

First round: I heard a wind-like whooshing inside the furnace of my lower abdomen, or the vase within it, and through inner visualization, saw fire arise with the wind.

第二次：热能从下丹田升起，拙火生起，同时有水降下，水火既济、心肾相交；

Second round: Heat rose from the lower dantian, and inner fire awakened as water descended at the same time, bringing water and fire into harmony and uniting the heart and kidneys.

第三次：火逐渐纯青，无呼呼风生，水火既济；

Third round: The fire gradually became a pure blue, the whooshing wind ceased, and water and fire remained in harmony.

第四次：火化作能量而上，绕两耳行至前额到鼻吐气，两耳发烫；

Fourth round: The fire transformed into energy and rose upward, traveling around both ears to the forehead and then to the nose as I exhaled. Both ears became hot.

第五次：能量化为光，整个腹腔有琉璃似的光，偶有光焰；

Fifth round: The energy transformed into light, filling the entire abdominal cavity with a crystal-like radiance, occasionally flaring into tongues of light.

第六、七、八、九次：光如如不动，冰清玉洁(内感稍热)。

Sixth, seventh, eighth, and ninth rounds: The light remained perfectly still, pure and immaculate as ice and jade, accompanied by a slight sensation of internal warmth.

中间有大约几次气不能充满宝瓶，皆因杂念生起，心不能空灵寂静而失败。

On several occasions, I could not fill the vase completely with breath because distracting thoughts arose. My mind failed to remain empty, clear, and still, and the attempts were unsuccessful.

第四次后，因疲累还休息了一会儿。

After the fourth round, I rested for a while because I was tired.

三点四十分修完宝瓶气，做短暂活动。

I finished practicing vase breathing at 3:40 p.m. and did some light exercises.

晚六点半，心口忽极度燥热。

At 6:30 p.m., I suddenly felt intense heat and agitation in my chest.

不想看书、打坐，写了半小时书法，调整自己情绪心态。

I had no desire to read or meditate, so I practiced calligraphy for half an hour to regulate my emotions and state of mind.

正身、正意、正言，气才能入中脉。

Only when posture, intention, and speech are properly aligned can the vital energy enter the central channel.

心魔最难调伏。

The demons of the mind are the hardest to subdue.

用电饭锅煮了一些水，湿气升起来，心上燥热减轻了许多。

I boiled some water in the rice cooker, and as the moisture rose into the air, the heat and agitation in my chest eased considerably.

原来房内太干燥，一下子不能适应。

It turned out that the room was simply too dry, and I had been unable to adapt to it.

如不转化色身，我们心的承受能力究竟有多强？

If we do not transform our physical bodies, how much can our minds truly endure?

我们崩溃、堕落、烦躁，短暂的快乐，佛陀的教诲、理论与我们毫不相关，除非我们自己有觉受、体验，心才能真正溶入佛法智慧的海洋，才能转业力带给我们的一切，转了之后，才知道一切皆空性。

When we break down, fall into destructive patterns, become agitated, or chase fleeting pleasures, the Buddha's teachings and doctrines can seem to have nothing to do with us. Only when we develop our own direct awareness and experience can the mind truly merge into the ocean of Buddhist wisdom. Only then can we transform everything brought about by karma; and only after such transformation can we understand that all things are empty of inherent existence.

现在太需要适合此时代众生修行的法门。

We urgently need methods of spiritual practice suited to the sentient beings of our time.

THE RETREAT JOURNAL · 03

三月十四日

March 14

早上六点起床，练动功。

I rose at six in the morning and practiced dynamic qigong.

然后洗漱，打扫卫生。

Then I washed up and cleaned the room.

房里暖气太热了，很干燥，只好反复拖地。

The heating made the room unbearably hot and dry, so I repeatedly mopped the floor to add moisture to the air.

七点开始打坐，今早开始练习女丹功。

I began meditating at seven and started practicing women's inner alchemy this morning.

感悟：

Reflections:

一、刚学打坐时，持咒可消口业，净化脉道，要熟记几个咒语，用金刚持诵念。

First, when beginning meditation, reciting mantras can help purify the karma of speech and cleanse the subtle channels. One should memorize several mantras and recite them using vajra recitation, with the lips barely moving or remaining still.

二、平时正身、正言、正意，在气脉转化时才能顺利归入中脉，坐外功夫至关重要。

Second, maintaining proper posture, speech, and intention in daily life helps the vital energy enter the central channel smoothly as the subtle channels transform. Practice beyond the meditation cushion is crucial.

三、不管修行任何法门，心念的空灵寂静至关重要，否则收益不明显。

Third, whatever method of spiritual practice one follows, the mind's clarity, openness, and stillness are essential. Without them, the benefits will be limited.

下午四点开始在院子里走动，因院子小，只能绕个小圈。

At four in the afternoon, I began walking around the courtyard. It was small, so I could only follow a short circular path.

忽有声音自空中传来：“意守中丹田，两手摆开，不要举在胸前，走路要慢，摆正脚，不要走八字。”

Suddenly, a voice came from the sky: “Keep your awareness on the middle dantian. Let your arms swing naturally instead of holding them in front of your chest. Walk slowly, keep your feet straight, and do not turn them outward.”

我闻声改正了自己的走路姿势。

Hearing this, I corrected my walking posture.

但声音又传来：“心太急，腿脚未伸，心先出去了。”

But the voice continued: “Your mind is too hurried. Before your legs and feet have even extended, your mind has already rushed ahead.”

我很惊诧，这一点自己并未察觉到，果如其然。

I was astonished. I had not noticed this tendency in myself, yet the observation was exactly right.

我急忙调整心态，让心腿一致。

I quickly adjusted my state of mind, bringing my awareness into harmony with my legs and feet.

声音又说：“心如在你自己的身体上，身体的关节是很柔软的，只是心经常不在自己身上。”

The voice spoke again: “If your mind were truly present in your own body, its joints would feel supple and flexible. The problem is that your mind is often somewhere other than where your body is.”

我觉照，果如是。

I observed this directly and realized that it was indeed so.

这样走了几圈后，身体忽然柔软、发热，只觉得有一个肉体在走，不是我，我喜悦地存在一片光明中。

After walking a few more circuits, my body suddenly became supple and warm. I felt as though a physical body were walking, but that body was not me. I rested joyfully in a field of luminous clarity.

声音说：“这叫般舟三昧禅定。”

The voice said, “This is the meditative absorption known as the Pratyutpanna Samadhi.”

有时，一位师父的教诲并不是让他的弟子去做什么，他深沉的宁静、空灵给予弟子的加持更多。

Sometimes, a master's teaching does not consist of telling disciples what to do. His profound stillness and spacious clarity can confer a far greater blessing upon them.

弟子们只需在他身边能安静下来就足够。

It is enough for the disciples simply to become quiet in his presence.

傍晚，禅定中师父说：“大日如来将为你做智慧灌顶。”

In the evening, during meditation, my master said, “Mahavairocana Buddha will bestow an empowerment of wisdom upon you.”

THE RETREAT JOURNAL · 04

三月十五日

March 15

早上六点起床，在院子里行般舟。

I rose at six in the morning and practiced walking meditation in the courtyard in the manner of Pratyutpanna Samadhi.

行般舟不像跑香，一定要慢。

This practice is not like the brisk walking meditation used in some Chan traditions; one must walk slowly.

一只脚完全踏地，另一只脚再起。

One foot must be firmly planted on the ground before the other foot lifts.

开始不妨将意念放在腿脚，心脚合一，等腿脚发热后，再收回来，轻轻守心轮，空灵觉照，心念专一。

At first, it helps to place the mind on the legs and feet, uniting awareness with each step. Once the legs and feet begin to feel warm, gently draw the awareness back and rest it lightly at the heart chakra, remaining spaciously aware and keeping the mind focused.

这样行走一会儿后，腿脚、身体就仿佛不是自己的了。

After walking in this way for a while, the legs, feet, and body seem almost as though they no longer belong to me.

其实走着入禅定也是很快很舒适的。

In fact, entering meditative absorption while walking can happen quite quickly and feel very comfortable.

在院子里转了大概二百多圈，开始洗漱，打扫房间。

I walked more than two hundred circuits around the courtyard, then washed up and cleaned the room.

气候转暖，房间因烧暖气还是很干燥。

The weather was getting warmer, but the room remained very dry because of the heating.

我大量喝水，但嘴唇还是每天都干裂脱皮，心灵开始澄静。

I drank plenty of water, yet my lips continued to crack and peel every day. Meanwhile, my mind was beginning to grow clear and still.

中午半小时午休，然后洗了衣服。

I rested for half an hour at noon and then washed my clothes.

两点才开始打坐，念六字大明咒感觉很好。

I did not begin meditating until two in the afternoon, and reciting the Six-Syllable Great Bright Mantra felt wonderful.

忽见从门进来一西域和尚，有少量头发，用金刚圈在头顶束着，肩背一布袋，手里摇着一个铃，像密宗的法器。

Suddenly, a monk from the Western Regions entered through the door. He had a little hair gathered at the crown of his head with a vajra ring, a cloth bag slung over his shoulder, and a bell in his hand resembling a ritual instrument used in Esoteric Buddhism.

他自我介绍：“我是佛图澄，受观世音菩萨委托来帮你开顶。”

He introduced himself: “I am Fotucheng. Bodhisattva Avalokiteshvara has sent me to help you open the crown chakra.”

然后在空中看到白衣观音和一群人出现，佛图澄仔细查了我的气脉，说：“中脉、任督二脉均有堵塞，血脉太弱，需……”

Then I saw White-Robed Avalokiteshvara and a group of other figures appear in the sky. Fotucheng carefully examined my subtle channels and said, “The central channel and the Ren and Du meridians are all obstructed, and your blood circulation is too weak. You need to…”

这时见普贤如来骑白象出现，化身一美貌放光男子，颈带银圈……

At that moment, Samantabhadra Buddha appeared riding a white elephant, transforming into a handsome, radiant man wearing a silver ring around his neck…

我则意守心轮，觉一股热能从海底轮涌上来，但能量不大，心口发热，观两乳放白光。

I kept my awareness on the heart chakra and felt a stream of heat rising from the root chakra, though the energy was not strong. My chest grew warm, and I visualized white light radiating from both breasts.

佛图澄说“好”。

Fotucheng said, “Good.”

然后他念嗡还是吽记不清楚，连念几次。

Then he chanted a syllable—I cannot remember whether it was Omor Hum—repeating it several times.

只见我头顶像喷泉一样冲出二十七道光柱，然后这片头顶就像掀开一片草垫一样向上拱起，同时两鬓向两边扩开，头骨气脉在发生变化，头顶变得不再平整。

I saw twenty-seven pillars of light shoot upward from the crown of my head like water from a fountain. The top of my head then seemed to arch upward, as though a woven grass mat were being lifted. At the same time, both sides of my head expanded outward, and the subtle channels within my skull seemed to be changing, leaving the crown no longer level.

这时佛图澄说“开顶完成”，便告辞。

At that point, Fotucheng said, “The opening of the crown is complete,” and took his leave.

同时见空中观音菩萨和普贤菩萨等众人也离去。

I also saw Avalokiteshvara, Samantabhadra, and the other figures depart from the sky.

晚十二点时，忽有韦陀菩萨说：“大日如来来临，需起身迎接。”

At midnight, Bodhisattva Weituo suddenly said, “Mahavairocana Buddha is arriving. You must rise to receive him.”

我刚躺下，遂披衣坐起，打坐入定。

I had only just lain down, but I immediately put on my robe, sat up, and entered meditation.

只见从对面山坳里升起巨大的一轮太阳，渐渐靠近溶于我身（大日如来即法身佛）。

I saw an enormous sun rising from a mountain hollow opposite me. It gradually approached and merged into my body. Mahavairocana Buddha is the Buddha of the Dharma Body.

而且在太阳升起处，有两人吹着牛角一样的号角，天空中宝盖幢幢，宝盖渐移近，非常广大，似密宗建的壇城一般。

At the place where the sun rose, two figures were blowing horns resembling those made from ox horns. Jeweled canopies and banners filled the sky, gradually drawing closer and growing immense, like a mandala constructed for Esoteric Buddhist rituals.

大日如来未幻化名相，只听自己心轮发声：“我将为你做智慧灌顶。”

Mahavairocana Buddha did not assume a distinct form or appearance. Instead, I heard a voice arise from my own heart chakra: “I will bestow an empowerment of wisdom upon you.”

而后空中出现一对硕大的男女生殖器相交合。

Afterward, an enormous pair of male and female sexual organs appeared in the sky, joined together.

男的生殖器发出红光……

The male organ emitted a red light…

THE RETREAT JOURNAL · 05

三月十六日

March 16

今天是闭关第五天，早上三点四十多醒来，四点灯泡炸裂，棉被着火。

Today was the fifth day of my retreat. I awoke shortly after 3:40 a.m., and at four o'clock the light bulb burst and my cotton quilt caught fire.

我坐了一会儿，感觉有点累，便在外屋又躺下，一直躺到护关人来取餐盒。

I sat for a while, but feeling somewhat tired, I lay down again in the outer room and remained there until the retreat attendant came to collect my food container.

可能是因为未休息好，头稍有点沉痛，而且提不起精神。

Perhaps because I had not rested properly, my head felt a little heavy and achy, and I had very little energy.

在门外行了一会儿般舟，精神好了很多，便洗漱，打坐、修宝瓶气。

After practicing walking meditation outside the door for a while, I felt much better. I then washed up, meditated, and practiced vase breathing.

中午吃完饭，昏沉，便睡觉。

After lunch, I felt drowsy and went to sleep.

睡了一会儿，头开始痛，流鼻涕，而且全身疲软无力，似有低烧。

After sleeping for a while, I developed a headache and a runny nose. My entire body felt weak and exhausted, and I seemed to have a slight fever.

心仍是有执着、牵挂、放不下的事情。

My mind still clung to things, harbored worries, and held on to matters I could not let go of.

晚梦境较杂乱。

My dreams that night were rather chaotic.

言论有用吗？有用。

Are words useful? Yes, they are.

事来时，任何经教理论都不抵用，心灵的那道防线很容易就被冲垮。

But when real events arise, no scriptural teaching or theoretical explanation seems sufficient. The defenses of the mind can be swept away with alarming ease.

心有执着、牵挂，满世界都是业种，遍满虚空的网，身在关房里，心想逃往何处？

When the mind clings and worries, karmic seeds seem to fill the entire world, forming a net that extends throughout the void. Even if the body is confined to a retreat room, where can the mind flee?

关房里也有斧子和绳索。

There are even axes and ropes inside a retreat room.

THE RETREAT JOURNAL · 06

三月十七日

March 17

今天不到四点醒来，但懒懒的，想再睡一会儿吧，便一觉又睡到了八点半。

I awoke before four today, but felt sluggish and thought I would sleep a little longer. Before I knew it, I had slept until half past eight.

起床后浑身难受，一点精神也没有，我试着喝了一小瓶酸奶，但无济于事，又到院里行走，收功后还是不舒服，全身像被抽筋一样。

After getting up, I felt miserable all over and had no energy whatsoever. I tried drinking a small bottle of yogurt, but it made no difference. I went walking in the courtyard, yet even after finishing the practice, I still felt unwell, as though my whole body were cramping.

上午睡了一会儿，洗了头发，以为能精神一点，但还是不行。

I slept for a while in the morning and washed my hair, hoping to feel more refreshed, but it did not help.

画了几幅画，没有打坐。

I painted several pictures but did not meditate.

晚上吃了一个苹果，并练女丹功。

In the evening, I ate an apple and practiced women's inner alchemy.

猛听到有人在大门外说话，俗家气味很浓，想想难道自己是僧吗？

Suddenly, I heard someone speaking outside the main gate. The worldly atmosphere in the voice was unmistakable, and I wondered: Was I really a monastic myself?

（觉者为佛，正者为法，净者为僧；觉而不迷，正而不邪，净而不染。）

(One who is awakened embodies the Buddha; one who is upright embodies the Dharma; one who is pure embodies the Sangha. To be awakened is to be free from delusion, to be upright is to be free from deviation, and to be pure is to remain unstained.)

THE RETREAT JOURNAL · 07

三月十八日

March 18

今天是第一个七天结束，时间过得太快了。

Today marked the end of the first seven-day period. Time had passed far too quickly.

总结这个七天收获不大，在禅定中有两位师父灌顶。

Looking back, I felt that I had gained relatively little during these seven days, although two masters had bestowed empowerments upon me during meditation.

但自己还不能行住坐卧都在定中，有时失念。

Yet I was still unable to remain in meditative absorption while walking, standing, sitting, and lying down. Sometimes I lost mindfulness.

偶有杂念牵挂，心轻安，身体明显消瘦，而且脱皮。

Occasional distracting thoughts and worries still arose, though my mind felt light and at ease. My body had visibly grown thinner, and my skin was peeling.

早六点起床，活动，打坐，看《掌中解脱》。

I rose at six in the morning, exercised, meditated, and read Liberation in the Palm of Your Hand.

快十点时，忽然一阵困盹袭来，吃了几颗大豆，困乏得更厉害，很想躺下睡觉。

At nearly ten o'clock, a sudden wave of drowsiness overcame me. I ate a few soybeans, but became even sleepier and desperately wanted to lie down.

但想想这样不行，便做了二十个仰卧起坐，又出去院里跑了半小时香，回来喝了水，但看到苹果后，便不假思索地吃了起来。

But thinking that I should not give in, I did twenty sit-ups and then went outside to practice brisk walking meditation in the courtyard for half an hour. When I returned, I drank some water, but upon seeing an apple, I began eating it without a second thought.

吃了一半，才觉得我究竟想干什么，怎么又站在这吃起苹果来了。

Only after eating half of it did I stop and wonder what on earth I was doing and how I had ended up standing there eating an apple again.

这两天失忆很厉害，似乎像丢了魂一样，刀把手割了个小口也不察觉。

My memory had been unusually unreliable over the past two days. I felt almost as though I had lost my soul; I even cut my hand slightly on a knife handle without noticing it.

十点半打坐到十一点多，神清气爽，有性住之感，如失散多年的东西回到自己体内一样。

I meditated from 10:30 until sometime after eleven. My mind became clear and refreshed, and I experienced a sense of the mind abiding in its own nature, as though something lost for many years had finally returned to my body.

下午一直看书，四点到五点半在院里行般舟禅定，直到全身发热为止。

I spent the afternoon reading. From four until half past five, I practiced walking meditation in the courtyard, continuing until my entire body felt warm.

看《掌中解脱》一书，有以下感想：

Reading Liberation in the Palm of Your Handgave rise to the following reflections:

以前自己对师父们的说法理解不透，不加珍惜，随便说与众生听，其实并非慈悲之举。

In the past, I had not fully understood the teachings of my masters and had failed to treasure them, casually repeating them to other sentient beings. In truth, this was not an act of compassion.

只是自己不能领悟深刻，被自己轻描淡写说了出来，大家不加重视，自己也没有应有的加持力。

Because I had not realized their deeper meaning, I presented them casually and superficially. Others therefore paid little attention to them, and my words carried none of the blessing or transformative power they should have possessed.

一个人只有真正认识到自己是佛，与佛无二，才会知众生皆具佛性，才会在每一餐饭、一粒米中感念众生的恩惠，才会真正发起上报四重恩，下济三途苦的愿力。

Only when a person truly recognizes their own Buddha-nature and realizes that it is no different from the Buddha's can they understand that all sentient beings possess Buddha-nature. Only then will they feel gratitude for the kindness of sentient beings in every meal and every grain of rice, and truly arouse the aspiration to repay the Four Great Debts of Gratitude above and relieve the suffering of beings in the Three Lower Realms below.

因此世界本为业报世界，业种无处不在。

Thus, this world is fundamentally a realm shaped by karmic consequences, where karmic seeds are present everywhere.

所以一个人如情欲不断，心对情还有依恋和执着，那尽虚空、遍法界情种随处炽燃、开花、结果，造业无有止境。

Therefore, if a person remains caught in sensual desire, with the heart still attached and clinging to emotional bonds, then seeds of passion will continue to blaze, blossom, and bear fruit throughout the entire expanse of space and the Dharma realm, generating karma without end.

THE RETREAT JOURNAL · 08

三月十九日

March 19

昨晚睡不着，头里像点了灯似地发亮，一直打坐到两点时才入睡。

Last night, I couldn't fall asleep; my head seemed to glow as though a lamp had been lit inside it. I continued meditating until two o'clock before finally falling asleep.

早六点便醒来，精神还可以，出去活动洗漱后，又开始打坐。

I woke up at six in the morning and felt reasonably well. After exercising outside and washing up, I resumed meditation.

下午天又开始转冷。

The weather turned cold again in the afternoon.

基本没有打坐，画了一些画，看了一会儿书，时间就过去了。

I did almost no meditation. I painted a few pictures, read for a while, and the day passed.

昨晚练宝瓶气，有一空行母从天而降，她看着我说：“很好。”

Last night, while practicing vase breathing, a dakini descended from the sky. She looked at me and said, “Very good.”

而后，天空突然出现白衣观音的化身，空行母看到观音菩萨，说：“怪不的修得这样好！”

Then an emanation of White-Robed Avalokiteshvara suddenly appeared in the sky. When the dakini saw the bodhisattva, she exclaimed, “No wonder your practice is going so well!”

同时像弹丸一样向空中射去，消失在远方。

At the same moment, she shot upward into the sky like a projectile and disappeared into the distance.

THE RETREAT JOURNAL · 09

三月二十日

March 20

早上七点起床，在外边行般舟，收拾房间，打坐。

I got up at seven in the morning, practiced Pratyutpanna walking meditation outside, tidied my room, and meditated.

这几天在行般舟时，似乎真有一个东西回到了自己身上，但有些脉道干涸，无法安住。

Over the past few days, while practicing this walking meditation, it seemed as though something had truly returned to my body. Yet some of my subtle channels felt dried up, making it difficult to remain settled.

身心本为一体，性住气自回，是自己心开始安住的一种体验。

Body and mind are fundamentally one. When the mind abides in its true nature, the vital energy returns of its own accord. This was an experience of my own mind beginning to settle.

摘录陈上师修行体会：

Excerpt from Master Chen's Reflections on Spiritual Practice:

欲证密宗果位大乐智慧身，必先开五轮，总摄五方佛功德。

To attain the Vajrayana realization of the Body of Great Bliss and Wisdom, one must first open the five chakras, which encompass the qualities of the Five Dhyani Buddhas.

欲开五轮，必开中脉，以证显密共证佛法身。

To open the five chakras, one must first open the central channel, thereby realizing the Dharmakaya, the Buddha-body realized in both the exoteric and esoteric traditions.

欲开中脉，必先用中脉脐轮(密轮)一段。

To open the central channel, one must first work with the section of the central channel associated with the navel chakra, or secret chakra.

欲开脐轮，必修瓶气拙火。

To open the navel chakra, one must practice vase breathing and inner-heat meditation.

欲修瓶气，必先修本尊身。

To practice vase breathing, one must first cultivate the deity's form within oneself.

欲修本尊身，必先修生起次第，必修四加行，及大乘空性缘起之止观力。

To cultivate the deity's form, one must first practice the generation stage, complete the four preliminary practices, and develop the power of śamatha and vipaśyanā grounded in the Mahayana understanding of emptiness and dependent origination.

欲具此止观力，四加行，必先修外四加行。

To develop this power of calm abiding and insight, and to complete the four preliminary practices, one must first undertake the outer preliminary practices.

如：畏轮回苦，知因果律，出离阓闹，痛念无常。

These include recognizing the suffering of samsara, understanding the law of cause and effect, withdrawing from worldly distractions, and deeply contemplating impermanence.

勿谓我有无常心，不可凭一时感想沧桑而谓具足矣，必也不染世事，不着五欲，于任何红尘繁华，彻见其成、住、坏、空，不加贪著，方是无常心切也。

Do not assume that you have truly understood impermanence merely because you occasionally feel the transience of life. Genuine contemplation of impermanence requires remaining unstained by worldly affairs and unattached to the five sensual pleasures. In the midst of all worldly splendor, one must clearly see its arising, abiding, decay, and dissolution without becoming attached. Only then is one's awareness of impermanence truly profound.

晚练宝瓶气，与道家的炼内丹方法结合在一起，师父说很好。

In the evening, I practiced vase breathing in combination with the Daoist method of cultivating the inner elixir. My master said this was very good.

THE RETREAT JOURNAL · 10

三月二十一日

March 21

昨晚梦境杂乱，出现一些感情上的纠葛。

My dreams were chaotic last night, and several emotional entanglements appeared in them.

我认为，还是自己在感情上有执着的东西。

I believe this shows that I still have emotional attachments.

万缘皆空，虽无可了的事，但自己内心还是会系在这些虚幻的事相上，无欲无求谈何容易。

All conditions are empty. Although there may be nothing that truly needs to be resolved, my mind still becomes entangled in these illusory appearances. How easy is it, after all, to live without desire or expectation?

不求了事，只求清净无欲，那万事可了也。

Rather than trying to resolve every matter, I need only seek inner purity and freedom from desire; then all matters can be resolved.

早五点半左右起床。

I got up at around five-thirty in the morning.

行般舟禅定，洗漱，打坐。

I practiced Pratyutpanna walking meditation, washed up, and sat in meditation.

中午送的饭少了一点，本欲让外面再拿个馒头，但又想心怎么分别这么多，多就多吃，少就少吃，随缘好了。

The lunch brought to me was a little smaller than usual. I initially wanted to ask the attendant to bring another steamed bun, but then wondered why my mind was making so many distinctions. If there was more, I could eat more; if there was less, I could eat less. I should simply accept things as they came.

便自己又吃了一个苹果，也填饱了胃。

Instead, I ate an apple myself, which filled my stomach.

自己的这个身体还是很重要，老怕饿着它、渴着它。

This body of mine is still important to me, and I am constantly afraid of leaving it hungry or thirsty.

“四大本是佛祖种”，但如心对它有牵挂、执着，便不在道中，还是把它当臭皮囊看算了。

“The four great elements are themselves seeds of Buddhahood.” Yet if the mind remains worried about and attached to the body, it is no longer abiding in the Way. Perhaps I should simply regard it as an impure bag of skin.

下午四点在院里行般舟禅定，听一音说：“守海底轮”，我试着守了一下，但海底轮没有任何感觉，这时声音又说：“像蜻蜓点水一样守。”

At four in the afternoon, I practiced Pratyutpanna walking meditation in the courtyard. I heard a voice say, “Rest your awareness on the root chakra.” I tried, but felt nothing there. Then the voice said, “Rest your awareness on it as lightly as a dragonfly touching the water.”

我试着做，忽然像平静的水面扔了一块石头，海底轮有热流向四面散开。

I tried following the instruction, and suddenly it was as though a stone had been thrown into still water: a current of warmth spread outward in all directions from the root chakra.

下午五点多打坐，冥心静坐，心极廓达。

A little after five, I sat in meditation, quietly gathering my mind. My awareness became extraordinarily open and expansive.

这时，忽有两股水流从督脉而下，我一看头顶有两位天女正在以手中的容器灌下，并说：“释迦牟尼佛要来看菩萨……这朵莲花好美呀！”

Suddenly, I felt two streams of water flowing down along the Du meridian. Looking up, I saw two celestial maidens pouring water from vessels above my head. They said, “Shakyamuni Buddha is coming to visit the bodhisattva… What a beautiful lotus!”

我凝神看，原来是在极乐世界两女在浇灌一株九品莲花。

I looked more closely and realized that the two maidens were watering a nine-grade lotus in the Land of Ultimate Bliss.

莲花是白色的、很大，而那株花就是我。

The lotus was large and white, and that flower was me.

这时，大势至菩萨手拿玉如意走来，说：“菩萨的化身快成就了。”

At that moment, Mahasthamaprapta Bodhisattva approached, holding a jade wish-fulfilling scepter, and said, “The bodhisattva's emanation is nearing completion.”

便用玉如意靠近那朵花移动。

He then moved the jade scepter close to the flower.

这时，有很多人簇拥释迦佛而来，释佛看了看那朵花，说：“我希望他报身快点成就。”

Then a large group of people arrived, accompanying Shakyamuni Buddha. The Buddha looked at the flower and said, “I hope his sambhogakaya, or bliss body, will attain completion soon.”

大势至说：“娑婆世界太贫瘠了，缺少养份。”

Mahasthamaprapta replied, “The Saha World is too barren; it lacks nourishment.”

释迦暗思：“她在大灵岩寺，那儿曾有辟支佛成佛。”

Shakyamuni reflected silently, “She is at Dalingyan Temple, where a pratyekabuddha once attained Buddhahood.”

便说：“我回去安排一下。”

He then said, “I will return and make some arrangements.”

便消失了。

With that, he disappeared.

一会儿，我看到在无生地开了一朵巨大的莲花，而我正在那儿打坐，一种能量从地下升起，冰清玉洁，像月光一样笼罩着我身心。

A little later, I saw an enormous lotus blossom in the Place of No Birth. I was sitting in meditation there, while an energy rose from beneath the ground, pure and crystalline, enveloping my body and mind like moonlight.

在前面的山中，有一宝珠，有一山神手握巨斧劈开山，宝珠冲天而出，一下隐没在我天目中，无任何感受，山又合在一起。

In the mountain ahead lay a precious jewel. A mountain spirit wielded a huge axe and split the mountain open. The jewel shot into the sky and instantly disappeared into my heavenly eye. I felt nothing at all, and the mountain closed up again.

晚护关人送一本佛像画册进来，画很漂亮，只追求了外在的形象或市场价值，但也能激发人对佛、菩萨的喜爱之感，随喜功德。

In the evening, the retreat attendant brought me an album of Buddhist images. The paintings were beautiful, although they seemed concerned primarily with outward appearance or commercial value. Even so, they could inspire affection for the Buddha and the bodhisattvas, and I rejoiced in whatever merit they might generate.

但我如画佛像，当要有一种加持力，抑或是佛像能给人一种心灵的触动。

But if I were to paint Buddhist images, they should convey a kind of spiritual blessing or touch people's hearts in a profound way.

这就需要自己修行到位，那样画画时，才有自己空寂的心力注入。

This would require my own practice to reach a sufficient depth, so that when I painted, I could infuse my work with the power of a mind resting in emptiness and stillness.

这几天打坐中，心轮处常自然出现一皎洁清澈的月轮，轮中有种子字“吽”，今天看一本介绍佛教的书，发现一个法门与自己自然出现的境界相似，便摘录“净菩提心观”自《大乘本生心地观经》：

Over the past few days, a bright, clear moon disc has frequently appeared spontaneously at my heart chakra during meditation, with the seed syllable “吽” (Hum) at its center. Today, while reading a book introducing Buddhism, I discovered a practice resembling the state that had arisen naturally in my experience. I therefore copied the following passage on the Contemplation of the Pure Bodhicitta, from the Sutra of the Great Vehicle on the Contemplation of the Mind-Ground of the Buddha's Original Birth:

心轮有月轮，无垢无净，内外澄澈，最极清凉。

At the heart chakra is a moon disc, neither defiled nor purified, clear and transparent within and without, utterly cool and serene.

月轮中有种子字“吽”。

At the center of the moon disc is the seed syllable “吽” (Hum).

THE RETREAT JOURNAL · 11

三月二十二日

March 22

早六点半起床，行般舟禅定，活动身体，后打扫卫生。

I got up at six-thirty in the morning, practiced Pratyutpanna walking meditation, exercised, and then cleaned the room.

上午静坐，观月轮从肺俞穴入，但胸腔脉火炽盛，烧灼感很厉害。

During morning meditation, I visualized the moon disc entering through the Feishu acupuncture point on my back, but the inner heat in my chest channels was intense, causing a severe burning sensation.

观音菩萨与师父们都说胸腔脉火需龙宫的宝物可帮助降下来。

Avalokiteshvara and my masters all said that a treasure from the Dragon Palace could help subdue the intense heat in my chest channels.

这时，见“水晶宫”方向忽有东海龙王手捧一金色球而来，并说：“此为龙宫的紫金摩尼球，愿献给菩萨修行。”

At that moment, I saw the Dragon King of the Eastern Sea approaching from the direction of the Crystal Palace, holding a golden sphere in his hands. He said, “This is the Dragon Palace's purple-gold mani jewel. I offer it to support the bodhisattva's spiritual practice.”

观世音菩萨说：“龙宫已献过很多次宝了，不好意思接纳。”

Avalokiteshvara said, “The Dragon Palace has already offered us many treasures. I feel embarrassed accepting another.”

龙王说：“唉，菩萨普度众生，我哪里还舍不得一件宝贝。

The Dragon King replied, “Ah, the bodhisattva works to liberate all sentient beings. How could I begrudge a single treasure?

此球有三个，乃东海的镇海之宝，少一个也无妨。”

There are three such spheres, and they are the treasures that protect the Eastern Sea. It will do no harm if one is given away.”

球有一个足球那么大，闪着幽幽的金光，菩萨与众位师父商量从我哪儿放进去。

The sphere was about the size of a soccer ball and glowed with a soft, golden light. The bodhisattva and the assembled masters discussed where it should enter my body.

有说从头顶，有说从肺俞。

Some suggested the crown of my head, while others proposed the Feishu point.

这时，阿弥陀佛忽在空中出现，忽用手指点，封住了我几个大的脉道，大家都说“好！”

At that moment, Amitabha Buddha suddenly appeared in the sky. With a touch of his finger, he sealed several of my major subtle channels. Everyone exclaimed, “Good!”

球从心口入，然后球化于心轮，能量随之冲开了阿弥陀佛所封的脉道。

The sphere entered through my chest and dissolved into the heart chakra. Its energy then surged outward, breaking open the channels that Amitabha Buddha had sealed.

大家说这样很好，可缓冲我脉道的冲力，增强承受力。

Everyone agreed that this was an excellent arrangement, as it could moderate the force surging through my channels and increase my capacity to withstand it.

阿弥陀佛消失，龙王也告辞原路返回。

Amitabha Buddha disappeared, and the Dragon King took his leave and returned by the way he had come.

我内观自己心脉有一股巨大的金色光柱，还没有完全化去。

Looking inward, I saw an enormous golden pillar of light within my heart channels that had not yet fully dissolved.

十点到十点半活动，行般舟禅定。

From ten to ten-thirty, I exercised and practiced Pratyutpanna walking meditation.

中午吃的较多，下午不舒服。

I ate rather a lot at lunch and felt unwell in the afternoon.

首先是一直处于想睡的状态，而且眼睛涩痒，小便增多，全身疲劳。

First, I felt persistently sleepy. My eyes were dry and itchy, I needed to urinate more frequently, and my whole body felt exhausted.

心绪较差，稍感灰暗。

My mood was poor, and I felt somewhat gloomy.

下午在院里行般舟禅定为主，但一回屋就想睡，睡又睡不着。

I spent most of the afternoon practicing Pratyutpanna walking meditation in the courtyard. Yet whenever I returned to my room, I felt sleepy but could not fall asleep.

胸口偶然还是有烧灼感。

I still experienced occasional burning sensations in my chest.

THE RETREAT JOURNAL · 12

三月二十三日

March 23

晚上梦较多，稀奇古怪，而且是一个小故事接一个，有头有尾，每做完一个会醒来，睡得不踏实。

I had many dreams that night, strange and bizarre ones, each unfolding like a complete little story after the previous one. I woke up after each dream, and my sleep was restless.

早上六点半起床，打扫卫生，动功，般舟三昧禅定。

I got up at six-thirty in the morning, cleaned the room, practiced dynamic qigong, and entered the walking meditation of Pratyutpanna Samadhi.

上午一直打坐。

I spent the entire morning meditating.

中午饭后躺在床上似睡非睡，忽然在空中现乐空双运修法。

After lunch, I lay on the bed in a state between sleeping and waking. Suddenly, a visualization of the practice of the union of bliss and emptiness appeared in the sky.

只见一对巨大的阴阳生殖器在空中交合，那巨大的生殖器似乎是自己气脉的任何处。

I saw enormous male and female sexual organs joined together in the sky. Those immense organs seemed to represent different parts of my own subtle energy channels.

内观自己全身气脉，像暴雨来前的乌云，翻滚不息。

Looking inward at the channels throughout my body, I saw them churning ceaselessly like dark clouds before a violent storm.

忽然，脑际耀眼一闪，似一颗流星闪过，光极亮，有闪电那样的强度。

Suddenly, a dazzling flash erupted in my mind, like a meteor streaking across the sky. The light was extraordinarily bright, as intense as a bolt of lightning.

而后，全身燥热难耐，爬起来，把外衣全脱去，只剩一身内衣，还是很热。

Afterward, unbearable heat surged through my body. I got up and removed all my outer clothing, leaving only my undergarments, but I still felt extremely hot.

下午继续静坐，今天眼睛痒，用大悲水洗。

I continued sitting in meditation in the afternoon. My eyes were itchy today, so I washed them with Great Compassion Water.

下午天气转冷，而且风大。

The weather turned colder in the afternoon, and the wind grew strong.

五点多时，在外行般舟三昧禅定，忽然想起父母朋友来，想自己修学多年，心性上进步甚少，家人为此付出甚多，自己只想活得明明白白，能解诸佛心要。

A little after five, while practicing Pratyutpanna Samadhi outdoors, I suddenly thought of my parents and friends. I reflected that although I had studied and practiced for many years, I had made little progress in my character, while my family had sacrificed a great deal for me. All I wanted was to live with true clarity and understand the essential mind of all the Buddhas.

诸佛既无妄语，那自己如能今生得解脱，当救度芸芸众生。

Since the Buddhas do not speak falsely, if I could attain liberation in this very life, I should then strive to liberate the countless sentient beings of the world.

既有成佛之路，那何必沉迷五欲，贪恋尘世的快乐。

Since there is a path to Buddhahood, why become lost in the five sensual pleasures or cling to worldly happiness?

何况人身很难得，生死不能自主，不小心就会失去。

Moreover, a human life is difficult to obtain, and we have no control over life and death. If we are not careful, this precious opportunity may slip away.

THE RETREAT JOURNAL · 13

三月二十四日

March 24

早上停电，不到六点，我握手电起床，在院里行般舟，大脑清醒了许多，但胃里很难受。

The power went out in the morning. Before six o'clock, I got up with a flashlight and practiced Pratyutpanna walking meditation in the courtyard. My mind became much clearer, but my stomach felt very uncomfortable.

今天，坐在禅床上，透过门窗玻璃审视这个小院。

Today, sitting on my meditation couch, I looked out through the glass in the door and windows at the little courtyard.

人总是时间久了，对万物都有感情，忽然觉得这个小院很熟悉，而且对小院有了依恋。

Over time, people develop emotional attachments to the things around them. I suddenly realized how familiar this little courtyard had become and how attached I had grown to it.

想想这一生有这么一处小院，在这样一个靠山的古刹中，门前有两棵古树，后院再种点花草，偶尔有一、二知己能来小坐，谈古论道，互诉情怀。

I imagined having such a courtyard for the rest of my life, within an ancient monastery nestled against a mountain, with two old trees at the entrance and flowers and plants growing in the back garden. Occasionally, one or two close friends could come for a quiet visit, discuss history and the Way, and share their innermost thoughts.

剩余时间，一人潜心静养，避开红尘的一切喧嚣，一切名利争夺，悠然自得度过一生，此生无憾矣！

For the rest of my time, I could devote myself to quiet contemplation, avoiding the noise of worldly life and all struggles for fame and fortune, living peacefully and contentedly until the end of my days. What more could I ask of life?

其实，每个人的生命愿望并不大，只是一卷入红尘的汪洋，便身不由己，不得清净自在。

In truth, people's deepest wishes are often quite modest. But once swept into the vast ocean of worldly life, they lose control of themselves and can no longer find peace and freedom.

昨晚打坐，发现一只熊精坐在寺院一块叫“无生地”的地方，韦陀大喝一声，熊精跃起而逃。

During meditation last night, I saw a bear spirit sitting in an area of the temple known as the Place of No Birth. Weituo shouted loudly, and the bear spirit leaped up and fled.

韦陀追赶，观音菩萨在空中出现，阻止韦陀，并喊熊精过来。

Weituo pursued it, but Avalokiteshvara appeared in the sky, stopped him, and called the bear spirit over.

熊精走过来，同时一只红色的狐狸也飞跃而至，他们似跪在菩萨面前，菩萨用柳枝洒水为他们灌顶，并对他们说，朗公化作金麒麟在此护场，希望他们俩跟着做个护法，积点功德。

The bear spirit approached, and a red fox bounded over as well. They appeared to kneel before the bodhisattva, who sprinkled water over them with a willow branch, bestowing an empowerment. The bodhisattva told them that Master Langgong had transformed into a golden qilin to protect the sacred grounds and expressed the hope that they, too, would become Dharma protectors and accumulate some merit.

这时，远方一只金麒麟大叫一声，全身放着金光，忽至菩萨身旁，熊精似有点怕它。

At that moment, a golden qilin cried out in the distance, its entire body radiating golden light. It suddenly appeared beside the bodhisattva, and the bear spirit seemed somewhat afraid of it.

菩萨与金麒麟说了刚才的意思，金麒麟便带它们俩飞跃而去。

The bodhisattva explained the arrangement to the golden qilin, which then carried the two spirits away with it in a great leap.

上午看《虚云老和尚开示》，老和尚无任何华丽词语，字字珠玑，句句切中要害。

In the morning, I read The Teachings of Venerable Master Xuyun. The old master's language contained no flowery expressions; every word was precious, and every sentence struck at the heart of the matter.

想一些古大德们开示好话说尽，甚至赌咒发誓，但有几人能上法船。

I reflected that some great masters of the past exhausted every eloquent teaching and even swore solemn oaths to inspire others. Yet how many people actually boarded the vessel of the Dharma?

佛菩萨们身先士卒，榜样也有，路也指明，只待大丈夫前行。

The Buddhas and bodhisattvas lead by example and have already shown us the way. All that remains is for people of courage and resolve to step forward.

一个心地清净柔软的人，看这个世界的一切都能迸发出情韵，乃至一块冰冷的石头，都那么熟悉、亲切，因自性相通，她怎会寂寞失落呢？

A person whose heart is pure and gentle can discover beauty and feeling in everything in the world. Even a cold stone can seem familiar and dear. When one's own nature resonates with all things, how could one ever feel lonely or abandoned?

道念若同情念，成佛多时。

If one's aspiration for the Way were as strong as one's longing for love, one would have attained Buddhahood long ago.

此心还需自己了。

Ultimately, each person must resolve the matter of their own mind.

诸佛指明了道路，解铃还需系铃人。

The Buddhas have shown us the way, but the one who tied the knot must untie it.

八万四千法门，门门都可了此心。

There are eighty-four thousand Dharma gates, and every one of them can lead to the resolution of this mind.

下午在院里行般舟三昧，忽心想要去龙宫洗个澡。

In the afternoon, while practicing Pratyutpanna Samadhi in the courtyard, I suddenly thought of going to the Dragon Palace to take a bath.

这时，有水族众女提水壶等物而来，为我从头淋浴。

At that moment, several women from the aquatic realm arrived carrying water vessels and other objects, and poured water over me from head to toe.

其中有一紫金壶，是千年龙角雕成，水流永不枯竭，而且去毒清火。

Among them was a purple-gold vessel carved from a thousand-year-old dragon horn. Its stream of water would never run dry, and it could dispel toxins and quell internal heat.

THE RETREAT JOURNAL · 14

三月二十五日

March 25

早五点半起床，行般舟禅定。

I got up at five-thirty in the morning and practiced Pratyutpanna walking meditation.

后背心稍疼。

I felt a slight pain in the middle of my back.

中午饭后稍休息，开始做瑜珈动功。

After a short rest following lunch, I began practicing dynamic yoga exercises.

做完几个动作后，后背疼缓减。

After completing several movements, the pain in my back eased.

下午四点开始打坐，看到一株九品莲花放光。

At four in the afternoon, I began meditating and saw a nine-grade lotus radiating light.

又重新看到自己降生的情景。

I saw the scene of my own birth once again.

房间外围空中有七色光环，并有菩萨手持净瓶向自己倒水。

Seven-colored halos appeared in the air surrounding the room, and a bodhisattva holding a pure-water vase poured water over me.

THE RETREAT JOURNAL · 15

三月二十六日

March 26

早上五点半起床，做了瑜珈动功和呼吸法。

I got up at five-thirty in the morning and practiced dynamic yoga exercises and breathing techniques.

眼睛疲劳，后背痛，脑里有点昏沉，屋里很干燥。

My eyes felt tired, my back hurt, and my mind was somewhat dull and sluggish; the room was very dry.

上午打坐一会儿，忽然困盹袭来，便就势躺下，一下就睡到了十点十分。

I meditated for a while in the morning, but suddenly a wave of drowsiness overcame me, so I lay down and slept straight through until ten past ten.

而且梦里几次想睁眼，都睁不开。

In the dream, I tried several times to open my eyes, but could not.

梦到母亲让自己多喝水，不要乱跑。

I dreamed that my mother told me to drink more water and not to run around.

下午坐还是不能长久，痤疮疼，想人得病真是一时半刻的事，死亡也可能随时都降临在我们身上。

In the afternoon, I still could not sit in meditation for long because my acne was painful. I reflected that illness can strike a person in an instant, and death, too, may come upon us at any time.

我心能不被这些境转吗？

Can my mind remain unmoved by these circumstances?

一个痤疮，就搅得自己心烦意乱，只想睡觉，没有精神。

Even a single pimple has left me agitated and distracted, wanting only to sleep and feeling completely listless.

四点半静坐。

At four-thirty, I sat quietly in meditation.

朗公忽来，问是否有疾？

Master Langgong suddenly appeared and asked whether I was ill.

我说痤疮痛，朗公说泰山本草药甚多，当为菩萨采之。

I told him that my acne hurt, and Master Langgong said that Mount Tai was rich in medicinal herbs and that he would gather some for me, the bodhisattva.

他肩搭一白色布袋，化作一道白光射入远方。

With a white cloth bag slung over his shoulder, he transformed into a streak of white light and shot off into the distance.

一会儿，他带一布袋草药而来，有一巨大山参，他命一小童手拿一上下相扣的钵把山参放入，架火烹之。

A little while later, he returned with a bag of medicinal herbs, including an enormous wild ginseng root. He instructed a young attendant to place the ginseng in a pair of bowls fitted together mouth to mouth, then set them over a fire to cook.

一会儿，小童报已熬好。

After a while, the young attendant reported that the preparation was ready.

他拿碗把山参水倒入，让我服。

Master Langgong poured the ginseng decoction into a bowl and asked me to drink it.

山参水化成玄红色，味略甜，不像一般人参的苦涩味。

The ginseng decoction had turned a deep, dark red and tasted slightly sweet, unlike the bitter, astringent flavor of ordinary ginseng.

朗公说：“这山参好大，再修就成了。”

Master Langgong said, “This ginseng root is enormous. With a little more cultivation, it will attain completion.”

他捣草药做成膏药状，要为我敷痤疮。

He crushed the herbs into a medicinal paste and prepared to apply it to my acne.

这时，一女声忽道：“让我来。”

At that moment, a woman's voice suddenly said, “Let me do it.”

只见一身背斗笠的女尼从天而降，手拿青剑。

A female nun wearing a bamboo hat descended from the sky, holding a green sword in her hand.

朗公介绍说：“巫山神尼，曾在终南山修道，后来泰山。”

Master Langgong introduced her, saying, “The Divine Nun of Mount Wu. She once cultivated the Way on Mount Zhongnan and later came to Mount Tai.”

神尼用剑割破疮，把脓全部挑出，说无妨了，又贴了朗公的膏药，在用剑割疮时，她口吐三昧真火，给剑消毒，我便问她用何功夫。

The Divine Nun used her sword to lance the pimples and remove all the pus, then said that everything was fine. She applied Master Langgong's medicinal paste. As she cut into the pimples, she breathed forth the true samadhi fire from her mouth to sterilize her sword, so I asked her what method she practiced.

她说：“女娲炼石功”。

She replied, “The Nüwa Stone-Refining Practice.”

我便请学，她便相授。

I asked her to teach me, and she agreed.

\*\*女娲炼石功：\*\*自己坐中间，围绕点火堆或火（我问非得点火吗？她说点火、蜡等能增强自信心），观想自己是块顽石，四周的火在烧炼自己，自己全身烧得通红，而后通体透明，从石之中（心轮处）盛开一朵石莲花。

The Nüwa Stone-Refining Practice:Sit in the center and light a fire or several small fires around yourself. (I asked whether lighting a fire was absolutely necessary. She explained that fire, candles, and similar things could strengthen one's confidence.) Visualize yourself as a solid, unyielding stone, with the surrounding flames refining you. Imagine your entire body becoming red-hot and then transparent throughout, until a stone lotus blossoms from within the rock, at the location of the heart chakra.

石莲花上端坐观音菩萨或释迦牟尼佛，莲花逐渐化佛身，悟我与佛无二无别，证入菩提也。

Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva or Shakyamuni Buddha sits upon the stone lotus. Gradually, the lotus transforms into the Buddha's body. Realize that oneself and the Buddha are neither two nor different, and thereby enter awakening to bodhi.

我拜谢，女尼不受，说：“朗公是我旧友，他愿化麒麟护山，我也来献一妙方。菩萨当练三日，必有奇效也。”

I bowed in gratitude, but the nun declined my thanks and said, “Master Langgong is an old friend of mine. Since he wishes to transform into a qilin to protect this mountain, I, too, have come to offer a wondrous method. The bodhisattva should practice it for three days, and there will surely be remarkable results.”

说完告辞，腾空而去。

Having said this, she took her leave and soared into the sky.

在这之前，我背痛，忽一白发老道手拿佛尘出现，我便请他为我疗。

Earlier, when my back was hurting, an elderly Taoist with white hair had suddenly appeared, holding a horsetail whisk, so I asked him to treat me.

他说：“小童无礼，与我有何恩德，便让我为汝疗。”

He said, “Young child, how impolite of you! What kindness or virtue have you shown me that you would ask me to treat you?”

我说：“自性相通故。当有同体之悲，无缘之慈。”

I replied, “Because our true natures are interconnected, there should be compassion arising from the recognition that we share one body, and unconditional loving-kindness without regard to personal ties.”

他说：“我也不悲不慈，你自痛你的，与我何干。”

He said, “I am neither compassionate nor kind. You may suffer your own pain; what has it to do with me?”

我说：“我本不痛，只是有障碍障道焉，为利有情众生，必须清除障碍。”

I said, “In truth, I am not the one who suffers. There is merely an obstacle obstructing the Way. To benefit sentient beings, this obstacle must be removed.”

他说：“为这个为利有情众生，为你治一治，我是太乙真人矣。”

He said, “For the sake of benefiting sentient beings, I shall treat you. I am the Immortal Taiyi.”

然后，他用一银针刺入我肺俞穴，刺的好深，即有污垢涌出，很脏，真人无奈，竟用口吸之，一道道黑色的光进入他口，吐出去变作石子。

He then inserted a silver needle deep into my Feishu acupuncture point on the back, near the lungs. Filth immediately welled out, and it was extremely dirty. With no other choice, the Immortal actually sucked it out with his mouth. Streams of black light entered his mouth, and when he spat them out, they turned into small stones.

我不好意思，太脏了。

I felt embarrassed because it was so filthy.

真人说：“还分别这么多”。

The Immortal said, “You still make so many distinctions.”

治完后，用白色佛尘一拂，便远去。

After finishing the treatment, he swept his white horsetail whisk once and departed into the distance.

第二次打坐，朗公把许多矿物质放在一个炒勺炒、熬，并命小童抓两条蚯蚓来，并把蚯蚓放入炒锅烤干，我见后忙超度。

During my second meditation session, Master Langgong placed various minerals in a metal ladle and roasted and simmered them. He ordered the young attendant to catch two earthworms and put them in the pan to dry-roast. When I saw this, I hurried to perform a ritual of spiritual deliverance for them.

朗公说：“太慈悲真没办法，你自坐你的，就当没看见。”

Master Langgong said, “You are so compassionate that there is simply no helping it. Just continue with your meditation and pretend you haven't seen anything.”

自己心里也暗笑自己，凭朗公的法力完全可以做超度的。

I secretly laughed at myself, since Master Langgong's spiritual powers were surely more than sufficient to perform the deliverance himself.

一会儿，炒勺里熬出像水银一样的东西，朗公说是汞，不是现在的水银，现在的水银有毒。

After a while, a substance resembling liquid mercury formed in the ladle. Master Langgong said it was mercury, but not the kind known as mercury today, which he said was poisonous.

我口服下，只看见汞顺自己全身骨骼而下，差一点，朗公又把锅里的汞尽量挤压倒出一点，喝下正好。

I swallowed it. I saw the mercury travel down along the bones throughout my body. There was almost not quite enough, so Master Langgong squeezed as much as he could out of the pan and poured a little more for me to drink; this proved to be just the right amount.

内观自己全身骨骼变成白色光柱，不耀眼，朗公说是去骨中之毒的，洗髓而已。

Looking inward, I saw all the bones in my body transform into columns of white light, which were not dazzling. Master Langgong said this was to remove toxins from the bones, simply a process of cleansing the marrow.

然后又用百花熬成汤，让我服之。

He then simmered a hundred kinds of flowers into a decoction and asked me to drink it.

说是百花，其实只四十味之多，熬时，满室异香。

Although he called it a hundred-flower decoction, it actually contained only about forty varieties. As it simmered, an extraordinary fragrance filled the entire room.

朗公说：“久服，可使脏器轻安……（记不得了）”。

Master Langgong said, “Taken over a long period, it can make the internal organs feel light and at ease…” (I cannot remember the rest.)

百花汤很甜很香。

The hundred-flower decoction was very sweet and fragrant.

我问：“世人可否如法炮制？”

I asked, “Can ordinary people prepare it in the same way?”

朗公说，世人恐找不到如此好的花，效果不佳。

Master Langgong said that ordinary people probably could not find flowers of such excellent quality, so the results would not be as good.

他曾长服此汤，现在不需要了。

He had taken this decoction regularly for a long time in the past, but no longer needed it.

然后，朗公说还有事，与小童一起告辞。

Master Langgong then said he had other matters to attend to and took his leave with the young attendant.

朗公相貌：三缕长须，三只眼，顶上有束髻（像道士），但穿和尚的灰色长袍。

Master Langgong's appearance: three long strands of facial hair, three eyes, and a topknot on his head like a Taoist, yet he wore a gray monk's robe.

THE RETREAT JOURNAL · 16

三月二十七日

March 27

六点起床，做动功后练“女娲炼石功”。

I got up at six, practiced dynamic exercises, and then worked on the “Nüwa Stone-Refining Practice.”

这几天眼睛有点干涩，早晚补充水果。

My eyes have been somewhat dry these past few days, so I have been eating fruit in the morning and evening.

“女娲炼石功”初看容易，但长时间定在这个观照中还不是很容易，让心变个石头还挺难，识精元明全得休息。

The “Nüwa Stone-Refining Practice” seems easy at first, but sustaining this contemplative visualization for a long time is not so simple. Turning the mind into a stone is surprisingly difficult; the discriminating consciousness and primordial clarity of awareness must both be allowed to rest.

证得空性的人，他的身心将变成一个巨大的能量场，摄受力非常之强。

A person who realizes emptiness will have a body and mind that become a vast field of energy, possessing an extraordinarily powerful capacity to attract and embrace others.

与他有缘的众生都会被他源源不断地摄入这个磁力的海洋而磁化。

Sentient beings with karmic affinities to such a person will be continuously drawn into this ocean of magnetic force and magnetized by it.

自己习气、欲望还很重，还在意别人的看法，虽很快能平和心态，还有想度人的欲望。

My own habitual tendencies and desires are still strong, and I still care about what others think of me. Although I can quickly regain a peaceful state of mind, I still have the desire to liberate others.

这种“欲望”虽说是愿力所致，但不清净，有杂染，有时就会变得执着，不能随顺众生，对机施教，有点像教育别人的样子。

Although this “desire” may arise from the power of my vows, it is not pure and contains defilements. At times, it becomes attachment, preventing me from adapting to sentient beings and teaching in accordance with their capacities; I end up acting as though I am trying to lecture others.

自己如不能以平等心待人，礼敬众生，不能沉静自然，即使有人恭敬你，把你当菩萨看，那也是假的。

If I cannot treat others with equanimity, respect all sentient beings, and remain calm and natural, then even if someone reveres me and regards me as a bodhisattva, that reverence is misplaced.

即使有人真发自真心，那也是这人心地纯净所致，你自己应该知道自己还有缺陷在哪里，不要自以为是，自己骗自己。

Even if someone sincerely regards me that way, it is because of the purity of that person's own heart. I should know where my own shortcomings lie and must not become self-righteous or deceive myself.

既发心要成道，就要克服一切障碍，才能破无明烦恼。

Having resolved to attain the Way, I must overcome every obstacle in order to break through ignorance and afflictions.

下午练瑜珈，有印度一位瑜珈师来教授瑜珈动作，学得不十分明白。

In the afternoon, I practiced yoga with an Indian yoga teacher who came to demonstrate the postures, although I did not understand everything very clearly.

阿难送来一些书，有《薄伽梵歌》，还有《瑜珈经》等，他很随便地放在我面前就走了，还看到他用一头大象驮着书。

Ananda brought me some books, including the Bhagavad Gitaand the Yoga Sutras. He casually set them down in front of me and left. I also saw him carrying the books on the back of an elephant.

我在学习瑜珈时变成一位很美貌的印度女孩，真是境由心生。

While studying yoga, I transformed into a very beautiful Indian girl. Truly, circumstances arise from the mind.

晚上练“女娲炼石功”，火焰像火山喷发的岩浆一样顺气脉上行，在心脉处，围着心脏燃烧、冶炼，后冲过心轮，直入顶，一个火焰组成的能量团冲顶轮而出，到达梵顶轮。

In the evening, I practiced the “Nüwa Stone-Refining Practice.” The flames rose through the energy channels like lava erupting from a volcano. At the heart channel, they burned and refined the area around the heart, then surged through the heart chakra and straight up to the crown. A ball of energy composed of flames burst out through the crown chakra and reached the Brahmarandhra, the aperture at the crown of the head.

光柱出现，诸佛在梵顶轮的光芒中，层层叠叠显像，有光明灌顶：明点与白色轻盈的液体顺中脉而下，源源不断直至海底轮，后呼吸几乎停止，有空洞的击打声响起，后脑发胀，两耳发热有呼呼风生，自己看到两眼球后面有光忽然从眼球冲出，原来与眼球相连的脉忽断开，光进入头顶，后又从头顶返下，在眉心形成一个明亮的光团，光团分两路，一路从眼出，一路连两鼻孔。

A pillar of light appeared, and Buddhas manifested in layer upon layer within the radiance of the Brahmarandhra. A luminous empowerment took place: luminous drops and a light, white fluid flowed down the central channel, continuously descending all the way to the root chakra. My breathing then almost stopped, and a hollow pounding sound arose. The back of my head felt swollen, my ears grew hot, and a rushing wind seemed to arise within them. I saw light suddenly burst out from behind my eyeballs, as though the channels connecting to the eyes had abruptly broken. The light entered the crown of my head and then flowed back down, forming a bright ball of light between my eyebrows. This ball of light split into two streams: one emerged through the eyes, while the other connected to both nostrils.

THE RETREAT JOURNAL · 17

三月二十八日

March 28

早五点半起床，做动功，般舟禅定，瑜珈。

I got up at five-thirty in the morning and practiced dynamic exercises, Pratyutpanna walking meditation, and yoga.

打坐中，忽至大梵天。

During meditation, I suddenly arrived in the Great Brahma Heaven.

见到阿难、文殊、乔陈如尊者。

I saw Ananda, Manjushri, and the Venerable Kaundinya.

大殿里有很多尊者和佛菩萨，我动了几个念头，他们就都笑我。

There were many venerable ones, Buddhas, and bodhisattvas in the great hall. When a few thoughts arose in my mind, they all laughed at me.

我说：“笑什么呢？人家现在不是迷了吗？”

I said, “What are you laughing at? I'm still deluded, aren't I?”

大家又笑了。

Everyone laughed again.

我在大梵天时，就像十二、三岁的小孩，释迦佛让阿难带我玩，文殊教我大乘经典，乔陈如尊者告诉我哪些习气和毛病需改正，也就是言行方面的老师。

When I was in the Great Brahma Heaven, I was like a child of twelve or thirteen. Shakyamuni Buddha asked Ananda to take me around and play with me, Manjushri taught me Mahayana scriptures, and the Venerable Kaundinya told me which habitual tendencies and faults I needed to correct, serving as my teacher in speech and conduct.

文殊带我沐浴，在半空中，有四龙吐水，像雾状，我站在中间，一会儿就浑身晶莹剔透，阿难说这才像大梵天的生命。

Manjushri took me to bathe. Suspended in midair, four dragons sprayed water that resembled mist. I stood in the middle, and before long my entire body became crystal-clear and translucent. Ananda said that this was what a being of the Great Brahma Heaven should look like.

文殊说：“你闭关期间，要在这呆一段时间。”

Manjushri said, “During your retreat, you should stay here for a while.”

释迦佛说：“大家都喜欢你。”

Shakyamuni Buddha said, “Everyone likes you.”

我跟阿难说：“你们为什么不去娑婆世界度众生。”

I asked Ananda, “Why don't you go to the Saha World to liberate sentient beings?”

阿难说：“你去了都迷成这样，谁敢去。”

Ananda replied, “Look how deluded you became when you went there. Who would dare to go?”

阿难说话老没正经。

Ananda was always joking around and never seemed to speak seriously.

释迦佛问他：“你昨天把书送给她没有？”

Shakyamuni Buddha asked him, “Did you deliver the books to her yesterday?”

阿难说：“送了，我看她也学不会。”

Ananda said, “I did, but I don't think she'll be able to learn any of it.”

释迦说：“你只管送书，其它不用管。”

Shakyamuni said, “Just deliver the books. You don't need to concern yourself with anything else.”

阿难说：“不过，菩萨有坚固的大悲心做基础，弘法也不难。”

Ananda added, “Still, when a bodhisattva has an unwavering heart of great compassion as a foundation, spreading the Dharma is not difficult.”

今天是观音圣诞。

Today is Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva's holy birthday.

在城市中生活，很久没看到小鸟。

Living in the city, I had not seen little birds for a long time.

今天打坐完，看到一只小鸟和喜鹊停在门楼上，感到有种回到大自然的感觉。

After meditating today, I saw a small bird and a magpie perched on the gate tower, and I felt as though I had returned to nature.

平时这个寺院游客少，又四面环山，树也不少。

This temple usually has few visitors. It is surrounded by mountains on all sides and has plenty of trees.

辟支佛塔后面住很多喜鹊，还常有啄木鸟在树上啄食，小鸟、蛐蛐也多，让人很惬意。

Many magpies live behind the Pratyekabuddha Pagoda, and woodpeckers often peck at the trees for food. There are also plenty of little birds and crickets, making the place feel wonderfully peaceful.

小鸟的自由自在，让人感到和平，安逸，宁静。

The birds' carefree freedom evokes a sense of peace, comfort, and tranquility.

下午睡了一会儿，便打坐，练瑜珈，吃了一个苹果。

In the afternoon, I slept for a little while, then meditated, practiced yoga, and ate an apple.

这几天练动功多，一天除午饭外吃三个苹果。

I have been doing a lot of dynamic exercises these past few days, and apart from lunch, I eat three apples a day.

傍晚时，心里忽然很想家，想亲人，这两天心脉在转化，心力很弱，老想流泪，就像刚开始学佛时，想到一点悲伤的事或想起鸡、牛等被杀，都会哭得止不住，现在又有点那个情况。

Toward evening, I suddenly felt a deep longing for home and my family. My heart channel seems to be undergoing a transformation these past two days, and my emotional strength feels very weak. I keep wanting to cry. It is much like when I first began studying Buddhism: even the slightest sad thought, or the thought of chickens, cows, and other animals being slaughtered, would make me weep uncontrollably. I seem to be experiencing something similar again.

原准备进关房要写一些东西，但到现在仍无兴趣，闭关快二十天了，恍若一梦。

I had originally planned to write something when I entered the retreat room, but even now I have no interest in doing so. Nearly twenty days of retreat have passed, and it all feels like a dream.

摘录《瑜珈的故事》

Excerpt from Stories of Yoga

吠陀文献的一部分几乎就像有关声音的教材，说明如何把声音当作灵修的工具。

Part of the Vedic literature reads almost like a textbook on sound, explaining how sound can be used as a tool for spiritual practice.

现代人被各种声音包围着，以致听力不再敏锐。

Modern people are surrounded by all kinds of sounds, to the point that their hearing is no longer as sensitive as it once was.

事实上，人体只能感知到一定频率的声音振荡。

In fact, the human body can perceive sound vibrations only within a certain frequency range.

最容易感受到的声音频率是一千至四千赫兹，人听不到二万赫兹以上的声音振荡，老鼠、蝙蝠、鲸和海豚则能发射和接收十万赫兹以上的声音振荡。

The sound frequencies most readily perceived by humans range from 1,000 to 4,000 hertz. Humans cannot hear sound vibrations above 20,000 hertz, whereas mice, bats, whales, and dolphins can emit and receive sound vibrations exceeding 100,000 hertz.

尽管我们没有能力听一定频率的声音，但比较而言，我们听的能力还是比看的能力强。

Although we cannot hear sounds at certain frequencies, our capacity for hearing is still greater than our capacity for seeing in some comparative respects.

凯瑟琳·蕾·密在她的著作《歌唱》中说：“聆听的感官……与内心的体验有关，音乐和声音给我们的影响最直接。

In her book Singing, Catherine Rae Meade writes, “The sense of hearing… is related to our inner experience. Music and sound have the most direct influence on us.

看不会像听那样引起我们内心如此强烈的共鸣。

Seeing does not evoke such a powerful resonance within us as hearing does.

这是因为我们的视觉感官事实上只能感知八度频率以内的光，而听觉感官却可感知到八倍于八度音频的声音，即从六十赫兹到一万六千赫兹的声音振荡。

This is because our visual senses can actually perceive only a limited range of light frequencies within the relevant octaves, whereas our auditory senses can perceive sound across a range many times wider—that is, sound vibrations from 60 to 16,000 hertz.

音波的频率决定声音的高低，光的频率决定光的颜色。

The frequency of a sound wave determines its pitch, while the frequency of light determines its color.

我们视力感知到的光的频率，比我们的听力感知到的声音的频率要高得多（大约一千零十倍），众所周知，频率越高，穿透某种材料的能力越小。

The frequencies of light perceived by our eyes are much higher than the frequencies of sound perceived by our ears—approximately 1,010 times higher. It is well known that the higher a wave's frequency, the less effectively it can penetrate certain materials.

例如：用一块纸板就能轻易挡住光线，但要挡住声音却需要一堵厚厚的墙。

For example, a piece of cardboard can easily block light, but blocking sound requires a thick wall.

波的振荡频率越低，其穿透能力越强。

The lower a wave's frequency of oscillation, the greater its penetrating power.

我们对声音很敏感，不仅是我们的耳朵，就连我们的皮肤和内脏都受它的影响。”

We are highly sensitive to sound. It affects not only our ears but also our skin and internal organs.”

科学显示，人的感官有限，不完美，世上存在大量超出人类感官知觉范围的事物。

Science shows that human senses are limited and imperfect, and that many things exist in the world beyond the range of human perception.

外士纳瓦经典证实了人类看和听的局限，并详细解释了人所不知的灵性声音种类。

Vaishnava scriptures affirm the limitations of human sight and hearing and explain in detail various kinds of spiritual sound that remain unknown to ordinary people.

THE RETREAT JOURNAL · 18

三月二十九日

March 29

早五点醒来，便不想再睡，起床后，先打扫卫生，洗漱完毕后，竟已六点。

I woke up at five in the morning and no longer felt like sleeping. After getting up, I cleaned the room first, and by the time I had finished washing up, it was already six.

这两天早上空腹胃里稍有不适，有时稍恶心，吃一点东西便好一点。

For the past two mornings, my stomach has felt slightly uncomfortable on an empty stomach, sometimes with a little nausea, which improves after I eat something.

昨天是观音诞，竟一天想哭，今天心态一下子平和了。

Yesterday was Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva's birthday, and I felt like crying all day. Today, my mind has suddenly become peaceful again.

供在佛桌瓶子里的枯枝发了很多绿芽，让我感到比那些开放的花朵都可爱。

The bare branches in the vase on the Buddha altar have sprouted many green buds, and I find them even more endearing than the flowers in full bloom.

万事万物在对比中才显出神奇，枯枝发新芽就会让人兴奋，让人觉得可贵而珍惜。

The wonder of all things becomes apparent through contrast. Seeing new buds emerge from bare branches fills me with excitement and makes me appreciate and cherish them all the more.

做完动功已经是七点多，吃了半个苹果当早餐，喝了一杯白开水，开始打坐。

By the time I finished my dynamic exercises, it was already past seven. I ate half an apple for breakfast, drank a glass of plain water, and began meditating.

但坐得不太安心，老觉得房角有老鼠。

However, I could not settle comfortably into meditation, as I kept feeling that there was a mouse in the corner of the room.

下地查看几次，没有老鼠，也未找到其它动物。

I got up several times to investigate, but found neither a mouse nor any other animal.

但屋角不停地嚓嚓响，像老鼠吃食，懒得管它。

Yet a continuous scratching sound came from the corner, like a mouse nibbling at food, and I could not be bothered to investigate any further.

书桌上笔筒里，散开放的两支铅笔之间，有只小蜘蛛竟架起了一条线爬来爬去。

Among two pencils lying loosely in the pen holder on my desk, a tiny spider had spun a thread and was crawling back and forth along it.

以前我很怕蜘蛛，现在竟觉得这只小蜘蛛很可爱。

I used to be very afraid of spiders, but now I actually find this little spider quite adorable.

午饭后，洗过饭盒，躺下却睡不着，心不够幽静，杂念很多。

After lunch, I washed my lunch container and lay down, but could not fall asleep. My mind was not sufficiently quiet, and distracting thoughts kept arising.

摘录，百丈门风:灵光独耀，迥脱根尘，体露真常，不拘文字。

Excerpt from the Baizhang lineage teachings: “The spiritual light shines alone, utterly free from the senses and their objects. The true and eternal essence reveals itself, unconstrained by words and letters.”

心性无染，本自圆成。

The nature of mind is unstained and inherently complete.

但离妄缘，即如如佛。

Simply depart from delusive conditions, and one is the Thus-Come Buddha, abiding in suchness.

菩萨平常一举一动，谨身护持，戒甚於初。

In every ordinary movement and action, a bodhisattva carefully guards and maintains their conduct, observing the precepts even more vigilantly than at the beginning.

既无恶因，何来恶果？

If there are no unwholesome causes, where could unwholesome results come from?

纵有恶果，都是久远前因。

Even when unwholesome results arise, they all stem from causes planted long ago.

既属前因种下，则后果难逃。

Once the causes have been planted, their eventual consequences are difficult to escape.

故感果之时，安然顺受，毫无畏缩。

Therefore, when the results come to fruition, accept them calmly and willingly, without the slightest retreat or fear.

这就叫明因识果（即不昧因果）。

This is called understanding causes and recognizing their results—that is, remaining fully aware of cause and effect.

虽是圣贤，因果不昧，曾种恶因，必感恶果，若明此义，则日常生活逢顺逢逆，苦乐悲欢，一切境界，都有前因，不在境界上妄生憎爱，自然能放得下。

Even sages are not exempt from the law of cause and effect. If they have planted unwholesome causes, they must experience the corresponding unwholesome results. Once this principle is understood, one realizes that all circumstances encountered in daily life—whether favorable or adverse, painful or pleasant, sorrowful or joyful—have their preceding causes. One no longer gives rise to arbitrary likes and dislikes in response to circumstances and can naturally let go.

一心在道，什么无明贡高习气毛病，都无障碍，自易入道。

With the mind wholeheartedly devoted to the Way, ignorance, arrogance, habitual tendencies, and other faults cease to be obstacles, making it easier to enter the Way.

（虚云开示）

—Teachings of Venerable Master Xuyun

有些人终日悠悠忽忽，疏散放逸，心不在道。

Some people drift aimlessly throughout the day, remaining careless and undisciplined, with their minds far from the Way.

虽做功夫，也是时有时无，断断续续，常在喜怒哀乐是非烦恼中打圈子，六根对六尘，乱转念头。

Even when they practice, their efforts are intermittent and inconsistent. They keep circling around emotions, disputes, and afflictions, while their six sense faculties encounter the six sense objects and their thoughts spin chaotically.

对合意的，则生欢喜贪爱心；对逆境，则生烦恼憎恶心。

When things please them, they develop delight and attachment; when faced with adversity, they become distressed and resentful.

做功夫不一定在静中，能在动中不动，才是真功夫。

Spiritual practice does not have to take place in stillness. The true practice is to remain unmoved amid activity.

四祖：夫百千法门，同归方寸，河沙妙德，总在心源。

The Fourth Patriarch said: “Hundreds and thousands of Dharma gates all return to the mind within; the wondrous virtues as numerous as the sands of the Ganges all reside at the source of mind.

一切戒门，定门，慧门，神通变化，悉自具足，不离汝心。

All precepts, meditative concentration, wisdom, and supernatural transformations are inherently complete within you and never separate from your mind.

一切烦恼业障，本来空寂。

All afflictions and karmic obstructions are originally empty and quiescent.

一切因果皆如梦幻。

All causes and effects are like dreams and illusions.

无三界可出，无菩提可求。

There is no threefold world from which to escape and no bodhi to seek.

人与非人，性相平等。

Humans and nonhumans are equal in their essential nature and characteristics.

大道虚旷，绝思绝虑，如是之法，汝今已得，更无缺少，与佛何殊。

The Great Way is vast and empty, beyond thought and deliberation. You have already attained this Dharma, lacking nothing further. How are you then different from a Buddha?

更无别法，汝但任心自在，莫作观行。

There is no other Dharma. Simply let your mind remain free and at ease; do not engage in contrived contemplation.

亦莫澄心，莫起贪嗔，莫怀愁虑，荡荡无碍，任意纵横。

Do not try to purify the mind, give rise neither to greed nor anger, and harbor no worries. Remain open, expansive, and unobstructed, moving freely in any direction.

境缘无好丑，好丑起于心，心若不强名，妄情从何起。

Circumstances and conditions are neither good nor bad in themselves; goodness and badness arise in the mind. If the mind does not impose arbitrary labels, how can delusive emotions arise?

妄情既不起，真心任遍知。

When delusive emotions no longer arise, the true mind can know all things freely and completely.

汝但随心自在，无复对治，即名常住法身，无有变易。

Simply let the mind be free and at ease, without resorting to further methods of suppression or correction. This is called the abiding Dharmakaya, unchanging and immutable.

出言吐语，自己要口诵心惟，让听的人如渴思饮。

When speaking, one should recite the words aloud while reflecting deeply upon them inwardly, so that those who listen feel as though they are thirsty and longing for a drink.”

（虚云开示）

—Teachings of Venerable Master Xuyun

达摩祖师曰：明佛心宗，行解相应，名之曰祖。

Bodhidharma said: “One who understands the essential teaching of the Buddha's mind and whose practice accords with that understanding is called a patriarch.

行解相应，就是说得到行得到。

Practice and understanding must correspond: one must be able both to explain the Dharma and to put it into practice.

古人有说得到行不到的，亦有行得到说不到的。

Among the ancients, some could explain the Dharma but could not practice it, while others could practice it but could not explain it.

说属般若慧解，行属实相理体。

Speaking pertains to the understanding of prajna wisdom, while practice pertains to the underlying principle of true reality.

二者圆融无碍，就是行说俱到。

When the two are perfectly integrated and unobstructed, both practice and explanation are complete.

小乘守偏空见法身，行人惑未破尽，理未打开，所以说不到。

Those of the Lesser Vehicle who cling to a one-sided view of emptiness may perceive the Dharmakaya, yet their delusions have not been completely broken and the underlying principle has not been fully opened to them; therefore, they cannot adequately explain it.

五品位后，讲的天花乱坠，行不到，不能断惑证真。

Those who have reached the stage beyond the Five Grades may speak with dazzling eloquence, but if their practice does not measure up, they cannot sever delusions and realize the truth.”

古人一举一动，内外一如，念念不差，心口相应。

The ancients were consistent inwardly and outwardly in every action, never deviating from moment to moment, with their minds and words in complete accord.

动静无心，凡圣情忘。

In movement and stillness, they were free of contrivance; all distinctions between ordinary beings and sages fell away.

明心见性的人，见物便见心，无物心不现。

One who has realized the mind and seen one's true nature sees the mind in every object; when there is no object, the mind does not manifest.

了明心地的人，动静净秽都是心。

For one who clearly understands the ground of mind, movement and stillness, purity and impurity are all manifestations of mind.

如净秽凡圣心不忘，就把本来处处是道场变成处处是障碍了。

If one cannot let go of distinctions between purity and impurity, ordinary beings and sages, then what was originally a place of practice everywhere becomes an obstacle everywhere.

下午行般舟禅定，观音菩萨授“绵行般舟禅定”，主要是女子气血上行，心行杂乱，情结难解，情执难破，故有情劫。

In the afternoon, while practicing Pratyutpanna walking meditation, Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva taught me the “Soft-Step Pratyutpanna Meditation.” The main idea was that women's qi and blood tend to rise upward, while their mental activity becomes disordered; emotional knots are difficult to untie, and emotional attachments are hard to break, giving rise to emotional tribulations.

因心轮处为女子血海，故在行般舟时，两脚先脚后跟着地，行路似走在海绵上，两脚绵软，而且意守涌泉。

Because the heart chakra is regarded as the sea of blood in women, when practicing Pratyutpanna walking meditation, one should place the heels on the ground first and walk as though on a sponge, keeping the feet soft and supple while focusing the mind on the Yongquan acupoints on the soles.

故涌泉在女子可称气海。

Thus, for women, the Yongquan points may be regarded as the sea of qi.

如女子两脚能绵软光滑，则全身气血循环畅通也。

If a woman's feet become soft and supple, the circulation of qi and blood throughout her body will also flow freely.

意守涌泉，虽属导引，但不致气血结于身，能使气血畅达矣。

Although focusing the mind on Yongquan is a form of energy-guiding practice, it does not cause qi and blood to stagnate in the body; rather, it helps them circulate freely.

（月经期间不必下守涌泉，行走时心念沉寂，空灵即可）

(During menstruation, there is no need to direct the mind downward to Yongquan. When walking, it is sufficient to let the mind become quiet, spacious, and clear.)

诸行无常，是生灭法。

All conditioned phenomena are impermanent; they arise and pass away.

三心本不可得，执着什么。

The three minds cannot ultimately be grasped, so what is there to cling to?

火候不到炉火纯青，宝剑炼不出来。

Unless the fire reaches its perfect intensity, no treasured sword can be forged.

修行不到位，不除净欲望习气，还是放不下，说到行不得。

If one's cultivation is incomplete and desires and habitual tendencies have not been thoroughly eliminated, one still cannot let go. One may speak of the Dharma but fail to put it into practice.

THE RETREAT JOURNAL · 19

三月三十日

March 30

早五点四十分起床，练动功，洗漱。

I got up at five-forty in the morning, practiced dynamic exercises, and washed up.

七点开始打坐。

I began meditating at seven.

打坐中，为一只金蟾王作了超度。

During meditation, I performed a ritual of spiritual deliverance for a King Golden Toad.

此地现在大约有十万多只金蟾，十万年前更多，几乎是金蟾聚积的地方。

There are now more than one hundred thousand golden toads in this area. There were even more a hundred thousand years ago, making it a place where golden toads gathered in great numbers.

后来因气候等原因，金蟾逐渐减少。

Over time, the golden toad population gradually declined due to climate and other factors.

前面龙宫的入口处，曾有金盆，故此地也叫金盆峡。

There was once a golden basin at the entrance to the Dragon Palace ahead, which is why this place is also called Golden Basin Gorge.

后来龙王要寻找新的水源，龙宫就辟水道与此盆口相连，因此口之水清澈而且四季不干涸。

Later, when the Dragon King sought a new water source, the Dragon Palace opened a waterway connecting it to the mouth of this basin, so the water here remained clear and never dried up in any season.

我为它作超度时，它变得硕大无比，而且周围忽乌烟瘴气，烟雾中无数蛇涌来。

As I performed the deliverance ritual for it, the toad grew unimaginably large. Suddenly, the surroundings became dark and murky, and countless snakes surged out of the smoke and mist.

我说：你与这些蛇有仇吗？

I asked, “Do you have a grudge against these snakes?”

它说：唉！此地蛇多，一直在与我们争夺地盘，世代结仇。

It replied, “Alas! There are many snakes here, and they have always competed with us for territory. Our enmity has continued for generations.”

我便念咒让诸蛇退去，让它能静心念佛号。

I then recited a mantra to make the snakes withdraw, allowing the toad to settle its mind and recite the Buddha's name.

它念不来南无阿弥陀佛，但会念南无大慈大悲观音菩萨，慢慢它心静了下来，一声一声念。

It could not recite “Namo Amitabha Buddha,” but it could recite “Namo Greatly Compassionate Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva.” Gradually, its mind became calm, and it began chanting one invocation after another.

这时，看到阿弥陀佛在空中放红色的光显像，手托一朵莲花，它便化成一颗放炽光的晶莹小球进入莲心，此后它的形态在空中散去，诸蛇也像云雾一样散尽。

At that moment, I saw Amitabha Buddha appear in the sky, radiating red light and holding a lotus flower in one hand. The toad transformed into a tiny, crystalline sphere of blazing light and entered the heart of the lotus. Its form then dissolved into the sky, and the snakes dispersed like clouds and mist.

弥陀像隐去。

The image of Amitabha Buddha faded away.

金蟾走时送一件礼物给我。

As the golden toad departed, it gave me a gift.

看经书小悟：诸佛菩萨本无言说，一切经典只是佛菩萨指月的手指，如能于无字处看到般若，从无声处体会到大悲，才与诸佛言说真正契入，与空性契入。

A small realization while reading the scriptures: Buddhas and bodhisattvas do not fundamentally rely on words. All scriptures are merely fingers pointing to the moon. Only when we can perceive prajna beyond written words and experience great compassion in silence can we truly enter into the meaning of the Buddhas' teachings and accord with emptiness.

上午胃里一直不太舒服，便大部分时间在院里行般舟，直走到两脚心发热出汗，又做了瑜珈动功。

My stomach remained uncomfortable throughout the morning, so I spent most of the time practicing Pratyutpanna walking meditation in the courtyard, continuing until the soles of my feet grew warm and sweaty. I then practiced dynamic yoga exercises.

这样已经是中午十一点多了。

By then, it was already past eleven in the morning.

今天是普贤菩萨圣诞，前天过观音诞，沾佛光吃到了许多供果，还有蛋糕。

Today is the holy birthday of Samantabhadra Bodhisattva. The day before yesterday was Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva's birthday, and thanks to the blessings of the Buddhas, I was able to enjoy many fruits offered on the altar, along with some cake.

胃里虽不舒服，但因动功做的多，故饭量觉比前增加。

Although my stomach felt uncomfortable, I had a greater appetite than before, perhaps because I had done so many dynamic exercises.

吃饭时，门外的树上不知停着只什么鸟，介于喜鹊与鸽子之间，很好看，胖乎乎的。

While I was eating, an unfamiliar bird perched in a tree outside the door. It looked somewhere between a magpie and a pigeon, and was very attractive and plump.

它不叫也不飞，一直在那根树枝上呆了很久。

It neither called nor flew away, remaining on the same branch for a long time.

我试着把自己的思维进入那只鸟，竟成功了。

I tried to enter the bird's mind with my own awareness, and to my surprise, I succeeded.

感觉自己悠忽与树上那只鸟合一，而且看到了树下的房屋与远山，感到那只鸟两爪子和腿累了，想休息一下，而且是只母鸟，还可能怀了鸟蛋（不太真切），忽有一丝愁绪飘过，像轻烟似的。

I felt myself suddenly merging with the bird perched in the tree. I could see the houses below and the distant mountains, and sensed that the bird's feet and legs were tired and that it wanted to rest. It also seemed to be a female bird, perhaps carrying eggs, though this was not very clear. A faint trace of sorrow drifted through its mind like wisps of smoke.

那只鸟想到了去年的事，但瞬间就过去了，没有捕捉到信息。

The bird seemed to recall something from the previous year, but the thought passed in an instant, and I could not capture any information from it.

原来鸟的念头闪得特别快，而且它想的不完整，似乎是关于鸟窝的事，看来它在为在哪搭个新家发愁。
