I practiced yoga in the afternoon. My muscles have been somewhat sore over the past few days, especially my calves and arms.

后打坐，守脐轮。

Afterward, I sat in meditation and focused on the navel chakra.

很长时间脐轮处无任何感觉，我继续保持心灵湛静，微微观照，若有若无，绵绵密密。

For a long time, I felt nothing at the navel chakra. I continued to maintain a clear, tranquil mind, observing it gently and subtly, with an awareness that was continuous yet almost imperceptible.

忽肚脐眼开始放金光，随后，光向内照，只见脐轮处忽升起一像龙卷风一样白色的光气，一直到心轮。

Suddenly, my navel began to emit golden light. The light then shone inward, and I saw a white, luminous current rise from the navel chakra like a tornado, extending all the way to the heart chakra.

随后，旋转的白色雾团开始慢下来，并舒展开，像一个上端开口下边细窄的白色口袋，然后慢慢降落回脐轮处。

The swirling white cloud gradually slowed and spread out, resembling a white pouch with a wide opening at the top and a narrow base, before slowly descending back to the navel chakra.

这时，胎息忽然启动，肚子起伏较大，有时忽停，肚皮似与后脊相贴。

At this point, embryonic breathing suddenly began. My abdomen moved noticeably, sometimes stopping abruptly, and my belly seemed to draw toward my spine.

鼻息开始还有，后越来越细，似乎停止。

At first, I could still feel my nasal breathing, but it gradually became finer until it seemed to stop.

不时有灰尘一样的雾气从脐轮处升腾起来。

From time to time, a dust-like mist rose from the navel chakra.

慢慢肚子动的幅度越来越小，里面似只有气在开合，偶然会听到婴儿的哭声，或寺院屋檐的铃声，或流水声。

Gradually, the movement of my abdomen became smaller and smaller, as though only the qi inside were expanding and contracting. Occasionally, I heard what seemed to be a baby's cry, bells hanging from the eaves of a temple, or the sound of flowing water.

我心湛然沉静，只是微微内视，忽看到脐轮，似显现成一个密宗图案里脉轮的样子，而且在脉轮脉与脉的空隙有很多梵文的咒语，重重叠叠……

My mind remained clear and still as I observed inwardly with gentle awareness. Suddenly, the navel chakra seemed to take the form of a chakra depicted in a tantric diagram, with many Sanskrit mantras appearing in the spaces between its channels, layered one upon another...

这时，忽看到有几根粗大的气脉从海底轮向上升起，紧贴身体表皮，海底轮放光，会阴处气胀，外生殖器和肛门都向内收缩，看到自己十一、十二岁的影像。

At this moment, I suddenly saw several thick energy channels rising from the root chakra, close against the surface of the body. The root chakra radiated light, and I felt an expansion of qi in the perineum, while the external genitals and anus contracted inward. I also saw an image of myself at eleven or twelve years old.

脐轮处还出现一截琉璃状的管子，有拇指粗，向上直通上去，消失在心轮处，管子下端有很短一小截血。

A short, glass-like tube also appeared at the navel chakra, about as thick as a thumb. It extended straight upward and disappeared at the heart chakra, with a small trace of blood visible at its lower end.

海底轮有一次火升起，两腿瞬间像火焰循环了一次，一下子发热，后又消失。

Once, a fire arose at the root chakra, and for an instant my legs seemed to complete a circuit of flame. They suddenly became hot, then the sensation disappeared.

观海底轮时，境界里也有雨、雾、水流等等音声或情景出现。

While observing the root chakra, I also experienced scenes and sounds of rain, mist, flowing water, and other such phenomena.

THE RETREAT JOURNAL · 28

四月八日

April 8

早晨五点五十起床，洗漱，打扫卫生。练动功一直到七点半，喝一小盒牛奶。

I got up at 5:50 a.m., washed and brushed up, and cleaned the room. I continued practicing dynamic exercises until 7:30, then drank a small carton of milk.

前几天在定境中，总是内视到海底轮有一根粗大的脉，四周缠绕着黑红色的血脉。

Over the past few days, during meditative concentration, I repeatedly perceived inwardly a thick channel at the root chakra, surrounded by dark red blood vessels.

在转化这些血脉时，白天晚上都像自己变成了母亲，有时回光返照，看自己的相貌都像母亲三十多岁的样子，我认为那些血脉必是父母的精血。

As I worked on transforming these blood vessels, I felt both day and night as though I had become my mother. Sometimes, when I turned my awareness inward and reflected on myself, even my appearance seemed to resemble my mother in her thirties. I believed these blood vessels must have originated from the vital essence and blood of my parents.

因为血来自于母。这些血必带有母亲怀胎时的全部信息和遗传基因，故转化气脉时，这段时间就会反复出现母亲怀我时的样子和习气。

Since blood comes from the mother, I believed it must carry all the information and genetic material associated with her pregnancy. Thus, while transforming my energy channels, I repeatedly experienced images of my mother during the time she carried me, along with what seemed to be her habitual tendencies.

所以，一个母亲在怀孕时，如能正身、正意、正言，身心清净，对孩子气脉的形成有很大影响，而气脉又会直接影响到孩子的气质和性格。

Therefore, if a mother maintains upright conduct, wholesome intentions, truthful speech, and purity of body and mind during pregnancy, this can have a significant influence on the formation of the child's energy channels, which in turn directly affect the child's temperament and personality.

而且孩子如修行，将来在转化气脉时也容易得多。

Moreover, if the child later takes up spiritual practice, transforming these energy channels may become much easier.

这几天，自己在行住坐卧时，也常看到自己十多岁时的样子。

Over the past few days, while walking, standing, sitting, or lying down, I have also frequently seen myself as I looked in my early teens.

而小时候的心理变化和习气、欲望也偶然在身上重现出来。

The psychological changes, habitual tendencies, and desires I had as a child have occasionally reappeared in me as well.

可见，人的每一个起心动念都会留有痕迹的，存在八识田中，只不过如形成习气，转化起来就慢一点。

This suggests that every thought and intention leaves a trace in the field of the eight consciousnesses. Once these traces develop into habitual tendencies, transforming them simply takes more time.

摘《楞严经注释》

Excerpt from Notes on the Shurangama Sutra

十二类众生，各各具备十二种颠倒。

The twelve classes of sentient beings each possess twelve kinds of inversion.

总的说来，应该是一百四十四种颠倒，在一一颠倒中，都具足八万四千乱想，故欲除妄想应须离念。

Altogether, there should be 144 kinds of inversion. Within each individual inversion are the full 84,000 kinds of confused thoughts. Therefore, to eliminate deluded thoughts, one must learn to let go of thoughts.

今天上午观《楞严经》。

This morning, I contemplated the Shurangama Sutra.

有人说《楞严经》是伪经，以我看来，《楞严经》确是佛说，是正知见，只是有一些比喻或更详尽的说明是后人加入的。

Some people say that the Shurangama Sutrais apocryphal. In my view, however, it truly conveys the Buddha's teaching and presents right understanding and right views. Only some of its analogies or more detailed explanations may have been added by later generations.

感悟

Reflections

要想除尽妄想习气，除非用智慧返观。

To eliminate deluded thoughts and habitual tendencies completely, one must turn inward and observe with wisdom.

但慧由定发，定从止起。

Yet wisdom arises from concentration, and concentration begins with stilling the mind.

众生心神散乱，妄想横飞，杂念不能止，怎能得定？

Sentient beings have scattered minds, with deluded thoughts flying in every direction. If miscellaneous thoughts cannot be stilled, how can concentration be attained?

心神安定，湛然常寂，则自性中本有的智慧自能逐渐开启，粗重的习气，欲望自可自然消失。

When the mind becomes settled, clear, and continually still, the wisdom inherently present in one's true nature can gradually unfold, and deeply ingrained habits and desires can naturally fade away.

所以修行之人，能去除妄想，止于一心是最根本的。

Therefore, for those who practice the Way, eliminating deluded thoughts and resting in undivided awareness are the most fundamental tasks.

今天是第四个七天，闭关已快满一月。

Today marks the fourth seven-day period, and my retreat is nearly a month long.

想这七天收获还有一点。

Looking back, I feel that I have gained something during these past seven days.

即气脉有不同程度开启转化，心性上也有小悟，初步体验心无所住的境界。

My energy channels have opened and transformed to varying degrees, and I have also had a small insight into the nature of mind, with an initial experience of the state in which the mind abides nowhere.

自此不与六根同醒，不与六根同眠，不与菩萨同生，不与吴爱真同死。

From this point onward, I shall neither awaken with the six sense faculties nor sleep with them; neither be born alongside the Bodhisattvas nor die alongside Wu Aizhen.

心脉自前几天初步开启后，整个胸腔常感觉空廓无物，时有清凉之气生起。

Since the heart channel first began to open a few days ago, my entire chest has often felt spacious and empty, and a cool energy occasionally arises within it.

观经还不能心顿时契入，还有分别理念知障。

When contemplating the sutras, my mind still cannot immediately merge with their meaning; conceptual discrimination and intellectual understanding remain obstacles.

心不能时时清净湛然，不能时时观、思、修同时生起。

My mind cannot yet remain clear and pure at all times, nor can contemplation, reflection, and practice arise simultaneously and continuously.

要知自心圆满与佛无二，对此绝无半点怀疑，虽其力未充，也已入佛子之位，富贵满足，绝不屑入贫贱之习气中。

One must recognize that one's own mind is complete and no different from the Buddha's, without the slightest doubt about this. Although the power of this realization may not yet be fully developed, one has already entered the ranks of the Buddha's children. With such inner richness and fulfillment, one would never stoop to the impoverished habits of mind associated with spiritual poverty.

这几天大便增多，有时一天达六、七次，也不便秘，不腹泻，小腹稍胀，有下坠感。

Over the past few days, I have been having more frequent bowel movements, sometimes six or seven times a day. I am neither constipated nor experiencing diarrhea, though my lower abdomen feels slightly bloated and heavy, with a sensation of downward pressure.

白带稍增多，睡眠越来越少。

Vaginal discharge has increased slightly, and I have been sleeping less and less.

静坐时间较长，动功比前段时间减少。

I have been spending longer periods in seated meditation, while practicing fewer dynamic exercises than before.

饭量趋于中等，早晚偶尔喝奶，不觉饥饿。

My appetite has settled at a moderate level. I occasionally drink milk in the morning or evening and do not feel hungry.

口有时干，喝水量增加。

My mouth is sometimes dry, and I have been drinking more water.

下午打坐，意守脐轮，觉能量不足，便出神去后山找石炼丹。

In the afternoon, while meditating and focusing my attention on the navel chakra, I felt that my energy was insufficient. I therefore sent my spirit out to the mountain behind me to find a stone for alchemical refinement.

从后山过去往前进入一个深谷，有一块擎天巨石写“黑风口”。

From the mountain behind me, I proceeded forward into a deep valley, where a towering, sky-reaching boulder bore the words “Black Wind Pass.”

巨石后有黑乎乎的山洞或是峡谷，我直走进去，伸手不见五指，走了一会儿，看到地上有块玄红色的石头在放光，便搬起来向外走。

Behind the boulder was a dark cave or perhaps a gorge. I walked straight inside, where it was so dark that I could not see my hand in front of my face. After walking for a while, I saw a deep reddish-black stone glowing on the ground, so I picked it up and started back out.

未走几步，听一声音说：“快走！”只觉身后仿佛排山倒海的气浪推过来，我快跑，刚出黑洞，忽觉又被一股强大的力量吸回去。

I had taken only a few steps when I heard a voice shout, “Hurry! Get out!” I felt a tremendous surge of energy, like mountains collapsing and seas overturning, rushing toward me from behind. I ran as fast as I could. Just as I emerged from the dark cavern, I suddenly felt myself being sucked back inside by an immense force.

我趴在地上，抱紧那块石头，但还是连人带石被往黑洞吸。

I threw myself onto the ground and clutched the stone tightly, but both the stone and I were still being pulled toward the dark cavern.

这时，韦陀在空中急忙把杵插入地下，我用手抱住杵才免被吸入黑洞。

At that moment, Bodhisattva Weituo hurriedly drove his vajra staff into the ground from the air. I wrapped my arms around the staff and was thus saved from being sucked into the cavern.

原来此黑洞是山的呼吸口，每隔十几分钟山气就会像人一样，一呼一吸，我刚才正好碰到了山气在出入，好险！

It turned out that this dark cavern was the mountain's breathing opening. Every ten-odd minutes, the mountain's energy breathed in and out like a human being. I had happened to encounter the mountain's breath as it flowed in and out. That had been a close call!

韦陀收了铁杵，说：“让你受惊了。”

Weituo withdrew his iron vajra staff and said, “I'm sorry to have frightened you.”

我的样子像十四岁左右的孩子，笑笑，爬起身抱起石头。

I looked like a child of about fourteen. I smiled, got back to my feet, and picked up the stone.

这时，朗公从前面过来，打了招呼，看了我怀里的石块，说：“这是水晶石极品。”

At that moment, Master Langgong approached from the front and greeted me. Looking at the stone in my arms, he said, “This is a supreme-grade crystal.”

我用手摸了一下那块石，上面的红色抹去之后，露出里面的白色石块。

I rubbed the stone with my hand, and when the red coating came away, a white stone was revealed beneath it.

石块发出的光，像太阳照在水面上，水光潋滟，幽幽的。

The light emitted by the stone resembled sunlight shining on the surface of water, with shimmering ripples and a soft, mysterious glow.

朗公说：“此黑风口，就像宇宙的黑洞，很危险。”

Master Langgong said, “This Black Wind Pass is like a black hole in the universe. It is very dangerous.”

他曾在此炼丹，只进去过两次。

He had once practiced alchemy there, but had entered the place only twice.

他说前面有丹炉，他帮我炼。

He said there was an alchemical furnace farther ahead and offered to refine the stone for me.

我们一起去了他的丹炉房，是用石头垒的。

We went together to his alchemy chamber, which had been built from stone.

朗公从小童手里拿过金钵，把石块放进钵里。

Master Langgong took a golden alms bowl from the young attendant and placed the stone inside it.

看见石块比金钵大，但朗公却把它一下子就放了进去，然后把两只金钵扣起，从炉靠下方的一个口放入丹炉。

I could see that the stone was larger than the golden bowl, yet Master Langgong placed it inside with a single effortless movement. He then covered it with a second golden bowl and inserted the two nested bowls into the furnace through an opening near its lower section.

在炉里是用上万年的松木做燃料。

The furnace was fueled by pinewood that had supposedly been preserved for tens of thousands of years.

朗公把进口封了，只在丹炉中间靠下的位置有一个通风口，可从口看到钵。

Master Langgong sealed the entrance, leaving only a vent near the lower middle of the furnace, through which the bowls could still be seen.

然后朗公开始点火炼丹。

Master Langgong then lit the fire and began refining the elixir.

这时，巫山神尼走了进来，说：“我说怎么会这么香，原来在炼丹。”

At that moment, the Divine Nun of Wushan walked in and said, “I was wondering why it smelled so fragrant. So you are refining an elixir!”

朗公说：“把你的青锋宝剑借我一用。”

Master Langgong said, “Please lend me your Green Edge sword for a moment.”

神尼便把手里的一柄短剑交给朗公。

The nun handed him the short sword she was holding.

朗公用剑指发气，与剑同时指向通风口，口里似在念咒。

Master Langgong extended his sword fingers to direct energy, pointing them and the sword simultaneously toward the vent, while seemingly chanting an incantation.

一会儿，只见丹炉里的火苗由红色变为青色，青色化成光凝住不动，石块在钵里化成水，开始为红色，朗公急停火。

After a while, the flames inside the furnace changed from red to blue-green. The blue-green flames then transformed into light and became motionless. Inside the bowl, the stone melted into liquid, which was initially red. Master Langgong quickly extinguished the fire.

钵里的水由红色变为金色，马上又变成白色的光团。

The liquid in the bowl changed from red to gold, then immediately transformed into a white sphere of light.

钵从炉里取了出来，朗公把水倒入一个小杯中冷却成两颗丸药让我服食。

The bowls were removed from the furnace. Master Langgong poured the liquid into a small cup, where it cooled and solidified into two pills for me to swallow.

我把它咽到心轮部位，然后让它自然落入脐轮。

I swallowed the pills, directing them first to the heart chakra and then allowing them to descend naturally to the navel chakra.

等了一会儿，只见脐轮处有光照上半身，在天目处晃动，像水晶发出的光。

After waiting a while, I saw light radiating from the navel chakra into my upper body. It shimmered around the area of the third eye like light emitted by a crystal.

这时，空中忽有奇怪的声音响起，直觉风声鹤唳，刺耳的声音反复响起，朗公与神尼都捂起耳朵，声音很恐怖。

Suddenly, strange sounds rang out in the air. The atmosphere felt ominous, as though every rustle of wind signaled danger. The piercing sounds repeated again and again, and both Master Langgong and the nun covered their ears. The noise was terrifying.

朗公举头寻视，看声音来自哪里。

Master Langgong raised his head and searched for the source of the sound.

忽然，空中有两只铁鸟从天飞降，分别落在我两肩旁。

Suddenly, two iron birds descended from the sky and landed beside my shoulders.

两只铁鸟很像一般神庙里供桌上鸟型的供油灯。

The two birds closely resembled the bird-shaped oil lamps placed on offering tables in ordinary temples.

腿很长，样子较凶，黑色，身体像铁做的。

They had long legs and fierce-looking features. They were black, and their bodies appeared to be made of iron.

随之，一个白发老人出现在空中，看不出是男是女。

Then an elderly white-haired figure appeared in the air, though I could not tell whether the figure was male or female.

这时，只见巫山神尼跪地喊：“师父，您怎么来了。”

At this, the Divine Nun of Wushan knelt down and cried, “Master, what brings you here?”

朗公也招呼说：“巫山神姥。”

Master Langgong also greeted the figure, saying, “Divine Elder of Wushan.”

神姥看了我一眼，对神尼说：“我在找你，快跟我回去。”

The Divine Elder glanced at me, then said to the nun, “I've been looking for you. Come back with me at once.”

这时，我向神姥作礼说：“观音菩萨拜见神姥！”

I bowed to the Divine Elder and said, “Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva pays her respects to the Divine Elder!”

因在空中，我显的相是一个孩子。

Since I was in the air, my visible form was that of a child.

神姥听到我的问候，定睛一看，我忽然变作白衣观音模样。

Hearing my greeting, the Divine Elder looked at me more closely. I suddenly transformed into the form of White-Robed Avalokiteshvara.

神姥马上跪地作礼说：“不知菩萨光临。怪不得铁鸟鸣叫。菩萨曾点化于我……。”

The Divine Elder immediately knelt and bowed, saying, “I did not know that the Bodhisattva had graced us with her presence. No wonder the iron birds were crying out. The Bodhisattva once guided me to awakening…”

我说：“菩萨已投胎做人，很多前缘记不起来，现在修行转化脉轮，不知神姥有何妙方。”

I said, “The Bodhisattva has already taken human birth and cannot remember many of her past connections. I am now practicing to transform the energy centers. I wonder whether the Divine Elder has any special method to offer.”

神姥说：“我炼的百花丹对女子转化海底轮有帮助。”

The Divine Elder replied, “The Hundred-Flower Elixir that I refine can help women transform the root chakra.”

说完，神姥向朗公借来金钵，而后念动咒语，只见从山中有无数的花草排成整齐的队伍源源不断地进入她手里托的钵中。

Having spoken, the Divine Elder borrowed a golden bowl from Master Langgong and began chanting an incantation. Countless flowers and herbs then emerged from the mountain, forming orderly lines as they streamed continuously into the bowl she held in her hands.

神姥忽让钵升入空中，在下边用剑指发光成火，使百花在钵内炼成一朵白色的莲花。

The Divine Elder suddenly caused the bowl to rise into the air. Beneath it, she directed light and energy through her sword fingers, producing flames that refined all the flowers into a single white lotus inside the bowl.

神姥取了莲花说：“这叫百味莲，菩萨请服用。”

The Divine Elder took out the lotus and said, “This is called the Lotus of a Hundred Flavors. Bodhisattva, please partake of it.”

这时，韦陀忽然而至，用手拿起莲花反复观看，而后才交与我手。

At that moment, Weituo suddenly appeared. He picked up the lotus and examined it repeatedly before finally handing it to me.

我便把那朵花吃掉了，入口芳香四溢。

I ate the flower, and its fragrance filled my mouth.

吃完花后，神姥与女尼告辞，铁鸟也随她们而去。

After I finished the flower, the Divine Elder and the nun took their leave, and the iron birds departed with them.

神姥边走边抹眼泪说：“偿了一个宿愿。”

As she walked away, the Divine Elder wiped away her tears and said, “At last, a long-cherished wish has been fulfilled.”

我继续打坐，朗公站在我面前，我请朗公坐，朗公却马上化作金麒麟趴在地上，小童也变作一只小金麒麟，趴在朗公旁边。

I continued meditating. Master Langgong stood before me, and I invited him to sit down. Instead, he immediately transformed into a golden qilin and lay on the ground. The young attendant also turned into a small golden qilin and lay beside him.

打坐中，感到自己脐轮处忽发热，而且向上又有龙卷风一样的白色雾腾起，而且从尾闾到两肾部位开始发亮，脉道显露出来，并且发热，光气沿督脉向上强有力地上行，只见两个肾像水中的草一样，被牵动着往上走，而且还来回摆动。

While meditating, I felt a sudden warmth at the navel chakra, and a white mist, resembling a tornado, rose upward. The area from the coccyx to the kidneys began to glow, revealing the energy channels and producing heat. Luminous energy surged forcefully upward along the Governing Vessel. I saw my two kidneys being drawn upward like aquatic plants swaying in water, moving up and down and rocking from side to side.

尾闾处有一个隐密的脉轮，叫“生死轮”。

There was a hidden chakra at the coccyx, called the “Wheel of Birth and Death.”

海底轮反应不是很明显。

The response at the root chakra was not particularly pronounced.

正在坐中，只见巫山神姥忽穿着僧服和神尼同样着装匆匆而来，说希望菩萨能为她师徒俩剃度，做菩萨弟子。

While I was still seated in meditation, the Divine Elder of Wushan suddenly hurried over, dressed in monastic robes matching those of the nun. She said she hoped the Bodhisattva would shave the heads of both master and disciple and accept them as her disciples.

菩萨答应了，用柳枝洒水在她们顶上，而后用手摩她们俩头顶，她俩头发自动全部脱落。

The Bodhisattva agreed. She sprinkled water over their heads with a willow branch, then stroked the crowns of their heads with her hands. All their hair fell away spontaneously.

菩萨为她俩起法名“一清”、“一弘”。

The Bodhisattva gave them the Dharma names Yiqing (“One Purity”) and Yihong (“One Vastness”).

而后，我继续打坐，她俩坐在旁边观看。

Afterward, I continued meditating while the two of them sat nearby and watched.

神姥忽起立对我说：“我观菩萨任脉血气不足，我的血经过上千年采日月之精华而成，可与菩萨服用。”

The Divine Elder suddenly stood up and said to me, “I perceive that the Bodhisattva's Conception Vessel lacks sufficient blood and vital energy. My blood has been cultivated over thousands of years by absorbing the essence of the sun and moon. I can offer it to the Bodhisattva to consume.”

随说抽出一柄短剑，削去自己左手，把血流入一个容器中，而那只左手又自动长了回去。

As she spoke, she drew a short sword and cut off her own left hand, allowing the blood to flow into a container. Her left hand then grew back automatically.

大概有半碗血，我便端起喝了，但心里暗忖“这个因缘可就大了”。

There was about half a bowl of blood. I picked it up and drank it, but inwardly thought, “This creates a very great karmic connection.”

因喝神姥的血，血就像是命，要用命来偿还的。

Because I had drunk the Divine Elder's blood, I felt that blood was like life itself, something that would have to be repaid with one's own life.

神姥已知我心意，竟马上抽剑说：“菩萨不用疑惑，如疑我先自尽。”

The Divine Elder already knew what I was thinking. She immediately drew her sword and said, “Bodhisattva, have no doubts. If you are uncertain, I shall take my own life first.”

边说边要用剑刺向腹中，我很感动，忙劝阻。

As she spoke, she moved to stab herself in the abdomen with the sword. Deeply moved, I hurriedly stopped her.

神姥才作罢。

Only then did the Divine Elder desist.

神姥在前面拜师时，还从口吐出一白色内丹供养，菩萨未受，她又纳入口中。

Earlier, when the Divine Elder had sought ordination, she had also produced a white inner elixir from her mouth as an offering. The Bodhisattva had declined it, so she took it back into her mouth.

神姥说，她曾在终南山与两位道长修炼，道长仙逝后，她又去了崂山与崆峒派长风道长修行。

The Divine Elder said that she had once practiced cultivation with two Daoist masters on Zhongnan Mountain. After they passed away, she went to Laoshan to study under Daoist Master Changfeng of the Kongtong school.

后遇观世音菩萨点化，让她在此山等候，说观音菩萨将来投胎来时，可收她作弟子，她已在此等了三百多年了。

Later, she encountered Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva, who guided her and instructed her to wait on this mountain. The Bodhisattva had said that when she eventually took human birth, she could accept the Divine Elder as a disciple. The Divine Elder had been waiting there for more than three hundred years.

神尼是她一百年前收的弟子。

The Divine Nun had become her disciple a hundred years earlier.

我继续打坐，只见百脉有血注入，然流动一会后就消失了，脉道又开始变得干涸。

I continued meditating and saw blood flowing into the hundreds of channels. Yet after circulating for a while, it disappeared, and the channels began to grow dry again.

血与我的气脉溶于一起，能量太小，都无济于事。

The blood merged with my energy channels, but its energy was too weak to make any meaningful difference.

这时，神姥忽用手拍她旁边两只铁鸟的背说：“神鸟，快去找两株灵芝草来。”

At this moment, the Divine Elder suddenly patted the backs of the two iron birds beside her and said, “Divine birds, hurry and find two lingzhi mushrooms!”

铁鸟应声飞去。

The iron birds immediately flew off in response.

片刻功夫，两只铁鸟各自口衔一支灵芝而回。

A short while later, the two iron birds returned, each carrying a lingzhi mushroom in its beak.

神姥一看，欣喜若狂，朗公也从地上一跃而起，化作人形。

At the sight of them, the Divine Elder was overjoyed. Master Langgong also sprang up from the ground and transformed back into human form.

他们都高兴地说，这下好了，菩萨真有福气，这灵芝是白灵芝，一万年才能成形，而且生长隐密，根本看不到。

They both exclaimed happily, “Wonderful! The Bodhisattva is truly blessed. These are white lingzhi mushrooms, which take ten thousand years to form. They grow in hidden places and are virtually impossible to see.”

平时不显形，而且两鸟采来的是阴阳两支灵芝，太好了。

They do not ordinarily reveal their forms, and the two birds have brought back one yin lingzhi and one yang lingzhi. This is excellent!”

朗公把两支白灵芝（一稍稍发青色）放入钵中，两钵相扣，用指发火炼，只见从钵中放出白色的光，把上面的钵顶起来，而且钵中似有声音。

Master Langgong placed the two white lingzhi mushrooms—one of which had a slight greenish tint—into a bowl, covered it with a second bowl, and used his fingers to generate fire for the refinement. White light emerged from between the bowls, pushing the upper bowl upward, while a sound seemed to come from within.

一会儿，两灵芝竟化作鸡蛋大小圆圆的、白色的球，放出白光。

After a while, the two lingzhi mushrooms transformed into a round, egg-sized white sphere that radiated white light.

我看到后，身子开始轻度震颤。

When I saw this, my body began to tremble slightly.

白色的球忽与我溶在一起，看到脐轮处发白色的光向四周散开。

The white sphere suddenly merged with me, and I saw white light spreading outward in all directions from the navel chakra.

（有的地方记不清楚）

(Some details are unclear in my memory.)

THE RETREAT JOURNAL · 29

四月九日

April 9

早六点起床，练动功到六点四十五，因屋外下雨，只能在屋内练。

I got up at six in the morning and practiced dynamic exercises until 6:45. Since it was raining outside, I had to practice indoors.

昨夜梦境仍较杂乱，心不能时刻湛然常寂。

My dreams were still rather chaotic last night, and my mind could not remain clear, serene, and still at all times.

其实湛然常寂也是妄想。

In fact, even the idea of remaining perpetually clear and still can itself be a deluded thought.

开脉轮，出神通，弘法利生，俱是虚幻。

Opening the chakras, attaining supernatural powers, and spreading the Dharma for the benefit of sentient beings—all are illusory.

以虚幻除虚幻，不能了生死矣！

Using illusions to eliminate illusions cannot bring an end to birth and death!

必要除尽种种妄想颠倒，才得究竟。

Only by completely eliminating all kinds of deluded thoughts and inverted views can one attain ultimate liberation.

摘《楞严经》

Excerpt from the Shurangama Sutra

精真妙明本觉圆静，非留死生及诸尘垢，乃至虚空，皆因妄想之所生起。

The essential, true, wondrously luminous, originally awakened nature is perfectly still. Birth and death, all defilements, and even space itself do not remain within it; they all arise from deluded thought.

妄元无因，於妄想中，立因缘性，迷因缘者，称为自然，彼虚空性，犹实幻生，因缘自然，皆是众生妄心计度。

Delusion originally has no cause of its own. Within deluded thought, people construct the principle of causation and conditions. Those who misunderstand causation and conditions call things spontaneous or natural. Yet even the nature of space is, in truth, illusorily produced. Both causation and conditions and spontaneity are conceptual fabrications of sentient beings' deluded minds.

今天中午吃饭，边吃饭边想，自己以前有对菜饭挑拣的毛病，不喜欢吃的菜就不吃，只吃喜欢的。

At lunchtime today, as I ate, I reflected on my former habit of being picky about food. I would refuse to eat dishes I disliked and eat only those I preferred.

现在就当自己托钵化斋，全由施主布施，不再计较好、坏、多少，便每天高高兴兴吃饭，不喜欢的菜也吃得很香了。

Now I imagine that I am a monastic carrying an alms bowl and receiving whatever food donors offer. I no longer judge whether the food is good or bad, or whether there is much or little. As a result, I eat happily every day, and even dishes I once disliked now taste delicious.

因为不再抱怨，不再分别，心清净的原因，观别人的言行举止，当警惕自己的起心动念及日后的作为。

Because I no longer complain or discriminate, my mind has become clearer. When observing other people's words and behavior, I remind myself to be vigilant about my own thoughts and intentions, as well as how I act in the future.

希望自己以后做任何事，如发心帮助别人当尽心尽力，完成自己份内之事，当力求心在其位，认真，细心，周到。

I hope that from now on, whatever I do, I will give my utmost effort when sincerely intending to help others. When carrying out my own responsibilities, I should remain fully attentive, conscientious, careful, and thorough.

多为他人着想，去除自私心理，真正从内心对别人付出的点滴感恩，而且言行一致。

I should think more about others, eliminate selfishness, and feel genuine gratitude from the heart for even the smallest things others do for me. My words and actions must also be consistent.

别人勉为其难或碍于面子为自己付出任何一点，自己都应该拒绝或立即予以回报，不能坦然接受，除非别人是至诚真心而做。

If someone makes a sacrifice for me reluctantly or merely out of social obligation, I should decline it or repay it immediately rather than accept it without reservation—unless the person acts with genuine sincerity and wholehearted goodwill.

想自己为别人付出的甚少，虽修行发愿为弘法利生而修，但自己习气欲望未除，那在行愿中便有杂染，做事有时会围着自己的利益打转，或虽发心，但并不愿尽心力，想想都惭愧矣！

Reflecting on how little I have done for others, I feel ashamed. Although I practice and make vows to spread the Dharma and benefit sentient beings, my habitual tendencies and desires remain. My actions and vows are therefore still tainted. Sometimes I revolve around my own interests when doing things; at other times, although I form a good intention, I am unwilling to give it my full effort. Even thinking about this makes me feel deeply ashamed.

佛子行事，当首断其欲，后利有情，愿诸佛菩萨加持，让自己有此力量！

A disciple of the Buddha should first relinquish selfish desires and then benefit sentient beings. May all Buddhas and Bodhisattvas bless me with the strength to do so!

雨到中午乃停，天阴，头有点昏沉。

The rain stopped around noon. The sky remained overcast, and my head felt somewhat heavy and dull.

气候对自己还有影响，天阴与头昏沉本是因缘会遇时的一种现象，只要自己心能寂静光明，天阴与头昏沉又有什么好坏过错呢？

The weather still affects me. An overcast sky and a heavy head are simply phenomena arising when certain conditions come together. If my mind can remain peaceful and luminous, what good or bad, right or wrong, is there in the cloudy sky or the dullness in my head?

中午饭后午休，梦自己在为自己说佛法，讲《楞严经》。

After lunch, I took a nap and dreamed that I was explaining the Dharma to myself and teaching the Shurangama Sutra.

快醒之时，似还记得原文，并似有所悟，醒后就忘记了。

Just before waking, I seemed to remember the original text and to have gained some insight, but I forgot it as soon as I awoke.

午睡醒来，胃有不适，又像前段时间开始吐酸水。

When I woke from my nap, my stomach felt uncomfortable, and I seemed to be experiencing the acid regurgitation that had begun some time earlier.

我边用手揉胃，边在屋内踱步。

I rubbed my stomach with my hand while pacing around the room.

一会儿又到院里，想行般舟，但因鞋坏进了水，拖鞋太大，没有办法行，便又回到屋内，想要么吃点什么也许会舒服一点。

After a while, I went into the courtyard, intending to practice Pratyutpanna walking meditation. However, my shoes were damaged and had let in water, while my slippers were too large to walk in properly. Unable to practice, I returned indoors, thinking that perhaps eating something might make me feel better.

忽看到地上的苹果，是中午托护关人员买来的，苹果有几种，正在想吃个苹果是否能好，忽想到这么好的苹果，我竟未用来先供佛，就自己吃了。

I suddenly noticed the apples on the floor. They had been purchased at noon by the person helping to support my retreat. There were several varieties. As I wondered whether eating an apple might help my stomach, it suddenly struck me that I had such fine apples but had not first offered any to the Buddha before eating them myself.

我们忆佛，当如子忆母，我怎么能看到喜欢、好的东西从未想到先供佛呢，只想到自己。

When we remember the Buddha, we should do so as a child remembers its mother. How could I see something desirable or excellent and never think of offering it to the Buddha first, thinking only of myself?

想到此，忙挑了最好的几个苹果放在供桌上，并点了半支香，也并未想其它，很恭敬地站在供桌边想：“我愿供养十方如来。”

Thinking this, I quickly selected several of the best apples and placed them on the altar. I lit half an incense stick and, without thinking of anything else, stood reverently beside the altar and thought, “I wish to make an offering to the Tathagatas of the ten directions.”

忽然，我面前空中，出现无数尊者，竟都在吃苹果。

Suddenly, countless venerable beings appeared in the air before me, and to my astonishment, they were all eating apples.

我又惊又喜，一下愣在那儿。

Overwhelmed with surprise and joy, I stood there stunned.

阿难坐在空中边吃边说：“诸佛菩萨吃你供养的苹果，只是为了你将来能得到众生的供养和帮助，并不是很喜欢吃。”

Ananda sat in the air, eating an apple as he spoke: “The Buddhas and Bodhisattvas eat the apples you offer only so that, in the future, you may receive offerings and assistance from sentient beings. It is not that they particularly enjoy eating them.”

听了此话，我又羞又愧，面对此境界，我忽然从诸佛吃苹果的相中见到空性，悟到实相无相的道理。

Hearing this, I felt both embarrassed and ashamed. As I witnessed this scene, I suddenly perceived emptiness in the image of the Buddhas eating apples and realized the principle that ultimate reality has no fixed form.

而在刹那间，一股热流从腹中生起，胃的不适马上就恢复了。

In that instant, a wave of warmth arose from my abdomen, and my stomach discomfort immediately subsided.

佛法不可思议。

The Dharma is inconceivable.

我原来供养诸佛，只有一种恭敬心，全无其它，诸佛菩萨竟显吃相给我看，让我在刹那间悟入空性。

When I made offerings to the Buddhas, I had felt nothing but reverence, with no other intention. Yet the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas showed themselves eating, allowing me to realize emptiness in a single instant.

从此，我当在此世界行菩萨道，做人事，恭敬供养三宝以及众生，因实相无相，诸法空性，众生皆是如来，空有不二。

From now on, I shall practice the Bodhisattva path in this world and attend to worldly responsibilities, reverently making offerings to the Three Jewels and to sentient beings. Ultimate reality has no fixed form, all phenomena are empty of inherent existence, and sentient beings are all Tathagatas. Emptiness and form are not two.

在我眼中一切皆具恒一真如实性，无二也！

In my eyes, everything possesses the same enduring, true suchness. There is no duality!

真正明白了《维摩诘经》所说：“观身实相，观佛亦然。”

I have truly understood the words of the Vimalakirti Sutra: “Contemplate the true reality of the body, and contemplate the Buddha in the same way.”

明白了“空即是色”的道理。

I have understood the principle that “emptiness is form.”

多谢诸佛加持！谢众生加持！

Many thanks to the blessings of all Buddhas! And thanks to the blessings of all sentient beings!

感悟

Reflections

万事万物不生不灭，也无有归处，立地呈现真如实性，不增不减，不垢不净，均立地成佛也！

All things neither arise nor cease, and none has a place to which it ultimately returns. Their true nature of suchness is present right here and now—neither increasing nor decreasing, neither defiled nor pure. In this sense, all attain Buddhahood here and now!

明了“芥子纳须弥”，根本就无芥子无须弥也，因心空故。

Once one understands the saying “A mustard seed contains Mount Sumeru,” one realizes that ultimately there is neither mustard seed nor Mount Sumeru, because the mind is empty.

如光光相融相映，不相碍。

Just as lights merge and reflect one another without obstructing one another.

修证菩提之人，如能对诸佛菩萨一念恭敬心起，无欲无求，恭敬供养，诸佛必加垂爱，以手摩其顶，此人必心光迸射，增智开慧。

If those cultivating and realizing bodhi can arouse a single moment of reverence toward the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas, making offerings respectfully without desire or expectation, the Buddhas will surely look upon them with compassion and touch their heads with their hands. The light of their minds will then burst forth, and their wisdom and insight will grow.

到此境界，任何言辞只是敲门砖，实无言词可说。

At this stage, all words are merely stepping-stones at the door; in truth, there are no words that can adequately express it.

因瞬间悟入空性，神形瞬间合一，因形、神皆显真如实性，无形相无神相，互不相碍，身心湛然沉静，了无挂碍。

Having realized emptiness in an instant, body and spirit united in that same moment. Both body and spirit revealed the true nature of suchness, without fixed bodily form or spiritual form, and without obstructing one another. Body and mind became clear, serene, and utterly free of impediment.

下午打坐，守海底轮，直到发热，境界中出现了以前性生活等与生殖系统有关的图像。

In the afternoon, I meditated while focusing on the root chakra until it became warm. Images related to my former sexual life and reproductive system appeared in the meditative state.

我未生起任何分别念头，只是旁观。

I did not generate any discriminating thoughts; I simply observed.

从今天打坐开始，不愿意闭眼。

Starting with today's meditation, I no longer felt inclined to close my eyes.

这时，忽见朗公来，我刚欲打招呼，又见随后佛图澄走了进来，从朗公手里接过金钵，说：“我为菩萨开顶快一个月，特来看望，我还为菩萨带来一个礼物。”

At that moment, Master Langgong suddenly appeared. Just as I was about to greet him, Fotucheng entered behind him, took a golden bowl from Master Langgong, and said, “It has been nearly a month since I opened the crown for the Bodhisattva, so I have come especially to visit. I have also brought a gift for the Bodhisattva.”

随之，打开相扣的两只钵，只见一只较小的三腿金蟾蹲在里面。

He then separated the two nested bowls, revealing a small three-legged golden toad crouching inside.

我说：“是只蟾蜍。”

I said, “It's a toad.”

佛图澄说：“菩萨只识有相之物，不识无相之物。此蟾不是一般的金蟾，是一灵物也。它只是暂变成金蟾之相。”

Fotucheng said, “The Bodhisattva recognizes only things with form, not things without form. This is no ordinary golden toad, but a numinous being. It has merely assumed the appearance of a golden toad for the time being.”

随之，他用手发光，那只蟾即变成一颗放白光的宝珠，有小孩玩的玻璃球大小。

He then emitted light from his hand, and the toad transformed into a luminous white jewel about the size of a child's glass marble.

随之，用手一指我海底轮处，发出一道白光，那只金蟾便顺白光运行到了我海底轮处。

He pointed toward my root chakra, sending forth a beam of white light. The golden toad traveled along the beam and entered the area of my root chakra.

后佛图澄和朗公便一起离去。

Afterward, Fotucheng and Master Langgong departed together.

我内视自己海底轮气脉里蹲一只金蟾，也不动。

I looked inward and saw a golden toad crouching motionless within the energy channels of my root chakra.

停了一会儿，只听到一声声金蟾的叫声，而后海底轮便发白光，似乎看到那只蟾在用口吸气脉中的黑色气团，而且我的身体忽然变得幽明空无，内视不到任何东西。

After a while, I heard the golden toad calling repeatedly. Then the root chakra began to emit white light. I seemed to see the toad drawing black energy clusters out of the channels with its mouth. My body suddenly became an empty expanse of dim, luminous space, and I could no longer perceive anything through inward observation.

只觉得幽明之光杳杳冥冥。

All I could sense was a distant, mysterious radiance, at once dim and luminous.

一会儿，忽看到金蟾化成水溶于脉道，叫声也不再响起。

After a while, I suddenly saw the golden toad dissolve into water and merge with the channels. Its calls ceased as well.

从督脉忽升起一道白光从尾闾而上，从任脉循环而下。

A beam of white light suddenly rose along the Governing Vessel from the coccyx, then circulated downward along the Conception Vessel.

看到子宫很肥大，两卵巢有光，不是很亮，而且子宫在缩小，阴道向里抽。

I saw that the uterus was greatly enlarged and that both ovaries were glowing, though not very brightly. The uterus then began to shrink, and the vagina contracted inward.

晚上头皮很痒，脸也痒，便洗了头发。

In the evening, my scalp and face became very itchy, so I washed my hair.

THE RETREAT JOURNAL · 30

四月十日

April 10

早四点半起床。

I got up at 4:30 a.m.

昨晚梦到自己在为自己说佛法，四点醒来，不想再睡。

Last night, I dreamed that I was explaining the Dharma to myself. I woke at four and did not want to go back to sleep.

但还是懒懒的赖在床上，直到半小时后才起床。

Still, I lay lazily in bed for another half hour before finally getting up.

这几天打完坐，两腿疼，不麻。

Over the past few days, both legs have hurt after meditation, though they have not felt numb.

即使睡一晚上也休息不过来，脚也疼，臂稍疼，我想与练瑜珈有关。

Even after a full night's sleep, the discomfort does not go away. My feet hurt, and my arms ache slightly. I suspect this may be related to practicing yoga.

早上起床后，即开始洗漱，打扫卫生，一直到六点二十分才结束。

After getting up, I washed and brushed up, then cleaned the room, finishing at 6:20.

开始做一个小时动功。

I then began an hour of dynamic exercises.

今天感觉时间过得特别快，有种梦游的感觉，而且忽然觉得这世界的一切与我都不相干，一切都住在本位上没有动，也不是与世界不相往来，只是无事可做，无心可挂。

Today, time seemed to pass unusually quickly, and I felt almost as though I were sleepwalking. Suddenly, everything in the world seemed unrelated to me. Everything remained in its own place, unmoving. It was not that I had withdrawn from the world; rather, there seemed to be nothing I needed to do and nothing for my mind to cling to.

但对诸法实相还不够透彻、明了。

Yet my understanding of the true nature of all phenomena was still not sufficiently thorough or clear.

中午吃完饭后，连着打喷嚏，忽然心情就变得异常糟糕，就像乌云忽然遮住了太阳。

After lunch, I sneezed repeatedly, and my mood suddenly became extremely bad, as though dark clouds had abruptly covered the sun.

起初是烦躁不安，我试着在院里行般舟，但无济于事，太阳在我眼中也变得灰暗，觉日子过得好无聊，对一切都失去兴趣。

At first, I felt restless and irritable. I tried practicing Pratyutpanna walking meditation in the courtyard, but it did not help. Even the sun looked dim to me. Life felt terribly boring, and I lost interest in everything.

又回房中做了二十个仰卧起坐，但还是不行。

I returned to my room and did twenty sit-ups, but that did not help either.

心态有点灰暗悲哀，这种力量太强，觉照也在，但生不起光明，很阴暗，头部昏沉。

My state of mind became gloomy and sorrowful. The force of these feelings was overwhelming. Awareness was still present, but it could not give rise to any sense of brightness. Everything felt dark, and my head was heavy and dull.

我找出毛笔练书法以调节。

I took out a calligraphy brush and began practicing calligraphy to regulate my mood.

先是临颜真卿的字，慢慢琢磨颜的字形字体，以转移自己的注意力。

I began by copying Yan Zhenqing's calligraphy, slowly studying the shapes and structure of his characters to redirect my attention.

颜的字体像泰山，稳中带有雄健，一笔一划皆像大丈夫行，脚踏实地，光明磊落。

Yan's style reminded me of Mount Tai: solid and stable, yet full of strength. Every stroke seemed to embody the bearing of an honorable man—grounded, upright, and openhearted.

整个字形，稳如磐石，刚劲有力。

Each character was as firm as bedrock, vigorous and powerful.

但他的字形给我感觉不够圆融，方的笔划太多。

Yet his style did not seem sufficiently rounded and harmonious to me; there were too many angular strokes.

我虽欣赏，但我的心性与字体不相适应。

Although I admired his calligraphy, I felt that its style did not quite accord with my own temperament.

字如其人，我临不出他字中透出的那份苍劲，那份丈夫暮年，壮心不已的感觉。

As the saying goes, handwriting reflects the writer. I could not reproduce the rugged strength that shone through his characters, nor the feeling of an aging man whose lofty ambitions remain undiminished.

我便换了王羲之的字帖临，我认为自己与王羲之的字还能相应。

I therefore switched to copying Wang Xizhi's calligraphy, which I felt resonated more closely with me.

王羲之号称书圣，他的字像华山，奇、秀、妙、绝。

Wang Xizhi is revered as the Sage of Calligraphy. His style reminded me of Mount Hua—extraordinary, elegant, exquisite, and peerless.

运笔行云流水，变化快,让人见之赏心悦目。

His brushwork flowed like drifting clouds and running water, changing swiftly and delighting the eye.

如他的字里能再多份空灵，那便有仙风道骨、脱胎换骨之感。

If his calligraphy possessed just a little more ethereal spaciousness, it would convey an immortal's grace and a transcendent spirit, as though one had undergone a complete transformation.

我临他的“兰亭序”，奇怪，对王的字我竟非常熟悉，这种感觉好像来自遥远的记忆。

As I copied his Preface to the Poems Composed at the Orchid Pavilion, I found, strangely, that his handwriting felt remarkably familiar, as though the feeling came from a distant memory.

临了一会儿，心力开始集中，虽写得很差，但也算认真。

After copying for a while, my attention began to concentrate. Although my writing was poor, I was at least practicing earnestly.

忽然，烦躁又出现了，我想是否与自己生理转化有关，眼前与脑里竟反复出现以前许多不如意的事，我让自己心不被这些境转。

Suddenly, the irritability returned. I wondered whether it was related to the physical changes I was undergoing. Many unpleasant events from the past repeatedly appeared before my eyes and in my mind. I tried not to let these circumstances sway my mind.

但一会儿，觉照就不管用了，整个人变得乌烟瘴气，像只关在笼里的狮子。

But after a while, awareness no longer seemed effective. My whole being became clouded and turbulent, like a lion trapped in a cage.

一会儿心里又开始悲哀，觉世事无常，生命无意义。

Soon sorrow arose again, and I felt that worldly affairs were impermanent and life had no meaning.

又想睡觉，我顺势躺在床上睡，让自己放松，旁观，但又睡不着，头里很亮，很空明，内观自己脐轮处不时有热风升起，还伴有阳焰，明亮的尘沙。

I wanted to sleep again, so I lay down, trying to relax and observe what was happening. Yet I could not fall asleep. My head felt intensely bright and clear. Turning my attention inward, I noticed warm currents of air occasionally rising from the navel chakra, accompanied by mirage-like phenomena and bright, dust-like particles.

我便内观，以求心能定住，但还是不行。

I continued observing inwardly, hoping to settle my mind, but it still did not work.

悲伤的气场笼罩着我，很想流泪。

An atmosphere of sorrow enveloped me, and I felt a strong urge to cry.

这时，我忽然想起了佛菩萨与众生，想到众生每天都生活在我现在这样的状态之中，无有能力自拔。

At that moment, I suddenly thought of the Buddhas, Bodhisattvas, and sentient beings. I reflected that countless beings live every day in states like the one I was experiencing, unable to free themselves.

我自修证以来，得佛菩萨加持与护持，曾也发愿，要成就后度脱芸芸众生，上报佛恩。

Since beginning my spiritual practice and realization, I have received the blessings and protection of the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas. I once vowed that, after attaining realization, I would liberate countless sentient beings and repay the kindness of the Buddhas.

即使我达不到这个目标，我也要给我周围每一位爱我的帮助过我的人带去快乐，安逸，祥和，但现在自己竟这个样子。

Even if I could not achieve that lofty goal, I still wanted to bring happiness, comfort, and peace to everyone around me who had loved or helped me. Yet here I was, in such a state myself.

想到此，忽然生起一种金刚无畏的力量，马上坐起来，这种力量忽然从愿力生起，非常强大，似能摧毁一切心魔外魔。

At this thought, a vajra-like, fearless strength suddenly arose within me, and I immediately sat up. This power emerged from my vows and was extraordinarily strong, seeming capable of destroying every inner demon and external obstacle.

我坐在坐垫上，冷眼旁观自己的软弱、自己的烦躁、悲哀，冷眼旁观此世界，心象钉在那儿，不动不摇，而且从此力量生起无穷无尽的悲愿。

Sitting on my meditation cushion, I coolly observed my own weakness, irritability, and sorrow. I observed the world in the same detached way, with my mind fixed firmly in place, unmoving and unshaken. From this strength arose an inexhaustible vow of compassion.

此时，我的身心忽变得空廓广阔，六道众生的苦难与我的悲心融为一体，在这种广大的悲愿中，我感受不到人为的悲伤，只是感受到无穷无尽的力量，无边无际的愿力充斥在每一寸空间。

At that moment, my body and mind suddenly became vast and spacious. The suffering of beings in the six realms merged with my compassion. Within this immense compassionate vow, I no longer felt personal sorrow; I felt only boundless strength, with limitless aspiration filling every inch of space.

自己只是愿力的幻化，瞬间无我！

I was merely an illusory manifestation of this vow—selfless in an instant!

下午在院里行般舟，形神稍恍惚，两腿特别疼，左脚底不时有水圈一样的气荡漾开。

In the afternoon, I practiced Pratyutpanna walking meditation in the courtyard. My body and mind felt somewhat hazy, and both legs hurt intensely. From time to time, energy spread outward from the sole of my left foot in ripples resembling circles on water.

右腿稍僵硬，左脚后跟时时有热流流过，两腿均有黑红色的气流流注脚底。

My right leg felt somewhat stiff, while warm currents repeatedly passed through my left heel. Dark red energy seemed to flow down both legs toward the soles of my feet.

行了不到一个小时，左腿感到沉重，但不疼了，有麻酥酥的感觉，便又在外面站了一会儿，即回屋里打坐。

After walking for less than an hour, my left leg felt heavy but no longer hurt; instead, it had a tingling sensation. I stood outside for a little longer, then returned indoors to meditate.

打坐时守海底轮，心感到空空荡荡，止在一处。

During meditation, I focused on the root chakra. My mind felt empty and spacious, resting in one place.

坐了半小时左右。

I sat for about half an hour.

忽有一人从头顶腾挪飞跃，而且似在唱歌，又在我面前奔跑，衣衫褴褛，个子不高，状如疯颠，我知道这是密勒日巴尊者。

Suddenly, a person leaped and bounded through the air above my head, seemingly singing, then ran in front of me. He was short, dressed in ragged clothes, and appeared almost mad. I knew him to be the Venerable Milarepa.

他忽然站在我面前，很庄严地将一把一把的牛粪糊在我脸上身上。

He suddenly stood before me and, with great solemnity, smeared handful after handful of cow dung over my face and body.

我说“多谢尊者加持！”尊者边贴牛粪边说：“转化海底轮需善无畏金刚，大力神金刚，喜乐双运金刚……等十二位金刚的护持才能打开，这是天山雪山的白水牛粪和着我的唾液，我今用此做个壇城。”

I said, “Thank you, Venerable One, for your blessings!” As he continued applying the cow dung, he said, “To transform the root chakra, it must be opened with the protection of twelve Vajras, including Vajra Subhuti, the Mighty Vajra, and the Vajra of Blissful Union… This is white water-buffalo dung from the snowy Tianshan Mountains, mixed with my saliva. I shall use it to create a mandala.”

一会儿，我全身上下全被牛粪覆盖了。

Before long, my entire body was covered in cow dung.

忽见前面空中来了十几位金刚，他们边走边说：“怎么这么香！”

Suddenly, more than a dozen Vajras appeared in the air before me. As they approached, they said, “Why is it so fragrant?”

他们过来，看了尊者后，说：“尊者，是何人在此用香料供养我们。”

They came closer and, after seeing the Venerable One, asked, “Venerable One, who has made offerings of fragrant substances to us here?”

尊者说：“这位行者可称是众空行母之母，因愿力故投生此世界，现转化海底轮，需众金刚帮助。”

The Venerable One replied, “This practitioner may be called the mother of all dakini mothers. She was born into this world because of her vows, and she is now transforming her root chakra. She needs the assistance of all the Vajras.”

几位金刚说：“众空行母之母皆是我等成就之母，我们自当效力，何用供养。”

Several Vajras said, “The mother of all dakini mothers is also the mother of our attainment. Naturally, we shall lend our aid. Why would any offering be necessary?”

说完后，忽大喝一声，便围坐在我周围，作一圈状，忽化作一个火圈，而且火圈逐渐缩小，进入我海底轮。

Having spoken, they suddenly gave a mighty shout and sat in a circle around me. They then transformed into a ring of fire, which gradually contracted and entered my root chakra.

只见海底轮处有光放出，其它无任何觉受。

I saw light radiating from the root chakra, but experienced no other sensations.

这时，我又看到十二位金刚坐在我身体的毛孔里，似在持咒。

Then I saw the twelve Vajras sitting in the pores of my body, seemingly reciting mantras.

还听到头顶空中有声音喧哗。

I also heard voices chattering in the air above my head.

听两天女在谈论：“这是谁建的壇城，好庄严，这是白水牛粪和圣水造的，不知谁在里面修行。”

I heard two celestial women talking: “Who constructed this mandala? How solemn and magnificent it is! It is made of white water-buffalo dung and holy water. I wonder who is practicing inside it.”

“我看到善无畏金刚。”

“I see Vajra Subhuti,” one voice said.

一个声音说：“好香啊！”

Another voice exclaimed, “How fragrant!”

这时，我忽听到似有水流动的声音或冒水泡的声音，一天女说：“好臊的味道！”

At that moment, I suddenly heard what sounded like flowing water or bubbling. One of the celestial women said, “What a foul, pungent smell!”

等一会儿，声音又说：“没有了。”

After a while, the voice said, “It's gone now.”

这时，只见众金刚忽然从我身中跃出，又化火圈围在我四周，而我海底轮处有白雾腾起，而且有光向四周呈圆圈状散开。

At this point, I saw all the Vajras suddenly leap out of my body and once again transform into a ring of fire around me. White mist rose from my root chakra, and light spread outward in circular waves.

这时，看到有一小节纯净的鲜红色的血充斥中脉，而从顶上虚空处降下乳白色的粘液。

I then saw a small quantity of pure, bright red blood filling the central channel, while a milky-white viscous fluid descended from the empty space above my crown.

不能看清是从任脉，还是中脉，但红白两种液体交汇在一起。

I could not clearly tell whether the fluid came through the Conception Vessel or the central channel, but the red and white substances converged and mingled.

这时，有声音说：“可以了。”

At that moment, a voice said, “That is enough.”

我观自己身体变成了一个圆锥状的空屋子，外面贴着牛粪，而自己似在里面打坐，但又看不到任何人。

I perceived my body as a hollow, cone-shaped chamber, with cow dung plastered on the outside. It seemed that I was meditating inside it, yet I could not see anyone there.

这时，忽然从定中出来，众金刚和尊者都已离去。

Then I suddenly emerged from the meditative state, and all the Vajras and the Venerable One had departed.

前几天在定中看到海底轮的血脉污秽不堪。

A few days ago, during meditation, I saw that the blood vessels around the root chakra were extremely impure.

因这段血脉是父母的精血，心中便生起凡夫精血不净的念头，而且很厌恶，无意识中对父母也失却恭敬。

Because I believed these vessels contained the vital essence and blood of my parents, I developed the notion that ordinary human reproductive fluids and blood were impure. I felt a strong aversion and, unconsciously, lost some of my reverence for my parents.

今天在转化气脉时，看到纯净的精血，心忽生大惭愧。

Today, while transforming the energy channels, I saw pure vital essence and blood, and a profound sense of shame arose in my heart.

这是父母给予的，父母何尝不净，是自心不净，不能从种种不净中见到净性，反而生起对父母不恭敬的邪念。

These were gifts from my parents. How could my parents themselves be impure? It was my own mind that was impure. Unable to recognize purity amid what appeared impure, I had instead allowed disrespectful and misguided thoughts toward my parents to arise.

自己妄想纷呈，昏扰痴昧，竟未报恩，先起点滴憎恶之心都是极可耻，极邪恶的念头，当警惕自己的起心动念！

My mind was filled with delusions, confusion, agitation, and ignorance. Before repaying my parents' kindness, I had already allowed even the slightest feeling of aversion toward them to arise. Such thoughts are deeply shameful and profoundly misguided. I must remain vigilant regarding every thought and intention that arises within me!

THE RETREAT JOURNAL · 31

四月十一日

April 11

早六点起床。昨晚腿、胳膊的肌肉疼，而且起了四次夜小解，睡得不踏实。早上起床后，腿不疼，胳膊还痛。起床后打扫卫生，练瑜珈，打坐到九点。

I got up at six in the morning. Last night, the muscles in my legs and arms ached, and I got up four times to urinate, so my sleep was restless. When I got up this morning, my legs no longer hurt, but my arms were still painful. After getting up, I cleaned the room, practiced yoga, and meditated until nine.

打坐时，我意守喉轮，但不停咳嗽，朗公来送了几颗丹药。

During meditation, I focused my awareness on the throat chakra, but I kept coughing. Master Langgong came and brought me several medicinal pills.

一会儿，只见文殊菩萨来，手托钵，为我洗喉部的脉道，说是刚从极乐世界盛来的功德水。洗脉道时，我发现自己喉、胸变化一朵晶莹的白莲花。洗完后，肺、喉、支气管里放光，文殊离去。

A little later, I saw Manjushri Bodhisattva arrive, holding an alms bowl in his hands. He washed the energy channels in my throat with what he said was merit water freshly collected from the Land of Ultimate Bliss. As he washed the channels, I noticed that my throat and chest had transformed into a crystalline white lotus flower. When he finished, light radiated from my lungs, throat, and bronchial tubes, and Manjushri departed.

又一会儿，两小童抬一大香炉走进来，揭开大香炉的盖，只见从香炉里放出一道光柱，冲入空中。在香炉中围着放了一圈香，两小童把香点着，把盖子盖好，说：是文殊让他们来的，这香是旃檀香，这个香炉文殊加持过。边说边捂着鼻子说：“太香了。”然后匆匆离去。

A little while later, two young attendants carried in a large incense burner. They lifted its lid, and I saw a column of light shoot out of the burner and soar into the sky. They arranged incense sticks in a circle inside it, lit them, and replaced the lid. They explained that Manjushri had sent them, that the incense was sandalwood, and that Manjushri had blessed the burner. As they spoke, they covered their noses and exclaimed, “The fragrance is so intense!” Then they hurried away.

我明白自己喉咙、呼吸系统的脉轮已多年被尘垢熏染，必是文殊点香净化我脉道。果然，香炉的香烟冒出来后，变成两股烟柱，直直进入我的鼻子，但我闻不到任何香气。我的鼻子还闻不到天香，而两小童都嫌香气太重，忙离去。

I understood that the chakras and channels of my throat and respiratory system had been clouded by impurities for many years, and that Manjushri must have lit the incense to purify my channels. Sure enough, when the smoke rose from the burner, it formed two columns that flowed straight into my nostrils, yet I could not smell any fragrance at all. My nose was still unable to detect the heavenly incense, while the two young attendants found its fragrance too strong and hurried away.

香气进入鼻腔、肺、大脑，里面都发白光，感觉特清净。而且气脉开始畅通，很舒服。过一会儿，香燃完了，两小童来把大香炉抬去。我还看见空中有青狮在远远眺望。

The fragrance entered my nasal passages, lungs, and brain, all of which began to emit white light. I felt exceptionally pure and clear. My energy channels also began to flow freely, bringing a very comfortable sensation. After a while, the incense had burned out, and the two young attendants returned to carry away the large burner. I also saw a blue lion gazing from a great distance in the sky.

片刻功夫，两小童又折回来，一小童手拿一个三角形的小炉，说这叫“鼎炉”，每个小孔里放着一小撮檀香面似的香。那小童边点香边说：“这香是文殊菩萨自己配的，非常珍贵，我们都没有闻过。”另一小童说：“你怎这么多言。”香点着了，我说：“你们俩也一起闻香吧。”他们高兴地跪在香炉前。

A short while later, the two young attendants returned. One was carrying a small triangular burner, which he said was called a dinglu, or ritual cauldron. Each of its small holes contained a pinch of incense resembling powdered sandalwood. As he lit it, the attendant said, “Manjushri Bodhisattva prepared this incense himself. It is extremely precious; none of us has ever smelled it before.” The other attendant said, “Why are you so talkative?” Once the incense was lit, I said, “You two should enjoy the fragrance with me.” They happily knelt before the burner.

这时，文殊走来，把小香炉拿起来直接放在我鼻下，三个孔冒出的香气，两股进入鼻，一股进入天目。文殊说：“这香炉是专为修行人特制的。这香是我在五台山选上千种名贵木材制成，而且里面又放了很多名贵中药。这些木材都是上万年的，非常难得。我自己也未闻此香。做三包，其余两包供养了释迦佛和阿弥陀佛，这包你用。”

At that moment, Manjushri approached, picked up the small incense burner, and held it directly beneath my nose. Fragrance rose from its three openings: two streams entered my nostrils, while the third entered my heavenly eye. Manjushri said, “This incense burner was specially made for practitioners. I selected more than a thousand kinds of precious wood on Mount Wutai to make this incense, and I also added many valuable medicinal herbs. These woods are all tens of thousands of years old and are exceedingly rare. Even I have never smelled this incense before. Three packets were made. I offered the other two to Shakyamuni Buddha and Amitabha Buddha. This packet is for you.”

我闻听此言，连声称谢。只觉香气进脑，整个大脑倍觉清醒异常，而且充满琉璃一样的白光。

Hearing this, I thanked him repeatedly. I felt the fragrance enter my brain, and my entire mind became extraordinarily clear and alert, filled with a white light resembling luminous crystal.

我说：“有青苹果的香味。”

I said, “It smells like green apples.”

文殊菩萨说：“不是，是极乐世界青莲的香味。”

Manjushri Bodhisattva replied, “No. It is the fragrance of blue lotuses from the Land of Ultimate Bliss.”

我仔细闻，果然是莲花味更确切一点。因气味很清雅、不浊。文殊说：“此香中只有一种香料就是青莲，是用了极乐世界的，可能此味偏重。”

I smelled it carefully and realized that the fragrance was indeed more accurately described as that of a lotus. It was delicate, pure, and free of any heaviness. Manjushri said, “There is only one aromatic ingredient in this incense: blue lotus. It comes from the Land of Ultimate Bliss, so perhaps its fragrance is particularly strong.”

香点完了，文殊用手指拔了拔香灰，底下还有一点火星和一点香粉未燃尽，文殊自己把鼻凑上去闻了一下说：“真的不错。”文殊还说：“此香不仅净化脉道，还醒脑提神。”我又忙谢文殊。

When the incense had burned out, Manjushri stirred the ashes with his fingers. There were still a few glowing embers and a little unburned incense powder at the bottom. He leaned down and smelled it himself, saying, “This really is excellent.” He added, “This incense not only purifies the energy channels but also clears and refreshes the mind.” I hurried to thank him again.

文殊说：“没有什么事了，我要回五台山。”边说边从云端隐去，我只远远看见青狮露了一下头。

Manjushri said, “There is nothing more to do. I must return to Mount Wutai.” As he spoke, he disappeared into the clouds. I caught only a distant glimpse of the blue lion's head.

我从定中出来，感鼻子异常通透，喉部、大脑清凉，不再咳嗽。脑部神清气爽，感觉整个房间都比以前亮了很多。

When I emerged from meditation, my nose felt extraordinarily clear, my throat and brain felt cool, and I was no longer coughing. My mind felt fresh and invigorated, and the entire room seemed much brighter than before.

起坐后吃了三颗核桃、一个苹果当作早餐。忽想起昨天我在供桌上香，并合掌暗想：“恭敬礼拜十方三世诸佛。”这时，忽从空中现出几尊佛，均合掌说：“善哉，大光明如来。”

After getting up from my meditation seat, I ate three walnuts and an apple for breakfast. Suddenly, I remembered that yesterday I had offered incense at the altar, joined my palms, and silently thought, “With reverence, I pay homage to all Buddhas of the ten directions and the three periods of time.” At that moment, several Buddhas suddenly appeared in the sky. They all joined their palms and said, “Excellent, Great Radiance Tathagata.”

我未作任何思考。但现在想起来，是什么意思呢？是说我将来成佛叫大光明如来，还是宿世成佛叫大光明如来。不过，叫什么都无所谓，只要坚信自己一定能成就就行了。其实成不成佛也不重要，只要能完成自己的宿愿就行。

I had not given it any thought at the time. But now, looking back, I wonder what it meant. Were they saying that I would become a Buddha in the future called Great Radiance Tathagata, or that I had attained Buddhahood in a previous life under that name? In any case, the name does not matter. What matters is maintaining firm confidence that I can accomplish my goal. In truth, whether or not I become a Buddha is not the most important thing; what matters is fulfilling the vow I made in a previous life.

中午吃完饭，睡不着，但觉大脑里酸麻胀痒，而且呼吸太通透，吸气时总觉得把头都吸满了，很不习惯。很想头向下立在那才舒服，但自己做不了头倒立，只好把身子搭在床沿，头顶在地上的垫子上。顶了一小时，头脸发热，舒服了一点。

After lunch, I could not fall asleep. My brain felt sore, numb, swollen, and itchy, and my breathing felt so clear and unobstructed that whenever I inhaled, I had the sensation that my entire head was filling with air. I found this very unfamiliar. I felt that I would be more comfortable standing upside down on my head, but since I could not perform a headstand, I draped my body over the edge of the bed and rested the crown of my head on a mat on the floor. I stayed in that position for an hour. My head and face grew warm, and I felt somewhat more comfortable.

又开始打坐。这时，感觉颈部气管处白光流动，同时痒，想咳嗽，但咳也不管用，光始终在运行。

I began meditating again. This time, I felt white light flowing through the area of the windpipe in my neck. The area was itchy, and I felt the urge to cough, but coughing did not help; the light continued to flow.

忽颈中有一飞速旋转的东西，上大下细，像花蕊，而且上面缠着一根脉，旋转一阵，忽反向旋转。这时，缠绕在上面的脉就顺势解开，那个东西开始展开，竟变得像荷花的莲蓬，向下垂下来，感觉上面有六十四孔，正好连接心轮的六十四脉(不确切，只是感觉)。

Suddenly, something appeared in my neck, spinning rapidly. It was broad at the top and narrow at the bottom, resembling the center of a flower, with an energy channel wrapped around it. After spinning for a while, it abruptly reversed direction. The channel wrapped around it then unwound with the movement, and the object began to unfold. It actually came to resemble the seedpod of a lotus, hanging downward. I sensed that it had sixty-four openings, corresponding exactly to the sixty-four channels of the heart chakra, though I was not certain and was relying only on my subjective impression.

而且此脉轮打开后，需日久得心水滋养才能成就功德：如可以听懂一切众生语言，而且语音柔软，一切众生也能听懂其说话，而且不管众生离此人距离远近，听声都同样清晰等等。

After this chakra opens, however, it must be nourished over time by the water of the heart before its virtues can fully develop. For example, one might become able to understand the languages of all sentient beings and speak in a gentle voice that all beings could understand. Regardless of how far away they were, they would hear the person's words with equal clarity, and so on.

这时，我不再守喉部，便开始守顶轮，因眉心脉轮已开不必守。守顶轮很长时间，忽听到一声鹤叫，见有一鹤鸣叫着飞到我面前，同时见空中有祥云，还有很多鹤。

At that point, I stopped focusing on the throat and began focusing on the crown chakra, since the brow chakra had already opened and no longer required attention. After concentrating on the crown chakra for a long time, I suddenly heard a crane call. I saw a crane crying out as it flew toward me. I also saw auspicious clouds and many other cranes in the sky.

我继续守顶轮，忽又听到一阵持咒的声音，好像云南西双版纳听南传佛教僧唱晚课的声音，声音像在唱，悠扬悦耳(听不太清楚)，是用梵文。

I continued focusing on the crown chakra when I suddenly heard the sound of chanting mantras. It resembled the evening chanting of Theravada Buddhist monks in Xishuangbanna, Yunnan. The voices seemed to sing in a melodious, pleasing manner, though I could not make out the words clearly. The chanting was in Sanskrit.

这时有声音说，释迦牟尼在帮我持咒。而且忽见空中似有释迦佛像，释迦头上盛开莲花，莲花上又有释迦佛在唱诵。

Then a voice said that Shakyamuni Buddha was helping me chant the mantras. I suddenly seemed to see an image of Shakyamuni Buddha in the sky. A lotus flower bloomed above his head, and another image of Shakyamuni Buddha appeared on that lotus, chanting.

同时，我看到自己顶上有万道金光从头顶每一毛孔透入，头顶发凉，而且忽然头、身子消失，只有一根蓝色粗壮的脉管耸立，而且头上虚空有风火同时出现，风助火势，呜呜作响。只一刹那，我又回归，所有境界消失。(释迦佛持咒的意思我大略能懂，像是在为我曾经的每一世消业、讲法。)

At the same time, I saw ten thousand rays of golden light entering through every pore on the crown of my head, which felt cool. Suddenly, my head and body disappeared, leaving only a thick blue channel standing upright. Above my head, in the empty sky, wind and fire appeared together; the wind fanned the flames, producing a deep, whistling sound. In an instant, I returned to normal, and all these visions disappeared. (I could roughly understand the meaning of Shakyamuni Buddha's mantra chanting: it seemed that he was helping me purify the karma of each of my past lives and expounding the Dharma to me.)

从自己个人的切身体验认为，气脉的转化或脉轮的开启，除非心性悟入空性，达到一定的寂静状态，即定力。不管是自己开启或受外力相助，那才能顺利进行，否则百分之九十会出偏。

Based on my own personal experience, I believe that the transformation of energy channels or the opening of chakras can proceed smoothly only when one has realized emptiness in one's own nature and attained a certain degree of stillness—that is, meditative concentration. Whether the opening occurs through one's own efforts or with the assistance of external forces, this condition is necessary; otherwise, in ninety percent of cases, things may go wrong.

其中的微妙把握确是由自己的个体情况而定，不是看书就能懂得，有时师父也无能为力。不知密宗的开启脉轮是怎样的体验。

The subtle art of handling these processes depends on each individual's particular circumstances. It cannot be understood simply by reading books, and sometimes even a teacher is powerless to help. I wonder what the experience of opening the chakras is like in Esoteric Buddhism.

我想：不管怎样，如不能悟入性空之理，一味追求生理上的转化，那很危险。而且即使转化，也不可能彻底究竟。

I think that, whatever the circumstances, it is dangerous to pursue physiological transformations single-mindedly without realizing the principle of emptiness in one's true nature. Even if such transformations occur, they cannot lead to complete and ultimate realization.

这几天空余时间除打坐外看《楞严经》，重读《楞严经》受益匪浅。有时还翻看《黄帝内经》，心寂静下来，再看《黄帝内经》，对经络的运行感到更明了。

During my spare time over the past few days, apart from meditating, I have been reading the Shurangama Sutra. Rereading it has been immensely beneficial. I also occasionally look through the Huangdi Neijing(The Yellow Emperor's Inner Canon). When my mind settles into stillness, I find the workings of the energy channels described in the text much easier to understand.

THE RETREAT JOURNAL · 32

四月十二日

April 12

早六点起床，练瑜珈，动功，洗漱到七点半。

I got up at six in the morning and practiced yoga and dynamic exercises. I finished washing and getting ready at seven thirty.

上午打坐，继续守顶轮，心渐渐沉寂。

I meditated in the morning, continuing to focus on the crown chakra, and my mind gradually settled into stillness.

这时，忽看到密勒日巴尊者又唱又跳，奔跑腾挪。一会儿，他在喜马拉雅山的一处空地上（四周是雪山），用石头砌一个壇城，石头为白色、扁圆形，砌好后，又用牛粪把那壇城的地铺好，在石屋的四周放了一圈金碗，当作油灯全部点亮。

At that moment, I suddenly saw Venerable Milarepa singing and dancing, running and leaping about. A little later, in an open space in the Himalayas surrounded by snow-covered mountains, he built a mandala out of stones. The stones were white and flat and rounded. After finishing the structure, he spread cow dung over the floor of the mandala and arranged a circle of golden bowls around the stone hut, lighting all of them as oil lamps.

而后，又脱下自己褴褛的衣服披在石屋上，衣服忽变化一个帐子，把整个石屋全围了起来。

Then he took off his tattered clothes and draped them over the stone hut. His clothes suddenly transformed into a canopy that completely enclosed the entire structure.

这时，尊者用手指着石屋，我忽发现自己坐在了石屋中，四面全是圆石头砌的墙。

At that moment, the Venerable pointed toward the stone hut, and I suddenly discovered that I was sitting inside it, surrounded on all sides by walls built from rounded stones.

这时，尊者念动咒语，只见从空中出现一个膀粗腰圆的神，戴着两只大耳环，眼很大，说：“尊者，我为此山的大力耳神，不知尊者有何吩咐，我当效力。”

The Venerable then recited a mantra. A deity appeared in the sky, broad-shouldered and thick-waisted, wearing two large earrings and possessing enormous eyes. He said, “Venerable one, I am the Powerful-Eared Deity of this mountain. What instructions do you have for me? I stand ready to serve.”

尊者说：“你先在此等候，一会儿有八十位空行母要来。”

The Venerable said, “Wait here for now. Eighty dakinis will arrive shortly.”

一会儿，只见空中笑声朗朗，衣服的环佩玎珰作响，八十位空行母鱼贯而来。其中领头的一位笑说：“尊者，是何人在此作供养。光焰如此明亮，香气浓郁芬芳。”

A little while later, I heard cheerful laughter in the sky and the clear tinkling of ornaments on their garments. Eighty dakinis arrived one after another. The woman leading them smiled and said, “Venerable one, who is making offerings here? The light shines so brilliantly, and the fragrance is so rich and sweet.”

尊者说：“是汉地的一位行者，在此修法身，需你们的帮助。”

The Venerable replied, “A practitioner from the Han Chinese lands is cultivating the Dharmakaya here and needs your help.”

空行母说：“尊者壇城如此庄严，我们都进不去了。”

The dakinis said, “Venerable one, your mandala is so magnificent that none of us can enter it.”

尊者摘下脖子上的一串念珠扔向石屋上空，只见念珠在石屋顶上放光、旋转，石屋上似有一个圆形光口，空行母们从光口而入。

The Venerable took a string of prayer beads from around his neck and tossed it into the air above the stone hut. The beads emitted light and spun above the roof, where a circular opening of light seemed to appear. The dakinis entered through this opening.

从外边看，石屋很小，但空行母们进来后，我觉屋子很大，还有余地。

From the outside, the stone hut looked very small, but once the dakinis had entered, I felt that it was spacious, with plenty of room to spare.

空行母进来后，其中一女说：“是观音菩萨。”便行跪礼。我说：“我正在开顶轮，需大家帮助。”领头的女子说：“大家行动吧。”

After the dakinis entered, one of them said, “It is Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva,” and knelt in reverence. I said, “I am in the process of opening the crown chakra and need your help.” The woman leading them said, “Everyone, get to work.”

忽然，我看见自己的头发向四周炸开，在顶上形成一圆盘状，每根头发上都似坐着一位空行母。

Suddenly, I saw my hair spread outward in every direction, forming a disk on top of my head. It seemed that a dakini was sitting on each strand of hair.

而后，我看到空行母们在奋力洗顶上的一面大锅(因以前开顶时，见顶上有一块凹下去，像雷达接收器，空行母们正在洗这个地方)。

Then I saw the dakinis working hard to wash a large pot on the crown of my head. (When my crown had opened previously, I had seen a recessed area there resembling a radar receiver. The dakinis were washing that very place.)

一位空行母说：“这个锅好大呀，是做什么用的。”领头的空行母说：“是开顶轮用的，这锅能接收诸天世界的全部信息，能量很大，我们一会洗净后，要速速脱身，否则被锅吸入，就不好出来了。”

One dakini said, “What an enormous pot! What is it used for?” The leader replied, “It is used to open the crown chakra. This pot can receive all the information from the heavenly realms and possesses tremendous energy. Once we finish cleaning it, we must get away quickly. Otherwise, if it draws us inside, it will be difficult to get back out.”

并又说：“谁拿了香洱海的香粉，可洒入锅里，气味就没有这么臊。”众空行母凡是带香粉的，纷纷把香粉洒入锅里。

She added, “If anyone has incense powder from Xiang'erhai, sprinkle some into the pot; that will make the smell less foul.” All the dakinis who had incense powder began sprinkling it into the pot.

一会儿，锅里开始幽明，发出幽明的白光，光愈来愈强。只听领头的空行母说：“快走！”便一齐从石屋射出，后站空中观看。

After a while, the pot began to glow faintly, emitting a dim white light that grew stronger and stronger. I heard the leader of the dakinis shout, “Quick, get out!” They all shot out of the stone hut together and then hovered in the sky to watch.

密勒日巴对大力神说：“一会儿，有一股光从石屋射出，你要用掌力与它相抵，再把它压回去。”

Milarepa said to the powerful deity, “In a moment, a beam of light will shoot out of the stone hut. You must resist it with the force of your palm and then press it back inside.”

这时，只见一道光柱从石屋射出，大力神用右掌与光相抵，然后说：“这是谁人发出的光，力量太大了。”又把左掌也用上去。

At that moment, a column of light shot out of the stone hut. The powerful deity pressed his right palm against it and said, “Who has emitted this light? Its power is enormous!” He then brought his left palm into action as well.

尊者说：“还能顶得住吗？”大力神说：“还行！”

The Venerable asked, “Can you still hold it back?” The powerful deity replied, “I can manage!”

这时，我忽观自己身内中空，有大力神正站在自己身体里面，用掌发力向自己顶上推着。持续了一阵，自己忽看到晴空、祥云，顶上凹下来的一片又向上凸起，而且向上浮起。

At that moment, I suddenly perceived that the inside of my body was hollow. The powerful deity was standing inside me, pressing upward toward the crown of my head with the force of his palms. After this continued for a while, I suddenly saw a clear sky and auspicious clouds. The recessed area on my crown rose into a bulge and then began to lift upward.

这时，大力神收掌退回空中。只见尊者拿出许多珠宝赠与大力神，说：“辛苦了。”大力神接受了，并跪地谢过，而后消失在空中。

At that point, the powerful deity withdrew his palms and returned to the sky. The Venerable took out a great many jewels and gave them to him, saying, “Thank you for your hard work.” The deity accepted the gifts, knelt to express his gratitude, and then disappeared into the sky.

尊者随后便坐在石屋前面，敲一个木鱼，并摇手中一个铃，说；“菩萨，该醒了。”这样反复说了几次，我看到自己头部变得异常空阔，而且有各种光，光中，只见自己闭目合十坐在里面。

The Venerable then sat in front of the stone hut, struck a wooden fish drum, and shook a bell in his hand, saying, “Bodhisattva, it is time to awaken.” After he repeated this several times, I saw that the inside of my head had become extraordinarily spacious. Various kinds of light filled it, and within that light I saw myself sitting with my eyes closed and palms joined.

忽又看到一朵莲花，忽从光中化生，从顶上穿出，而后在头顶开放。莲花晶莹剔透，鲜艳欲滴。

Suddenly, I saw a lotus flower materialize from the light. It emerged through the crown of my head and then blossomed above it. The lotus was crystalline and translucent, its colors so vivid that it seemed to glisten with fresh moisture.

这时，凡地的一切都消失了。

At that moment, everything in the ordinary human world disappeared.

我看到观世音菩萨穿白色衣裙，坐莲花座，端坐在云海之上，面前逐渐出现八仙，还听到韩湘子吹笛音，都在祝贺。

I saw Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva dressed in white robes and seated upright on a lotus throne above a sea of clouds. The Eight Immortals gradually appeared before me, and I also heard Han Xiangzi playing his flute. They were all offering congratulations.

而且还有无数仙人环绕。又看到诸天从空中出现，有声音：“帝释天祝贺菩萨归来。”“忉利天祝贺菩萨归来。”“兜率天祝贺……。”“大梵天祝……。”

Countless other immortals surrounded them. Then I saw beings from the various heavens appearing in the sky, accompanied by voices saying, “The Heaven of Indra congratulates the Bodhisattva on returning.” “The Heaven of the Thirty-Three congratulates the Bodhisattva on returning.” “The Tushita Heaven offers its congratulations...” “The Great Brahma Heaven offers its congratulations...”

诸天一一发出祝贺的声音，而且在空中一一变现。

One by one, the heavenly realms voiced their congratulations, each manifesting in the sky in turn.

这时，释迦牟尼佛在空中出现，未说一字，忽变作大魔王的样子，而且显示地狱种种黑暗。并有音说：“此诸种境界皆为妄想生成。”

At that moment, Shakyamuni Buddha appeared in the sky. Without uttering a word, he suddenly transformed into the likeness of a great demon king and revealed the many forms of darkness in the hell realms. A voice then said, “All these states and visions are generated by deluded thoughts.”

我说：“既为妄想，即为幻化，又怕什么呢？”声音又说：“菩萨得真三昧也。”我笑了笑，未再说话。这时，从定中出来。

I said, “Since they arise from deluded thoughts, they are illusory transformations. What is there to fear?” The voice replied, “The Bodhisattva has attained true samadhi.” I smiled and said nothing more. At that point, I emerged from meditation.

从定中出来后，嗅到自己身上汗臭味，房里也味道很重、很脏，感觉像住在猪圈鸡窝一样。可能是鼻子、眼睛这几天气脉转化的缘故。

After emerging from meditation, I smelled the sour odor of sweat on my body. The room also seemed to smell very strong and feel very dirty, almost as though I were living in a pigsty or a chicken coop. Perhaps this was due to the recent transformations I had experienced in the energy channels associated with my nose and eyes.

好在心不被境转，还较安定。前几天无此种感觉，房间自己每天打扫，应该还算整洁干净。

Fortunately, my mind was not carried away by these perceptions and remained relatively calm. I had not experienced this sensation in previous days, and I cleaned the room every day, so it should still have been reasonably neat and clean.

但在定中见一切都从光中化生，无尘垢染着。出定后，房间一切都没有光彩，对比太强烈，六根一下适应不过来。

But in meditation, I had seen everything emerging from light, untouched by dust or impurity. After leaving that state, everything in the room seemed devoid of radiance. The contrast was so strong that my six sense faculties could not adjust immediately.

而且这几天修持，六根也比以前通透，脉道洁净。

Moreover, after several days of practice, my six sense faculties seemed clearer than before, and my energy channels felt purified.

起座后，在院内行般舟，觉身如幻化。

After rising from my seat, I practiced Pratyutpanna walking meditation in the courtyard and felt that my body was like an illusion.

前几天心能湛然寂静，但现在似觉心连光也不存在。如幻影，但还有迹可寻，如人消失，影子还在。

In previous days, my mind had been able to remain profoundly still and clear. Now, however, I seemed to feel that even the light within the mind no longer existed. It was like an illusion that still left traces behind, as if a person had disappeared but their shadow remained.

返观自己脸、皮肤、骨骼像是一个物体的外包装。

Looking back at my own face, skin, and bones, I felt they were like the outer packaging of an object.

行完般舟，回屋内点三支香，点了两个蜡做的莲花灯，洗了一些苹果放供桌上，然后合十默想：“我在凡夫地，以此贫乏的东西供养十方三世如来与诸天菩萨。”

After completing the walking meditation, I returned to the room, lit three sticks of incense and two lotus-shaped candles, washed some apples, and placed them on the altar. Then I joined my palms and silently thought, “As an ordinary being, I offer these meager things to the Tathagatas and heavenly Bodhisattvas of the ten directions and the three periods of time.”

这时，我竟看到诸天都有我供桌上的东西，灯与果遍满三千大千世界。

At that moment, I actually saw the offerings from my altar appearing throughout the heavenly realms. The lamps and fruit filled the entire trichiliocosm, the great three-thousandfold world system.

这时，朗公进来说：“知菩萨今日证果，特来道贺。”我还礼。看到朗公在供桌前拜佛。

At that moment, Master Langgong entered and said, “I have learned that the Bodhisattva has attained realization today, and I have come especially to offer my congratulations.” I returned his greeting and watched him bow before the Buddha at the altar.

朗公礼完佛，对我说：“外面众仙来道贺。”我抬头看门外空中，有八仙等人，他们说：“菩萨，我们知你在闭关，只进去道贺，停留片刻马上就走，决不讨扰，请让韦陀菩萨放我们进去。”

After paying homage to the Buddha, Master Langgong said to me, “The immortals outside have come to offer their congratulations.” I looked up into the sky beyond the doorway and saw the Eight Immortals and others. They said, “Bodhisattva, we know you are in retreat. We will come in only to congratulate you, stay for a brief moment, and leave immediately. We will not disturb you. Please ask Bodhisattva Weituo to let us enter.”

我告诉韦陀让他们进来。

I told Weituo to let them in.

这时，见门开了，王母带众仙先进来。王母身边两小童带两篮五万年的桃送上，并两只可爱的玉兔。

Then the door opened, and the Queen Mother of the West entered first with the immortals. Two young attendants beside her presented two baskets of peaches said to be fifty thousand years old, along with two adorable jade rabbits.

而后，两大力士搬一个大香炉而入。有小童说：“文殊菩萨祝贺。这香炉是用普通黄金铸成，有一万年，其中玄妙菩萨以后会知。”说完，告辞。

Next, two powerful attendants carried in a large incense burner. One young attendant said, “Manjushri Bodhisattva sends his congratulations. This incense burner was cast from ordinary gold and is ten thousand years old. The mysteries it contains will become clear to the Bodhisattva in time.” After speaking, he took his leave.

又有空中出现一坠满金银珠宝、钻石玛瑙的碾药槽，只见有小童说：“是普贤如来祝贺。愿菩萨将来精细药物由此槽出，治世界病苦，广利有情。”

Then a medicine-grinding trough appeared in the sky, adorned with gold, silver, jewels, diamonds, and agate. A young attendant said, “This is a congratulatory gift from Samantabhadra Tathagata. May the Bodhisattva one day prepare finely compounded medicines in this trough to heal the world's illnesses and suffering and bring extensive benefit to sentient beings.”

远见空中有普贤菩萨的像。话毕，隐去。

In the distance, I saw an image of Samantabhadra Bodhisattva in the sky. When the attendant had finished speaking, he disappeared.

这时，忽面前的地下，涌出宝莲花，地藏王菩萨端坐其上，而后从莲花座走下来，身边的谛听口里衔一枯枝。

At that moment, a jeweled lotus suddenly emerged from the ground before me, with Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva seated upright upon it. He then stepped down from the lotus throne. By his side, his companion Diting held a withered branch in its mouth.

地藏菩萨用手拿起，说：“此枯枝从地狱寸草不生的地方化生而出，是地狱诸苦化现，希菩萨不要忘记地狱众生。以后见此枯枝，当想起地狱众生。”

Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva picked up the branch and said, “This withered branch has manifested from a place in hell where not a blade of grass can grow. It embodies the suffering of the hell realms. I hope the Bodhisattva will not forget the beings in hell. Whenever you see this branch in the future, remember the sentient beings in the hell realms.”

我点点头。地藏菩萨留下枯枝，坐莲花隐去。

I nodded. Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva left the withered branch behind, returned to his lotus throne, and disappeared.

这时，忽见空中又有释迦佛显像，而且在光中，有诸世界重重叠叠的佛显像。

Then I suddenly saw another manifestation of Shakyamuni Buddha in the sky. Within the light, Buddhas from countless worlds appeared in layer upon layer of overlapping visions.

释迦说：“今菩萨化生此世界弘法利生，诸天祝贺，甚稀有难得。希菩萨能广弘佛法，利益有情。我当以地涌金莲相助。”

Shakyamuni said, “The Bodhisattva has now manifested in this world to spread the Dharma and benefit sentient beings. The heavenly realms have come to offer congratulations. This is exceedingly rare and precious. I hope the Bodhisattva will widely propagate the Buddha's teachings and benefit sentient beings. I shall assist you by causing golden lotuses to emerge from the earth.”

说这话时，地上、空中同时涌出无数硕大的金色莲花。诸佛隐去。

As he spoke, countless enormous golden lotus flowers emerged simultaneously from the ground and the sky. The Buddhas then disappeared.

这时，诸仙告退，我看到门又关上。

At that point, the immortals took their leave, and I watched the door close again.

下午把进关时买的小米放入香炉，第一用来插香，第二用来供养诸佛。

In the afternoon, I placed the millet I had bought when entering retreat into the incense burner. First, I intended to use it as a base for holding the incense sticks; second, I wished to offer it to the Buddhas.

我点香，真诚礼佛，说：“希望能用这米供养十方三世佛，使人世界众生能风调雨顺，不要受无粮之灾。”

I lit the incense and sincerely paid homage to the Buddhas, saying, “May this millet serve as an offering to the Buddhas of the ten directions and the three periods of time. May the beings of the human world enjoy favorable weather and good harvests, and may they never suffer the calamity of having no grain.”

只听空中纷纷回声：“善哉，善哉！”而且看到诸世界诸佛俱从空中抓了一把小米放入此香炉中。

I heard voices resounding from the sky, one after another: “Excellent! Excellent!” I also saw Buddhas from various worlds each reach down from the sky, take a handful of millet, and place it into this incense burner.

自己还有个坏毛病，吃东西太快，明天开始改正。

I have another bad habit: I eat too quickly. Starting tomorrow, I will work on correcting it.

这个毛病已改了无数次了，这么简单的习气，改起来都这么难！

I have tried to correct this habit countless times already. Even such a simple ingrained habit is so difficult to change!

THE RETREAT JOURNAL · 33

四月十三日

April 13

早三点醒来，再无睡意。但还是躺在床上，直到四点寺院上早课的打板声响起，才起床。

I woke up at three in the morning and could not fall asleep again. Nevertheless, I stayed in bed until four, when the sound of the wooden board being struck at the temple to announce the morning service finally prompted me to get up.

洗漱后，做瑜珈呼吸法，后动功，一直到七点。

After washing up, I practiced yogic breathing exercises, followed by dynamic exercises, continuing until seven o'clock.

上香、点灯供佛，然后吃了三颗核桃、一个苹果、一杯水当作早餐。

I offered incense and lit lamps before the Buddha, then ate three walnuts and an apple and drank a glass of water for breakfast.
