给自己拍了两张相，发现自己什么时候变得又老又丑，想曾经也是很漂亮的。

I took two photographs of myself and realized how old and unattractive I had become. I remembered that I had once been quite beautiful.

丑也罢，老也罢，即使在家每天做美容保养，也是迟早的事，青春不会永驻，生老病死无常。

Whether ugly or old, this is inevitable, even if I were to stay at home and practice beauty treatments and skincare every day. Youth never lasts forever, and birth, aging, sickness, and death are impermanent.

自己修证佛法，能从心理上彻底改变自己，不再迷茫于各种妄想幻境当中，能从生老病死中解脱出来，进而帮助那些在烦恼苦海中沉浮的众生，即使付出任何人世间的代价有什么遗憾呢！

Through practicing and realizing the Buddha's teachings, I can transform myself inwardly and completely, no longer losing myself in deluded thoughts and illusory experiences. If I can liberate myself from birth, aging, sickness, and death, and then help sentient beings who are tossed about in the bitter sea of afflictions, what would there be to regret, even if I had to pay any price in this world?

这个色壳子迟早要脱去的，何况还只是一个坚固妄想而已。

This physical shell will eventually be shed anyway. Besides, it is nothing more than a deeply ingrained delusion.

众生着相，一生为这个色壳子所累！

Sentient beings cling to appearances and spend their entire lives burdened by this physical shell!

生命生生死死，诸法幻幻灭灭，有什么意思？！有什么看不开，放不下呢？！

Life passes through birth and death again and again, while all phenomena appear and disappear like illusions. What meaning is there in all this?! What is there that I cannot see through or let go of?!

上午看《楞严经》，快中午时，忽感觉困盹，便放书斜躺在床上，闭目养神。

In the morning, I read the Shurangama Sutra. Shortly before noon, I suddenly felt drowsy, so I put the book down, reclined diagonally on the bed, and closed my eyes to rest.

此时，忽有淫欲生起，不是从心，而是从海底轮，感受竟愈来愈强烈，但心中无任何念头。

At that moment, sexual desire suddenly arose, not from the mind but from the root chakra. The sensation grew increasingly intense, yet no corresponding thoughts arose in my mind.

有些奇怪，急正身打坐，修师父教授的大光明法第一部。

Finding this rather strange, I quickly straightened up, sat in meditation, and practiced the first part of the Great Radiance Method taught by my master.

以前观自己倒立的像马上就很清晰，但这次却是观到在座位下方有一支像大蜡烛燃起的火苗，火苗来回摆动。

Previously, when I visualized an inverted image of myself, it would become clear almost immediately. This time, however, I saw a flame beneath my meditation seat, resembling a large candle that had just been lit. The flame swayed back and forth.

我注意调息，等呼吸快若有若无时，火苗摆动却并未停止，这是从未有过的现象。

I focused on regulating my breathing. When my breath became so subtle that it was almost imperceptible, the flame continued to sway. This had never happened before.

忽然火苗变成炽盛的火焰，继而更强大，变成像电焊一样猛烈吹出的光焰，白色，有风吹动的呜呜声。

Suddenly, the little flame became a blazing fire. It grew even more powerful, transforming into a torrent of radiant flames that burst forth with the intensity of an electric welding arc. The light was white, accompanied by a deep, whistling sound like wind blowing through it.

继而，光焰忽化为无比巨大的白色光流，像火流，但无焰，只有光明炽烈。

Then the radiant flames suddenly transformed into an immense stream of white light, like a river of fire without any actual flames, blazing with pure, intense luminosity.

只瞬间，光明的火流席卷而上，我被吞没了。

In an instant, this luminous torrent swept upward and engulfed me.

只觉得四肢百脉有暖热升起，但不是很强。

I felt warmth rising through my limbs and all my energy channels, though the sensation was not particularly strong.

光焰过后，全身忽疲软无力，只有一些暖暖的觉受。

After the blaze of light passed, my entire body suddenly became limp and powerless, leaving only a gentle sensation of warmth.

这时，正好护关人送饭来，我站起身，觉头旋晕，勉强用心力护持身体把饭取回来。

Just then, the person responsible for bringing meals to those in retreat arrived with my food. I stood up and felt dizzy, as though my head were spinning. I had to rely on sheer mental effort to steady myself and bring the meal back.

在院中，只觉身体像游魂，软绵绵的，看到身体里全是流淌的光明流，像火山喷出的岩浆从山体淌下。

As I crossed the courtyard, I felt like a disembodied spirit, my body weak and limp. I saw streams of luminous energy flowing throughout my body, like lava pouring down the sides of a volcano.

饭后躺在床上，全身无一点力，似觉刚大死后又还生。

After eating, I lay down on the bed, completely devoid of strength. It felt as though I had undergone a great death and then returned to life.

躺了一会儿，全身更难受了，酸麻胀困，无力，燥热，而且耳朵很热，觉有暖暖的光溢出耳轮外，全身变成轻盈的发光体，只心轮处一直非常清凉，心很安定。

After lying there for a while, my whole body became even more uncomfortable. I felt soreness, numbness, swelling, exhaustion, weakness, and intense heat. My ears were especially hot, and I sensed warm light spilling beyond the rims of my ears. My entire body seemed to have become a light, luminous form. Only the area of the heart chakra remained consistently very cool, and my mind was calm and settled.

躺在那，没有其它感觉了，只觉得像在生死之间晃荡，像生命又经历了一次轮回。

As I lay there, I had no other distinct sensations. I simply felt as though I were wavering between life and death, as if my life had passed through another cycle of rebirth.

想刚才发起的火光明巨烈，必是性火，性火真火。

Reflecting on the fierce blaze of light that had just arisen, I concluded that it must have been the fire of one's innate nature—the true fire of one's nature.

因心中无欲，性火发动时，引起生殖系统的习气而多生淫欲的感觉。

Because there was no desire in my mind, the arising of this fire of innate nature must have triggered habitual tendencies in the reproductive system, giving rise to strong sensations of sexual desire.

况师父的大光明法第一步必是直从欲根入手，日久功深，直断淫根。

Moreover, the first step of my master's Great Radiance Method must work directly at the root of desire. With sustained practice and deepening effort over time, it aims to sever the root of sexual desire itself.

不知其他人转化色根时是怎样体验。

I wonder what other people experience when transforming the roots of sensual desire.

淫根断时，必是像经历一次生死轮回。

When the root of sexual desire is severed, it must feel like passing through another cycle of birth and death.

因从此，生命能量将逆流而上，向下流动的门已基本不再开启。

From that point onward, the energy of life would flow upward in the opposite direction, and the gateway through which it flows downward would essentially no longer open.

在床上躺一个小时后，体力渐渐恢复。

After lying in bed for an hour, my strength gradually returned.

身体感觉稍燥热，但已不是很难受，只是稍疲劳而已。

My body still felt somewhat overheated and dry, but the discomfort had eased considerably, leaving only mild fatigue.

此光明不同于拙火，拙火升起时，很热，真息进入百脉后，软绵绵的很舒服。

This luminosity was different from inner heat. When inner heat arises, the body becomes very hot, but when the true breath enters all the energy channels, the resulting sensation is soft, gentle, and deeply comfortable.

而此光明却是像把身心一下烧得灰飞烟灭，又重生。

This luminosity, by contrast, felt as though it had instantly burned my body and mind to ashes, only for me to be reborn.

但凭以往经验气脉转化不可一次而就，因染污的严重程度必经过无数次才可以究竟，脱胎换骨。

However, based on my previous experience, the transformation of the energy channels cannot be completed in a single session. The degree of accumulated impurity means that countless repetitions may be necessary before the process reaches its ultimate conclusion and brings about a complete transformation.

如心性不能转化，气脉转化总在反复。

If one's fundamental nature of mind does not transform, the transformation of the energy channels will continue to fluctuate and repeat itself.

整个下午，像重感冒似的，但不烧、不昏沉，也睡不着觉，情绪不够爽朗，稍有灰暗。

Throughout the afternoon, I felt as though I had a severe cold, yet I had no fever, no mental dullness, and could not fall asleep. My mood was not particularly bright and felt somewhat gloomy.

这几天大便次数还多，一天三至四次左右，小便正常。

My bowel movements had also been frequent over the past few days, occurring about three or four times a day, while urination remained normal.

虽不吃早晚饭，但水果吃的较多。

Although I did not eat breakfast or dinner as full meals, I ate quite a lot of fruit.

想想人这个肉体，真是没什么意思！

When I think about this human body of flesh, it really seems rather pointless!

中午睡不着，便躺了一会，出去行般舟，但没走几圈，却连眼睛都快睁不开。

At noon, I could not sleep, so I lay down for a while and then went outside to practice Pratyutpanna walking meditation. But after walking only a few circuits, I could hardly keep my eyes open.

我又回屋躺在床上，但躺下几秒钟，马上又特别精神，一点睡意也没有了。

I returned to my room and lay down again, but within seconds I became extremely alert, with not the slightest trace of sleepiness.

便就那么静静躺着，两腿困乏得厉害。

I simply lay there quietly, my legs feeling terribly exhausted.

这时，忽闭眼见自己的身体像一面镜子，房子里的家具摆设竟印在身体上，尤其是供桌与上面的佛像、供品清楚地全印在大腿上照出来，色彩都非常清晰。

At that moment, I closed my eyes and suddenly saw my body as though it were a mirror. The furniture and furnishings in the room appeared to be imprinted on my body. In particular, the altar, the Buddha images upon it, and the offerings were all clearly reflected on my thighs, with their colors rendered in remarkable detail.

以前也有此现象，但照的没这样清楚。

I had experienced this phenomenon before, but the images had never appeared so clearly.

便起来打坐。

I then got up and began meditating.

忽杂念生起，竟至静不下来，便诵六字大明咒。

Suddenly, distracting thoughts arose, and I found myself unable to settle into stillness. So I began reciting the Six-Syllable Great Bright Mantra: Om Mani Padme Hum.

观想身中空，有中脉直直的一根管子，六字大明咒的每个字都在中脉中从上到下排列着，而且随念咒的音上下移动。

I visualized my body as hollow, with a single straight channel running through its center. Each syllable of the Six-Syllable Great Bright Mantra was arranged vertically inside this central channel, moving up and down in accordance with the sound of my chanting.

观了一会儿，忽喉结处堵塞（在转化过程中，耳里反复听到打饱嗝之声从脉道发出），竟发不出声音，便不再继续念。

After maintaining this visualization for a while, I suddenly felt a blockage at my Adam's apple. During the transformation process, I had repeatedly heard sounds like belching coming from the energy channels inside my ears. Now I could no longer produce any sound, so I stopped chanting.

这时看喉轮前几天打开的像莲蓬一样的东西发幽暗色光，每个孔里下去一根脉与心轮连，那些孔里都放出白光，一道一道的。

At that point, I saw that the lotus-seedpod-like structure that had opened in my throat chakra several days earlier was emitting a dim light. From each of its openings, an energy channel descended and connected to the heart chakra. Each opening emitted its own distinct beam of white light.

忽莲蓬中间的一根脉，从两乳中间而下。

Suddenly, one of the channels at the center of the seedpod descended from the point between my breasts.

整个任脉看不到脉，像胸前有一处狭谷，有一道光从下边照上来。

I could no longer see the channel of the entire Conception Vessel. Instead, the area across my chest seemed like a narrow valley, with a beam of light shining upward from below.

同时看到从卵巢处伸出两脉直向上通过乳房进入头部。

At the same time, I saw two channels extending upward from the area of the ovaries, passing through the breasts and entering the head.

子宫感觉在向上提，同时感到乳腺缩了回去，看到胸腺像两片枯卷回去的树叶又打开了。

I felt that my uterus was being lifted upward. At the same time, I sensed my mammary glands retracting, and saw the thymus gland as though it were two withered, curled leaves that then unfolded again.

而且互相交换位置，震动、旋转，又有光顺任脉而上。

They also seemed to exchange positions, vibrate, and rotate, while more light flowed upward along the Conception Vessel.

这时，会阴处胀得很厉害，忽冲出一道光柱直上，但这道光柱却像一个软软的透明管状袋子在腹腔晃动（难道是中脉？）。

At that moment, I felt intense pressure in the perineal area. Suddenly, a column of light shot straight upward, but this column seemed like a soft, transparent, tubular sac swaying within the abdominal cavity. (Could this be the central channel?)

这时，忽从梵顶轮光中射下无数道光，自己看到光从每根头发孔里溢射出来，整个头里全是耀眼的光，似有白色的光点顺中脉而下。

Then countless rays of light suddenly descended from the radiance of the crown chakra. I saw light streaming out through every hair follicle, filling my entire head with dazzling brilliance. It seemed that white points of light were moving downward along the central channel.

这时，对面的远山中，有两人在吹号角，一轮太阳逐渐向我移近，我知这是大日如来的化身。

At that moment, I saw two people blowing horns among the distant mountains opposite me. A sun gradually moved closer toward me, and I knew it was a manifestation of Mahavairocana Buddha.

太阳直入我子宫部位，而后顺中脉而上，到顶轮时，整个身体忽然炸灭了，只剩下一块盆骨。

The sun entered directly into the area of my uterus and then moved upward along the central channel. When it reached the crown chakra, my entire body suddenly exploded and vanished, leaving only my pelvic bone.

我忽从定中出来。

I suddenly emerged from meditation.

六点多时，外面送来一小碗小西红柿和菠萝，我全吃掉了。

A little after six, someone brought me a small bowl of cherry tomatoes and pineapple. I ate them all.

想起这几天在气脉转化时，有时看自己密密麻麻缠绕在主脉上的脉解开后，百脉伸展的样子很像一株巨大的莲花。

I remembered that during the transformation of my energy channels over the past few days, I had sometimes seen the densely intertwined channels wrapped around the main channel unravel and spread outward, resembling an enormous lotus plant.

子宫是藕，心轮像花，顶轮也像花，喉轮处像莲蓬，下巴下边的脉像莲叶上的筋脉，中脉像茎。

The uterus resembled the lotus root; the heart chakra resembled a flower, as did the crown chakra; the throat chakra resembled a lotus seedpod; the channels beneath the chin resembled the veins of lotus leaves; and the central channel resembled the stem.

刚开始打开像，但慢慢就不像了。

At first, the structures seemed to resemble these things as they opened, but gradually they no longer did.

晚上吃完水果，在院里行般舟。

In the evening, after eating fruit, I practiced Pratyutpanna walking meditation in the courtyard.

这两天气温又下降，较冷而且风大。

The temperature had dropped again over the past two days, and it was cold and windy.

只走了几圈就回屋了，活动了一下而已。

I returned indoors after walking only a few circuits; it had been little more than a brief exercise session.

坐在屋中，余习发作，忽觉心空空荡荡，无所依傍，似乎身体也不存在，自己也靠不住了，有种怪怪的感觉。

Sitting in the room, I felt the effects of lingering habitual tendencies. Suddenly, my mind felt utterly empty and unsupported, with nothing to rely on. It seemed that my body did not exist either, and even my sense of self no longer felt dependable. The sensation was strange and unsettling.

身心都很空阔，又似用力太猛，有点疲劳。

Both mind and body felt vast and empty, yet it also seemed that I had exerted myself too intensely, leaving me somewhat fatigued.

桌上的书本，房里的东西似乎恍如记忆中的物品，熟悉而陌生。

The books on the table and the objects in the room seemed like things remembered from a distant memory: familiar, yet strangely unfamiliar.

感觉自己变的不真实，似乎自己是从未来时空回来的人，还未倒过时差。

I felt as though I had become unreal, almost like someone who had returned from a future point in time and had not yet adjusted to the time difference.

THE RETREAT JOURNAL · 34

四月十四日

April 14

昨晚快两点才睡着觉，精气神特别足，一点睡意也没有。

Last night, I did not fall asleep until nearly two o’clock. I felt exceptionally energetic, with not the slightest trace of drowsiness.

最后起床看书，但竟愈看愈精神。

Eventually, I got up to read, but the more I read, the more alert I became.

后勉强进入似睡非睡之中，觉去普贤菩萨处，有文殊菩萨与普贤菩萨给我讲大乘经典，还对我言一些化身境界的情形。

Later, I managed to enter a state somewhere between sleeping and waking. I felt as though I had gone to the abode of Bodhisattva Samantabhadra, where Bodhisattva Manjushri and Bodhisattva Samantabhadra expounded Mahayana scriptures to me and spoke about certain experiences associated with emanation bodies.

等他们说完后，我忽睁眼，已是早七点。

When they had finished speaking, I suddenly opened my eyes and discovered that it was already seven in the morning.

忙起床，在外面练了一会儿动功。

I hurried out of bed and practiced dynamic exercises outside for a while.

洗漱完毕，又上香供佛。

After washing up, I lit incense and made offerings to the Buddha.

因屋里空间太小，除过节日上三柱香外，平时只上一柱。

Since the room was too small, I usually offered just one stick of incense, except during festivals, when I offered three.

但今天似觉有客人来，便上了三柱香。

Today, however, I had the feeling that guests were coming, so I offered three sticks.

上罢香，我在床上盘腿坐好，刚进入定态，只见远方的山中就有两人吹起了长长的号角，我想：“是大日如来来了吗？”便静静等候。

After offering the incense, I sat cross-legged on my bed. As soon as I entered a meditative state, I saw two people in the distant mountains sounding long horns. I wondered, “Has Mahavairocana Tathagata arrived?” and waited quietly.

忽见两身披黄色法衣的人抬两个像鸟一样的高脚灯走了进来，放在我面前。

Suddenly, two people wearing yellow Dharma robes entered, carrying tall lamps on legs that resembled birds’ legs. They placed the lamps in front of me.

还拿来一个宝塔，塔与灯都高出床一大截，两人把灯与塔都点亮。

They also brought a precious pagoda. Both the pagoda and the lamps stood considerably taller than the bed, and the two attendants lit them all.

塔上有孔，从孔里点，就有一道光亮直冲上塔顶，大概塔中埋有灯芯。

There was an opening in the pagoda, and when they lit it through that opening, a beam of light shot straight up to its summit. Perhaps a lamp wick had been placed inside the pagoda.

两人点好后，便礼拜退站一旁。

After lighting everything, the two attendants bowed, withdrew, and stood to one side.

这时，只见远方走来一位身披法衣的法王（法衣颜色记不清），而且在道两旁有很多喇嘛跪地磕头。

At that moment, I saw a Dharma king approaching from the distance, dressed in Dharma robes, though I could no longer remember their color. Many lamas were kneeling and prostrating along both sides of the path.

法王快到我门口时，回头对那些跪着的喇嘛说：“你们先退去吧！”

When the Dharma king was nearly at my door, he turned to the kneeling lamas and said, “You may withdraw for now.”

然后进屋里来。

He then entered my room.

他眼很大，浓须、鼻孔和耳上均有耳环，身子很宽很高，头戴五佛冠。

He had very large eyes, a thick beard, rings in his nostrils and ears, a broad, tall body, and a Five-Buddha Crown on his head.

他进门后，先看了一眼我的供桌，然后似单腿跪地，右臂着地说：“叩见西方阿弥陀佛与诸大菩萨！”

Upon entering, he glanced at my altar, then appeared to kneel on one knee, resting his right arm on the ground as he said, “I pay homage to Amitabha Buddha of the Western Pure Land and all the great Bodhisattvas!”

然后站起身自我介绍说：“我为喜乐双运金刚，今受文殊菩萨和观音菩萨之请来与你行乐空双运之法。

He then stood up and introduced himself: “I am the Vajra of Blissful Union. At the invitation of Bodhisattva Manjushri and Bodhisattva Avalokiteshvara, I have come to practice with you the Dharma of the union of bliss and emptiness.

我现为藏地xxx。”

I am presently \[a figure whose name or title was recorded as “xxx”] in Tibet.”

我点头说：“谢金刚加持！”

I nodded and said, “Thank you, Vajra, for your blessing!”

在我眼里，他与其它时候境界不同是，他给我感觉是一个人，而不是化身，他的身体柔软有弹性，是人的皮肤。

What seemed different about this experience from the other states I had encountered was that he felt like a real person to me, rather than an emanation. His body was soft and elastic, with the texture of human skin.

我们先在床上，后在空中交抱行乐空双运之法。

We first embraced and practiced the method of the union of bliss and emptiness on the bed, and later in the air.

他说：“我观菩萨脉道尚未纯熟，希你能在作法时，意守心脉，意念专一，否则易气散而漏。”

He said, “I observe that your channels are not yet fully developed. When practicing this method, I hope you will keep your attention on the heart channel and maintain single-pointed concentration; otherwise, your energy may disperse and leak away.”

我照着如此做，在此过程中，他说：他已经很久不用此法度众生了，此法对现在众生弊多利少，故动作太笨拙了，问我姿势是否舒适。

I followed his instructions. During the practice, he told me that he had not used this method to guide sentient beings for a long time, because it brought more disadvantages than benefits to people today. He therefore moved rather awkwardly and asked whether the posture was comfortable for me.

此法在密为大圆满心髓法门，在汉地为破生死牢关。

In Esoteric Buddhism, this method is a practice of the heart essence of the Great Perfection; in Chinese Buddhism, it is said to break through the formidable barrier of birth and death.

在作法过程中，我意守心脉，无其它觉受，观有白色的光亮点，像夜空中的流弹一样不停从他身体中进入我中脉，伴有红光。

During the practice, I kept my attention on the heart channel and experienced no other sensations. I visualized bright white points of light, accompanied by red light, continuously entering my central channel from his body, like tracer rounds streaking across the night sky.

最后，他大喝三声，他的“法器”在我身体中剧烈震动，我似变作一片空白状态。

Finally, he shouted three times, and his “Dharma implement” vibrated violently inside my body. I seemed to enter a state of complete blankness.

而后，就见他忽从我身边跃出，跃入空中作礼隐去。

Afterward, I saw him suddenly leap away from my side, rise into the air, make a gesture of respect, and disappear.

在行法过程后期，他还用双手使劲揉搓我两乳，我觉两乳变作两团白光，他笑说：“你很漂亮。”

Toward the end of the practice, he also vigorously rubbed both my breasts with his hands. I felt them transform into two spheres of white light. He smiled and said, “You are beautiful.”

在证得空性的人口里说这话，就像他指着一朵花说：“这花很漂亮，”没有半分邪淫的东西在里面。

When such words come from someone who has realized emptiness, they are like pointing to a flower and saying, “This flower is beautiful.” There is not the slightest trace of sexual misconduct in them.

我心很安详，无任何分别。

My mind was peaceful, without any distinctions or judgments.

两穿黄衣的侍者又把灯与塔抬去，又远远看到很多喇嘛也渐渐退去。

The two attendants in yellow returned to carry away the lamps and pagoda. In the distance, I also saw many lamas gradually withdrawing.

从定中出来，只觉自己气脉一下子变得很雄厚，脉道前几天一直很干涸，现在只觉全身湿漉漉的，而且有白色能量流不停从会阴处涌上心轮，身体非常舒服。

When I emerged from meditation, I felt that my energy and channels had suddenly become much more substantial. For the past few days, the channels had felt extremely dry, but now my whole body seemed moist, and streams of white energy continuously surged from the perineal area up to the heart chakra. My body felt exceptionally comfortable.

禅定中境界与气脉转化，及出神修证，虽说不适合大部分人，但必有人与我境界有类同处。

Although the experiences encountered in meditation, the transformation of energy and channels, and practices involving the departure of consciousness from the body may not be suitable for most people, there must be some whose experiences resemble mine.

故这次闭关自己就全部如实记下来（以前十几年都没有作任何记录），以作一些提示。

For this reason, during this retreat I have recorded everything as faithfully as possible. In the previous ten-plus years, I had made no records at all. I hope these notes may serve as pointers.

让有些人能看到自己走过的路，就知道对错，不再迷茫，而且让他们少走弯路。

I hope some people will be able to see the path I have traveled, distinguish right from wrong, find their way out of confusion, and avoid unnecessary detours.

如自己确实走错了路，也使后人能从此引以为鉴，不再重蹈覆辙。

If I have indeed taken a wrong path, I hope those who come after me can learn from my mistakes and avoid repeating them.

现修证到此，自己对自己的修行充满了乐观、信心，似有太阳就要驱散薄雾而出，有鸡鸣要见曙光，一切将大白于天下的感觉。

At this stage of my practice and realization, I feel optimistic and confident about my progress. It is as though the sun is about to emerge and disperse the thin mist, as though the rooster is about to crow and herald the dawn, and everything is about to be revealed in the light of day.

但还有雾与余习未除，需精进行持，以待时日！

Yet some mist and residual habits remain. I must continue practicing diligently and wait for the right time!

自己的整个修证过程，是从天人起步，又在狮王，四大天王，韦陀菩萨的密切护持下，出神去天界各处参访，现在才又平安回到娑婆世界。

My entire process of spiritual cultivation and realization began among the heavenly beings. Under the close protection of the Lion King, the Four Heavenly Kings, and Bodhisattva Weituo, my consciousness then traveled to various places in the heavenly realms. Only now have I returned safely to the Saha World.

因阴神不究竟，为妄想所成，故需在此世界成就法、报、化三身。

Because the yin spirit is not the ultimate realization and is formed by deluded thoughts, one must accomplish the three bodies—the Dharmakaya, sambhogakaya, and nirmanakaya—in this world.

现在世人都呆板地理解经、教、律。

People today interpret the sutras, teachings, and precepts rigidly.

在修持上也墨守成规，而且用有限的智慧去以文断义，理解经典，使修行人吃了无数苦头，对佛法还是摸不到门路。

They also adhere inflexibly to established forms of practice, using limited wisdom to judge meaning solely by the written words and interpret the scriptures. As a result, practitioners endure countless hardships yet still cannot find their way into the heart of the Dharma.

当我在定中，用超越时空，遍观一切处的眼看此世界时，看到许多修行人执着机械的修行，像木偶。

When, in meditation, I viewed this world with a vision that transcended time and space and encompassed all places, I saw many practitioners clinging to mechanical forms of practice, like puppets.

而且像盲人摸黑行走，不禁感叹可怜！

They seemed like blind people stumbling through the darkness, and I could not help feeling compassion for them.

佛法不离世间，自性不离万法，心、佛、众生本无差别。

The Dharma is not separate from the world; one's true nature is not separate from the myriad phenomena. Mind, Buddha, and sentient beings are fundamentally no different.

鲜活的佛法就在日常动念，举手投足处，分什么出世入世，真的是说难也难，十万八千里远，说容易也容易，眼前现成！

The living Dharma is right there in our everyday thoughts, in every gesture and movement. Why divide it into worldly and transcendent paths? Truly, it can be both difficult and easy: difficult, as though it were a hundred and eight thousand miles away; easy, because it is already fully present right before our eyes!

中午吃完饭，似觉疲倦，想睡，便在床上躺了不到一小时，并未睡着，便觉精力又开始充沛，全无睡意和疲倦之感，只是脚部肌肉和两腿还是酸困不舒服。

After lunch, I felt somewhat tired and wanted to sleep, so I lay on the bed for less than an hour. I did not fall asleep, yet I soon felt my energy returning, with no trace of drowsiness or fatigue. Only the muscles in my feet and both legs still felt sore, heavy, and uncomfortable.

故开始学练瑜珈时一定要学会放松肌肉，习练前后都要做放松动作。

Therefore, when beginning to learn yoga, it is essential to learn how to relax the muscles and to perform relaxation exercises both before and after practice.

两点时做瑜珈，感觉今天身体异常柔软。

At two o’clock, I practiced yoga and found my body unusually flexible that day.

只做了十几个动作，便全身暖流循环，腿脚也不觉疼了，而且身上透出微细的汗。

After performing only a dozen or so movements, I felt warm currents circulating throughout my body. The pain in my legs and feet had also disappeared, and a fine sheen of sweat emerged on my skin.

下午看书直到七点时，又开始坐。

I continued reading until seven in the evening, when I began meditating again.

忽觉自己在地狱行走，阴暗无光的地狱中，有血水污池，池中有生命挣扎。

Suddenly, I felt as though I were walking through hell. It was a dark, lightless realm, with filthy pools of blood in which living beings struggled.

我身后跟着一条大蟒蛇和一只大乌龟，随我游走。

A giant python and a large tortoise followed behind me as I moved through this place.

我回头看了一下这条蛇和乌龟，这龟与蛇的前世便像过电影一样在我眼前闪过。

I turned to look at the snake and the tortoise, and scenes from their previous lives flashed before my eyes like a film.

看到龟与蛇的前世是两个日本兵，三个日本兵正围在一个草垛旁，看一个中国女人躺在那生孩子。

I saw that, in their former lives, the tortoise and the snake had been two Japanese soldiers. Three Japanese soldiers were gathered beside a haystack, watching a Chinese woman lying there as she gave birth.

当那女人把孩子生下来后，女人用双手把孩子托起来，一个日本兵从她手中把孩子抢去，另一日兵便用洋刀狠狠刺向那女人腹中，女人惨叫一声，镜头消失了。

When the woman delivered her baby, she lifted the child in both hands. One Japanese soldier snatched the baby from her, while another viciously stabbed the woman in the abdomen with a military saber. The woman let out a terrible scream, and the scene vanished.

又见那三个日兵把那孩子剖腹，挖出心、肝、肾，架在火上烤着吃，并狞笑着。

Then I saw the three Japanese soldiers cut open the baby's abdomen, remove the heart, liver, and kidneys, and roast them over a fire to eat, all the while grinning savagely.

看到其中两个日兵在吃时，忽然他们的身形中印出了地狱这只龟和蛇的形象。

As I watched two of the soldiers eating, the forms of the tortoise and the snake from hell suddenly appeared superimposed on their bodies.

我心中不忍看，但想这两个日本兵真是吃人恶魔，变成龟和蛇都太便宜他们了。

I could not bear to watch. I thought that these two Japanese soldiers were truly man-eating demons, and that being reborn as a tortoise and a snake was far too lenient a punishment for them.

但忽又想，那女人前世造了何种罪，死得那样惨。

But then I wondered what terrible wrongdoing the woman might have committed in a previous life to suffer such a gruesome death.

这时，那女人宿世的镜头出现了。

At that moment, scenes from her own past lives appeared.

那女人前世是个屠夫，有一只母牛怀了小牛，那屠夫却把母牛杀死了。

In a previous life, the woman had been a butcher. A cow was pregnant with a calf, but the butcher slaughtered the cow anyway.

那母牛血已快流尽，但眼睛不闭，死死盯着那屠夫，直到看到那屠夫从它腹中剖出小牛，又把已成形的小牛开肠破肚，才把眼睛闭上。

The cow had almost bled to death, yet it kept its eyes open, staring fixedly at the butcher. It did not close them until it had watched the butcher cut the calf from its womb and then disembowel the fully formed calf.

那只母牛的眼里充满痛苦、怨恨、任人宰割的愚昧，那眼神深深留在我的脑海里。

The cow's eyes were filled with suffering, resentment, and the helpless ignorance of a creature at the mercy of others. That gaze remained deeply etched in my mind.

在母牛的旁边，还有几只等待宰杀的羊，一起目睹了那种情景。

Beside the cow stood several sheep awaiting slaughter, all witnessing the same scene.

而那只牛和几只羊便是后来的日本兵。

The cow and those sheep were later reborn as the Japanese soldiers.

而那屠夫虽造杀业，但心地较宽宏，爱打抱不平，仗义勇为，即投胎又转为人，成了那妇女。

Although the butcher had accumulated the karma of killing, she had a relatively generous heart, loved standing up for the oppressed, and was courageous in defending what was right. After death, she was reborn as a human being again and became the woman I had seen.

那妇女被日本兵杀后，又投胎做了一个大户人家的丫鬟，每到月经来时，就肚子疼得满地打滚，无药可治。

After the woman was killed by the Japanese soldiers, she was reborn once more, this time as a maid in a wealthy household. Whenever she menstruated, she suffered such severe abdominal pain that she would writhe on the floor. No medicine could cure her.

原来前世生孩子血气虚弱后，被用刀刺破子宫，又极恐惧，故留下的因果病。

I understood this to be a karmic illness left over from her previous life: after giving birth, when her body was weakened by blood loss, her uterus had been pierced by a blade, and she had experienced extreme terror. These experiences, I believed, had left their mark.

看到此，心生起无穷悲心，冤冤相报，何时才能终结……

As I witnessed all this, boundless compassion arose in my heart. When would this cycle of grievance and retaliation ever come to an end?

我感觉自己悲心太沉重，便从定境出来，不再打坐，继续看书。

I felt that the weight of my compassion had become too heavy to bear, so I emerged from the meditative state, stopped sitting, and continued reading.

THE RETREAT JOURNAL · 35

四月十五日

April 15

今天是第五个七天了。

Today marks the beginning of the fifth seven-day period of my retreat.

早上六点起床，打扫卫生，做瑜珈，上香供佛。

I got up at six in the morning, cleaned the room, practiced yoga, and offered incense to the Buddha.

喝一杯咖啡，吃了一小把黄豆。

I drank a cup of coffee and ate a small handful of soybeans.

稍作休息，开始打坐。

After resting briefly, I began meditating.

今天感觉心非常沉而且定，身体若有若无，凝然不动，内心沉静至极，不再打妄想。

Today, my mind felt exceptionally deep and settled. My body seemed to exist and yet not exist, remaining completely motionless, while my mind became profoundly still, with no more wandering thoughts.

观自己的习气毛病飞出，像尘雾一样荡开、消散。

I visualized my habitual tendencies and faults flying away, spreading out like clouds of dust and then dissipating.

心非常辽阔，没有光明相，但内外洞明，空定而住。

My mind felt immensely vast. There was no particular appearance of light, yet everything within and without was clearly illuminated, and I rested in a state of empty concentration.

心极空，连如如不动的如如都觉多余。

My mind was utterly empty; even the notion of an unchanging suchness seemed superfluous.

世界诸境与自己像有一根粗大的钢绳相连，此时，忽然断裂只有一丝尚连，须臾，连一丝也无。

It seemed as though all the phenomena of the world were connected to me by a thick steel cable. Suddenly, the cable snapped, leaving only a single thread of connection. In an instant, even that thread disappeared.

观有黑色浓雾从脐轮处涌出，黑色浓雾中有十二类众生轮回境像。

I visualized thick black mist surging out from the navel chakra, within which appeared scenes of the twelve classes of sentient beings cycling through rebirth.

一会儿，黑雾散尽，自己身心光明生起，如如不动。

After a while, the black mist dispersed completely, and light arose throughout my body and mind, which remained unmoving in suchness.

觉自己像是罩在一种厚沌的光明中，罔象无明四字实能表达此境。

I felt as though I were enveloped in a dense, primordial luminosity; the four characters “罔象无明” seemed to describe this state well.

此时，诸心了不可得，诸境无有生处。

At that moment, none of the mind's activities could be grasped, and no point of origin could be found for any phenomenon.

对“生灭灭已，寂灭现前”这两句话不能体悟，便行住坐卧在默参这两句话。

Unable to realize the meaning of the words “When arising and ceasing have ceased, quiescence manifests,” I silently contemplated them while walking, standing, sitting, and lying down.

后去院里行般舟也在参这两句话，后忽停住，对空礼拜，求释迦佛慈悲开示。

Later, I continued contemplating these words while practicing Pratyutpanna walking meditation in the courtyard. Suddenly, I stopped, bowed toward the empty sky, and asked Shakyamuni Buddha to compassionately offer me guidance.

自己站在院中，双手合十，入定。

I stood in the courtyard with my palms joined and entered meditation.

忽空中响起四句偈语：“诸行无常，是生灭法，生灭灭已，寂灭现前。”

Suddenly, a four-line verse sounded in the sky: “All conditioned things are impermanent; this is the law of arising and ceasing. When arising and ceasing have ceased, quiescence manifests.”

当念完后停了几秒钟，声音又反复念诵“生灭灭已！生灭灭已！”

After the verse ended, there was a pause of several seconds, and then the voice repeatedly chanted, “When arising and ceasing have ceased! When arising and ceasing have ceased!”

我身心似雷声轰鸣，通体透彻，心轮呈圆镜般向四周放出光明。

My body and mind seemed to resound with thunder. I felt transparent throughout, and my heart chakra radiated light in all directions like a perfectly round mirror.

忽然，身心与不生不灭的法身相契入，在不生不灭的境界中，体悟到了不生不灭，寂灭现前。

Suddenly, my body and mind seemed to merge with the unborn and undying Dharmakaya. Within this state beyond birth and death, I experienced the meaning of the unborn and undying, and quiescence manifested.

声音忽消失，我又祈求再作开示。

The voice suddenly disappeared, and I asked for further guidance.

这时，声音重起：“寂灭不住，法性迁流，迁流不住（记不清楚），回归寂灭。”

Then the voice sounded again: “Do not abide in quiescence; the nature of Dharma flows and changes. Do not abide in the flow \[I cannot remember the exact words]; return to quiescence.”

这四句话响起时，忽觉寂灭也无，诸法实相无相，迁流不断，生生灭灭，同现本体，回归寂灭。

As these four phrases sounded, I suddenly felt that even quiescence was absent. The true nature of all phenomena is formless; their flow never ceases. Arising and ceasing unfold continuously, yet all reveal the same underlying essence, returning to quiescence.

中午不想吃饭，便在院里行般舟，感觉生命能量逆流，愈走愈不饿。

At noon, I did not feel like eating, so I practiced Pratyutpanna walking meditation in the courtyard. I felt my life energy flowing in reverse, and the longer I walked, the less hungry I became.

后回到屋内，打开饭盒，看到饭菜时，肚里虽鼓鼓的，但却有吃饭的欲望。

Later, I returned indoors and opened my lunchbox. Although my stomach felt full, seeing the food made me want to eat.

便想，既然打来了，就吃掉吧，明天开始辟谷好了，便吃了饭和菜。

I thought, “Since the food has already been brought in, I might as well eat it. I can begin fasting from grains tomorrow.” So I ate the rice and vegetables.

吃完后，身体不舒服，有粗重感，而且半小时后牙床稍觉肿胀、痒，而且胃里沉重不适，痰多，身体皮肤也开始痒，便在屋内简单洗澡才好一点。

After eating, I felt uncomfortable and heavy. About half an hour later, my gums felt slightly swollen and itchy, my stomach felt heavy and uncomfortable, I had more phlegm, and my skin also began to itch. I felt somewhat better after taking a quick shower indoors.

这段时间，身体脱皮厉害，可能也与气候有关。

Recently, my skin has been peeling quite badly, which may also be related to the weather.

整个下午都在观《维摩经》。

I spent the entire afternoon contemplating the Vimalakirti Sutra.

晚上练女丹功。

In the evening, I practiced female internal alchemy exercises.

揉乳次数比以前增加，因有十多天未练，我没有按原来的次数揉。

I increased the number of breast-massage repetitions. Since I had not practiced for more than ten days, I did not follow my previous repetition count.

当揉乳向外方向至三百多圈时，忽有白色的能量流，非常醒目，顺尾闾而上，到顶、到天目部位，后忽向下转向耳后从胸腔进入乳房。

When I had performed more than three hundred outward-directed massage rotations, a striking stream of white energy suddenly appeared. It traveled upward along the coccygeal area to the crown and the heavenly-eye region, then abruptly turned downward, passed behind the ears, and entered the breasts through the chest cavity.

这是女子的督脉循行路线。

This is the route of the Governing Vessel as I understand it in women.

观自己心轮部位有心气上升，像文火在微微蒸喉轮。

I observed heart energy rising from the heart chakra, gently steaming the throat chakra like a low flame.

而喉轮处向下的莲蓬有水生出，有几滴水滴向心脉。

Water appeared in a lotus-pod-like structure descending from the throat chakra, and a few drops fell toward the heart channel.

在观心轮过程中，有几次两肾部位发紧，而且疼。

While observing the heart chakra, I felt tightness and pain around both kidneys several times.

膻中部位总有两股光来回闪动交错，似要合并似的。

Two streams of light kept flashing back and forth across the Shanzhong point, crossing one another as though about to merge.

天目稍胀，不停发光。

My heavenly-eye region felt slightly swollen and continued emitting light.

发光时，闭眼看到屋内的一切景象，而且心脏不停震颤，似树上一个苹果底下潜伏一虫要顶着苹果出来似的。

When the light appeared, I could see everything in the room with my eyes closed. Meanwhile, my heart kept trembling, rather like an insect hidden beneath an apple on a tree, pushing upward as though trying to emerge through the fruit.

一会儿心脏就震动几下，但心率没有任何变化，也没有任何的心慌或心紧张的感觉。

My heart would tremble several times in succession, but my heart rate did not change, and I felt neither palpitations nor anxiety.

我想是任脉不通畅，能量不足。

I thought that my Conception Vessel was not flowing freely and that my energy was insufficient.

故从今天开始辟谷，约十天左右。

Therefore, I decided to begin a grain-free fast today, intending to continue for about ten days.

对女子来说，任脉，心轮、海底轮都是非常重要的关键部位。

For women, the Conception Vessel, heart chakra, and root chakra are all crucial areas.

在上面气脉的循环转化过程中，我仍然反复会听到气脉中有打饱嗝的声音。

During the circulation and transformation of energy through these channels, I continued to hear repeated belching-like sounds arising from within them.

THE RETREAT JOURNAL · 36

四月十六日（今天开始辟谷）

April 16 (Beginning the Grain-Free Fast Today)

早五点五十分起床，打扫卫生，动功，瑜珈，喝水，吃了两颗核桃。

I got up at 5:50 a.m., cleaned the room, practiced dynamic exercises and yoga, drank some water, and ate two walnuts.

而后开始看书《张三丰、吕洞宾文集》

Afterward, I began reading Collected Works of Zhang Sanfeng and Lü Dongbin.

摘录《张三丰文集》：

Excerpts from Collected Works of Zhang Sanfeng:

①修道以修功德为根本，为基础。

1\. Cultivating merit and virtue is the root and foundation of the spiritual path.

②人仙：炼元精补元气，道德不够，身体健却不能超生死。

2\. Human Immortal:Refines primordial essence to replenish primordial qi. If one's virtue is insufficient, the body may become healthy, but one cannot transcend birth and death.

地仙：炼元气而结内丹，已无漏精之患。

Earth Immortal:Refines primordial qi to form the inner elixir and is no longer troubled by the loss of essence.

但戒行不严，可陆行却不能上天，不离尘埃，即地中仙。

However, if one's observance of precepts is lax, one may travel on land but cannot ascend to heaven. Remaining within the dust of the mundane world, one is an immortal of the earth.

神仙：炼元气而化元神，已有神通之妙，水火无害，然功行不够，只做个神仙，又名水仙，也叫尸解，属小乘之果。

Spirit Immortal:Refines primordial qi to transform it into the primordial spirit, attaining wondrous spiritual powers and becoming unharmed by water or fire. Yet if one's cultivation and merit are insufficient, one remains merely a spirit immortal, also called a water immortal. This is also associated with shijie, or liberation through the corpse, and is considered a lesser-vehicle attainment.

天仙：神仙能广积功德，后炼神还虚，面壁九年，即为天仙，也称为得道。

Heavenly Immortal:When a spirit immortal accumulates extensive merit and virtue, then refines the spirit and returns it to emptiness, spending nine years facing a wall, they become a heavenly immortal, also known as one who has attained the Dao.

③鬼是纯阴之气，仙是纯阳之气。

3\. Ghosts consist of pure yin energy, while immortals consist of pure yang energy.

人得半阴半阳所以有形有体，有生有死。

Humans possess both yin and yang, which is why they have form and body, are born, and eventually die.

把阴气炼无则成仙。

By refining away yin energy, one becomes an immortal.

把阳气耗尽却成鬼。

If yang energy is exhausted, however, one becomes a ghost.

④无我就会无人，无人因此无欲，大清净大欢喜从此而得。

4\. With no self, there is no other; with no other, there is no desire. From this comes great purity and great joy.

弟子们参悟禅偈找效果，就会生出障碍，原因像种上谷子只有几天就找果实一样。

When disciples contemplate Zen verses while searching for results, obstacles arise. This is like planting grain and looking for fruit after only a few days.

“心虚”能获实际利益，要知道没效果就是效果。

An “empty mind” can bring real benefits. One should understand that having no apparent results is itself a result.

⑤人如有私欲那么许多道理就弄不明白。

5\. If people harbor selfish desires, they will be unable to understand many principles clearly.

地理风水必须顺应天理。

Geomancy and feng shui must accord with the principles of Heaven.

既要顺应天理，就不能有俗人的欲望，所以此道只有聪明正直的圣人贤士才能学习。

To accord with the principles of Heaven, one must be free from ordinary worldly desires. Therefore, only wise, upright sages and worthy people can study this art.

看风水的人，十个有九个穷，就是知道天理却不能顺应。

Nine out of ten feng shui practitioners are poor because, although they understand the principles of Heaven, they fail to live in accordance with them.

看风水的即以风水作报应。

For those who practice feng shui, the consequences of their actions are themselves reflected through feng shui.

给吉人好地，坏人不好的地，不受吉人恩惠，不怕邪人埋怨，心才是明达。

Give auspicious land to virtuous people and inauspicious land to wicked people. Accept no favors from the virtuous and fear no complaints from the wicked; only then can one's mind be clear and discerning.

上午打坐。

I meditated in the morning.

身体从早上就觉冷，观今天天气晴朗，艳阳高照，不应冷。

I had felt cold since early morning. The sky was clear and the sun was shining brightly, so I thought I should not be feeling cold.

看了一会儿书，便打坐观心脉处。

After reading for a while, I sat down to meditate and observe the heart channel.

忽想到刚才看书中张三丰，便想何不请教他气脉的一些问题，看道教的看法。

I suddenly thought of Zhang Sanfeng, whom I had just been reading about, and wondered why not ask him some questions about the energy channels and learn how they are viewed in Daoism.

便对空请三丰真人一叙。

So I addressed the empty space and invited Immortal Zhang Sanfeng to appear and speak with me.

忽面前祥云缭绕，紫气腾腾，看到一巨大乌龟正在吐舌游走。

Suddenly, auspicious clouds swirled before me, purple qi billowed upward, and I saw an enormous tortoise moving about with its tongue extended.

云雾之中，显露一仙岛，我想应是蓬莱仙岛。

An immortal island emerged through the clouds and mist. I thought it must be Penglai Island.

仙鹤齐飞，乐音袅袅。

Immortal cranes flew together, and melodious music drifted through the air.

这时，一童子在云雾中显身说：“三丰真人正在沐浴更衣，稍候便到。”

At that moment, a young attendant appeared amid the clouds and said, “Immortal Zhang Sanfeng is bathing and changing his clothes. He will be here shortly.”

一会儿，一鹤发童颜、眼露精光的仙翁，手拿白色佛尘，身穿作法的道衣大踏步而来。

Soon, an immortal elder with white hair and a youthful face, his eyes shining brightly, strode toward me in Daoist ritual robes, holding a white horsetail whisk.

在他身前身后，仙鹤上下翻飞。

Immortal cranes flew up and down before and behind him.

真人到我面前行叩拜礼，我连说：“免礼！”

When the True Immortal reached me, he performed a deep prostration. I repeatedly said, “Please rise; there is no need for formalities!”

真人说：“菩萨弘法利生，行菩萨道，可敬！”

The True Immortal said, “A Bodhisattva who spreads the Dharma, benefits sentient beings, and walks the Bodhisattva path deserves respect!”

我让真人帮助查看脉道情况。

I asked the True Immortal to examine the condition of my channels.

真人说：“菩萨百脉已开，只待一阳来复。

The True Immortal said, “Bodhisattva, your hundred channels have opened; all that remains is for the returning yang to arise.

但天水不清（任脉），地精不明（督脉），现当应守海底矣！”

However, the Heavenly Water is not yet clear (the Conception Vessel), and the Earth Essence is not yet bright (the Governing Vessel). For now, you should focus on guarding the root chakra!”

我便把意观照在海底轮，但觉海底干涸。

I directed my attention to the root chakra, but it felt parched and dry.

真人说：“想是菩萨开百脉时，已耗尽真气。

The True Immortal said, “It seems that when you opened the hundred channels, you exhausted your true qi.

遇一般人，需凝神气穴，加以调养，慢慢元气才可恢复。

For an ordinary person, the spirit would need to be gathered at the qi center, followed by restorative cultivation, so that primordial qi could gradually recover.

但菩萨心性宏厚，可直接于片刻之间摄天地之精气以补之。

But a Bodhisattva of such a generous and expansive nature can directly absorb the essential qi of Heaven and Earth within moments to replenish it.

至此五里之外，有玉真池，是泰山极阴之处，我当为菩萨取之。”

Five lifrom here lies Jade Truth Pool, an extremely yin place on Mount Tai. I shall fetch its qi for you.”

说完此话后，真人升入空中，解下随身带的葫芦向远方的玉真池吸取真气，只见一道白雾状的光从一处山凹被吸入葫芦。

Having said this, the True Immortal rose into the air, took the gourd he carried with him, and drew true qi from the distant Jade Truth Pool. I saw a beam of mist-like white light being drawn from a mountain hollow into the gourd.

真人封好盖，端到我面前，把葫芦口对准我小腹部位，那光便直入我海底轮。

He sealed the gourd, brought it before me, and pointed its opening toward my lower abdomen. The light then entered my root chakra directly.

只见海底轮云雾升腾，我微微意照。

I saw clouds and mist rising from the root chakra and gently kept my attention there.

忽身体被云雾覆盖，在云雾中有闪电雷鸣，天崩地裂之声，风声鹤唳极其恐怖。

Suddenly, clouds and mist enveloped my body. Within them came lightning and thunder, sounds like the collapse of Heaven and Earth, and terrifying howling winds and cries of cranes.

但我心未动。

Yet my mind remained unmoved.

真人说：“这是定境，菩萨不必理会。”

The True Immortal said, “These are experiences arising in meditation. Bodhisattva, there is no need to pay them any attention.”

一会儿，又出现各种声音，动物的叫声，似处于市井闹市。

After a while, all kinds of sounds appeared again, including animal cries, as though I were in a bustling marketplace.

真人又在旁提醒：“这是定境，菩萨不要理会。”

The True Immortal reminded me again, “These are experiences arising in meditation. Bodhisattva, pay them no mind.”

我只是止心一处。

I simply kept my mind focused on one point.

忽真人说要离去片刻，起身而去。

Suddenly, the True Immortal said he needed to leave for a moment, then rose and departed.

这时，我听到一阵漏气的声音，似从尾闾处，像一个长长的屁。

At that moment, I heard a sound of escaping gas, apparently from the coccygeal area, like a long fart.

我明白了，是在排肠中浊气。

I understood that this was the expulsion of turbid gas from the intestines.

怪不得真人离去也（开个玩笑）。

No wonder the True Immortal had left, too—just kidding!

而且又听有流水声，还有冒水泡声，是在排膀胱浊气。

I also heard the sound of flowing water and bubbling, which I interpreted as the expulsion of turbid qi from the bladder.

一会儿真人回来，手里拿一把剑，并有二小童拿来三根大蜡烛，还有一香炉，还有一些供品。

After a while, the True Immortal returned carrying a sword. Two young attendants brought three large candles, an incense burner, and some offerings.

真人点香摆供，又点好蜡烛，而后口中念咒，手握青剑，只见从蜡烛上飞起三道光，像三颗升空的光弹落在外面的山上。

The True Immortal lit the incense, arranged the offerings, and lit the candles. He then chanted an incantation while holding a blue-green sword. I saw three beams of light rise from the candles like three luminous projectiles, soaring through the air and landing on the mountains outside.

作完法，两童把蜡和香炉留下，把供品撤去。

After the ritual, the two attendants left the candles and incense burner behind and removed the offerings.

按道教的礼节，有人在修道时，要用此法告知四面山神等，以防山崩地裂，出现任何震动，惊扰他们。

According to Daoist ritual etiquette, when someone is cultivating the Dao, this method is used to notify the mountain deities in all directions, so that they will not be startled if landslides, earthquakes, or other disturbances occur.

我继续意守海底轮，觉腹腔空空，忽觉本无一物可求。

I continued focusing on the root chakra. My abdominal cavity felt empty, and suddenly I realized that there was nothing to seek in the first place.

心态一下放下来，变的更加沉寂而虚无，但身体还是发冷。

My mind relaxed at once, becoming even quieter and emptier, though my body still felt cold.

真人说：“是阴极阳生的现象。”

The True Immortal said, “This is a phenomenon in which yang arises at the extreme of yin.”

我坐在那，良久，无一点动静，便对真人表示歉意，意思是耽搁他这么久。

I sat there for a long time without the slightest movement, then apologized to the True Immortal for keeping him waiting so long.

真人说：“无妨，我可在此一直陪伴菩萨，看等中午正阳升起时，应该会有点消息。

The True Immortal said, “It is no trouble. I can stay here and accompany you, Bodhisattva. Let us see whether there is any change when the midday yang reaches its peak.

菩萨自可恬静虚无静坐养气。”

You may simply sit in peaceful stillness and emptiness to nourish your qi.”

我坐了一会，忽觉又冷又累，很想躺下睡。

I sat for a while, then suddenly felt cold and exhausted, with a strong desire to lie down and sleep.

便睡了片刻，但喉部忽有光流动，剧烈咳嗽，大概咳嗽了五、六分钟。

I slept briefly, but suddenly felt light moving through my throat and began coughing violently for about five or six minutes.

复又起来，去院里走走。

I got up again and walked around the courtyard.

十一点半时，又回屋打坐。

At 11:30, I returned indoors to meditate.

觉身体还是累，眉心一亮，有光明断续生起。

I still felt tired, and a light appeared between my eyebrows, flickering on and off.

这时，却困得厉害，连头都抬不起来，便躺在床上，以练功态睡着，一直到两点半才醒来。

At that point, I became so sleepy that I could barely lift my head. I lay down and fell asleep while maintaining my meditation posture, waking only at 2:30 p.m.

胃里不太舒服，喉部似有东西堵着。

My stomach felt uncomfortable, and my throat seemed to have something stuck in it.

在睡前不断生起的光明中，看到一根血脉从肚脐到心脉，而这根脉从肚脐进去与脐轮相连又通下去连两卵巢，应是任脉。

Amid the recurring light that appeared before I fell asleep, I saw a blood vessel running from the navel to the heart channel. This vessel seemed to enter through the navel, connect with the navel chakra, and continue downward toward both ovaries. I thought it must be the Conception Vessel.

睡醒后，又全身开始发热，而且喉咙似肿了，有点疼。

After waking, my whole body began to feel hot again, and my throat seemed swollen and somewhat painful.

我忽然很想喝一些稀米汤，便从供佛的香炉中用小勺挖出两小勺来，用电饭锅煮着喝了碗米汤。

I suddenly had a strong desire to drink some thin rice gruel. I scooped out two small spoonfuls from the rice offered to the Buddha, cooked them in an electric rice cooker, and drank a bowl of rice gruel.

辟谷是不吃谷物的，但就当喝药吧。

A grain-free fast means not eating grains, but I decided to treat it as medicine.

果然，喝完后，喉咙不疼了。

Sure enough, after drinking it, my throat stopped hurting.

今天还吃了一个苹果。

I also ate an apple today.

摘录：

Excerpt:

去恶善生，忘情命生，厌伪真生，意平德生。

Let go of evil, and goodness arises; forget attachment, and life arises; reject the false, and truth arises; bring the mind to equanimity, and virtue arises.

心通慧生，见道无生，尽浊清生，阴尽阳生。

When the mind opens, wisdom arises; when the Dao is seen, birthlessness is realized; when turbidity is exhausted, purity arises; when yin is exhausted, yang arises.

性定光生，敬参应生，大慈救生，道用微生。

When nature settles, light arises; through reverent inquiry, realization arises; through great compassion, deliverance arises; when the Dao is put to use, subtle wonders arise.

下午，四点时，全身又开始忽冷忽热，还想睡觉。

At four in the afternoon, my whole body began alternating between cold and hot again, and I felt sleepy.

便看《霍金与上帝的心智》一书。

So I read Hawking and the Mind of God.

霍金以二十世纪物理学的两大支柱相对论和量子力学为立足点，对宇宙学进行了精湛的研究，提出一系列天才的思想——奇点定理，黑洞面积定理，霍金辐射，无界宇宙假设等等。

Building on the two great pillars of twentieth-century physics—relativity and quantum mechanics—Stephen Hawking conducted profound research into cosmology and proposed a series of brilliant ideas, including the singularity theorems, the black hole area theorem, Hawking radiation, and the no-boundary proposal for the universe.

科学家们在探求宇宙的现象与生命的本质上，开始与宗教相靠近。

As scientists investigate cosmic phenomena and the nature of life, their inquiries are beginning to approach questions long explored by religion.

但科学是需要实证的，而在人类世界，用此世界的任何理论体系都不可能揭示生命的本质。

Yet science requires empirical verification, and in the human world, no theoretical system developed within this world can fully reveal the essence of life.

分子、原子、粒子、光子到波，时间、空间、维层等等，即使我们能用这些术语或数字，一层一层揭开宇宙、生命的面纱，但我们人类拥有的智慧也太小了。

From molecules and atoms to particles, photons, and waves, from time and space to dimensions and layers of reality—even if we could use such terms and numbers to peel away the veils surrounding the universe and life, human wisdom would still be far too limited.

我们可能用科学来用于医疗、化学，包括我们的行住坐卧，让我们借助外在的工具模仿出其它世界生命的生活方式，但还是有局限性的。

We may apply science to medicine, chemistry, and even our everyday activities, using external tools to imitate the ways of life of beings in other worlds. Nevertheless, these applications remain limited.

因为速度、时间、物质等都是相对于生命的意识而存在的，对于生命的本质——那个如来，这些是不存在的。

For speed, time, matter, and similar concepts exist only in relation to the consciousness of living beings. In the ultimate essence of life—that which is the Tathagata—these distinctions do not exist.

科学就像是用有缺陷的个体想去证明解释一个整体现象，那是不可能的。

Science is like an imperfect individual attempting to prove and explain an integrated whole; such an undertaking is impossible.

一切都是相对的，它能够在一个天才科学家的头脑里以推理来完成，但它却在此世界永远无法证明。

Everything is relative. A gifted scientist may construct a coherent explanation through reasoning, yet it may never be possible to prove it within this world.

宇宙的规律我们可以揭示出来，我们可以在人间借助工具享受光音天的模拟生活，但宇宙的本质是超越任何生命意识形态的，对有生命意识的生命而言，宇宙的真相永远是无声的，是沉默的。

We may uncover the laws of the universe and use technology in the human world to simulate the life of the Heaven of Radiant Sound. Yet the essence of the universe transcends every form of living consciousness. For beings endowed with consciousness, the truth of the universe will always remain voiceless and silent.

晚上护关居士送进很多花和水果，我很开心。

In the evening, a lay practitioner helping to support my retreat brought in many flowers and fruits, which made me very happy.

今天是农历三月十五，我正好来供佛。

Today is the fifteenth day of the third lunar month, so the offerings arrived just in time for me to make offerings to the Buddha.

如果在以前，如我在闭关，有人买花送进来，不管他是出于什么用意，我都会认为没有意义，没有必要，而且还浪费钱，还不如把买花的钱放在功德箱里，但现在我绝对不会这样想。

In the past, if someone had brought me flowers during a retreat, regardless of their intention, I would have considered it meaningless and unnecessary, a waste of money, and thought it would have been better to put the money into a merit box instead. But I would never think that way now.

送我花的人，他一定存着非常美好的意念，我首先要随喜他，如把花用来供佛菩萨，那更净化、升华了他的心念，意义就更大。

The person who brought me flowers must have had very good intentions. My first response should be to rejoice in their kindness. If the flowers are then used as offerings to the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas, their intention is further purified and elevated, making the gesture even more meaningful.

其实，这个世界上，究竟什么事是最有意义的？

In truth, what is the most meaningful thing in this world?

我们首先要打破这种执着。

First, we must break free from this kind of attachment.

当你第一眼看到花的时候，你的心中首先生起的是赞叹花的美丽，而不是其它世俗的东西，否则就是染着。

When you first see a flower, your immediate response should be to appreciate its beauty, rather than becoming preoccupied with worldly considerations; otherwise, the mind has become attached and defiled.

一个小孩子是不会问一件东西值不值得买，多少钱的，而我们成人却在精打细算过日子中失却了这份童真。

A child does not ask whether something is worth buying or how much it costs. Yet we adults often lose this childlike innocence by calculating every expense and meticulously managing our lives.

当然，我们要节俭，节俭是一种美德，但如你把每件事都用作修行的话，那么奢侈、节俭都变成了你修行的法门，可以破你的执着的东西。

Of course, we should be frugal; frugality is a virtue. But if we use everything as a means of practice, then both extravagance and frugality can become Dharma gates through which we loosen our attachments.

其实我们在算计中，一生却拥有了太多我们不需要的东西，我们成人为此付出精力、时间、金钱、甚至生命，在解决吃住行后，我们并不真正知晓哪一件东西是真正对我们有用，哪一件事做对了。

In our calculations, we often accumulate far more things than we need over a lifetime. We adults expend energy, time, money, and even our lives on them. Even after securing food, shelter, and transportation, we still do not truly know which things are genuinely useful to us or which actions we have taken that are truly right.

我把花插入花瓶，水果摆好，一个供大悲水的瓶里插着一支枯枝。

I placed the flowers in a vase and arranged the fruit. In a bottle used for offering great-compassion water, I had placed a withered branch.

前段时间，它发了一些嫩芽，但停暖气后，枯枝就真正成了枯枝，因温度不够，快枯死了。

Some time ago, it had sprouted a few tender shoots, but after the heating was turned off, the branch truly became withered again. The temperature was too low, and it was close to dying.

但我没有扔，仍然放在供桌上。

Yet I did not throw it away; I continued to keep it on the altar.

看到它，我会想到地藏王菩萨留下的枯枝，想到地狱众生。

Whenever I saw it, I thought of the withered branch left by Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva and of the beings suffering in hell.

我在香炉点了三柱香。

I lit three sticks of incense in the burner.

然后，恭敬至诚地默想，希望能代娑婆世界的所有众生供养十方三世如来。

Then, with reverence and sincerity, I silently contemplated making offerings to the Tathagatas of the ten directions and the three periods of time on behalf of all sentient beings in the Saha World.

如前几天，我会瞬间看到诸佛世界，空中遍满供品，但今天一切都异常寂静。

As on previous days, I expected to see the worlds of the Buddhas in an instant, with offerings filling the sky. But today, everything was extraordinarily still.

忽然，一个声音在空中响起：“诸佛并无言说，天眼所见也是虚幻。

Suddenly, a voice sounded in the sky: “The Buddhas do not speak, and what is seen by the heavenly eye is also illusory.

你能在实相中见无相，而此无相也是实相。”

You can perceive formlessness within true reality, and this very formlessness is also true reality.”

我一下明白了自己又在一念中有了分别着相，现在所见的诸佛的相与无相，俱是自性实相的显现，见与不见只是眼识的分别，自性是无眼、耳、鼻、舌、身、意的，它见也未见，未见也见，我瞬间回光返照。

I suddenly understood that, in a single thought, I had once again made distinctions and become attached to appearances. The forms and formlessness of the Buddhas I perceived were both manifestations of the true reality of my own nature. Seeing and not seeing were merely distinctions made by visual consciousness. True nature has no eyes, ears, nose, tongue, body, or mind; it both sees and does not see, and neither sees nor fails to see. In that instant, I turned my awareness inward and reflected upon my own mind.

这时，忽然体悟到诸佛菩萨与自己同体，与万物同体。

At that moment, I suddenly realized that the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas shared the same essence as myself, and that I shared the same essence as all things.

看到每一个苹果、每一朵花都在闪光，都是如来，都是祖师西来意。

I saw every apple and every flower shining with light. Each was the Tathagata; each embodied the meaning of the Patriarch's coming from the West.

我便进一步理解了“若见诸相非相，则见如来”。

I then gained a deeper understanding of the words, “If one sees that all appearances are not appearances, one sees the Tathagata.”

如果前几天自己对“无相”还有寂灭的心态，那今天的“无相”却成了诸佛的妙用，让自己从寂灭处开出莲花，从平凡中体悟了神奇！

If, in previous days, my understanding of “formlessness” had still carried a sense of quiescent extinction, today formlessness became the wondrous functioning of the Buddhas. It was as though a lotus had blossomed from quiescence, allowing me to realize the extraordinary within the ordinary!

当我快离开供桌时，声音说：“诸天世界供品繁迭，但能用无相的心供养诸佛的人，却稀有难得。

As I was about to leave the altar, the voice said, “Offerings abound throughout the heavenly worlds, but those who make offerings to the Buddhas with a mind free of attachment to form are exceedingly rare.

如此供养，才是契合诸佛心意。”

Such offerings are the ones that truly accord with the minds of the Buddhas.”

我礼拜而退。

I bowed in reverence and withdrew.

THE RETREAT JOURNAL · 37

四月十七日

April 17

早快六点钟起床，先擦干净供桌，而后上了香，正在我至诚礼拜时，忽有一声说：“我是阿底峡尊者，现在他化自在天教化众生。菩萨的悲愿遍满三千大千世界。但现在众生执着于经律教的修证，你的弘法将来会有很多困难。故希望你能去一下藏地……希望你在那能平安、快乐、圆满。”

I got up shortly before six in the morning, first wiping the altar clean and then lighting incense. As I was bowing with utmost sincerity, a voice suddenly spoke: “I am the Venerable Atisha. I am now teaching and guiding sentient beings in the Heaven of Transformation at Will. The Bodhisattva’s compassionate vows pervade the entire great three-thousandfold world system. Yet sentient beings are now attached to cultivation and realization through scriptural teachings and monastic rules, so your efforts to spread the Dharma will face many difficulties in the future. Therefore, I hope you will make a trip to Tibet… I hope you will find peace, happiness, and fulfillment there.”

早上练完动功后，吃了一些水果，开始看《楞严八十分义》。

After completing my moving exercises in the morning, I ate some fruit and began reading Eighty Points on the Meaning of the Shurangama Sutra.

上午看《楞严经》，打坐。十点多在外边行般舟。忽又想起昨天看书关于时间、速度、空间等的问题。其实佛法的许多问题也是可以用这些来解释的。

In the morning, I read the Shurangama Sutra and meditated. A little after ten, I went outside to practice Pratyutpanna walking meditation. Suddenly, I recalled the questions about time, speed, and space that I had read about yesterday. In fact, many questions in Buddhism can also be explained in these terms.

比如，我们都有一个简单的固定观念，即时间是流逝的。它一分一秒从我们身边流过，四季在变化，我们在衰老，而对速度的概念我们简单地认识为静止或运动，抑或运动快与慢。空间的概念则是有或无，即此空间里有物质或没有物质。

For example, we all hold a simple, fixed notion that time flows. It passes us by second after second; the seasons change, and we grow old. We understand speed in similarly simple terms: something is either stationary or moving, and movement is either fast or slow. As for space, we think in terms of presence or absence—whether matter exists in a particular space or does not.

但简单地从娑婆世界众生对时间的认知就是不同的。比如，释迦牟尼佛在成道时，恒河里的一条黑龙看到后说：“昨天刚有一尊佛涅槃，今天又有一尊佛诞生。”对我们人而言，两尊佛诞生的时间间隔可能有上亿年，但对龙来说，只是今天与昨天。可见，时间是不确定的。

Yet even the perception of time differs among sentient beings in the Saha world. For example, when Shakyamuni Buddha attained enlightenment, a black dragon in the Ganges witnessed the event and said, “A Buddha entered nirvana only yesterday, and today another Buddha has appeared.” For us humans, the interval between the appearances of the two Buddhas might span hundreds of millions of years. But to the dragon, it was merely the difference between yesterday and today. This shows that time is not fixed.

再比如，佛在说法时，各界众生都能听到，但因时间差的不同，那这界众生说：“我昨天听佛讲法。”而另一界众生说：“我是今天上午听到的。”再有一界众生说：“佛将在明天为我们讲法。”所以，佛说法不能说是过去、现在、未来，只能说“一时”，即有一个时间，佛讲了法。

For another example, when the Buddha teaches the Dharma, sentient beings in different realms can all hear him. Yet because of differences in their experience of time, beings in one realm might say, “I heard the Buddha teach yesterday.” Beings in another realm might say, “I heard him this morning.” And beings in yet another realm might say, “The Buddha will teach us tomorrow.” Thus, the Buddha’s teaching cannot simply be assigned to the past, present, or future. Instead, it is described as occurring “at one time”—that is, there was a time when the Buddha expounded the Dharma.

从此看上去，时间只是相对于不同众生的心意识生起的，它是虚幻的，不定的。

From this perspective, time arises relative to the mind and consciousness of different sentient beings. It is illusory and indeterminate.

而速度我们知道，如一个物体运动太快时，物体就消失了。我们几乎看不到它的存在。我们看不到它存在，怎知它是运动还是静止的。如果它运动到超光速，可能另一世界生命看到它是不动的。

As for speed, we know that when an object moves too fast, it seems to disappear. We can barely perceive its existence. If we cannot see it, how can we know whether it is moving or stationary? If it were to travel faster than light, perhaps beings in another world would perceive it as motionless.

而且，地球一直在宇宙中公转和自转，但我们却感觉地是静止不动的。而当我们奔跑时，一个寄生在我们体内的细菌也感受不到我们在运动。故静止或运动也是不同的生命形态有不同的体会，也是不同生命意识形态的执着，是虚幻的。

Furthermore, the Earth continually revolves around the Sun and rotates on its axis, yet we feel as though the ground beneath us is stationary. When we run, a bacterium living inside our body may not perceive that we are moving at all. Thus, different forms of life experience stillness and motion differently. These perceptions are also attachments arising from different forms of consciousness, and are therefore illusory.

而虚空中的有与无，比如，我们人执着在现在的时间观念里，现在你看到这是空的地，上面没有任何东西。而另一类生命却执着在它看到的时间概念中，它看到的是过去，它看到这有一处房子在这里。又有一界生命执着在他的时间观念里，它看到将来，这个地方是很多树木。故因时间观念的不同，空间也成为相对的。

The same applies to the presence or absence of things in space. For example, attached to our present notion of time, we might look at an empty plot of land and see nothing there. Another kind of being, attached to its own experience of time, might perceive the past and see a house standing on that very spot. Yet beings in another realm might perceive the future and see that the place is filled with trees. Because notions of time differ, space too becomes relative.

故时空、速度全是不同生命体意识形态得出的结论，后又执着在这些结论中，生死流转。

Therefore, time, space, and speed are all conclusions drawn from the consciousness of different forms of life. Beings then become attached to these conclusions and continue to revolve through birth and death.

而我们的意识是虚幻不实的，是不断变化的，故一切外在的实相也是虚幻不实的，也即实相无相。

Our consciousness is illusory and insubstantial, constantly changing. Therefore, all external appearances are likewise illusory and insubstantial. This is what is meant by saying that the true reality is without fixed characteristics.

而当我们入定后，我们超越了时空的概念，我们不再跟着时间流动，跟着任何空间实相产生分别。那时，所有相对于我们心意识生起的东西全部粉碎。

When we enter samadhi, we transcend the concepts of time and space. We no longer flow along with time or make distinctions based on the appearances of things in space. At that point, everything that arises relative to our mind and consciousness falls away.

因为在无时间、空间，无现在、过去、未来时，你是谁？你在哪？你是无我的，心意识消失了，你既然不在现在、过去、未来，不在此处，又不在彼处，那你只能无处不在。

For when there is no time or space, no present, past, or future, who are you? Where are you? There is no self, and mind-consciousness has disappeared. If you exist neither in the present, past, nor future, neither here nor there, then you can only be everywhere and nowhere.

而既然你无处不在，那世界万法都是你了。那就是若见诸相非相，即见如来。也即一花一如来，一叶一世界了。

And if you are everywhere and nowhere, then all phenomena in the world are you. This is the meaning of “If you see that all appearances are not fixed appearances, you see the Tathagata.” It is also the meaning of “In one flower, a Tathagata; in one leaf, a world.”

而且，如果我们一旦把时空否定了，超越了对时空的执着，那么我们其实什么也没有做，宇宙也没有开始，我们也无生灭，我们会瞬间回归到万法的源头，我们的轮回只是一个梦。

Furthermore, once we set aside time and space and transcend our attachment to them, we will realize that, in fact, we have done nothing at all. The universe has never begun, and we have neither arisen nor ceased. In an instant, we return to the source of all phenomena, and our cycle of rebirth is seen to have been merely a dream.

自己慈悲心还是不够。就从记日记说，开始想认真记下来，给周围的朋友们看，也希望对大家学佛法能增加点信心。但记到后来就不想记了，觉得没有意义。而且手指疼，不想写这么多字。

My compassion is still insufficient. Take this diary, for example. When I began, I wanted to record everything carefully and share it with friends around me, hoping to strengthen their confidence in learning the Dharma. But as time went on, I lost the desire to keep writing and began to feel that it was meaningless. My fingers also hurt, and I no longer wanted to write so many words.

即使只能给别人一点点利益，我心里也欣慰，只是怕做无意义之事。希望大家能看书后，发起一念向佛的心也足矣！

Even if my writing could benefit others just a little, I would be content. I am simply afraid of doing things that have no meaning. If reading these words could inspire even a single thought of turning toward the Buddha in someone’s heart, that would be enough!

能够抛出一片瓦砾，大家看到后，登上佛法的大法船，上面自然有诸多法门，诸多经典，诸多大德开示，用来度脱众生也！

If I can throw out even a small piece of rubble to catch someone’s attention, perhaps they will then board the great vessel of the Dharma. On that vessel, there are naturally many methods of practice, numerous scriptures, and teachings from many eminent masters—all available to help ferry sentient beings to liberation!

中午时，稍有点偏头疼，而且头较沉重，但不吃饭，身体轻盈了许多。口的习气还是重，虽肚里不觉饿，但看了吃的东西，口里还是想嚼一嚼。

Around noon, I had a slight headache on one side, and my head felt rather heavy. Yet because I had not eaten, my body felt much lighter. My habitual craving of the mouth remained strong: although I did not feel hungry, seeing food still made me want to chew something.

摘录《王重阳文集上》：

Excerpt from Collected Works of Wang Chongyang, Volume One:

修道最忌讳邪淫、杀伐之心、阴险、狡诈，这些其实容易戒掉。至于小小喜怒，是非好坏，人之常情，最难警惕戒除。不能有纤毫的小事，让心牵挂，思绪全无，心中安静，忘人忘物，不受眼前境界干扰则与真人为伴。

In cultivation, the things most to be avoided are sexual misconduct, a murderous disposition, deviousness, and deceit. These are actually relatively easy to give up. What is hardest to guard against and eliminate are minor likes and dislikes, anger and pleasure, and judgments of right and wrong or good and bad—ordinary human reactions. Not even the smallest matter should be allowed to occupy the mind. When all distracting thoughts have ceased, the mind is quiet, one forgets both people and things, and one is no longer disturbed by the circumstances before one’s eyes, one keeps company with the Realized Ones.

自己没有做善事而获得称颂并不吉祥，反省自己没有毛病而受到诽谤，对自己并无伤害。得失在于自己的认识，受到伤害而不悲哀的人，才是思想境界最高的人。

To receive praise for good deeds one has not performed is inauspicious. To be slandered after examining oneself and finding no fault causes no real harm. Gain and loss depend on one’s own understanding. The person who can be harmed without becoming distressed has attained the highest level of understanding.

心不受外名为虚心，心不逐外名为安心，心既虚又安，则道来居。

When the mind is not affected by external things, it is called an empty mind; when it does not chase after external things, it is called a settled mind. When the mind is both empty and settled, the Dao comes to dwell within it.

身与道同则无时而不存，心与道同则无法而不通。

When the body is one with the Dao, there is no time at which it is not present. When the mind is one with the Dao, there is no principle it cannot penetrate.

心忘虚念，即超欲界，心忘诸境，即超色界，不著空见，即超无色界。

When the mind lets go of empty thoughts, it transcends the Desire Realm. When it forgets all appearances, it transcends the Form Realm. When it does not cling to the view of emptiness, it transcends the Formless Realm.

下午看道教的书籍并打坐。打坐时，冥心静虑，绝情灭志。但脉道干涸，耗神太久，需静养矣！定中身体如黑洞，幽明湛寂，连光都被摄受。

In the afternoon, I read Daoist texts and meditated. During meditation, I quieted the mind and stilled my thoughts, cutting off emotions and desires. But my energy channels felt depleted, and I had spent too long exhausting my spirit. I needed to rest and recuperate. In samadhi, my body seemed like a black hole, profoundly still in its dim radiance, drawing even light into itself.

今天下午开始打坐时，不时有小虫爬到身上，半小时以内，竟有四只小虫，两只爬的，两只飞的。是何原因且不管，但在静坐中，只要自己一看到，便立即用手拂去，故很长时间未能静下来。

This afternoon, shortly after I began meditating, small insects kept crawling onto me. In less than half an hour, there were four of them: two crawled, and two flew. Whatever the reason, whenever I noticed one during meditation, I immediately brushed it away with my hand, so I could not settle down for a long time.

想自己虽有众菩萨加持，但自己如不能从细微的起心动念处做起，就想舒舒服服不精进修持而能得道，如存有这种侥幸心理简直就是做梦。

I reflected that although I might receive the blessings of many Bodhisattvas, if I failed to work on the subtlest movements of my own mind, yet expected to attain the Dao without diligent practice, simply by sitting comfortably, then I would be indulging in wishful thinking.

外因永远通过内因起作用，诸佛的加持言说固然重要，但自己不能时时觉照，信受奉持，也是枉然。

External conditions always operate through internal conditions. The blessings and teachings of the Buddhas are certainly important, but if I cannot remain mindful, receive the teachings with faith, and put them into practice, they will be of no avail.

大道虚阔无为，功德赫赫，岂是巧用心思，不愿舍弃一点，不愿放下一点的世俗小人可以窃取的。

The Great Dao is vast, open, and effortless, and its virtues are magnificent. How could it be seized by worldly-minded people who rely on clever schemes and refuse to relinquish or let go of even the smallest thing?

自己既然打坐，就当收摄心神抛却诸缘，一心安坐，竟让几个小虫就扰的静不下来。

Since I had sat down to meditate, I should have gathered my attention, set aside all distractions, and sat peacefully with a single-pointed mind. Yet a few little insects had been enough to keep me from settling down.

细思之，在修道路上，自己有什么值得自豪的成绩呢？！

On deeper reflection, what achievements did I really have to be proud of on the path of cultivation?!

想到如不修持，自己形消骨残时，还不是在坟墓中被诸虫吞噬。

I thought that if I failed to cultivate, then when my body wasted away and my bones were all that remained, would I not simply be consumed by insects in the grave?

中午还抽时间打扫卫生。今天打扫卫生时，比平时做得慢，仔细、认真。而且一直让自己形神合一，无有杂念，微微觉照，希望自己在行住坐卧中都能不失定态。

At noon, I also made time to clean. Today I cleaned more slowly, carefully, and attentively than usual. Throughout the task, I tried to unite body and mind, remain free of distracting thoughts, and maintain gentle awareness. I hoped to preserve this state of collectedness in every activity—walking, standing, sitting, and lying down.

傍晚时，练瑜珈，而且在院外行了一会般舟。

In the evening, I practiced yoga and spent some time doing Pratyutpanna walking meditation outside the courtyard.

THE RETREAT JOURNAL · 38

四月十八日

April 18

早上六点起床，身子稍有点发软，但精力还旺盛，身体轻了很多。做动功，喝水，吃了块菠萝后看道教书。

I got up at six in the morning. My body felt slightly weak, but I still had plenty of energy, and I felt much lighter. I did my moving exercises, drank some water, ate a piece of pineapple, and then read Daoist texts.

摘录道教典籍：

Excerpts from Daoist scriptures:

心走即收回，收回又放下，用后复求安，求安即生悟也。（丹诀）

“When the mind wanders, bring it back; after bringing it back, let it go. After applying the mind, seek stillness again; in seeking stillness, understanding arises.” (Alchemical Instructions)

游方枯坐，故非道也。当以气游行于通身关窍内乃可，不打坐于枯木寒堂，须以神打坐于此身妙窍中乃可。

“Wandering from place to place and sitting rigidly in lifeless stillness is not the Dao. One must allow qi to circulate through the body's passages and apertures. Rather than merely sitting in a cold hall like a withered tree, one must sit in meditation with the spirit resting within the body's wondrous inner apertures.”

保身以安心养肾为主，心能安则离火不外荧，肾能养则坎水不外崩，火不外荧则无神摇之病而心愈安。水不外崩则无精涸之症而肾愈澄。肾澄则命火不上冲，心安则神火能下照，神精交凝，乃可以却病，乃可言修矣。

“To preserve the body, the principal methods are to calm the mind and nourish the kidneys. When the mind is settled, the Li fire does not flare outward; when the kidneys are nourished, the Kan water does not spill away. When the fire does not flare outward, the spirit is not disturbed, and the mind becomes even more tranquil. When the water does not spill away, essence is not depleted, and the kidneys become clearer. When the kidneys are clear, the fire of life does not surge upward; when the mind is settled, the fire of spirit can shine downward. When spirit and essence converge and condense, illness can be warded off, and cultivation can truly begin.”

每逢打坐，必要心静神凝，一毫不能起忖度希冀之心，只要抱住内呼吸做功夫。

“Whenever you meditate, your mind must be still and your spirit concentrated. Not the slightest thought of speculation or expectation should arise. Simply remain with the inner breath and continue your practice.”

进气是修道第一步要紧功夫，心神两静，空空寂寂，鬼神不得知其功夫。

“Gathering qi inward is the first essential step in Daoist cultivation. When both mind and spirit are tranquil, utterly empty and still, even spirits and deities cannot discern the practitioner's work.”

凝神调息，以暇以整，勿助勿忘，心平则神凝，气和则息调。

“Concentrate the spirit and regulate the breath, proceeding calmly and methodically. Neither force the process nor forget it. When the mind is balanced, the spirit gathers; when the qi is harmonious, the breath becomes regulated.”

心无杂念，体若太虚，一尘不染，万虑皆空，心死神活，体虚气运，才能求一阳之道，二候之功。己之性若住，彼之气自回。

“When the mind is free of distracting thoughts, the body becomes like the great void, unstained by a single speck, and all worries fall away. When the ordinary mind dies away and the spirit comes alive, when the body becomes empty and qi circulates, one can seek the Dao of the returning Yang and accomplish the work of the second stage. When one's own nature abides in stillness, the qi will naturally return.”

快八点时，开始打坐，至九点四十三分。按道家讲，女子当于心脉处把血化气，这是最基本的，否则其它免谈。但密宗从打开脉轮入手想也能转化血，入手处不同罢了。

Shortly before eight, I began meditating and continued until 9:43. According to Daoist teachings, women should transform blood into qi at the heart channel; this is the most fundamental step, without which nothing else can be discussed. Esoteric Buddhism, however, may also achieve the transformation of blood by beginning with the opening of the chakras. The starting points simply differ.

但不管道、密，在修身时，对心性的要求都是一致的。

Yet whether one follows Daoism or Esoteric Buddhism, the requirements for cultivating the mind and nature are the same.

正准备看经书，忽看到喉部有黑色的光，便马上又开始坐。觉颈部有两条螺旋形缠绕的脉开始解开。而同时，有黑红色的光团从中冒出，随之散去。

Just as I was preparing to read a sutra, I suddenly saw a black light around my throat, so I immediately sat down to meditate again. I felt that two spiraling, intertwined channels in my neck were beginning to unwind. At the same time, clusters of dark red light emerged from them and then dissipated.

但看到甲状腺中间部位脉道很窄，而且气脉呈暗色，想必未通，舌稍干燥。

However, I saw that the channel through the middle of the thyroid area was very narrow, and the qi channel appeared dark, suggesting that it had not opened. My tongue was slightly dry.

十点半时，开始看《妙法莲华经》。

At 10:30, I began reading the Lotus Sutra.

十二点半开始打坐。坐中，忽从后腰处升起清凉之气，弥散小腹、心轮部位，整个腹腔非常清凉、舒服。

I began meditating at 12:30. During meditation, a cool current of qi suddenly rose from my lower back and spread through my lower abdomen and heart chakra. My entire abdominal cavity felt wonderfully cool and comfortable.

随之，有湛明的光生起，看到肋骨被湛明的光充斥，而且胸骨和脊柱的骨髓中也有光。

Then a clear, luminous light arose. I saw the light filling my rib cage, as well as the marrow within my breastbone and spine.

以前也有各种光生起，有时把四面的山都照亮了，但随光生起的都是热流。而现在的光虽幽明、湛然，但似乎能量更大，好像从骨中循环，而且随光生起的清凉之感以前没有，两臂也感清凉。

Various kinds of light had arisen before, sometimes illuminating all the surrounding mountains, but those lights were always accompanied by currents of heat. This light, by contrast, was subtle yet clear and luminous, and seemed to carry greater energy. It appeared to circulate through the bones, accompanied by a cool sensation I had never experienced before. Both arms also felt cool.

这气与光生起后，呼吸好久才一次，而且心异常定。后看到肚脐处似有束着的脉忽解开，同时呼吸变得非常深长，就像胎儿，一呼一吸，就能在全身的四肢百脉运化一周，即走一个大周天。

After this qi and light arose, I took a breath only after a long interval, and my mind became extraordinarily still. Then I saw what seemed to be a tightly bound channel at my navel suddenly loosen. My breathing simultaneously became extremely deep and prolonged, like that of a fetus. With each inhalation and exhalation, qi seemed to circulate through all the limbs and channels of the body, completing one full circuit—a major circulation of the microcosmic orbit.

这两天，经常打坐中，有房间的东西照印到身体上面，身体幽明得像一面镜子，头后有时有圆圆的光环，腰部有七彩的光带。

Over the past two days, during meditation, I have often seen objects in the room reflected upon my body. My body seems dimly luminous, like a mirror. Sometimes a round halo appears behind my head, and a band of seven-colored light surrounds my waist.

晚上读《妙法莲华经》，如世尊重在耳边宣说此意，身心的喜悦得未曾有，并相继观到有三处地方放光。

In the evening, I read the Lotus Sutra. It felt as though the World-Honored One were personally expounding its meaning beside my ear. My body and mind experienced a joy unlike anything I had known before. I then perceived light shining from three separate places.

一处床上，一处地上，一处门窗外边。光像太阳反射到水面上，刺眼地随水波波动，而且同时闻到时断时续的檀香味。

One was on the bed, another on the floor, and the third outside the door and windows. The light resembled sunlight reflecting off the surface of water, dazzling and flickering with the ripples. At the same time, I intermittently smelled sandalwood incense.

韦陀说：“有其它世界众生在听你读《妙法莲华经》”。

Weituo said, “Sentient beings from other worlds are listening to you read the Lotus Sutra.”

我读到卷三“化城喻品”后，有点困乏，便准备睡去。

After reading through the “Parable of the Phantom City” chapter in Volume Three, I began to feel tired and prepared to go to sleep.

这时，有声音说：“你原来要读完卷四的。”我心说：“明天接着读吧”，声音未再响起。

At that moment, a voice said, “You originally intended to finish Volume Four.” I replied silently in my mind, “I’ll continue reading tomorrow.” The voice did not speak again.

THE RETREAT JOURNAL · 39

四月十九日

April 19

昨晚躺在床上，却愈来愈清醒，但懒病复发，睡不着也不想起，一直从十点半躺到十二点半后才渐渐睡去。

Last night, I lay in bed but became increasingly alert. Yet my old habit of laziness returned: I could not sleep, but I did not want to get up either. I lay there from 10:30 until after 12:30, when I gradually drifted off.

早五点多时，忽被雷鸣惊醒。外面下暴雨，雷声隆隆。六点半时雨停了，天还阴。喝了一杯水，开始做动功。

A little after five in the morning, I was suddenly awakened by thunder. A heavy rainstorm was raging outside, with thunder rumbling loudly. By 6:30, the rain had stopped, although the sky remained overcast. I drank a glass of water and began my moving exercises.

坐在禅床上，从门窗的玻璃望出去，外面的树木似乎在一夜之间，都发满了绿叶，嫩绿的叶子，显得阳光也明媚。小鸟的羽毛也绚丽，而且鸟的叫声也似乎欢快了很多。

Sitting on my meditation bed, I looked through the glass in the doors and windows. It seemed that overnight, all the trees outside had burst into full leaf. Their tender green foliage made the sunlight seem brighter, too. The birds' feathers looked more vivid, and their songs seemed much more cheerful.

虽早已立春，但看到绿叶，心中才觉得春天来了，有种生机勃勃的感觉。雨又开始下了，天也有点阴，各种乱飞的小虫都藏匿了起来，偶尔听到几声小鸟的低声嘟哝……大道无为，生命自然化育、生生不息。

Although spring had officially begun some time ago, it was only when I saw the green leaves that I truly felt spring had arrived. Everything seemed full of vitality. The rain began again, and the sky grew somewhat gloomy. The little insects that had been darting about disappeared into hiding, and occasionally I heard the quiet muttering of a bird or two. …The Great Dao acts without contrivance; life develops naturally and flourishes without end.

我是不喜欢阴雨连绵的天气的，但看到外面身穿绿衣、正尽情在雨中舒展枝条的树木，我似乎也变成了一株植物，心里轻松欢快起来，一种静谧、温暖的感觉油然而生。

I have never liked prolonged rainy weather. Yet as I watched the trees outside, clad in green and stretching their branches freely in the rain, I seemed to become a plant myself. My heart grew light and joyful, and a feeling of quiet warmth arose naturally within me.

我用无为的心，默默观赏着大自然阴晴圆缺的奇妙和快乐！

With a mind free of contrivance, I silently appreciated the wonders and delights of nature as it moved through its changing states of sunshine and rain, fullness and decline.

没有打坐，自然地散坐在禅床上，用静谧的心听着雨滴的滴嗒声，观看地面激起的朵朵小水花，用心侧听隐藏起来的喧哗，植物抽节的噼啪声，到乌云的流动、宇宙空阔的回音……每一种声音都是大道的宣说，都是如来的妙音，每一种情景都包含着上帝造物的神奇！菩萨无边的妙用！

I did not formally meditate. Instead, I sat casually on my meditation bed, listening with a tranquil mind to the patter of raindrops and watching the little splashes that sprang up from the ground.
