I listened attentively to the hidden bustle of the world, the crackling sounds of plants sending out new shoots, the movement of dark clouds, and the echoes of the vast universe. …Every sound was an expression of the Great Dao, a wondrous note of the Tathagata. Every scene contained the miraculous wonder of God's creation—the boundless workings of the Bodhisattvas!

娑婆是如此的洁净，生命是如此的美丽，大道之理无处不在，无时不在，只要你用无欲的心去观去听……

The Saha world is so pure, and life is so beautiful. The principles of the Great Dao are everywhere and present at every moment, provided only that you observe and listen with a mind free of desire. …

早上出院中涉水脚凉，中午时，胃里觉凉、不适，便想吃点热饭，这个念头一生起，便看到有许多喜欢吃的菜等等浮现在面前，而且味也从喉里冒出来。但胃里实不饿，饱饱的。

In the morning, I walked through water in the courtyard, and my feet became cold. By noon, my stomach felt cold and uncomfortable, so I thought about eating some hot food. As soon as the thought arose, I saw images of many dishes I liked appearing before me, and their flavors seemed to rise up from my throat. Yet my stomach was not actually hungry; it was already full.

早上还吃了一个苹果，自己感觉是食道气脉在转化，还有食欲的习气。中午辟谷结束，开始吃饭。

I had also eaten an apple in the morning. I felt that the qi channels in my esophagus were undergoing a transformation, and that habitual food cravings remained. At noon, I ended my fasting period and began eating again.

食道与脾胃转化时，辟谷是一定要的，但要看自己身体的情况而定。最多一天一餐，吃水果气清，有利于脉道净化。如吃水果可以的话，就不要吃饭，最好是只喝水，什么也不吃。

During the transformation of the esophageal, spleen, and stomach systems, fasting is essential, though the decision should depend on one's physical condition. At most, one should eat one meal a day. Eating fruit keeps the qi clear and helps purify the channels. If eating fruit is manageable, then one should avoid regular meals; ideally, one should drink only water and eat nothing at all.

吃完饭，就想睡觉，头里昏沉。躺了一会儿，杂念竟多起来，心也有点烦。

After eating, I wanted to sleep, and my head felt heavy and foggy. I lay down for a while, but distracting thoughts began to multiply, and I grew somewhat irritable.

看来，淫欲与食欲这两个根本欲如能除去，其它欲望、习气会减淡很多，而且杂念自然减少，心身得清净。

It seems that if the two fundamental desires—sexual desire and the desire for food—could be eliminated, other desires and habitual tendencies would weaken considerably. Distracting thoughts would naturally diminish, and body and mind would become pure and tranquil.

自己现在对自身有时流露的习气和欲望深恶痛绝，尤其是反复几次都无法改正的。

At present, I feel a deep aversion toward the habitual tendencies and desires that sometimes surface in me, especially those I have repeatedly failed to correct.

下午吃完饭，躺了一会儿，一直在看《法华经》。到三点半时，天忽然阴了下来，雷声轰鸣，闭关的小院与屋里一下子黑了，门外的树疯狂地扭动着肢体，几只小鸟惊恐地掠过树梢，风助雨势，噼里啪啦铺天盖地而来，似还夹着小冰雹，有瞬间吞没一切之势。

In the afternoon, after eating, I lay down for a while and continued reading the Lotus Sutra. At 3:30, the sky suddenly darkened and thunder roared. The small courtyard where I was in retreat and the room itself became dark all at once. The trees outside the door twisted wildly, and several frightened birds darted across the treetops. The wind drove the rain forward in a deafening, all-enveloping torrent, seemingly mixed with small hailstones, as though everything might be swallowed up in an instant.

我开了灯，把经书放下，静静观雨，休息一下眼睛。

I switched on the light, put down the sutra, and quietly watched the rain, giving my eyes a rest.

雨下了十几分钟，忽然停了，天空瞬间放晴，大自然真是奇妙！

The rain continued for a little over ten minutes and then suddenly stopped. The sky cleared in an instant. Nature truly is wondrous!

下午，在看到《法华经》卷五，佛告弥勒菩萨说佛寿命之长，不可思议。自己竟不自觉合掌，心中极大欢喜。

In the afternoon, while reading Volume Five of the Lotus Sutra, I came to the passage in which the Buddha tells Maitreya Bodhisattva that the Buddha's lifespan is inconceivably long. Without even realizing it, I brought my palms together, and immense joy arose in my heart.

好像是自己最敬爱的父母说自己寿命将不会有终结，而且那种喜悦竟像电流遍及全身。这时，只觉头顶忽生清凉，似佛以手摩头顶。

It was as though my most beloved parents had told me that their lives would never end. The joy felt like an electric current coursing through my entire body. At that moment, I felt a sudden coolness at the crown of my head, as though the Buddha were gently stroking it with his hand.

快七点时，开始打坐。二十分钟后，自己面前忽然出现世尊当年在菩提树下打坐的情景。

A little before seven, I began meditating. Twenty minutes later, a scene suddenly appeared before me: the World-Honored One meditating beneath the Bodhi tree in ancient times.

树枝繁叶茂，而且还有细藤缠绕，世尊坐在树下，结跏趺坐，面带微笑，但身体极瘦，皮包骨头。我能清楚看到条条肋骨，但从骨头里却隐约散发出金光，手结定印，头上没有顶，从顶上像探照灯似的有光向空中射去，而且整个身体像钉子定在地上一样。

The tree had luxuriant branches and foliage, with slender vines winding around it. The World-Honored One sat beneath it in the full lotus posture, smiling, but his body was extremely thin, with skin stretched over bone. I could clearly see each rib, yet a golden light seemed to emanate faintly from within his bones. His hands formed the meditation mudra. There was no visible crown at the top of his head; instead, a beam of light shot upward into the sky from his crown, like a searchlight. His entire body seemed fixed to the ground like a nail driven deep into the earth.

面对世尊，我返观自己，看到自己的身体一点也不稳，好像肌肉都在晃动（气脉循环），而且又白又胖，心里忽生惭愧，便情不自禁双手合十礼拜。

In the presence of the World-Honored One, I turned my attention inward and observed my own body. It was not stable at all; my muscles seemed to be trembling, perhaps because of the circulation of qi through the channels. My body also appeared pale and plump. A sudden sense of shame arose in my heart, and I instinctively brought my palms together and bowed.

这时，忽然世尊与树似移到我的关房，而我坐在禅床上。世尊入定的像忽然开口说话：“修学禅定，要先调好呼吸。阴神为风大凝聚而成，当先以此入手……（记不清楚）。”

Suddenly, the World-Honored One and the tree seemed to have moved into my retreat room, while I remained seated on my meditation bed. The image of the World-Honored One in samadhi unexpectedly began to speak: “When learning and practicing meditation, one must first regulate the breath. The yin spirit is formed through the condensation of the wind element, so this is where one should begin…” I could not remember the rest.

世尊说话时，并未睁眼，脸部罩在光中朦胧。又说：“你把手伸开。”

As the World-Honored One spoke, his eyes remained closed, and his face was indistinct beneath a veil of light. He continued, “Open your hands.”

我把结定印的双手放在两膝盖上，手心向上，只见世尊把两放金光的手放在我手上，说：“深呼吸，长长地吸气，然后咽到腹腔。”

I placed my hands, still forming the meditation mudra, on my knees with my palms facing upward. I then saw the World-Honored One place his two golden-radiant hands on mine and say, “Breathe deeply. Inhale slowly and fully, then swallow the breath down into your abdominal cavity.”

我照此做，做了几次后，世尊说很好。我问：“是练宝瓶气吗？”

I followed his instructions. After I had done this several times, the World-Honored One said, “Very good.” I asked, “Is this vase breathing?”

世尊说：“不是。不用憋气，这样呼吸只适合你，连着吸十次。”

The World-Honored One replied, “No. Do not hold your breath. This way of breathing is suitable specifically for you. Take ten consecutive inhalations.”

我又照做。一会儿，世尊说：“好，你气已吸满。一会儿不管发生任何事，都不要惊怖。”我澄心静坐。

I followed his instructions again. After a while, the World-Honored One said, “Good. You have now drawn in enough qi. Whatever happens in a little while, do not be frightened.” I cleared my mind and sat quietly.

刚开始吸气时，只见从腹腔升起白色光团，后面渐渐弥散，而我把意念全集中在呼吸上，也未观之。

As I began inhaling, I saw a white sphere of light rise from my abdominal cavity and gradually spread out behind me. However, I concentrated my entire attention on the breath and did not observe it further.

忽然，全身整个肌肉从两手开始，像从骨头上自动脱落一般蜕去，但并未露出骨头，而是身体变得幽明。

Suddenly, the muscles throughout my body seemed to peel away, beginning with my hands, as though they were detaching themselves from the bones. Yet the bones were not exposed; instead, my body became subtly luminous.

这期间，似从空中飞来一人，似像鸟人，光中未看清楚，飞到世尊头一侧不知说什么，世尊回答一句话，我猜是梵文，音调很美，但未听懂，那人飞走了。

During this experience, someone seemed to fly down from the sky, appearing somewhat like a bird-man. I could not see the figure clearly through the light. The being flew to one side of the World-Honored One's head and said something. The World-Honored One replied with a single sentence, which I guessed was in Sanskrit. Its sound was beautiful, but I could not understand it. The being then flew away.

这时，世尊忽说：“我离去一下。”我便看到有人从我面前世尊入定的身体中站起来离去。

At this point, the World-Honored One suddenly said, “I shall leave for a moment.” I then saw a figure rise from the meditating body of the World-Honored One before me and depart.

一会儿，世尊回来，手里拿一个牛角。世尊说：“这是大梵天的净莲池水，你海底轮脉道干燥，要用此水浇灌。”

A little later, the World-Honored One returned, carrying a horn in his hand. He said, “This is water from the Pure Lotus Pool of Great Brahma Heaven. The channel at your root chakra is dry, so it must be irrigated with this water.”

我问：“为何要用牛角盛水？”

I asked, “Why use a horn to hold the water?”

世尊说：“这是犀牛角，表示此水稀有难得。”

The World-Honored One replied, “This is a rhinoceros horn, symbolizing that this water is rare and precious.”

我说：“净莲池水很珍贵吗？”

I asked, “Is the water from the Pure Lotus Pool very precious?”

世尊答：“在娑婆世界很珍贵。”

He answered, “It is very precious in the Saha world.”

世尊把水倒入我海底轮，我又看到世尊复归到身体上，双手还放在我手心。

The World-Honored One poured the water into my root chakra. I then saw him return to his own body, with his hands still resting on my palms.

然后说：“观海底轮，不管出现任何声音只管静坐，不必恐怖。”

He then said, “Keep your attention on the root chakra. Whatever sounds arise, simply remain seated in meditation. There is no need to be afraid.”

我照做。其间，有女人生孩子的惨叫声，有一屠夫用刀在凶狠地剁什么，还有歌唱的声音，声音很多很杂，中间还似有地狱的图像，我一直摄心静坐，不去分别，也不惊不怖。

I followed his instructions. During the experience, I heard a woman screaming in the agony of childbirth, a butcher viciously chopping something with a knife, and singing. There were many different sounds, all jumbled together, and images of hell seemed to appear among them. I continued to gather my mind and sit in meditation, making no distinctions and feeling neither alarm nor fear.

似乎等了很久，忽然有一道光从海底轮冲天而起，伴随着还有一条脉缠绕在这道光柱上。

It seemed that I waited for a long time. Suddenly, a beam of light shot upward from my root chakra into the sky, accompanied by a channel that wound around the column of light.

世尊说：“好了，你中脉通了。”我观此脉是一道直直的光柱，向上通出顶轮。

The World-Honored One said, “Good. Your central channel has opened.” I perceived this channel as a straight column of light extending upward through the crown chakra.

我问：“世尊，那缠绕的脉是什么？”

I asked, “World-Honored One, what is the channel winding around it?”

世尊说：“不必管，那是脐带。”

The World-Honored One replied, “There is no need to concern yourself with it. That is the umbilical cord.”

一会儿，我看到那根脐带从中脉上软软地落下来。

A little later, I saw the umbilical cord gently detach itself from the central channel and fall away.

前边我还问世尊，为何守海底，他说：“这是命根，你从此出还需从此入。”

Earlier, I had also asked the World-Honored One why I should keep my attention on the root chakra. He replied, “This is the root of life. You must return through the same place from which you emerged.”

中脉通了以后，世尊说：“好了，你已一切具足。”说完，图像和树悠忽隐去。

After the central channel opened, the World-Honored One said, “Good. You now have everything you need.” As soon as he finished speaking, the images and the tree suddenly vanished.

在开始观海底轮时，还看到自己海底轮变成一片荷叶。后来，又变成一面镜子，关房的所有物体全照在镜子上。

When I first began contemplating the root chakra, I also saw it transform into a lotus leaf. Later, it became a mirror, reflecting every object in my retreat room.

而在供桌上所有的东西都罩着白光，像隐在雾里一样。仔细再看，桌子很清楚，桌上却什么也没有，佛像供品都看不到，太不可思议了。

Everything on the altar was enveloped in white light, as though concealed in mist. Looking more closely, I could see the table clearly, yet there was nothing on it: neither the Buddha statues nor the offerings were visible. It was truly astonishing.

而在前几天，腿上照见关房情景时，供桌佛像等是最清楚的。

A few days earlier, when I had seen the scene of my retreat room reflected on my legs, the altar and Buddha statues had been the clearest objects of all.

这次打坐至出定后是一个小时。

This meditation session lasted one hour, ending when I emerged from samadhi.

THE RETREAT JOURNAL · 40

四月二十日

April 20

五点五十分起床，开始打扫卫生。昨天下雨，有很多树叶落下来，院子很脏，用了将近一小时才把屋内屋外收拾干净，做了动功，开始看《法华经》。早上吃了一个苹果，喝了一杯水。

I got up at 5:50 and began cleaning. It had rained the day before, and many leaves had fallen, leaving the courtyard quite dirty. It took nearly an hour to clean both inside and outside the room. I then did my moving exercises and began reading the Lotus Sutra. For breakfast, I ate an apple and drank a glass of water.

读经感悟：

Reflections on Reading the Sutras:

《妙法莲华经》众经之首，经中之王，如能得之，立地成佛！

The Wonderful Dharma Lotus Sutra is foremost among sutras, the king of scriptures. Whoever truly apprehends its meaning can attain Buddhahood here and now!

可叹世界之人观经，不能得经，只是看书、念书，无法净六根，净身口意观之。不能得真经也！

Alas, people in this world study the sutras without truly grasping them. They merely read the text and recite its words, without purifying the six sense faculties or contemplating it through purified body, speech, and mind. In this way, they fail to attain the true meaning of the sutra.

虽白纸黑字，读的琅琅上口，但要深解意趣，身、口、意与经之意融于一起，不分彼此，同一性体，与白纸、黑字、文章段落无关矣！

Although the words are printed in black and white and can be recited fluently, one must penetrate their deeper meaning. Body, speech, and mind must merge with the meaning of the sutra, becoming inseparable from it and sharing the same essential nature. At that point, the matter has nothing to do with white paper, black characters, or the arrangement of paragraphs.

如读经之人不能信受奉持，如入宝山而空返，徒劳无功。

If someone reads the sutras but cannot accept their teachings in faith and put them into practice, it is like entering a mountain full of treasures and returning empty-handed: all the effort has been in vain.

如以文解字，不断诸欲，不净身口意，也不能解如来真实意，而徒增理障与骄慢习气耳！

If one merely interprets the written words intellectually, without abandoning desires or purifying body, speech, and mind, one still cannot understand the Tathagata's true intent. One merely increases one's conceptual obstacles and habits of arrogance.

若真能体悟片言只语，也受益无穷。

But if one can genuinely realize even a few words or a single phrase, the benefit will be boundless.

THE RETREAT JOURNAL · 41

四月二十一日

April 21

昨晚十二点半睡，今早起稍迟了，便未做动功，开始打坐。昨晚梦自己反复给自己讲禅定。

I went to sleep at 12:30 last night and got up a little late this morning, so I skipped my moving exercises and began meditating instead. Last night, I dreamed that I was repeatedly explaining the practice of meditation to myself.

今天一天，除了打坐，练瑜珈外，便是看《八仙全传》，书虽是以故事的形式写成，像通俗小说，但作者对修道的见地方面还是很到位的，文笔也称优美。想这位作者无垢道人在修行上当也不错。

Apart from meditating and practicing yoga, I spent the entire day reading The Complete Story of the Eight Immortals. Although the book is written as a story, much like a popular novel, the author's insights into Daoist cultivation are quite perceptive, and the writing is elegant as well. I imagine that the author, Daoist Wugou, must also have had a good understanding of spiritual practice.

晚上看完书后，忽想很久了未与八仙聊聊。前几天八仙来，也只匆匆而去。便入定，欲请八仙来一叙。

After finishing the book in the evening, I suddenly thought that I had not spoken with the Eight Immortals for a long time. When they visited a few days ago, they had left again in a hurry. So I entered samadhi, intending to invite them to come for a chat.

但韦陀菩萨提醒，说：“太晚了，不必请八仙全来。如请，只请吕洞宾来好了。否则，八仙全来，声势太大，此方土地、山神都得忙起来。”我想也是道理。

But Bodhisattva Weituo reminded me, saying, “It is too late. There is no need to invite all Eight Immortals. If you want to invite someone, just ask Lü Dongbin to come. Otherwise, the arrival of all Eight Immortals would create too much commotion, and the local earth deities and mountain spirits would all have to busy themselves.” I thought that made sense.

一会儿，一位仙风道骨，约三十四、五岁左右的道人在空中显像。他道人装束，手拿一柄佛尘，头后边也有像佛菩萨头上的圆环，而且还带着一只雄壮的大狼狗，狼狗卧在他脚边。

A little later, the image of a Daoist appeared in the air. He had an ethereal, immortal bearing and looked about thirty-four or thirty-five years old. He wore Daoist robes and held a horsetail whisk. Behind his head was a circular halo like those seen behind Buddhas and Bodhisattvas. He was also accompanied by a large, powerful wolfhound, which lay down beside his feet.

我忙打招呼并说：“请吕祖来，原无事，只是想聊一会儿。”

I quickly greeted him and said, “I invited Patriarch Lü here for no particular reason. I just wanted to have a chat.”

洞宾说：“八仙都很忙，现在也很少聚在一起。”

Dongbin said, “The Eight Immortals are all very busy, and these days we rarely gather together.”

谈到气脉的问题，洞宾说：“菩萨既是佛门弟子，当修学佛家法门更快一点。道家注重奇经八脉，大小周天，而佛教密宗注重开顶、开脉轮，其实效果是一样的。”

When we discussed the qi channels, Dongbin said, “Since you are a Buddhist practitioner, Bodhisattva, you may progress more quickly by studying Buddhist methods. Daoism emphasizes the eight extraordinary meridians and the microcosmic and macrocosmic orbits, while Esoteric Buddhism focuses on opening the crown chakra and the other chakras. In fact, the results are the same.”

我问他现在近况，他说在做生意……我便说：是啊！现在学道也需要钱，无钱不足以修道。

I asked him how he was doing lately, and he said he was in business. …I replied, “Indeed! Even studying the Dao requires money nowadays. Without money, it is difficult to pursue cultivation.”

他便拿出两锭银子放在我面前的书桌上，说：“如菩萨学道无钱，我可资助菩萨。”

He took out two silver ingots and placed them on the desk in front of me. “If you lack money for your cultivation, Bodhisattva, I can support you,” he said.

我笑了，想前几年过生日，洞宾竟送了两根金条给我做生日礼物。

I laughed, remembering that a few years earlier, Dongbin had actually given me two gold bars as a birthday present.

想到此，我便看了一眼那两锭银子。忽然，那银子变得很大，一下子压在我心口，我无法把它放下来，心口越来越沉。

As I recalled this, I glanced at the two silver ingots. Suddenly, they grew enormous and came crashing down onto my chest. I could not push them off, and the pressure on my chest grew heavier and heavier.

洞宾说：“菩萨若对名、利有放下的念头，便是已着了它们的相。”

Dongbin said, “Bodhisattva, if you think about letting go of fame and profit, you have already become attached to their appearances.”

我马上释然，心口瞬间就轻松了，便说：“谢吕祖指点。”

I immediately understood, and the pressure on my chest vanished. I said, “Thank you for your guidance, Patriarch Lü.”

洞宾说：“名、利并无过错，有钱可以布施，可以做许多善事，过错在人心。”

Dongbin said, “There is nothing inherently wrong with fame or profit. With money, one can give generously and perform many good deeds. The fault lies in the human heart.”

我点头说：“是啊！如人无贪欲、执着，名利有什么对错呢？而且名利本空，又放个什么？……”

I nodded and said, “Exactly! If a person has no greed or attachment, what is right or wrong about fame and profit? Besides, fame and profit are empty by nature. What, then, is there to let go of? …”

又谈到剑法上，我说：“看一书里写你的天遁剑法，是很厉害的。”

We then talked about swordsmanship. I said, “I read about your Heavenly Evasion Sword Technique in a book. It sounds incredibly powerful.”

洞宾马上说：“我现可以传给菩萨。”

Dongbin immediately replied, “I can teach it to you now, Bodhisattva.”

我笑说：“我无一点剑学基础，怎能一下学会。”

I laughed and said, “I have no foundation in swordsmanship at all. How could I learn it all at once?”

洞宾说：“不然，菩萨一旦录入八识田中，需要时即能起用。”

Dongbin replied, “That is not so. Once it has been imprinted in the field of the eighth consciousness, Bodhisattva, you will be able to call upon it whenever it is needed.”

说完，他在空中完整地打完天遁剑法的每一招，并每打一招，口里说这一招叫何名。

With that, he demonstrated the entire Heavenly Evasion Sword Technique in the air, performing every move and announcing the name of each technique as he went.

我也无心学习，但还是静静观之。

I had no particular intention of learning it, but I watched quietly all the same.

又谈到道教的发展，洞宾说：“未来的趋势是佛、道、儒能三教合一。”我也点头赞同。

We also discussed the future development of Daoism. Dongbin said, “The future trend will be the unification of Buddhism, Daoism, and Confucianism.” I nodded in agreement.

还谈到意生身和道教的出阴神问题，洞宾说：“菩萨现在叫意生身，但道教的出阴神如从人起修，与菩萨有很大不同。你现在的‘阴神’可分身无数，上天入地，毫不挂碍。但道教的出阴神只有一个，而且还不能离开肉身太远，无此大神通。”

We also discussed the mind-made body and the Daoist practice of projecting the yin spirit. Dongbin said, “What you have now is called a mind-made body, Bodhisattva. But the Daoist practice of projecting the yin spirit, when undertaken by a human practitioner, is quite different from your experience. Your current ‘yin spirit’ can manifest in countless forms and travel freely through the heavens and into the earth without hindrance. In Daoism, however, the projected yin spirit is singular and cannot travel very far from the physical body. It does not possess such great supernatural powers.”

又谈了一些琐碎事，洞宾便告辞而去。

We chatted about a few other minor matters, and then Dongbin took his leave.

THE RETREAT JOURNAL · 42

四月二十二日

April 22

今天是第六个七天。早六点起床，做了动功。这几天气候稍冷，而且风大，今天全天想用来打坐，休息时观《华严经》。

Today marked the beginning of the sixth seven-day period. I got up at six in the morning and did my moving exercises. The weather had been rather cold and windy over the past few days, so I planned to spend the entire day meditating, reading the Avatamsaka Sutra during breaks.

晚七点多时，巴山圣母来看我。因下午自己动了几个念头，说出关后要先去洗个澡，身上痒。而且昨上午洗了头发，今天头发乱蓬蓬的，无法收拾。自己早上梳了半天，心想再剪短点好了。

A little after seven in the evening, the Holy Mother of Bashan came to visit me. That afternoon, I had entertained several thoughts: after completing my retreat, I would first take a bath because my skin was itchy. I had also washed my hair yesterday morning, and today it was so unruly that I could not manage it. After spending a long time combing it that morning, I thought I might as well cut it shorter.

晚上打坐时，便有泰山玄母娘娘派了两个贴身丫鬟来帮我洗澡。两小丫鬟抬来一个木桶，桶里的水放了水晶粉等。

While I was meditating that evening, the Dark Mother Goddess of Mount Tai sent two personal maids to help me bathe. The two young maids carried in a wooden tub filled with water mixed with crystal powder and other ingredients.

我便坐在桶里，她俩手里各拿一件东西洗，软软的，绵绵的。

I sat in the tub while each of them washed me with a soft, fluffy implement.

一个小丫鬟说：“菩萨的头发不多，要喝我们那的水，头发会又长又黑。”

One of the maids said, “Bodhisattva, your hair is rather thin. If you drink the water from our place, your hair will grow long and black.”

我看到这俩个丫鬟的头发确实是又长又黑。

I noticed that both maids did indeed have long, black hair.

一会儿，这个丫鬟又说：“菩萨的背上长了许多小包，玄母娘娘有很多药粉，对皮肤很好的，菩萨可去问玄母娘娘要一点擦皮肤。”

A little later, the same maid said, “Bodhisattva, you have many little bumps on your back. The Dark Mother Goddess has plenty of medicinal powders that are excellent for the skin. You could ask her for some to apply.”

另一丫鬟说：“多嘴。”

The other maid said, “You talk too much.”

后又解释说：“其实那儿的水对头发好，也是因人而异的。”

She then explained, “Actually, the water from our place benefits the hair differently from person to person.”

我笑笑，没吱声。

I smiled but said nothing.

洗完后，她俩拿出一件白色的内裙让我穿，外面又套了一件黄色带花的裙子。

After the bath, they brought me a white underdress to put on, followed by a yellow skirt decorated with flowers.

然后，我随她们一起去玄母娘娘处，她们俩又把那桶水抬回去浇花了。

I then accompanied them to the Dark Mother Goddess's residence. The two maids carried the tub of water back with them to water the flowers.

玄母娘娘住的地方像天界的宫殿，亭台楼阁，较豪华雅静。

The Dark Mother Goddess lived in a place resembling a celestial palace, with pavilions and towers that were luxurious yet elegant and serene.

玄母娘娘与巴山圣母在那已等着。

The Dark Mother Goddess and the Holy Mother of Bashan were already waiting there.

我进到屋里后，玄母娘娘拿出一个梳妆用的木箱子，长长的、黑色雕花，箱里有许多药粉，一盒一盒排列着。

After I entered the room, the Dark Mother Goddess brought out a long, black wooden dressing case decorated with carvings. Inside were many boxes of medicinal powder, neatly arranged in rows.

娘娘用一小碟调这些药粉，把它们全涂在我身上、脸上，说：“这是用上等水晶石和上百种矿物质、上千种花配制的，有杜鹃、芍药、牡丹……”

The goddess mixed the powders in a small dish and applied them all over my body and face. She said, “These are made from the finest crystals, hundreds of kinds of minerals, and thousands of flowers, including azaleas, peonies, and tree peonies…”

涂完脸，又涂头发，后给我吃了一颗水晶小球，说是水晶丹。

After finishing my face, she applied the mixture to my hair and then gave me a small crystal-like ball to swallow, which she called a Crystal Elixir.

吃了这丹，是为了让涂的这些美肤品保留长的时间。

She explained that taking the elixir would help the beauty treatments remain effective for a longer time.

开始进屋时，还给我喝了一碗水，水里有很多白色小球，像珍珠。

When I first entered the room, she had also given me a bowl of water to drink. It contained many little white balls that looked like pearls.

玄母说：“不是珍珠，是用水晶炼的，对皮肤保养很有好处。”

The Dark Mother Goddess said, “They are not pearls. They are made from refined crystal and are very beneficial for skin care.”

我看玄母很年轻，皮肤又嫩又白，像十六、七岁的处女，但头上却有两根鸡毛。

The Dark Mother Goddess looked very young, with delicate, fair skin like that of a girl of sixteen or seventeen, yet two chicken feathers protruded from her head.

我默想了一下，原来玄母曾是一只雉鸡，后来修炼成一只凤凰，又从凤凰修成仙。

I reflected on this for a moment and understood that the Dark Mother Goddess had once been a pheasant, which later cultivated itself into a phoenix and then cultivated further to become an immortal.

怪不得头上有两根雉鸡毛，像两只触角。

No wonder she had two pheasant feathers on her head, resembling a pair of antennae.

等把一切美容的事项做完后，我便由一位侍女陪同，出去玩了。

Once all the beauty treatments were complete, a maid accompanied me outside to enjoy myself.

玄母与圣母说有一些事要相商。

The Dark Mother Goddess and the Holy Mother said they had matters to discuss.

那两个小丫鬟，玄母喊她们一个云霞、一个巫霞。

The Dark Mother Goddess called the two young maids Yunxia and Wuxia.

我玩了一会儿，便回到闭关房，继续打坐。

After spending some time enjoying myself, I returned to my retreat room and resumed meditating.

忽见前面空中来了一队仙女，前面领头的手抱玉兔，是嫦娥。

Suddenly, I saw a procession of celestial maidens approaching through the air. The woman leading them held a jade rabbit in her arms. It was Chang'e.

她们在门口与韦陀说什么，后走了进来。

They spoke with Weituo at the doorway and then came inside.

嫦娥说：“奉王母之命来为我梳妆。”

Chang'e said, “I have come by order of the Queen Mother of the West to attend to your appearance.”

我一听，心里想：以后可不能随便乱动念头，今天动了一个打扮的念头，就来了两队人要为我梳妆。

Hearing this, I thought to myself that I must be careful not to entertain random thoughts in the future. Just one thought about grooming myself today had brought two groups of attendants to help me dress and beautify myself.

但既然来了，我表示欢迎。

Still, since they had come, I welcomed them.

嫦娥在我的头发上喷了一种香蜡，是水雾状的，脸上涂了香粉，而且说我脸上有肉刺，要为我挑出来。

Chang'e sprayed a fragrant, wax-like substance onto my hair in the form of a fine mist and applied scented powder to my face. She also said I had skin growths on my face that she would remove.

我马上看到自己的脸变得很大，毛孔有小手指那么粗大。

I immediately saw my face enlarge, with pores as wide as my little finger.

嫦娥从毛孔里拔出一个肉刺，拔的时候，她总是让我闭气。

Chang'e pulled a skin growth out of one of the pores, repeatedly telling me to hold my breath as she did so.

后又为我画了眉毛，我也只静静地看她忙来忙去。

She then shaped my eyebrows. I simply sat quietly, watching her bustle about.

而后，她又拿出很多白色的小丹，放进我全身的很多穴位处。

Afterward, she took out many small white pills and placed them at numerous acupoints throughout my body.

嫦娥说：“你已用石英水洗过了，我为你梳妆就省事多了。”

Chang'e said, “You have already washed with quartz water, so it is much easier for me to prepare you.”

嫦娥走时，拿出一个银项圈说：“我很喜欢菩萨，想把这个项圈送给菩萨作个礼物。”

As Chang'e was leaving, she took out a silver necklace and said, “I like you very much, Bodhisattva, and would like to give you this necklace as a gift.”

我笑笑，收下了，嫦娥便带一队小丫鬟远去。

I smiled and accepted it. Chang'e then departed with her group of young maids.

晚上打坐时，似鼻骨开了缝，有三道光柱随呼吸与后脑相连，与督脉通，鼻里与口腔上牙床很凉。

During meditation that evening, it seemed as though the nasal bones had opened along a seam. Three columns of light appeared to connect with the back of my head in rhythm with my breathing, linking up with the Governing Vessel. The inside of my nose and the upper gums in my mouth felt very cool.

THE RETREAT JOURNAL · 43

四月二十三日

April 23

昨晚十点多睡下，十二点时醒来打坐二个多小时，又睡了一会儿。

I went to bed a little after ten last night. At midnight, I woke up and meditated for more than two hours, then slept a little longer.

但中间有飞虫在头上来回飞，被惊醒，这样折腾了两次，快天亮了才又睡了一个多小时。

However, a flying insect kept buzzing back and forth over my head and startled me awake. This happened twice, and I did not manage to sleep again for a little over an hour until just before dawn.

早上起来，头稍有点昏沉，但精神还可以，做了动功，开始看《华严经》。

When I got up in the morning, my head felt slightly foggy, but my energy was reasonably good. I did my moving exercises and began reading the Avatamsaka Sutra.

在观经中途休息时，我上香供佛说：“供养十方三世一切诸佛，诸大菩萨众，愿诸佛加持自己能入诸佛智海，能了知诸佛神变境界，让自己拥有种种善巧方便度脱娑婆众生。”

During a break from contemplating the sutra, I lit incense and made an offering to the Buddha, saying, “I offer this to all Buddhas of the ten directions and the three periods of time, and to the great assembly of Bodhisattvas. May the Buddhas bless me so that I may enter the ocean of their wisdom, understand the wondrous transformations and realms of the Buddhas, and acquire the many skillful means needed to liberate sentient beings in the Saha world.”

这时，空中出现一庄严佛像说：“善哉！善哉！我为普贤如来，你能以如此愿力入普贤行愿海，我当加持护念。”

At that moment, a majestic Buddha image appeared in the air and said, “Excellent! Excellent! I am Samantabhadra Tathagata. With such vows, you may enter the ocean of Samantabhadra's conduct and aspirations. I shall bless and protect you.”

这时，我忽然看到自己头上戴了一顶宝冠，而且全身璎珞珠宝庄严。

Suddenly, I saw that I was wearing a jeweled crown and that my entire body was adorned with magnificent necklaces and precious jewels.

在变化时，从头顶灌下一白色光柱，自己通体明彻放白光，而且同时看到自己在一刹那间变成刚才普贤如来的相，心光明净，纤尘不染。

As this transformation took place, a column of white light poured down through the crown of my head. My entire body became luminous and radiated white light. At the same time, I saw myself transform in an instant into the very appearance of Samantabhadra Tathagata. The light of my mind was clear and pure, untouched by even the slightest speck of dust.

在供桌旁站了一会儿，我便谢过普贤菩萨，又回到座位上观《大方广佛华严经普贤行愿品》第四卷。

After standing beside the altar for a while, I thanked Samantabhadra Bodhisattva, returned to my seat, and resumed contemplating Volume Four of the Samantabhadra's Vows and Practices section of the Avatamsaka Sutra.

摘录《华严经》第六卷：

Excerpt from Volume Six of the Avatamsaka Sutra:

当知自心即是一切佛菩萨法，由知自心即佛法故，则能净一切刹入一切劫。是故善男子，应以善法扶助自心，应以法雨润泽自心，应以法治净自心，应以精进坚固自心，应以忍辱卑下自心，应以禅定清净自心，应以智慧明利自心，应以佛德发起自心，应以平等广博自心，应以十力四无所畏明照自心。

“You should understand that your own mind is itself the Dharma of all Buddhas and Bodhisattvas. By realizing that your own mind is the Buddha-Dharma, you can purify all Buddha-lands and enter all kalpas. Therefore, good man, you should support your mind with wholesome teachings, nourish it with the rain of the Dharma, purify it through the discipline of the Dharma, strengthen it through diligence, humble it through patience, cleanse it through meditation, sharpen it through wisdom, inspire it through the virtues of the Buddhas, broaden it through equality, and illuminate it through the Ten Powers and the Four Fearlessnesses.”

原来准备今天看十卷《华严经》，但看到第九卷时就困了，便睡去。

I had originally planned to read ten volumes of the Avatamsaka Sutra today, but I became sleepy while reading Volume Nine and went to sleep.

THE RETREAT JOURNAL · 44

四月二十四日

April 24

今天是自闭关以来起床最晚的一天，七点半起床。

Today I got up later than on any other day since beginning the retreat: at 7:30 a.m.

昨晚九点多钟睡，但到一点钟醒来，便再无睡意。

I went to bed a little after nine last night, but woke up at one in the morning and could no longer fall asleep.

但总是觉得一点钟起床有点早，也不想起来打坐，便强迫自己又睡了，一觉到早上七点半才醒。

However, one o’clock seemed a little too early to get up, and I did not feel like sitting in meditation, so I forced myself to go back to sleep and did not wake again until 7:30 a.m.

起来不是很舒服，睡得太多的缘故。

I did not feel very comfortable when I got up, probably because I had slept too much.

打扫卫生，来个大扫除到八点半才结束。

I cleaned the retreat space thoroughly, finishing the major cleanup at 8:30.

简单活动了一下，吃了一个苹果，一杯茶水，开始观《华严经》。

After moving around a little, I ate an apple, drank a cup of tea, and began contemplating the Avatamsaka Sutra.

摘录《华严经》第十一卷：

Excerpts from Volume Eleven of the Avatamsaka Sutra:

一切众生皆以无量极微大种聚集成身，犹如大海众微水滴。

All sentient beings form their bodies from countless minute particles of the great elements, just as the ocean is composed of innumerable tiny drops of water.

如是人身皮毛及毛孔各三俱胝。三俱胝虫之所依住。

The human body has thirty million hairs and pores, respectively, which provide dwelling places for thirty million tiny organisms.

以是谛观皮肤穿漏两眼睛内，手足掌中脂膏集处毛虫无不生。

Observe carefully: within the skin's openings, inside the eyes, and in the fatty areas of the palms and soles, tiny worms grow everywhere.

其余身分间无空缺。

In the remaining parts of the body, there is no empty space between them.

又观此身唯五大性。

Contemplate further that this body consists solely of the five great elements.

何等为五。

What are these five?

所谓坚湿暖动及虚空性。

They are solidity, moisture, warmth, movement, and the nature of space.

所言坚者，所谓身骨三百六十及诸坚碍皆地大性。

Solidity refers to the body's 360 bones and all other solid, obstructive structures, which belong to the great element of earth.

凡诸湿润皆水大性。

All that is moist belongs to the great element of water.

一切暖触皆火大性。

All sensations of warmth belong to the great element of fire.

所有动摇皆风大性。

All movement belongs to the great element of wind.

凡诸窍隙皆空大性。

All cavities and openings belong to the great element of space.

然彼四大皆多极微於空界中互相依住。

These four great elements consist of innumerable minute particles that depend on one another within the realm of space.

极微自性微细难知，除佛菩萨余无能见。

The nature of these minute particles is subtle and difficult to comprehend; apart from Buddhas and Bodhisattvas, no one can perceive them.

如是五大和合成身，如世仓篅终归败散。

Thus the five great elements combine to form the body, just as a worldly granary will eventually decay and fall apart.

如是身器由业所持。

This bodily vessel is sustained by karma.

非自在天之所能作。

It is not created by Maheshvara, the Great Lord.

亦非自性及时方等。

Nor is it created by inherent nature, time, direction, or other such factors.

譬如陶师埏值成器，内盛臭秽，彩画严饰，诳惑愚夫。

It is like a potter molding clay into a vessel that holds foul matter within, then decorating it with colorful designs to deceive the ignorant.

又如四蛇置之一箧。

It is also like placing four snakes inside a single basket.

如是四大和合为身。

In the same way, the body is formed through the combination of the four great elements.

一大不调百病起。

When even one of these elements falls out of balance, a hundred illnesses may arise.

是故智者应观此身，如养毒蛇，如持坏器。

Therefore, the wise should contemplate this body as though tending a venomous snake or carrying a broken vessel.

善男子，汝复应知内身外器皆四大成。

Good man, you should also understand that both the inner body and the external world are formed from the four great elements.

从始至终五时流变。

From beginning to end, they undergo transformation through five successive stages.

云何外器五时流变。

What are the five stages of transformation of the external world?

谓尽虚空十方世界众生所感妄业所持。

Throughout space and the worlds in the ten directions, the external world is sustained by the deluded karma generated by sentient beings.

劫初成时人寿无量自然化生无我我所。

When the world first forms at the beginning of a kalpa, human lifespans are immeasurable, beings arise spontaneously, and there is no sense of self or possession.

次食段食贪等现行。

Next, attachment to solid food and other forms of craving begins to manifest.

次由我所共立田主以为统御。

Then, because of possessiveness, people collectively establish landowners to govern them.

次寿渐减乃至十年由恶业故起小三灾。

After that, lifespans gradually decline until they reach ten years, and the minor three calamities arise because of evil karma.

至第五时世界将坏，火灾既起梵世皆空。

By the fifth stage, the world is nearing destruction; when the fire calamity begins, even the realm of Brahma is emptied.

水灾风灾相续亦而。

The calamities of water and wind follow in succession.

是名外器五时流变。

These are the five stages of transformation of the external world.

云何内身五时流变。

What are the five stages of transformation of the inner body?

谓婴孩位心无分别，如劫初时人无我所。

In infancy, the mind makes no distinctions, just as people at the beginning of a kalpa have no sense of self or possession.

次童幼位能辨是非，如第二时立自他别。

In childhood, one begins to distinguish right from wrong, just as the second stage brings the distinction between self and others.

次壮年位纵贪嗔痴如第三时，共立田主。

In adulthood, one indulges in greed, anger, and ignorance, just as people in the third stage collectively establish landowners.

次衰老位众病所侵，如第四时寿等损减。

In old age, one is afflicted by many illnesses, just as lifespans decline in the fourth stage.

次至死位身坏命终，如第五时世界坏灭。

Finally, at death, the body disintegrates and life comes to an end, just as the world is destroyed in the fifth stage.

是名内身五时流变。

These are the five stages of transformation of the inner body.

一切众生从四大身能生四病，即身病、心病、客病及俱有病。

All sentient beings can develop four kinds of illness through their bodies composed of the four great elements: bodily illness, mental illness, externally caused illness, and illness arising from both internal and external causes.

言身病者，风黄痰热而为其主。

Bodily illness is primarily caused by disturbances of wind, bile, phlegm, and heat.

言心病者，颠狂心乱而为其主。

Mental illness is primarily characterized by madness and a disturbed mind.

言客病者，刀杖所伤动作过劳以为其主。

Externally caused illness is primarily due to injuries from blades or staves, and excessive exertion.

其余品类展转相因，令众生受身心苦。

Other kinds of illness arise through interconnected causes, bringing physical and mental suffering to sentient beings.

如是众病、贫贱人少，众劳役故。

Such illnesses are less common among the poor because they are accustomed to hard labor.

富贵人多，过优乐故。

They are more common among the wealthy because of excessive comfort and pleasure.

身病，从宿食生。

Bodily illness can arise from undigested food remaining in the system.

苦诸众生能於饮食知量知足。

If sentient beings know moderation and contentment in eating and drinking,

量其老少气力强弱，时节寒热风雨燥湿，身之劳逸，应自审察，无失其宜。

they should carefully consider their age, physical strength, the seasons, cold and heat, wind and rain, dryness and dampness, as well as their levels of exertion and rest, adjusting their habits appropriately.

能令众病无因得起。

In this way, they can prevent many illnesses from arising.

傍晚打坐，看到舌下有两脉通向甲状腺后边的一个穴（渴爱泉），从此穴直通尾闾秘密轮，秘密轮处似有深潭水，但水里有红色的雾，不够澄净。

During evening meditation, I saw two channels beneath the tongue leading to a point behind the thyroid gland, which I call the Spring of Craving. This point connected directly to the Secret Chakra at the coccyx. There seemed to be a deep pool of water at the Secret Chakra, but red mist hung over the water, leaving it unclear.

此水又与海底轮相连。

This water was also connected to the root chakra.

因渴爱习气未净，故水不澄净，而舌下常干渴，舌体偶干燥，颈部气脉不畅。

Because the habitual tendencies of craving had not yet been purified, the water was not clear. My mouth was often dry beneath the tongue, my tongue occasionally became dry, and the energy channels in my neck did not flow freely.

还看到脚底涌泉穴靠下有轮（足胜轮或万福轮），此轮开启后，大周天已通。

I also saw a wheel below the Yongquan, or Bubbling Spring, point on the sole of the foot. I called it the Foot-Victory Wheel or the Myriad Blessings Wheel. Once this wheel opened, the macrocosmic orbit was said to be fully connected.

这两天忽又开始看到哪儿都脏，而且味道难闻，去卫生间有时会干吐，好像闻了难闻的气味，脾胃会痉挛。

Over the past two days, I had suddenly begun to see dirt everywhere and find the smells unpleasant. Sometimes I gagged when going to the bathroom, as though foul odors caused my stomach and spleen to cramp.

THE RETREAT JOURNAL · 45

四月二十五日

April 25

早五点四十多起床，这几天练瑜珈身上肌肉不疼了，但浑身却懒懒的，大概也是一个过程。

I got up shortly after 5:40 a.m. After practicing yoga for several days, my muscles no longer hurt, but my whole body still felt sluggish. Perhaps this was also part of the process.

起床后，打扫卫生。

After getting up, I cleaned the retreat space.

在擦供桌时，边擦边看着供桌上的阿弥陀佛想：这尊佛像太脏了，该怎样清洗一下呢？

As I wiped the altar, I looked at the statue of Amitabha Buddha and thought, “This statue is so dirty. How should I clean it?”

因佛像是木头雕刻的，又站在一个莲座上，头上的发丝雕得很细密，里面有尘土，莲花瓣里也有，用布子是擦不掉的。

The statue was carved from wood and stood on a lotus pedestal. The hair on its head was intricately carved, with dust lodged between the strands and inside the lotus petals—places a cloth could not reach.

想是想，但自己未想出好办法，只把供桌擦干净，便点了三柱香。

I thought about it but could not come up with a good solution, so I simply finished cleaning the altar table and lit three sticks of incense.

默想：愿供养十方三世诸佛、诸大菩萨。

I silently contemplated: “May I make offerings to all Buddhas and great Bodhisattvas of the ten directions and the three periods of time.”

这时，我忽看到身处极乐世界的阿弥陀佛冲我微笑。

At that moment, I suddenly saw Amitabha Buddha, dwelling in the Land of Ultimate Bliss, smiling at me.

随之，一白色的火球唰得一下从极乐世界飞来，落入我面前的香炉里。

Then a white ball of fire shot from the Land of Ultimate Bliss and landed in the incense burner before me.

随之，三柱香变得又高又大，呈红色，似有三条金色的龙缠在三柱香上。

The three sticks of incense then grew tall and large, turning red, with what appeared to be three golden dragons coiling around them.

而且香炉本是黑色瓷器，此时变成金色的，而且面前的阿弥陀佛像放出万道金光。

The incense burner, originally made of black porcelain, turned gold, and the statue of Amitabha Buddha before me radiated countless golden rays of light.

等佛像停止放光时，忽空中飞来两天女，手拿喷壶，冲佛像喷水，手里拿着长长的羽毛清洗佛像……

When the statue stopped radiating light, two celestial maidens suddenly flew down from the sky. They carried spray bottles and sprayed the statue with water, then used long feathers to clean it…

从此境界出来后，我看着面前的佛像，还是从前那样尘土覆盖。

When I emerged from this vision, I looked at the statue before me. It was still covered in dust, just as it had been before.

便想：娑婆世界众生无有神通，怎能看到此佛像已清洗过，清净庄严。

I thought, “Sentient beings in the Saha World do not possess supernatural powers. How could they see that this Buddha statue had been cleaned and was now pure and dignified?”

但想众生看不到，只是因眼根不净，故此世界处处污垢不堪。

But I then thought that beings could not see this simply because their visual faculty was impure; therefore, they perceived filth everywhere in this world.

而眼根不净，是因心不净耳，如心净，六根自然干净。

The visual faculty is impure because the mind is impure. When the mind is pure, the six sense faculties naturally become pure.

诸佛菩萨的种种教诲、种种法门都是在清洗我们的心。

The various teachings and Dharma methods of Buddhas and Bodhisattvas are all ways of cleansing our minds.

自己这几天脏器似变得很柔弱，看到脏东西或嗅到难闻的气味就想吐，其实还是自己心中有脏、净的分别执着或习气。

In recent days, my internal organs seemed to have become very sensitive and weak; seeing dirty things or smelling unpleasant odors made me want to vomit. In fact, this was still due to my mind's habitual attachment to distinctions between dirt and purity.

自己这张脸倒是每天清洗得干干净净，但真的就很干净吗？

I washed my face thoroughly every day, but was it really clean?

把毛孔放大来看，也是藏污纳垢，全身的穴窍脏器何处无细菌滋生，也不比面前的佛像干净多少，自欺欺人而已。

Magnified, the pores also contained dirt. Where in the body's orifices and organs could bacteria not grow? The body was hardly any cleaner than the Buddha statue before me. I had merely been deceiving myself and others.

想到这些，脾胃的承受力一下增强了，面前的脏、净在自己眼里忽变得都很平常，没有什么分别。

As I reflected on this, my stomach and spleen suddenly seemed better able to tolerate things. The dirty and the clean before my eyes suddenly seemed ordinary, with no meaningful distinction between them.

手仍在扫地，但身心寂静，似进入定态，也不再觉得有灰尘钻入自己鼻子，也不再不停咳嗽打喷嚏，似乎六根全部关闭一般，呼吸也若有若无。

My hands continued sweeping the floor, but my body and mind were still, as though I had entered a meditative state. I no longer felt dust entering my nose, nor did I keep coughing and sneezing. It was as if all six sense faculties had closed, and my breathing had become almost imperceptible.

只有我们身心清净，心时时在道上，诸佛菩萨时时在满我们的愿，时时在加持教导我们，只是我们心蒙垢太重，而又时时失念，心不在道，故不能觉知。

Only when our body and mind are pure, and our thoughts remain constantly aligned with the Way, can we recognize that Buddhas and Bodhisattvas are continually helping fulfill our aspirations, blessing us, and guiding us. But our minds are so heavily obscured by defilements, and we so frequently lose mindfulness and stray from the Way, that we cannot perceive this.

早晨打扫完卫生，做了动功，开始观《华严经》第二十八卷

After finishing the morning cleaning, I practiced some dynamic exercises and began contemplating Volume Twenty-Eight of the Avatamsaka Sutra.

摘录《华严经》卷二十九：

Excerpts from Volume Twenty-Nine of the Avatamsaka Sutra:

……善男子，菩萨若能如是净修心诚，则能积集一切善根，随所修行皆能证入。

“…Good man, if a Bodhisattva can cultivate the mind sincerely and purely in this way, they will accumulate all roots of goodness and attain realization through whatever practices they undertake.

何以故。

Why is this so?

尽除一切诸障难故。

Because all obstacles and hindrances will be completely eliminated.

所谓见佛障，闻法障，亲近供养诸如来障，方便摄取诸众生障，严净种种佛国土障。

These include obstacles to seeing the Buddha, hearing the Dharma, approaching and making offerings to the Tathagatas, skillfully guiding and embracing sentient beings, and adorning and purifying various Buddha lands.

菩萨以离如是诸障难故，若发希求善知识心不用功力则便得见。

When Bodhisattvas are free of such obstacles, if they sincerely aspire to seek a spiritual teacher, they will be able to meet one without needing to exert great effort.

乃至究竟成一切智。

Ultimately, they will attain omniscience.”

这两天看《华严经》，看到善财的五十三参，回想起自己这十多年的到处参学，虽然在师父的冥冥指引下一直走了下来，途中困难也有，障碍也有，迷茫也有，但直到今天才觉得似乎真正明白了一些做人的道理。

Over the past two days, while reading the Avatamsaka Sutra, I came across Sudhana's fifty-three visits to spiritual teachers and reflected on my own travels in search of teachings over the past decade or more. Though I have continued along this path under my master's unseen guidance, encountering difficulties, obstacles, and confusion along the way, only today did I feel that I had perhaps begun to understand some genuine principles of how to live as a human being.

这十多年自己也一直冒充是个修道人，但观自己这几年的所作所为，起心动念，不对境还能清净，一对境便杂念纷飞，欲望顿现。

For more than ten years, I had also been pretending to be a practitioner. Looking at my actions and thoughts over the past few years, I saw that I could remain calm when unchallenged, but as soon as I encountered a situation that tested me, distracting thoughts surged and desires immediately arose.

贪、嗔、痴、慢、疑习气毛病到今天还有余留。

Even today, the habitual afflictions of greed, anger, ignorance, arrogance, and doubt remained.

成佛，救度众生似乎是自己一直追求的目标，但成佛是怎样？又怎样救度众生？却是迷迷茫茫、糊里糊涂。

Becoming a Buddha and liberating sentient beings had seemingly been my lifelong goals. Yet what did it mean to become a Buddha? And how was one to liberate sentient beings? I remained confused and uncertain about both.

今天重新回忆往事，如过眼烟云、南柯一梦。

Today, looking back on the past, it all seemed like passing clouds and mist, like a dream from which one awakens.

虽过去心不可得，但过去所为足以鞭策现在，让自己从现在的每一步、每一念都能以一位菩萨的行为要求自己，督促自己。

Although the mind of the past cannot be grasped, my past actions were enough to spur me onward now, urging me to hold myself accountable to the conduct of a Bodhisattva in every step and every thought from this moment forward.

看到身边的修行人绝大部分都仍在步自己的后尘，口里说修道成佛，也能克服一些困难，但对境时，心又迷茫，抵抗不了任何诱惑，有时还用一些佛法的大道理为自己寻找借口，禅宗就是被这些人糟蹋了（包括自己在内）。

I saw that most practitioners around me were still following the same path I had taken. They spoke of cultivating the Way and becoming Buddhas, and could overcome some difficulties, but when confronted with challenging circumstances, they became confused and could not resist temptation. Sometimes they even used lofty Buddhist principles to make excuses for themselves. People like this—including myself—were bringing disgrace upon Chan Buddhism.

身、口、意没一刻清净，习气欲望很重，又不广积功德，福报不足以抵业，竟敢说“做与不做一个样，心无挂碍就是”。

Their bodies, speech, and minds were never truly pure; their habitual tendencies and desires remained strong, and they did not accumulate merit and virtue. Their blessings were insufficient to offset their karma, yet they dared to say, “Doing something and not doing it are the same; all that matters is having a mind free of attachment.”

试想想，自己能做到心无挂碍吗？！

Just think: could they truly maintain a mind free of attachment?!

更有甚者，自己都修得糊里糊涂，却自认为是明白人，满口话甚深禅意，让人摸不着头脑，举手投足俨然祖师西来意。

Worse still, some practiced in utter confusion yet considered themselves enlightened. They spoke endlessly in obscure Chan language that left others bewildered, while their every gesture and movement seemed intended to display the profound intent of the patriarchs who came from the West.

不识对方根基，修学程度，便想对对机锋，显显自己高深，真是误人误己，害人不浅。

Without understanding another person's capacities or level of practice, they tried to trade Chan riddles and show off their supposed profundity. This truly misled both themselves and others, causing considerable harm.

下午快四点钟时，护关居士送进一碗核桃，自己边看经书边吃了起来。

At nearly four in the afternoon, the lay practitioner helping protect my retreat brought me a bowl of walnuts. I began eating them while reading the sutra.

刚吃了几颗，忽然觉得应该先供佛。

After eating just a few, I suddenly felt that I should make an offering to the Buddha first.

这段时间，一想起诸佛菩萨，自己心中便会生起一种暖流与爱意，象想到了父母、兄妹等亲人，那种爱一下就能充满自己的身心，让自己的心变得极柔和，以此柔和的爱意，使自己看到小虫也不忍伤之。

Recently, whenever I thought of the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas, a warm current of love would arise in my heart. It was like thinking of my parents, siblings, and other loved ones. That love would immediately fill my body and mind, making my heart exceptionally gentle. With such tender affection, I could no longer bear to harm even a tiny insect.

我把核桃放在供桌上，上了三柱香，边礼拜边想：供养十方三世诸佛，诸大菩萨，愿自己能恒久心里充满此爱意，救护三界一切众生，而又能同时拥有智慧、力量度脱众生。

I placed the walnuts on the altar, lit three sticks of incense, and bowed as I contemplated: “I make offerings to all Buddhas and great Bodhisattvas of the ten directions and the three periods of time. May my heart remain filled with this love forever, so that I may protect all sentient beings throughout the three realms and also possess the wisdom and strength needed to liberate them.”

这时，天空中忽有无数双手伸向我头顶为我灌顶。

At that moment, countless hands suddenly reached down from the sky toward the crown of my head, performing an empowerment.

有声音说：“善哉！此灌顶来自于你无穷尽的爱”。

A voice said, “Excellent! This empowerment comes from your boundless love.”

同时，看到自己头顶光柱升入空中，现无见顶相。

At the same time, I saw a column of light rising from the top of my head into the sky, manifesting the sign of a summit that could not be seen.

这时，从面前的香炉缭绕的烟雾中，化生出重重叠叠的诸佛世界，而从一世界中，有一队人向我走来。

Then, from the curling smoke rising from the incense burner before me, layer upon layer of Buddha worlds manifested. From one of these worlds, a procession of people approached me.

有一老者，身披袈裟，胡须皆白，法相庄严，对我说：“我为释迦牟尼。今我将为你作最后一次剃度。”

An elderly man, clad in a monastic robe, with a completely white beard and a dignified appearance, said to me, “I am Shakyamuni. Today I shall give you your final tonsure.”

边说边为我剃头发。

As he spoke, he shaved my head.

并说：“愿此剃度后，你心如我心，如诸佛心，如诸大菩萨于菩提道场得不退转。”

He continued, “May you, after this tonsure, have a mind like mine and like the minds of all Buddhas. May you, like the great Bodhisattvas at the place of enlightenment, never regress from the path to awakening.”

剃完后，释迦牟尼又于身后一小童手托的盘中取一件袈裟，披在我身上说：“此为达摩当年去东土时的紫金摩尼袈裟，现传于你，愿你能广建禅宗道场，弘扬顿悟法门，于万法中不著一法，于诸文字境界中见无字般若……（记不清原话）。”

After shaving my head, Shakyamuni took a robe from a tray held by a young attendant behind him and draped it over me. He said, “This is the purple-gold mani robe that Bodhidharma wore when he traveled east to the land of China. I now transmit it to you. May you establish many Chan centers and propagate the Dharma of sudden awakening. May you remain attached to no single Dharma among the myriad teachings, and perceive the Prajna beyond words amid all realms of written language…” (I cannot remember the exact words.)

我身披袈裟，现出家丈夫相，释迦与所有侍者远去，诸佛世界忽然隐去。

Clad in the robe, I took on the appearance of a male monastic. Shakyamuni and all his attendants departed, and the Buddha worlds suddenly vanished.

释迦佛剃度后，头顶上会留有从左向右旋过去的三道旋纹，此纹不会消失。

After Shakyamuni Buddha performed a tonsure, three whorls turning from left to right would remain on the crown of the head and never disappear.

我在定中见有圣僧头顶有此纹记，便知是释迦佛亲自剃度的弟子，这是释迦佛剃度手法的特有标志。

In meditation, when I saw a holy monk with these marks on his head, I knew he was a disciple personally tonsured by Shakyamuni Buddha. These marks were said to be a distinctive sign of Shakyamuni's tonsure technique.

我记不清自己已被剃度几次，大概有十多次了，每一次剃度前，自己身心解脱都有一次质的飞跃。

I could not remember how many times I had undergone tonsure in these visions—probably more than ten. Before each tonsure, there had been a qualitative leap in the liberation of my body and mind.

剃度后，自己心结打开，心垢去掉一层，光明顿现。

After each tonsure, knots in my heart seemed to untie, another layer of mental defilement fell away, and light suddenly appeared.

中午吃苹果削皮，掉地上一块。

At noon, while peeling an apple, I dropped a piece of peel on the floor.

下午时，竟看到那块皮上爬满了小蚂蚁，便不假思索把那块苹果皮连同蚂蚁一起扔到了废纸篓里。

In the afternoon, I noticed that the piece of peel was covered with tiny ants, and without thinking, I threw the peel and the ants together into the wastebasket.

废纸篓在院子里，也不是很大，我想，蚂蚁吃完苹果皮当会从纸篓爬出去吧。

The wastebasket was in the courtyard and was not very large. I thought that once the ants had finished eating the apple peel, they would probably crawl back out.

但又想，爬是能爬出去，但蚂蚁未必肯出去，因纸篓还有很多果皮，大概还会招来许多同伙一起进去吃。

But then I thought that although they could climb out, they might not choose to leave, since there were many other fruit peels in the basket that could attract more ants to come and feed with them.

但等明后天，纸篓满后，我会把那只放废纸的塑料袋扎了口子扔出去，如有些烧垃圾的，当把许多垃圾一起点火烧掉，那这群蚂蚁就葬身火海了……

In a day or two, when the basket was full, I would tie up the plastic bag used for wastepaper and throw it away. If the garbage were taken somewhere and burned with other refuse, the whole colony of ants would perish in the flames…

由此，我忽然想到了人，许多人的一生也就像蚂蚁这样，为一日三餐奔忙，一直到又老又病，到最后一口气，也不愿从纸篓里爬出来，不知此世界还有佛法，还有解脱之事，即使知道，福德不够，也不能修学。

This suddenly made me think of human beings. Many people spend their entire lives like these ants, rushing about to secure their daily meals until they grow old and sick. Even with their final breath approaching, they are unwilling to climb out of the wastebasket. They do not know that the Dharma exists in this world, or that liberation is possible. Even if they do know, they may lack the merit and blessings needed to undertake the practice.

想想六道众生，甚是可怜！

When I thought of sentient beings in the six realms of rebirth, I felt profound compassion for them.

自己现今能有福德福缘修证佛学，定当精进修持，决不懈怠，如能成就，定当上报四重恩，下济三途苦，无怨无悔！

Now that I have the merit and fortunate conditions to study and practice the Buddha's teachings, I must practice diligently and never slacken. If I attain realization, I will repay the four great debts of gratitude above and relieve the suffering of beings in the three lower realms below, without regret or resentment!

五点钟打坐中，有音与自己对话。

During meditation at five o'clock, a voice spoke with me.

“你说自己要度三界众生，你了解三界众生的一切吗？”

“You say you want to liberate sentient beings throughout the three realms. Do you understand everything about them?”

我说：“不了解。”

I replied, “No, I don't.”

“那你不了解三界众生，怎能度化他们呢？

“Then how can you guide and liberate sentient beings in the three realms if you do not understand them?

比如你爱一个人，你不了解他的一切怎能关心呵护他呢？

For example, if you love someone, how can you care for and protect them without understanding them?

故你要广学一切法门。

Therefore, you must study a broad range of Dharma methods.

佛为大药王，你要用种种法门救治三界众生。”

The Buddha is the Great King of Medicine; you must use various Dharma methods to heal the beings of the three realms.”

“那怎样了解三界众生呢？”

“Then how can I understand the sentient beings of the three realms?”

“你要进入甚深禅定，只有在甚深禅定中，才能了知三界众生的种种起居饮食、生活习性，种种欲乐、爱好，种种心念，种种根性……

“You must enter profound meditative absorption. Only in deep meditation can you understand the daily routines, eating habits, and ways of life of beings in the three realms; their various pleasures, interests, thoughts, and spiritual capacities…

你才能因势利导，救拔他们出离苦海。”

Only then can you guide them according to their circumstances and help them escape the sea of suffering.”

“怎样进入甚深禅定呢？我以前的修学不是禅定吗？”

“How can I enter profound meditative absorption? Wasn't my previous practice meditation?”

“以前也是定，但对色身来说不是正定。

“Your previous practice did involve concentration, but it was not right samadhi with respect to the physical body.

以前你只是成就法身、化身。

Previously, you had only attained the Dharmakaya and the transformation body.

但现在必须转化色身，要修四禅八定才能进一步转化色身。

But now you must transform the physical body. You need to cultivate the four dhyanas and eight samadhis to transform it further.

你现在已善于调柔自己身心，清净庄严，而且气脉已基本通达，进入正定并不困难。”

You have now learned to calm and harmonize your body and mind, making them pure and dignified, and your energy channels are largely clear. Entering right samadhi should not be difficult.”

“现在修定用不用辟谷，或夜不倒单等。”

“Should I practice fasting or remain seated throughout the night while cultivating samadhi?”

“如心已转化，哪有那么多周折。”

“If the mind has already transformed, why make things so complicated?”

“但如不吃东西，易转化气脉。”

“But if I don't eat, it may be easier to transform the energy channels.”

“一切都是心的幻化，身体都没有，气脉免谈。”

“Everything is an illusion created by the mind. There is no body to begin with, so there is no need to talk about energy channels.”

我开始打坐。

I began meditating.

音又说：“把呼吸调好，没有其它。”

The voice said again, “Regulate your breathing. Nothing else.”

快八点时，我刚开始打坐，忽听到对面墙靠屋顶处有坚硬的啪啪响，睁眼看时，见有一只大蝎子正把尾巴卷起来又放开在玩，把屋顶的铁皮条打的啪啪响。

Just before eight o'clock, as I had begun meditating, I suddenly heard a hard, repeated tapping sound near the ceiling on the opposite wall. When I opened my eyes, I saw a large scorpion repeatedly curling up and releasing its tail, striking a metal strip on the ceiling and making it snap loudly.

自己第一次见此毒物，心中便有点紧张，怕它爬下来。

It was the first time I had seen such a venomous creature, and I felt a little nervous, afraid it might crawl down.

好在它又从屋顶的缝隙中爬回去了。

Fortunately, it crawled back through a gap in the ceiling.

前天打坐时，看到很多蝎子在爬，但因在定中，不知看到了哪里，想必是屋顶上有很多毒物。

Two days earlier, during meditation, I had seen many scorpions crawling around. Because I was absorbed in meditation, I did not know where I had seen them, but I supposed there were many venomous creatures on the roof.

韦陀说：“蝎子阴毒，却喜欢阳气足的地方。

Weituo said, “Scorpions are sinister and venomous, yet they like places with abundant yang energy.

你这段时间正处在阴极阳生的时候，故招来许多蝎子。”

You are currently at a stage when yin has reached its extreme and yang is beginning to emerge, which is why you have attracted so many scorpions.”

自己这段时间在定中也不像以前那样。

My experiences in meditation lately had also been different from before.

曾经，自己出神去天龙山蝎子精洞里玩，对满洞蝎子一点畏惧感都没有，像幻化出来的。

In the past, I had traveled out of my body to visit the cave of the scorpion spirit on Tianlong Mountain. I had felt no fear at all of the scorpions filling the cave; they had seemed like mere illusions.

而现在即使在定中，也心怀胆怯。

Now, however, I felt apprehensive even while in meditation.

上次看到蜈蚣也是又恶心又慌乱，不够镇定，想必是气脉转化之故。

The last time I saw a centipede, I had felt both disgusted and panicked, unable to remain calm. I supposed this was due to the transformation of my energy channels.

而且这几天心力极弱，到晚上更甚。

Moreover, my mental energy had been extremely weak over the past few days, especially in the evenings.

THE RETREAT JOURNAL · 46

四月二十六日

April 26

昨晚睡觉没有关灯，第一是怕蝎子再爬出来，第二是这几天一闭眼就看到有许多小虫。

I left the light on while sleeping last night. First, I was afraid the scorpion might come out again. Second, over the past few days, whenever I closed my eyes, I would see many tiny insects.

有的在缝隙，有的在洞里，有的正到处乱爬。

Some were in crevices, some inside holes, and others were crawling around everywhere.

各种各样的小虫，自己看到后，全身就痒痒。

Whenever I saw these various little creatures, my whole body would start to itch.

开灯感觉会好点。

I felt a little better with the light on.

后似睡非睡中，忽看到自己头两侧单腿站着两只鹤，一边一只，自己心里明白，这两只鹤是专驱逐吃小虫的。

Later, in a state between sleeping and waking, I suddenly saw two cranes standing on one leg beside my head, one on each side. Somehow, I understood that these two cranes were there specifically to drive away the insects that ate the little bugs.

而且床下，屋子的地上到处都长着灵芝和山参。

Moreover, lingzhi mushrooms and wild ginseng were growing everywhere beneath the bed and across the floor of the room.

这些灵芝还会说话，让我安心睡觉，说有它们在，小虫不会再来的。

The lingzhi mushrooms could even speak. They told me to sleep peacefully and said that, with them there, the little insects would not return.

自己这晚竟睡得安稳，一觉睡到六点半多才起床。

That night, I actually slept soundly and did not get up until a little after 6:30 a.m.

睁开眼后，似乎还看到头两侧的大白鹤。

After opening my eyes, I seemed to see the two large white cranes still standing beside my head.

起床后，自己边洗漱边想，自己能有此福气受到这么多照顾，不知其他修学人遇到此情况怎么办呢？

After getting up, I thought while washing my face and brushing my teeth: I was fortunate to receive so much care. I wondered what other practitioners would do if they encountered such a situation.

大概他们看不到，反而不会觉得是问题吧。

Perhaps they would not see these things and therefore would not regard them as a problem.

如能看到的，诸佛菩萨一定会加持的。

If they could see them, the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas would surely bless and support them.

而且连这些成精的山参灵芝都能护持。

Even these wild ginseng roots and lingzhi mushrooms that had acquired spiritual powers could offer protection.

中午睡觉，两小腿和脚胀痛，很难受。

At noon, while sleeping, I experienced severe swelling and pain in both lower legs and feet, which was very uncomfortable.

自己观看，看到的是两条淤血青紫的小腿，一条腿的肌肉裂开向外翻出，另一条腿似坏了一个坑，上面有蛆爬着，想是果报。

When I examined them inwardly, I saw two lower legs mottled blue and purple with stagnant blood. The muscles of one leg had split open and turned outward, while the other seemed to have a cavity of decayed flesh with maggots crawling over it. I thought this might be karmic retribution.

而起床拉起裤脚，两腿完好，但非常难受，腿要不停地来回动。

When I got up and pulled up my trouser legs, both legs were intact, but the discomfort was intense, and I had to keep moving them back and forth.

我求韦陀帮我看一下，韦陀却找来朗公。

I asked Weituo to examine my condition, but he instead brought Master Langgong to me.

朗公说：“这是因果病。

Master Langgong said, “This is an illness caused by karma.

你正在受报，需功德圆满成正等正觉的佛祖才能治，别人恐不行。”

You are undergoing karmic retribution. Only a Buddha who has perfected all merit and attained complete, perfect enlightenment can cure it. Others may not be able to.”

这时，我便对空礼拜，求佛祖指点。

At that point, I bowed toward the empty space, asking the Buddha to guide me.

刚礼拜完，就见从远处的云端里走出一位平民打扮的男子，约三十多岁的样子，挑着两只用布裹住口的黑瓷罐，而且边走边唱，歌声嘹亮悦耳，但我未听懂唱什么。

As soon as I finished bowing, I saw a man dressed as an ordinary commoner emerge from distant clouds. He appeared to be in his thirties and carried two black porcelain jars whose openings were covered with cloth. He walked along singing in a clear, melodious voice, although I could not understand the words.

这时，只见朗公马上向此人招手，并说：“这是个挑担郎中，他能治你的病。”

Master Langgong immediately beckoned to the man and said, “He is a traveling doctor who carries his medicines on a shoulder pole. He can treat your illness.”

韦陀正要阻拦（我也有点疑惑，想：刚才你还说只有佛祖能治。），那人已被朗公招了过来。

Weituo was just about to stop him. I was also somewhat puzzled, thinking, “Didn't you just say that only the Buddha could cure me?” But Master Langgong had already beckoned the man over.

只见他笑嘻嘻地站在我面前，看了一下我的腿说：“这是五毒郁积气脉所致，用我的水洗一下便好。”

The man stood before me with a cheerful smile. After examining my legs, he said, “This is caused by an accumulation of the five poisons obstructing your energy channels. Wash them with my water, and you will be fine.”

说时，拉开一个罐子的布，从里面拿一只勺子舀水洒在我腿上说：“我这是五毒水，正好以毒攻毒。”

As he spoke, he uncovered one of the jars, scooped out some water with a spoon, and sprinkled it over my legs. “This is Five-Poison Water,” he said. “It will use poison to counteract poison.”

这时，我看到韦陀在朗公后面双手合十向此郎中礼拜，我心中当时也明白了，这定是佛祖化现。

At that moment, I saw Weituo standing behind Master Langgong, palms joined in reverence to the traveling doctor. I immediately understood that this must be the Buddha appearing in transformed form.

水洒在腿上后，腿上淤血青肿的肌肉马上消失，看到有红色气流向大腿处循环。

After the water touched my legs, the bruised, swollen muscles and stagnant blood immediately disappeared. I saw red currents of energy circulating toward my thighs.

这时，郎中忽升空中，显出佛祖的相，并说：“用此水连洗三天即可。”

Then the doctor suddenly rose into the air and revealed the appearance of the Buddha. He said, “Wash with this water for three consecutive days, and that will be sufficient.”

随声音隐去。

With those words, the figure disappeared.

朗公看我两腿的肌肉变得好多了，但一腿还有裂口，便揭开另一罐子的布子，说：“噢！这边是清水，大概是用来清洁的。”

Master Langgong saw that the muscles in both my legs had greatly improved, but one leg still had an open wound. He uncovered the other jar and said, “Oh! This one contains clean water, probably for cleansing.”

便又用另一个罐子的水洒在我腿上，伤口马上愈合了，两腿发凉，但还有点胀，不痛了。

He sprinkled water from the other jar over my leg. The wound healed immediately. Both legs felt cool and were still a little swollen, but the pain was gone.

朗公依旧用布盖好罐子，我们都向空中礼拜，谢佛祖。

Master Langgong covered the jars with their cloths again, and we all bowed toward the sky to thank the Buddha.

感悟：

Reflections:

修证佛法首断淫根，如不断淫欲，智慧终不能圆满，烦恼习气不能尽。

The first priority in realizing and verifying the Dharma is to sever the root of sexual desire. If sexual desire is not overcome, wisdom can never be perfected, and habitual afflictions cannot be completely eliminated.

如断淫根，渴爱习气随之断除，即可圆满无漏智慧功德，才真正获自在，才能真正在红尘中游戏，入酒肆淫房也不染着。

Once the root of sexual desire is severed and the habitual tendencies of craving are eliminated along with it, one can perfect uncontaminated wisdom and merit and attain true freedom. Only then can one move freely through the ordinary world without becoming attached, remaining untainted even when entering taverns or houses of sexual pleasure.

才能出污泥而不染，随缘了旧业，才能有力量不舍一法普度众生。

Only then can one emerge from the mud unstained, resolve past karma according to conditions, and gain the strength to liberate all sentient beings without abandoning any Dharma method.

但人从淫欲中来，断淫根甚难。

Yet human beings arise through sexual desire, so severing its root is extremely difficult.

直需火中取莲，死里还生。

It is like plucking a lotus from fire and returning to life from the brink of death.

佛祖当年也只是让弟子持戒，随修行渐渐断除淫心。

Even the Buddha, in his time, instructed his disciples to observe the precepts and gradually eliminate sexual desire through practice.

但现在不像正法时期的印度，那时持戒较易。

But the present day is unlike India during the age of the True Dharma, when keeping the precepts was easier.

现在寺院都是旅游胜地，出家人也可私有资产积聚，大的寺院生活较富裕，僧人在修证方面不得要领。

Nowadays, temples have become tourist attractions, and monastics can also accumulate personal assets. Life in large monasteries is relatively comfortable, while many monks have not grasped the essentials of spiritual realization.

即使一些愿真正发心修持、荷担如来家业的出家人，在持戒上也觉较难，屡屡破戒。

Even some monastics who sincerely aspire to practice and shoulder the Tathagata's mission find it difficult to keep the precepts and repeatedly break them.

因诱惑太多，道心不坚固，定力又不够。

There are too many temptations, their resolve in the Way is not firm enough, and their meditative concentration is insufficient.

破戒后心里又有破戒的障碍，反而有时比在家人更为难修。

After breaking the precepts, they must also contend with the mental obstacles that follow, so at times their path becomes even more difficult than that of laypeople.

希望诸佛菩萨加持，能有更多更好的适合末法时代众生修持的法门出现于世，让一些发心真修实证的人能遇到相应的善知识，遇到适合自己修学的法门。

I hope the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas will bless the world with more and better methods of practice suited to sentient beings in the Dharma-Ending Age, so that those who sincerely aspire to practice and attain realization can meet suitable spiritual mentors and find methods appropriate to their needs.

而且能让这些人值遇善知识和好法门时，佛菩萨加持，让他们能虚心求学，不要让我慢迷住双眼，而一再错过。

May the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas also bless such people when they encounter good teachers and excellent Dharma methods, enabling them to learn with humility rather than allowing arrogance and conceit to blind them and cause them to miss these opportunities again and again.

快五点钟时，我开始打坐。

Shortly before five o'clock, I began meditating.

打坐中，忽从自己头顶冲出万道光芒直插云霄，而且光芒里有彩云缭绕，与天相接。

During meditation, countless rays of light suddenly burst from the crown of my head and shot into the sky. Colorful clouds swirled within the radiance, which reached all the way to the heavens.

整个头顶消失、发凉。

The entire crown of my head seemed to disappear and felt cool.

这时，韦陀菩萨说：“大日如来……”

At that moment, Bodhisattva Weituo said, “Mahavairocana Buddha…”

刚说了半句话，只见对面远处的山中，便有两人相对吹号角，号声比以往更嘹亮，而且山似开了一个缺口，有无数牛、羊等动物像决堤的潮水一样奔涌而来。

He had barely spoken half the phrase when I saw two people in the distant mountains facing each other and blowing horns. Their calls were more piercing than ever before. The mountain seemed to split open, and countless cattle, sheep, and other animals surged forth like a flood bursting through a breached dam.

我稍有些纳闷，只静观之。

I was somewhat perplexed, but simply watched in silence.

牛羊等动物到我房门外时，分开左右两排跪在地上，我才看到这些动物变成了无数藏民，有男有女有老有少。

When the cattle, sheep, and other animals reached the outside of my room, they separated into two rows on either side and knelt on the ground. Only then did I see that the animals had transformed into countless Tibetan people—men and women, young and old.

这时从正中空中显出一相，音说“我为牧羊人”，身子穿着牧羊人的棉袄，似是一牧羊人的装束，但头却隐在一轮圆日中。

Then a figure appeared in the sky directly ahead. A voice said, “I am the Shepherd.” The figure wore a shepherd's padded jacket and appeared dressed like a herdsman, but its head was concealed within a round sun.

而且此相不停变化，成藏地各种佛像金刚等相。

The figure kept changing, assuming the forms of various Buddhas and Vajras from Tibetan Buddhism.

我也一直未作任何念头，只像在梦中静静观看。

I formed no thoughts throughout, simply watching quietly as if in a dream.

这时，有一年轻藏民从山后奔来，跪在地上作礼。

At that moment, a young Tibetan man came running from behind the mountain, knelt down, and paid his respects.

我看到空中的相变成一个法王，穿藏民衣服，头发有佛圈状纹，头顶有肉髻，法相庄严，而且正坐在一高广的法座上。

I saw the figure in the sky transform into a Dharma King, dressed in Tibetan clothing. His hair bore circular, Buddha-like patterns, and he had a protuberance on the crown of his head. His appearance was solemn and dignified, and he sat upon a tall, spacious Dharma throne.

那男子在法座下说了一些话，法王就让他去了。

The man spoke to him beneath the throne, and the Dharma King then dismissed him.

一会，见他与几个人抬一高大的鼓而来，放在法座前，法座与鼓都从地面直到半空中那么高。

A little later, I saw the man return with several others carrying a huge drum. They placed it before the throne, which, like the drum, rose from the ground high into the air.

而且拿来一只香炉。

They also brought an incense burner.

法王喊了一声什么，开始点香，三炷香很高大，火焰一下腾空而起，非常明烨。

The Dharma King called out something and began lighting incense. The three sticks were enormous, and their flames suddenly leapt high into the air, blazing brilliantly.

法王又开始击了三下法鼓，鼓声雄宏。

The Dharma King then struck the ritual drum three times, producing a deep and majestic sound.

这时，路边跪着的人开始欢呼、持咒，我耳里自始至终一直充满藏语念咒语的声音。

The people kneeling along the roadside began cheering and chanting mantras. Throughout the entire vision, my ears were filled with the sound of mantras being recited in Tibetan.

法王后边，有人从山那边铺了一条羊毛毯，几个藏族年轻女子手捧白色哈达，一步一跪而来，一直到我面前，把哈达挂在我脖子上。

Behind the Dharma King, someone laid a woolen carpet from the other side of the mountain. Several young Tibetan women approached, holding white khatas and kneeling with every step. When they reached me, they draped the khatas around my neck.

随后，又有几位年轻女子手捧托盘，盘中有器皿，里面似盛有清水，几个女子到我面前时，我都会用手指蘸水弹向她们头顶。

Afterward, several more young women approached carrying trays with vessels that seemed to contain clear water. Whenever one of them came before me, I dipped my fingers into the water and flicked a few drops toward the crown of her head.

这几个女子后面竟还跟了一条小叭狗，那狗竟爬在我面前立起身，两只圆眼瞪着我迟迟不走。

A small pug even followed behind the women. It crawled up in front of me, stood upright, and stared at me with its two round eyes, refusing to leave for quite some time.

直到我用手抚摸了它的头顶，才摇尾而去。

Only after I stroked the top of its head did it wag its tail and leave.

这时，号角重又响起，法鼓也开始敲，而且越来越紧密。

The horns sounded again, and the ritual drum began to beat, its rhythm growing faster and more intense.

等一下，法王唱了一声，号与鼓声停了下来。

After a while, the Dharma King sang out a single note, and the horns and drum fell silent.

只见法王用藏语大声说了一些话，进入我耳后，马上自动翻译成汉文，意思大概如下：

I saw the Dharma King speak loudly in Tibetan. As the words entered my ears, they were immediately translated automatically into Chinese. Their approximate meaning was as follows:

“大慈大悲的观世音菩萨（三称），你今降生在此世，成为众生的依祜主。

“O greatly compassionate Avalokiteshvara, repeated three times: You have now appeared in this world and become the protector upon whom sentient beings rely.

我今代表藏地人民欢迎你到藏地来，救度藏地的苦难大众。

On behalf of the people of Tibet, I welcome you to Tibet to liberate its suffering people.

我今所作不为别事，为你出关作一庆祝，只希望你出关后，将吹大法螺，击大法鼓，震醒沉睡的人们，震醒沉睡的佛法，让大众不要沉醉于佛法的枝末（其它记不清楚）。”

I do this for no other reason than to celebrate your emergence from retreat. I only hope that after you leave retreat, you will blow the great Dharma conch and beat the great Dharma drum, awakening those who sleep and reviving the slumbering Dharma. May people not become intoxicated by the peripheral details of Buddhism…” (I cannot remember the rest clearly.)

最后，法王又称南无大悲观世音菩萨。

Finally, the Dharma King again chanted, “Homage to Greatly Compassionate Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva.”

这时空中有两条龙开始喷水，象征日新月异。

At that moment, two dragons in the sky began spraying water, symbolizing renewal and constant progress.

后法螺又吹响，鼓声又敲起，在远处的山凹处，有一只雄鸡高声啼鸣，随之，有百鸟从山中飞起，像彩云一般，一轮巨大的红日从鸡后冉冉升起，所有图像逐渐隐去。

Then the Dharma conch sounded again, and the drum began to beat. In a distant mountain hollow, a rooster crowed loudly. Hundreds of birds rose from the mountains like colorful clouds, and an enormous red sun slowly rose behind the rooster. All the images gradually faded away.

此法事气势庞大，多谢大日如来！

This ritual was magnificent in scale. Many thanks to Mahavairocana Buddha!

晚上打坐约一个小时后，忽看到头顶黑压压的一片，似乌云涌来。

After meditating for about an hour in the evening, I suddenly saw a vast dark mass above my head, like a bank of storm clouds rolling in.

我以前都是韦陀帮忙罩一个光罩，现自己用紫金袈裟把自己整个盖住，加个意念便隐去身形。

Previously, Weituo would help by covering me with a protective dome of light. This time, I covered my entire body with the purple-gold robe and, with a single thought, concealed my form.

韦陀菩萨也化一道光柱消失了。

Bodhisattva Weituo also transformed into a column of light and disappeared.

因已有很多次这种情况，知是魔王带魔众经过，因自己道业未成，不便与之抗衡。

Since this had happened many times before, I understood it as the Demon King passing by with his retinue. Because my cultivation was not yet complete, it would not be appropriate for me to oppose them.

魔王在前，魔子魔孙在后，人数众多，走了很长时间，才从空中过完。

The Demon King went first, followed by his many demon sons and descendants. Their numbers were vast, and it took a long time for the entire procession to pass through the sky.

这时，只见一金刚手里提许多人头，在我头顶空中盘旋。

At that moment, I saw a Vajra warrior circling in the sky above my head, carrying many human heads in his hands.

我看到他手中的人头有我的家里的人。

I saw the heads of members of my family among those he carried.

来回走了多时，此金刚说：“怎么没有，应该在这。”

After circling back and forth for quite some time, the Vajra warrior said, “Why isn't she here? She should be here.”

这时，本地土地手捧一根大人参出现在空中，说：“金刚在找什么？”

At that moment, the local Earth God appeared in the sky holding a large ginseng root and asked, “What are you looking for, Vajra warrior?”

他说：“在找一位三十多岁的女人。”

He replied, “I am looking for a woman in her thirties.”

土地把人参献上说：“此地没有三十多岁的女人。”

The Earth God presented the ginseng root to him and said, “There is no woman in her thirties here.”

那黑金刚便收了人参准备离去。

The dark Vajra warrior accepted the ginseng root and prepared to leave.

土地说：“是否能留一颗人头给我。”

The Earth God asked, “Could you leave one of the heads with me?”

这时，我看到此金刚手里的人头中有哥哥，正在不停打喷嚏。

At that moment, I saw my older brother's head among those carried by the Vajra warrior. It was sneezing repeatedly.

土地说：“就留他吧。”

The Earth God said, “Leave him here, then.”

那金刚似乎拿了土地的人参，不好意思不留，便把那人头留下说：“五千多人，缺一个也无妨。”

The Vajra warrior seemed reluctant to refuse after accepting the Earth God's ginseng, so he left the head behind and said, “There are more than five thousand people. One missing won't matter.”

土地忙把那人头接住。

The Earth God quickly caught the head.

等金刚走后，土地喊韦陀菩萨，韦陀出现在空中，把那人头向地面抛去。

After the Vajra warrior had left, the Earth God called for Bodhisattva Weituo. Weituo appeared in the sky and tossed the head toward the ground.

我也显像说：“那还有那么多人。”

I also manifested an image and said, “But there are still so many others.”

韦陀盘坐在空中说：“我作法让他的咒术失灵。”

Weituo sat cross-legged in the sky and said, “I will perform a ritual to neutralize his spell.”

只见韦陀口中念念有词，这时，便见到空中有无数人头向地面坠去。

I saw Weituo murmuring incantations, and then countless human heads began falling from the sky toward the ground.

刚做完法，魔王又带人返了回来，我与韦陀、土地都隐去身形。

As soon as the ritual was complete, the Demon King returned with his retinue. Weituo, the Earth God, and I all concealed our forms.

只见那金刚在魔王面前作礼说：“大王，不知何人破了我的诛法，此人神通很大，我无力与之抗衡。”

I saw the Vajra warrior bow before the Demon King and say, “Your Majesty, I do not know who has broken my killing spell. This person possesses great supernatural powers, and I am unable to contend with them.”

魔王想了一下，便挥手让他退下。

The Demon King thought for a moment, then waved for him to withdraw.

并仰天微微叹息说：“大势所至矣！”

He sighed faintly toward the sky and said, “The tide of events has reached its inevitable course!”

这时，魔王忽命队伍中一美艳的女子上前，附耳交待了几句，便狂笑而去。

Then the Demon King suddenly summoned a beautiful woman from among his retinue, whispered a few instructions into her ear, and departed with a wild laugh.

那女子给魔王作礼后，像一阵黑色的漩流进了我父母家。

After bowing to the Demon King, the woman swept away like a black vortex and entered my parents' home.

我看到那女子附在母亲身上。

I saw the woman attach herself to my mother.

这时，韦陀在空中出现，手拿杵指向我母，并说：“大胆魔女，还不快出来。”

At that moment, Weituo appeared in the sky, holding his vajra and pointing it toward my mother. He said, “How dare you, demoness! Come out at once!”

这时，只见一团黑气从母亲身上飘出，到空中后变成一位美丽的女人，跪在韦陀面前，并用手摸韦陀指向她的杵，面上露出妩媚的媚笑。

A cloud of black vapor drifted out of my mother's body and transformed in the sky into a beautiful woman. She knelt before Weituo and touched the vajra he had pointed at her, wearing a seductive smile.

而且，此女的手摸韦陀的杵时，那杵似中了魔力，开始发白光，从杵传到韦陀手臂。

As the woman's hand touched Weituo's vajra, it seemed to be under a spell. It began to emit white light, which spread from the vajra up Weituo's arm.

韦陀站在那里忽然僵立不动，我大吃一惊。

Weituo suddenly froze in place, unable to move. I was shocked.

这时，忽在空中出现无数韦陀，同时大吼：“大胆魔女，我是韦陀大将军，还不赶快离去！”

Then countless manifestations of Weituo suddenly appeared in the sky, all shouting in unison, “How dare you, demoness! I am General Weituo. Leave at once!”

只见魔女脸色忽变，一阵黑烟而去。

The demoness's expression suddenly changed, and she vanished in a cloud of black smoke.

我对韦陀说：“想不到自己修行，给家人带去这么多麻烦。”

I said to Weituo, “I never imagined that my spiritual practice would bring so much trouble to my family.”

韦陀说：“不要担心，他们不会有事的。”

Weituo replied, “Do not worry. They will be fine.”

THE RETREAT JOURNAL · 47

四月二十七日

April 27

昨晚睡得不好，因常有一种小虫飞来飞去，不知是从哪儿飞出来的。

I slept poorly last night because a small insect kept flying around, and I had no idea where it was coming from.

飞的又不稳当，横冲直撞，声音很大，像蜜蜂，有时撞到墙上、玻璃上发出声音。

It flew erratically, darting about and making a loud buzzing sound like a bee, sometimes crashing into the walls or windows with an audible thud.

小虫个头大，背壳硬，我抓住扔出去一个，一会儿又一个飞进来，可能是从房顶的缝隙出来的吧。

The insect was fairly large, with a hard shell on its back. I caught one and threw it outside, but before long another flew in. Perhaps they were coming through gaps in the ceiling.

快二点多才睡，中间又起来几次，故早上起床时已是七点一刻了。

I did not fall asleep until nearly two in the morning, and I got up several times during the night, so it was already a quarter past seven when I finally rose.

忙起床洗漱、打扫卫生，喝了一杯水，吃了一个苹果就快九点钟了。

I hurried to wash up and clean the room, drank a glass of water, and ate an apple. By then, it was almost nine o’clock.

上午一直打坐。

I spent the entire morning in meditation.

刚开始坐时，先是观到一切都变成了一种光，包括自己的身体，而且这种光也虚幻不实，一切房屋、树木物体都虚幻不实地在这种光里若隐若现、若有若无、变化不定，而且连生起这种念头的心也虚幻不实。

When I first sat down, I perceived everything transforming into a kind of light, including my own body. Yet this light, too, seemed illusory and insubstantial. Houses, trees, and all other objects appeared and disappeared within it, alternately seeming to exist and not to exist, constantly changing. Even the mind that gave rise to these thoughts seemed illusory and insubstantial.

定了一会儿，又出定，觉噪音很多，外面各种飞鸟的叫声、屋内地上爬的、空中飞的小虫的嗡嗡声、自己的心跳声、血液的流动声、地球的转动声，此起彼伏，像在奏交响乐。

After remaining in concentration for a while, I emerged from that state and became aware of a great many sounds: birds calling outside, insects crawling along the floor and buzzing through the air inside the room, the beating of my own heart, the flow of my blood, and even the rotation of the Earth. The sounds rose and fell in succession, like an orchestra performing a symphony.

慢慢，这些声音变的与我毫不相干，整个宇宙变成一种凝固不动的光，所有的声音、色彩、境界统统都像凝固在光里一样。
