Gradually, these sounds seemed to have nothing to do with me. The entire universe became a motionless, solidified light, with all sounds, colors, and phenomena seemingly frozen within it.

那境界像树枝等杂物凝冻在厚厚的冰块里，冰块是透明的，还能看到里面凝住不动的点点黑色物质。

The scene resembled miscellaneous objects, such as branches, trapped inside a thick block of ice. The ice was transparent, and I could still see tiny black particles suspended motionless within it.

这样定了一会儿，忽然神识又开始涣散，想到了家里的人。

I remained in that state for a while, but suddenly my consciousness began to wander again, and I thought of my family.

只一个念头，那凝固的光便消失了，自己便把让自己牵挂的、喜欢的、讨厌的、放不下的人统统拿来，一个一个放在面前观，边观边解剖自己的心念，为什么放不下，执着在哪儿，有什么放不下……

With just that single thought, the solidified light vanished. I then brought before my mind, one by one, all the people I worried about, loved, disliked, or could not let go of. As I contemplated each person, I examined my own thoughts: Why could I not let go? Where did my attachment lie? What was it that I still clung to?

因为心非常沉静，最后竟把所有的人观得像外面飘落在地上的枯叶，浑身瞬间轻松了，无任何牵挂和杂念。

Because my mind was exceptionally calm, I eventually perceived all these people as though they were nothing more than withered leaves scattered on the ground outside. In an instant, my entire body felt light and free, without a single worry or distracting thought.

只观到自己心脉处红红的，像是受了伤似的。

The only thing I noticed was a reddish area around the energy channels near my heart, as though it had been injured.

大概只要有牵挂，不管是讨厌的，还是喜欢的，都会让自己心脉受伤的。

Perhaps any attachment, whether to someone I disliked or someone I loved, could injure these channels around the heart.

自己便把念力守在那红红的地方，直到那红色的光忽然消失，转化成湛明的光，而且这种湛然的光明迅速扩大到整个身体，观到整个身体变得湛然幽明。

I therefore kept my attention focused on that reddish area until the red light suddenly disappeared and transformed into a clear, luminous radiance. This serene brilliance rapidly spread throughout my entire body, and I perceived my whole body as becoming clear, luminous, and mysteriously radiant.

自己便一直定在这种幽明的境界里，无我无他，但还有念头知道自己定在这种境界里。

I remained absorbed in this luminous state, with no sense of self or other, although a thought was still present, knowing that I was resting in this state of concentration.

这时，朗公忽来，用昨天释佛留下的罐里的水开始浇我全身，我未出定，也未打招呼，只是定在那种幽明的光中，但他说话、做事我心里很清楚。

At that moment, Master Langgong suddenly appeared and began pouring over my entire body the water from the jar that Shifo had left yesterday. I neither emerged from meditation nor greeted him. I simply remained absorbed in that luminous state, although I was fully aware of everything he said and did.

他边用五毒水不停地浇，边用手中的一把玉如意敲打我的骨骼，听到自己骨骼关节被震开发出的叭叭响声。

He continuously poured the Five Poisons Water over me while using a jade ruyi scepter to tap my bones. I heard sharp cracking sounds as the vibrations seemed to loosen my skeletal joints.

而且骨头很硬，骨质也不好，还有的地方发黄，有的发红、发白，颜色也不均匀。

My bones were extremely hard, and their quality seemed poor. Some areas were yellowish, others reddish or whitish, and their coloring was uneven.

朗公说：“这么硬，关节都像锈住了。”

Master Langgong remarked, “They’re so hard. The joints are practically rusted shut.”

这时，自己看到自己身体纯粹是摆在禅床上的相，没有呼吸，正在被朗公又洗又清理。

At this point, I perceived my body as nothing more than an image lying on the meditation bed, no longer breathing, while Master Langgong washed and cleaned it.

朗公敲了半天，看到关节震动时，从里面飞出来的尘土。

After Master Langgong had been tapping my bones for a long time, I saw dust flying out from inside them whenever the joints vibrated.

一会儿，又看到有一女童给朗公送来一个像现代喷杀虫剂的瓶子，朗公把它喷在骨骼上、脏器里，说是杀虫的。

A little later, I saw a young girl bring Master Langgong a bottle resembling a modern insecticide spray. He sprayed it over my bones and internal organs, saying that it was intended to kill insects.

后又与小童进入我的身体清扫我的骨缝、脏器，简直就像在大扫除。

Then he and the little girl entered my body and cleaned between my bones and throughout my internal organs. It was practically a major spring-cleaning.

一会儿，自己观整个骨骼白骨流光，脏器也很干净了。

After a while, I perceived my entire skeleton glowing with a pure white radiance, and my internal organs appeared clean as well.

但朗公似乎还不满意。

But Master Langgong did not seem satisfied yet.

又见鲁班手拿巨斧前来，为我修理骨骼损坏的地方，叮叮当当一阵响，像在做木工活。

I then saw Lu Ban arrive, carrying an enormous axe. He began repairing the damaged parts of my skeleton, producing a series of clanging sounds, as though he were doing carpentry.

一会儿，鲁班说：“她这骨骼很多已坏掉了，需重新化生，没办法修理。

After a while, Lu Ban said, “Much of her skeleton has already deteriorated. It must be regenerated from scratch; there is no way to repair it.

三十三重天上有种‘和合胶’可以化生一切，请世尊帮忙可以拿到。”

“There is a substance called ‘Harmonizing Glue’ in the Thirty-Three Heavens that can regenerate anything. Please ask the World-Honored One to help us obtain some.”

这时，空中出现了释迦牟尼的巨大座像，像满整个虚空。

At that moment, an enormous seated image of Shakyamuni Buddha appeared in the sky, filling the entire expanse of space.

巨大座像庄严肃静，虚空中的飞禽走兽、房屋、树木依然清晰存在，也不从他身上出，也不会印在他身上，似乎毫不相干，但两者都能清楚看到。

The colossal figure was solemn and majestic. Birds and animals, houses, and trees remained clearly visible in the surrounding space. They did not emerge from his body, nor were their images reflected upon it. The two seemed entirely unrelated, yet both could be seen distinctly.

只见世尊伸出右手，鲁班便站在他手掌心，世尊收回巨臂，轻轻抬抬手掌，鲁班就消失在空中。

I saw the World-Honored One extend his right hand, and Lu Ban stood in the palm of his hand. The Buddha drew back his enormous arm and gently raised his palm, whereupon Lu Ban disappeared into the sky.

一会儿，见鲁班手拿一个琉璃瓶又出现在世尊手中，世尊把他轻轻放在我面前，世尊的相慢慢才消失，我看到世尊盘坐着的巨大的脚快伸到我关房内。

A little later, Lu Ban reappeared in the Buddha’s hand, holding a glass-like bottle. The World-Honored One gently set him down in front of me. Only then did the Buddha’s image gradually fade away. I could see his enormous feet as he sat cross-legged, almost reaching into my retreat room.

鲁班手里的琉璃瓶像流动的光焰，但有瓶子的形状，他把瓶口对着我，从头浇下来，有粘稠的光从头灌下来，我的头、肩随着光变得湛然幽明。

The glass-like bottle in Lu Ban’s hands seemed to contain flowing flames of light, although it retained the shape of an ordinary bottle. He pointed its opening toward me and poured the contents over my head. A viscous, luminous substance streamed down from above, and as the light flowed over me, my head and shoulders became clear, radiant, and mysteriously luminous.

骨骼消失了，瓶子里的胶水一下就倒完了，但我只转化了头和肩。

My bones disappeared. The glue in the bottle was emptied all at once, but only my head and shoulders had been transformed.

朗公说：“没有了吗？”

“Is that all?” Master Langgong asked.

鲁班说：“因是娑婆世界，重生出来慢一点，瓶里一会还会生出来的。”

“Because this is the Saha World, regeneration takes a little longer,” Lu Ban replied. “The bottle will replenish itself shortly.”

果然，几秒钟后，瓶里的胶又满了，这样反复生反复倒，直到把我的骨骼全部变化掉为止。

Sure enough, a few seconds later, the bottle was full of glue again. They repeated the process, allowing the substance to regenerate and pouring it over me again and again until my entire skeleton had been transformed.

然后，鲁班说：“现在她的骨骼是化生出来的，不能算父母所生。”

Then Lu Ban said, “Her skeleton has now been generated anew. It can no longer be considered something born of her parents.”

我一直定着，观看这些境界，心里无任何杂念，身体像个木偶器具，随他们摆弄。

I remained in meditation, observing these scenes without a single distracting thought. My body felt like a wooden puppet or an instrument, being handled as they pleased.

看到韦陀也一直站在空中观看。

I also saw Weituo standing in the sky, watching the entire process.

真是山大了，什么动物都有。

It is true what they say: when a mountain is vast, it contains every kind of creature.

刚才又看到从房顶缝隙中爬出一只小蜥蜴，也是第一次见。

Just now, I saw a little lizard crawling out through a gap in the ceiling. It was the first time I had seen one here, too.

这几天天开始转暖，所有的动物都开始抛头露面。

The weather has been warming over the past few days, and all kinds of creatures are beginning to emerge.

房屋太旧了，每天打扫两次，都有无数小虫像从空中化生一样，不停地被我从屋里请到院子里去。

The building is so old that even though I clean twice a day, countless little insects keep appearing as though they were spontaneously generated out of thin air. I am constantly escorting them from my room into the courtyard.

这几天心力极弱，有时自己都能感到心弦孱弱纤细，有点小的动静都会吓一大跳，但心却不慌乱，那种感觉说不出来，像吓一跳的不是我，我一直是无动于衷的，但确实又是全身心的吓了一跳。

My mental and emotional strength has been extremely weak these past few days. At times, I can almost feel the delicate, fragile strings of my heart. Even the slightest unexpected sound makes me start violently, yet my mind does not become agitated.

It is difficult to describe the sensation. It feels as though it is not really me who is startled; I remain inwardly unmoved, and yet my entire being undeniably reacts with a start.

今天观《华严经》，观到第三十八卷，说善才童子观普贤从初发心所行之道。

Today, while contemplating the Avatamsaka Sutra, I reached Volume Thirty-Eight, which describes Sudhana’s contemplation of the path Samantabhadra followed from the moment he first aroused the aspiration for enlightenment.

其心广大犹如虚空，大悲坚固犹若金刚。

His mind was vast as space, and his great compassion was as steadfast as a diamond.

忽然自己心有所动，竟定在那儿。

Suddenly, something stirred within me, and I became absorbed in meditation right there.

瞬间感觉自己心若虚空，无挂无碍，哪有什么柔弱、有力，连虚空皆不可得，好几天由于心脉转化或生理的原因导致的心力不足一下子消失了。

In an instant, I felt that my mind was as vast as space, without attachment or obstruction. How could it be described as weak or strong? Even space itself could not be grasped. The weakness of mind and spirit that had troubled me for several days, whether due to changes in the heart channels or to physiological causes, suddenly disappeared.

出定后，心力虽还不是很强，但感觉承受力已恢复到成人的标准了。

After emerging from meditation, my mental strength was still not particularly strong, but I felt that my capacity to withstand things had returned to a normal adult level.

观《华严经》，因是向寺院师父借来的，怕自己出关前看不完。

I was reading the Avatamsaka Sutra, which I had borrowed from a monk at the temple, and I was afraid I would not finish it before the end of my retreat.

只好先看了一到十卷后，又看了二十六到四十卷。

So I first read Volumes One through Ten, followed by Volumes Twenty-Six through Forty.

现在还有时间，再返回来看十一到二十五卷。

Now that I still have some time, I am going back to read Volumes Eleven through Twenty-Five.

看书中间，不停有小虫飞出来，横冲直撞。

As I read, little insects kept flying out, darting about wildly.

我一会儿就送到院子里十几只。

Within a short time, I had escorted more than a dozen of them into the courtyard.

最后，只好祈请此方土地神想办法，我合掌礼拜此方土地。

In the end, I had no choice but to ask the local Earth God for help. I folded my palms and bowed in reverence to the deity of this land.

只见一须发皆白的小老儿从大门笑哈哈走了进来，而且手拿一佛尘。

I saw an elderly man with completely white hair and a white beard come laughing through the main gate, holding a fly whisk in his hand.

我说：“你是此方土地吗？”

“Are you the Earth God of this area?” I asked.

他说：“我是此方八百里内土地神。

“I am the Earth God responsible for a territory extending eight hundred liin every direction,” he replied.

说来惭愧，名誉上是管八百里，其实我只能管到方圆六百里。

“I must confess, though: officially, I am in charge of eight hundred li, but in reality, I can only manage a radius of six hundred.

所以，只能称六百里土地。”

“So I should really be called the Earth God of Six Hundred Li.”

边说边笑，看上去这位土地爷爷很幽默风趣。

He spoke with a laugh. This grandfatherly Earth God seemed to have a wonderful sense of humor.

我说了小虫太多，不知土地神有何办法。

I explained that there were too many insects and asked whether the Earth God had any way to deal with them.

土地说：“这好办。”

“That’s easy,” the Earth God said.

说完，便双手合十，站在屋中念起咒来。

He then pressed his palms together and began chanting a mantra in the middle of the room.

瞬间，有无数小虫从屋子的四面八方云集而来，全部附在土地身上。

In an instant, countless little insects converged from every corner of the room and attached themselves to his body.

只片刻，土地浑身成了一个虫子堆。

Within moments, the Earth God was completely covered in a mass of insects.

我有点吃惊，暗想：“此办法不是很好吧。”

I was rather taken aback and thought to myself, “That doesn’t seem like a very good solution.”

这时忽从院子中央又冒出一个土地神，笑嘻嘻地说：“菩萨，老衲在此。”

Just then, another Earth God suddenly appeared in the middle of the courtyard, smiling broadly. “Bodhisattva, I am here,” he said.

我一看也笑了，原来土地神早就金蝉脱壳出去了。

I looked at him and laughed, too. It turned out that the Earth God had already made his escape by leaving behind a decoy, much like a cicada shedding its shell.

但屋子中央这个爬满小虫的土地竟也会走，只见院子里的土地挥挥佛尘说：“跟我来。”

Yet the Earth God in the middle of the room, now covered in insects, could walk as well. I saw the one in the courtyard wave his fly whisk and say, “Come with me.”

那屋中的土地便转身出门而去。

The Earth God inside the room then turned and walked out through the door.

所有的小虫都牢牢地贴在那土地身上，像用胶粘住一样。

All the insects clung tightly to his body, as though they had been glued there.

只听见土地远远喊了一声：“菩萨，告辞了，请菩萨安心用功吧！”

From a distance, I heard the Earth God call out, “Bodhisattva, I shall take my leave. Please continue your practice in peace!”

便消失在大门外。

Then he disappeared beyond the main gate.

土地走后，屋子里忽然安静了很多，没有小虫的动静了。

After the Earth God departed, the room suddenly became much quieter. I could no longer hear the insects buzzing about.

不知晚上怎样，拭目以待。

I would have to wait and see what happened that evening.

如果起作用，应该闭关前就拜见此地的山神和土地。

If this method really worked, I should have paid my respects to the local mountain god and Earth God before beginning the retreat.

俗话说：县官还不如现管呢。

As the saying goes, sometimes the local official is more useful than a county magistrate.

傍晚打坐。

In the evening, I sat in meditation again.

初坐时，看到自己天目处有一手指粗的黑洞。

At first, I saw a black hole about the width of a finger at the location of my heavenly eye.

而且发胀，自己便把意念守在那黑洞处。

It also felt swollen, so I focused my attention on that hole.

观了片刻，念力自动下移到鼻梁靠近两眼角那一段，鼻子又开始发胀、痒。

After observing it for a while, my mental focus moved downward of its own accord to the section of the bridge of my nose near the inner corners of my eyes. My nose began to feel swollen and itchy.

而且自己内心对自己说：“鼻子这块有脉不通。

Within myself, I seemed to hear these words: “There is a blocked channel in this part of the nose.

打通时，因此处脉极微细，而且有两根极敏感神经，触动神经会牵动心意识，出现一些幻境，自己一定不要恐怖惊慌，否则前功尽弃。”

“When it opens, the channel is extremely fine, and there are two highly sensitive nerves here. Stimulating them can affect the mind and consciousness, producing certain illusory scenes. You must not become frightened or panic, or all your previous efforts will be wasted.”

说完，就把意念守在鼻子那块。

After this, I kept my attention fixed on that part of my nose.

此时，那段通道像堵塞了很久，似有脉粘连在一起。

The passage felt as though it had been blocked for a long time, with what seemed like channels stuck together.

自己观到红红的鼻粘膜，当感觉有能量通过时，看到鼻毛乍起，瞬间，鼻毛变化一只长满了腿的毛毛虫，而且还有一只大大的螃蟹扑面而来，伸出蟹钳夹住了那段鼻子。

I perceived the reddish mucous membrane inside my nose. When I felt energy passing through, I saw the hairs inside my nose suddenly stand on end. In an instant, they transformed into a hairy caterpillar covered in legs. At the same time, an enormous crab lunged toward my face and extended its pincers to clamp onto that part of my nose.

自己知道这是幻化，心中不惊不怖，丝毫不为所动，只是死死的将意念守在那一块。

I knew these were illusory transformations. I felt neither fear nor dread and was not moved in the slightest. I simply kept my attention firmly fixed on that spot.

忽然，幻境消失了，同时，有两股白色的能量流上升入脑，而且鼻梁似乎拓宽，有能量从鼻子的脉扩散向两边的眼底，眼睛里白光涌动（按正常，此脉打开，日久功深，可过目不忘，一目十行。）

Suddenly, the illusory scene disappeared. At the same time, two streams of white energy rose into my brain. The bridge of my nose seemed to widen, and energy spread from the channel in my nose toward the areas beneath both eyes. White light surged within my eyes. (Under normal circumstances, once this channel opens and one has practiced deeply over a long period, one may develop the ability to remember everything at a glance and read ten lines at a time.)

我又守了一会儿，便把念力移向喉部，因喉部气脉还是不畅。

I kept my attention there a little longer, then shifted it to my throat, because the energy channels there still did not seem to flow freely.

守了一会儿，观到喉轮和天花板处有两个大洞，似破了洞的渔网，觉脉道损坏严重。

After concentrating for a while, I perceived two large holes, one at the throat chakra and another in the ceiling. They looked like holes in a fishing net, and I felt that the channels had been severely damaged.

而且破洞处有根鱼脊骨，自己把它从脉道拔了出来。

There was also a fish’s backbone lodged in one of the holes, and I pulled it out of the channel.

想是曾吃鱼的果报显像，便又是忏悔又是回向功德，又是发愿普度。

I thought this might be a manifestation of karmic retribution for having eaten fish in the past. So I repented, dedicated the merit of my practice, and made vows to liberate all beings.

这样慢慢才看到靠颈椎处有两道白光上升入后脑，但喉前部还是不行。

Only gradually did I begin to see two streams of white light rising from an area near my cervical spine into the back of my brain. The front of my throat, however, still seemed blocked.

慢慢，才感到有清凉忽然入喉，像吃了人丹。

Little by little, I finally felt a cool sensation suddenly enter my throat, like the refreshing effect of taking a traditional medicinal pill known as rendan.

而且看到舌头发金光，自己便很欢喜。

I also saw my tongue emitting golden light, which made me very happy.

因如舌发金光，象征自己曾广积口德，而且所言不虚，才能看到自己舌的光呈金色。

I believed that a golden tongue symbolized having accumulated much merit through virtuous speech and having spoken truthfully, and that this was why I could see a golden radiance coming from my tongue.

喉部、口腔气脉仍未完全通达，只能慢慢修持。

The energy channels in my throat and mouth were still not completely open, so I could only continue practicing patiently, step by step.

现在快三个小时了，小虫子一个也不见，自己觉得似从闹市一下进入了山里，耳根里清净了很多，太感谢土地爷了。

Nearly three hours had passed, and not a single insect had appeared. I felt as though I had suddenly left a bustling city and entered the mountains; my ears were finally enjoying much greater peace and quiet. I was deeply grateful to the Earth God.

THE RETREAT JOURNAL · 48

四月二十八日

April 28

一晚上未有小虫骚扰，睡得较好。

No insects disturbed me during the night, and I slept relatively well.

只是不困，十二点多才睡下。

I simply did not feel sleepy, so I did not go to bed until after midnight.

早五点四十分起床，洗漱后，洗了几件衣服，喝了一小盒牛奶。

I got up at 5:40 a.m. After washing up, I washed a few items of clothing and drank a small carton of milk.

给寺院师父写了便条，告诉自己按时出关，后开始观《华严经》。

I wrote a note to the monk at the temple, informing him that I would end my retreat on schedule, and then began contemplating the Avatamsaka Sutra.

今天可能因为经期，身体感觉疲软，故早上补充了一杯牛奶，但未见起色。

Perhaps because I was menstruating, my body felt weak and fatigued today. I therefore had an extra glass of milk in the morning, but noticed no improvement.

傍晚打坐，又见释佛巨大的像遍满虚空，但与房屋树木，空中的一切毫不障碍。

During evening meditation, I again saw an enormous image of Shifo filling the entire expanse of space, yet it did not obstruct the houses, trees, or anything else in the sky.

这可能是自己能同时观到两个维层的景致，如是释佛来到我面前的空中，他巨大的身形应该遮住外面的天空与树木才对，但我却又能同时看到。

Perhaps I was able to perceive scenes from two different dimensions simultaneously. If Shifo had appeared in the space before me, his enormous figure should have blocked my view of the sky and trees outside, yet I could still see them at the same time.

但却又看到释佛的像明明在我院子里的上空，巨大的脚都快放到我打坐屋子的门里了。

At the same time, I could clearly see Shifo's image suspended above my courtyard, with his enormous feet almost reaching into the doorway of the room where I meditated.

而门也无脚穿过来的痕迹，神通境界不可思议。

Yet there was no sign of his feet passing through the doorway. The workings of supernatural powers are truly inconceivable.

看到释佛时，便看到有几个人在门口建起两幢八宝玲珑塔，非常美观，塔上的铃发出悦耳的声音。

As I gazed at Shifo, I also saw several people building two exquisite pagodas adorned with the Eight Treasures near the entrance. They were very beautiful, and the bells on the pagodas produced a pleasing sound.

下午，还从空中飞来一只巨大的怪鸟，它全身乌黑，头上毛很长，似女人剪得齐齐的刘海，从空中降下来时，随身子的起伏上下波动。

In the afternoon, an enormous, strange bird flew in from the sky. Its entire body was jet-black, and the feathers on its head were very long, resembling a woman's neatly trimmed fringe. As it descended, the feathers bobbed up and down with the movement of its body.

它落在院子中时，跪在地上，变化一个身披黑斗篷的男子，手拿一封信举过头说：“菩萨，太上老君让送信给你。”

When it landed in the courtyard, it knelt on the ground and transformed into a man wearing a black cloak. Holding a letter above his head, he said, “Bodhisattva, the Supreme Lord Lao has sent me to deliver this letter to you.”

我有点惊奇，老君以这种方式联络，便出门去接了信，那人瞬间又变成鸟腾空而去。

I was rather surprised that Lao Jun had contacted me in this way, so I went outside to receive the letter. The man instantly transformed back into a bird and flew away into the sky.

我拆开信，老君大意是：见信如见面。

I opened the letter. Lao Jun's message was essentially as follows: “Reading this letter is like seeing me in person.

因现在西域，不能脱身，祝我闭关圆满结束。

“I am currently in the Western Regions and cannot get away. I wish you a successful and complete conclusion to your retreat.

多谢义父挂念。

“Thank you, adoptive father, for keeping me in your thoughts.”

下午禅定中宁母与五母来，五母进来后，只不停打量这个寺院，似很喜欢这儿，说这个寺院好大啊！

During afternoon meditation, Mother Ning and Mother Wu arrived. After entering, Mother Wu kept looking around the temple, apparently very taken with it. “This temple is so big!” she exclaimed.

宁母说仍在峨眉山修行，现普贤菩萨已把她调入金顶的主殿执事，不在下面当差了。

Mother Ning said that she was still practicing on Mount Emei. Samantabhadra Bodhisattva had now transferred her to serve in the main hall at the Golden Summit, so she was no longer assigned to duties down below.

还带来普贤菩萨的问候，并送一枚金色的花，像一枚胸针大小。

She also brought greetings from Samantabhadra Bodhisattva and gave me a golden flower about the size of a brooch.

我拿起来看到下面的柄上写着一行字“普贤大行愿海”，我便珍藏起来。

I picked it up and saw the words “Samantabhadra's Vast Ocean of Great Vows and Practices” inscribed on its stem. I carefully put it away as a treasured keepsake.

宁母问寒问暖，又带了她亲自从山上摘的松籽给我。

Mother Ning asked how I was doing and showed great concern for me. She had also brought me pine nuts that she had personally gathered on the mountain.

这时，正好巴山圣母派的两个童女彩鸾、彩凤抬一大桶洗澡水而来，要为我沐浴。

Just then, two young maidens from the retinue of the Holy Mother of Bashan, Cailuan and Caifeng, arrived carrying a large tub of bathwater for me.

宁母与五母便告辞了。

Mother Ning and Mother Wu then took their leave.

五母说在五台山藏经阁执事，具体哪个寺院，无暇问及。

Mother Wu said she was serving in the sutra library on Mount Wutai, but I had no time to ask which particular temple.

我只是勉励她们不要辜负普贤和文殊两位菩萨的厚爱，好好精进修行，等自己圆满后当度脱她们。

I simply encouraged them not to disappoint the great kindness shown to them by Samantabhadra and Manjushri Bodhisattvas, but to practice diligently and make steady progress. Once my own practice was complete, I would help liberate them.

她们走时，自己想送她们一点什么东西，正在踌躇送什么好，忽见自己满身披挂的全是金银、珍珠、玛瑙、玉器，忙从手臂上脱下一对宽大的金手镯，送给两母，两母都很高兴。

As they were leaving, I wanted to give them something. While wondering what would make a suitable gift, I suddenly noticed that I was adorned from head to toe with gold, silver, pearls, agate, and jade. I quickly removed a pair of broad gold bracelets from my arms and gave them to the two women. They were both delighted.

我又从脖子上摘下一些项链给她们，正要再摘，忽想到她们福报不够，如送东西太多，被其它邪门外道看到来抢夺，岂不是给她们惹出祸来？便没有再送。

I then took some necklaces from around my neck and gave them to the women. Just as I was about to remove more jewelry, I suddenly thought that their store of merit and good fortune might not be sufficient. If I gave them too much and other heterodox beings saw it and tried to seize the gifts, would I not be bringing trouble upon them? So I stopped giving them anything more.

自己原来没想到自己这么富有，那以后在定中也可物布施。

I had never realized that I was so wealthy. In that case, I could also make material offerings while in meditation.

别人帮忙做了事，也可赠一些礼物给人家。

When others helped me with something, I could give them gifts in return as well.

THE RETREAT JOURNAL · 49

四月二十九日

April 29

今天是闭关的第七个七天了，早上六点起了床，洗漱，打扫卫生，并洗了一些衣服，还喝了一小盒牛奶。

Today marks the beginning of the seventh seven-day period of my retreat. I got up at six in the morning, washed up, cleaned the room, washed some clothes, and drank a small carton of milk.

心态很平常，像刚进关一样，没有什么波动。

My state of mind was quite ordinary, just as it had been when I first entered retreat, without much emotional fluctuation.

只是昨晚睡到床上，忽想到世人。

Last night, however, after lying down in bed, I suddenly began thinking about ordinary people.

因四十多天未近距离接触外人，自己感觉身心非常清净，虽然外表依然未变，但内身心却是流光溢彩、通体透彻。

Having had no close contact with other people for more than forty days, I felt that my body and mind had become exceptionally pure and still. Although my outward appearance remained unchanged, my inner being seemed to shimmer with light and to be clear and transparent throughout.

在关内时时听到外面人的说话声，都透出一种土气与俗气来，感到他们心垢很厚，像结了痂似的，而且言行俗不可奈。

While in retreat, whenever I heard people talking outside, their voices seemed to convey a certain earthiness and worldliness. I felt that the impurities in their minds were thick, almost like hardened scabs, and that their words and behavior were unbearably vulgar.

自己知不应有此分别，但那种感觉太强烈了，像污秽的气扑面而来。

I knew I should not make such distinctions, but the feeling was so intense that it seemed as though a foul odor were blowing directly into my face.

自己觉得，有些是自己今生必须要做的，如：孝顺赡养父母，抚育子女，尊师爱友，弘扬佛法等，自己只是觉得这是一种无法推卸的责任，自己必须尽心尽力完成，只是一切以轻重缓急来做。

I felt that there were certain things I had to do in this life, such as honoring and supporting my parents, raising my children, respecting teachers and cherishing friends, and spreading the Buddha's teachings. I regarded these as responsibilities I could not shirk and had to fulfill to the best of my ability, while prioritizing them according to their relative importance and urgency.

自己已了悟因果，看透红尘人与人之间的恩恩怨怨，是是非非，包括父母、子女、兄妹、爱人等，在心中只是一种因缘，自己现在心中已无任何贪著恋爱，孰轻孰重、孰近孰远之想，只是了缘，尽量随顺满他们的愿而已。

I felt that I had understood cause and effect and seen through the entanglements of gratitude, resentment, right, and wrong that bind people together in the mundane world. This included relationships with parents, children, siblings, partners, and others. In my heart, they were simply connections arising from causes and conditions. I no longer felt attachment or romantic longing, nor did I think in terms of who mattered more or less, or who was closer or more distant. I simply sought to fulfill these karmic connections and accommodate their wishes as far as possible.

当然，一切还是以道业为重，对不理解自己的人，随他们骂自己无情无义、狠心好了。

Of course, spiritual practice remained my highest priority. Those who did not understand me could call me heartless, unfeeling, or cruel if they wished.

自己觉内心的领悟与感受，想暂时无人能真正理解了。

I felt that, for the time being, no one could truly understand my inner realizations and experiences.

如不是这些责任在身，自己定会远遁山林，与清风明月为伴，即使餐风露宿……那才是自己真正最喜欢的光景。

If I did not have these responsibilities, I would certainly retreat far into the mountains and forests, keeping company with the fresh breeze and the bright moon, even if I had to live on wind and sleep beneath the dew. That was the life I truly longed for most.

想自己慈悲之心还是未真正生起来，也未真正无我。

Reflecting on this, I realized that genuine compassion had still not fully arisen in me, and that I had not truly attained selflessness.

否则，怎会常思维自己自在享受呢？

Otherwise, why would I so often think about enjoying freedom and comfort for myself?

也应多想想众生的苦楚。

I should also think more often about the suffering of sentient beings.

而且自己有能力从五毒之中拔出来，脱离烦恼，也是众生成就了自己。

Moreover, my ability to extricate myself from the Five Poisons and free myself from afflictions was also made possible by the role sentient beings had played in my development.

自己断不能有此自私的念头，当时时以众生为念。

I absolutely must not entertain such selfish thoughts. I should keep sentient beings in my heart at all times.

上午十点半开始上香打坐。

At ten thirty in the morning, I lit incense and began meditating.

刚出定，只见韦陀菩萨告曰：有众仙前来祝贺。

As soon as I emerged from meditation, I saw Bodhisattva Weituo announce, “A group of immortals has come to offer their congratulations.”

只见空中显出玉帝的相，同时有两男孩抬进一个硕大的夜明珠，底座用木雕刻。

I saw the image of the Jade Emperor appear in the sky. At the same time, two boys carried in an enormous luminous pearl mounted on a carved wooden base.

一男孩说：“此夜明珠是玉帝送给菩萨的，三千多年，从龙宫而来，可以清热解毒、避暑用，晚上光明照耀像日月。”

One of the boys said, “This luminous pearl is a gift from the Jade Emperor to the Bodhisattva. It is more than three thousand years old and comes from the Dragon Palace. It can clear heat, detoxify, and provide relief from the summer heat. At night, it shines as brightly as the sun and moon.”

说完，玉帝的相从空中消失，两男孩作礼而去。

After he had finished speaking, the Jade Emperor's image disappeared from the sky, and the two boys bowed and departed.

那珠子晶莹剔透，珠萦绕着朦胧的青色薄烟，像从水面升腾的雾气。

The pearl was crystalline and translucent, surrounded by a faint, hazy veil of bluish mist resembling vapor rising from the surface of water.

随后，太上老君母来临，坐鸾驾，有上千侍女随从。

Next, the Mother of the Supreme Lord Lao arrived in a phoenix carriage, accompanied by more than a thousand maidservants.

老君母下轿，嘘寒问暖，后拿出一柄很小的宝剑，说：“这是一条大蟒蛇修了一万年的丹所化。

After stepping down from her carriage, the Mother of Lao Jun asked after my well-being. She then took out a very small treasured sword and said, “This sword was formed from the elixir cultivated by a great python over ten thousand years.

此蛇曾是剑仙，故把丹炼得像一柄剑，可大可小，灵气异常。”

“This serpent was once a sword immortal, so it refined its elixir into the shape of a sword. The sword can expand or shrink and possesses extraordinary spiritual energy.”

去年进贡老君母，老君母认为是个宝贝，一直想留着送给我。

It had been presented to the Mother of Lao Jun as a tribute last year. She considered it a treasure and had always intended to keep it for me.

我谢过老君母，老君母便告辞。

I thanked the Mother of Lao Jun, and she then took her leave.

老君母的随从在院子上空还未完全散去，只见弥勒菩萨忽挺个大肚子，背个布袋而来，落下云头说：“这么热闹啊！”

The attendants of the Mother of Lao Jun had not yet completely dispersed from the sky above the courtyard when Maitreya Bodhisattva suddenly appeared, his large belly protruding and a cloth sack slung over his back. Descending from the clouds, he exclaimed, “What a lively gathering!”

随之拿下布袋，往地上一倒，便有许多好吃的东西。

He took off his sack and tipped it onto the ground, spilling out a great quantity of delicious food.

大概倒了半袋，说：“可以了，足够你吃几世了。”

After emptying about half the sack, he said, “That will do. There is enough here to feed you for several lifetimes.”

我说：“弥勒菩萨何必费心弄吃的给我。”

I said, “Maitreya Bodhisattva, you needn't go to so much trouble to bring me food.”

弥勒说：“你以为去西藏路上会有好吃的吗？便给你带点吃的。”

Maitreya replied, “Do you think there will be good food on the road to Tibet? I thought I would bring you something to eat.”

我笑了笑说：“菩萨，我这色身如此笨重，何时转化得了。”

I smiled and said, “Bodhisattva, this physical body of mine is so cumbersome. When will I ever be able to transform it?”

弥勒不以为然地说：“真的出来了，还怕假的。

Maitreya dismissed my concern. “Once the real thing emerges, why fear what is false?

太阳出来，乌云迟早会散去，糊涂蛋。”

“When the sun comes out, the dark clouds will eventually disperse, you silly goose.”

边说边背起布袋踏歌而去。

Singing as he spoke, he hoisted his sack onto his back and danced away.

这时，忽从后门进来三个人。

At that moment, three figures suddenly entered through the back door.

前面一个头的下半部分像鱼，鱼须长而多，上半部分像龙，身体像人身。

The head of the one in front had the lower half of a fish, with long, abundant whiskers, while the upper half resembled a dragon. Its body was human in shape.

后边跟俩穿黑衣服的小厮一直未抬头，看不清容貌，进来后站在我禅床的左侧，吓得浑身发抖。

Behind him were two attendants dressed in black. They kept their heads bowed, so I could not make out their faces. After entering, they stood to the left of my meditation bed, trembling all over with fear.

那似龙似鱼的人先让那俩小厮跪下，自己也跪下说：它为东海一蛟，在这守侯很久，刚才韦陀去送老君母，他才有机会从后门溜进来，希望菩萨点化。

The dragon-fish figure first ordered the two attendants to kneel, then knelt himself and said that he was a jiao dragon from the Eastern Sea. He had been waiting here for a long time and had only managed to slip in through the back door when Weituo went to escort the Mother of Lao Jun away. He hoped the Bodhisattva would offer him spiritual guidance.

这时，我看到白衣观音很慈和地用手摸三人的头，后面那两个黑衣人简直受宠若惊，欣喜若狂。

At that moment, I saw Avalokiteshvara, dressed in white, gently and compassionately pat the heads of all three figures. The two attendants in black were overwhelmed by this unexpected kindness and became ecstatic with joy.

观音还送它们用龙的语言写的《观音普门品》让他们仔细研读，并说前面的大蛟一千年后可投胎做人，后面的两个三千年后才可投胎做人，到时菩萨再来度化。

Avalokiteshvara also gave them a copy of the Universal Gate Chapterof the Lotus Sutra, written in the language of dragons, and instructed them to study it carefully. The Bodhisattva said that the great jiao dragon in front could be reborn as a human in one thousand years, while the two attendants behind him would have to wait three thousand years before being reborn as humans. At that time, the Bodhisattva would return to guide and liberate them.

要它们多做善事，多积功德。

The Bodhisattva urged them to perform more good deeds and accumulate merit.

此时，韦陀已在空中，默默观注这一切，未发一言，但威怒四射。

By then, Weituo was already in the sky, silently watching everything. He said nothing, but his imposing and wrathful presence radiated in every direction.

观音说完后，三个人不敢抬头看韦陀，急忙想从后门溜出去，但观音菩萨笑着指点他们从正门走。

After Avalokiteshvara finished speaking, the three figures did not dare raise their heads to look at Weituo. They hurriedly tried to slip out through the back door, but Avalokiteshvara smiled and directed them to leave through the main entrance.

三个人只能从韦陀脚下仓惶而去，但看出他们欢喜的很。

The three had no choice but to hurry past beneath Weituo's feet, yet they seemed extremely happy.

老蛟刚走，半空中水晶宫方向忽升起一巨大龙头，一条龙身露出一半时，变成一龙头人身，穿白色长袍，龙头也变得像人脑袋一般大小。

As soon as the old jiao dragon had departed, an enormous dragon's head suddenly rose into the sky in the direction of the Crystal Palace. When half of its body had emerged, it transformed into a figure with a dragon's head and a human body, dressed in a long white robe. Its dragon's head also shrank to about the size of a human head.

龙说：“东海龙王拜见菩萨，今菩萨出关，老龙前来祝贺。”

The dragon said, “The Dragon King of the Eastern Sea pays his respects to the Bodhisattva. Now that the Bodhisattva is completing the retreat, this old dragon has come to offer his congratulations.”

随着声音，几女童抬进有盆口大小的白莲花，都似开未开，摆满一地。

As he spoke, several young maidens carried in white lotus flowers as large as washbasins. They were all on the verge of blooming, and soon the ground was covered with them.

龙王又命两小童送上一个珊瑚石，也有底座，龙王介绍说：“此珊瑚已有五万年，是龙宫之宝物。

The Dragon King then ordered two young attendants to bring forward a piece of coral mounted on a base. He introduced it, saying, “This coral is fifty thousand years old and is one of the treasures of the Dragon Palace.

菩萨可看，此珊瑚中有一天然造型，似人之眼睛，故五万年的时间，在此眼中炼出一颗宝珠，像人之眼球。”

“Bodhisattva, look closely. This coral has a natural formation resembling a human eye. Over fifty thousand years, a precious pearl has formed within this eye-like shape, resembling a human eyeball.”

我仔细观看，见此珊瑚四边不齐整，中间部位狭长光滑，形似一只人眼，而最妙的是珊瑚中空，有一圆形小球在里面来回转动，像人眼睛一样。

I examined it carefully. The coral had an irregular outer shape, while its middle section was elongated and smooth, resembling a human eye. Most remarkable of all, it was hollow, with a small spherical object moving back and forth inside it, just like an eyeball.

龙王说：“菩萨常眼疲劳，可对此宝珠观看，即可消除。”

The Dragon King said, “Bodhisattva, whenever your eyes feel tired, gaze at this precious pearl and the fatigue will disappear.”

我便瞪着那珠看了一会，忽然，那珠从珊瑚中一跃而出，进入我眼中，并一分为二。

I stared at the pearl for a while. Suddenly, it leaped out of the coral, entered my eye, and split into two.

龙王和我都忽感意外，龙王说：“想不到此宝与菩萨倒有缘分，也是合该菩萨得此宝。

Both the Dragon King and I were taken by surprise. The Dragon King said, “I did not expect this treasure to have such a connection with the Bodhisattva. It seems that it was destined to come into your possession.

不过，宝珠虽走，但此珊瑚也算是海中极品，菩萨当珍藏，不要丢弃。”

“Although the pearls have departed, this coral is still an exceptional treasure of the sea. Bodhisattva, you should keep it carefully and not discard it.”

我谢过龙王，龙王便告退而去。

I thanked the Dragon King, who then took his leave.

此时，地上的白莲尽数开放，放出晶莹的光芒，满屋青莲的香味。

At that moment, all the white lotuses on the ground blossomed, radiating a crystalline light and filling the entire room with the fragrance of blue lotuses.

龙王刚走，只见远处的山中，有两人吹起长长的号角。

As soon as the Dragon King had departed, I saw two figures in the distant mountains blowing long horns.

我想，是大日如来吗？

I wondered, “Could it be Mahavairocana Buddha?”

但不像，因大日如来出现时，两人吹的号像长长的牛角做的。

But it did not seem so, because when Mahavairocana Buddha appeared, the horns blown by the two figures had looked as though they were made from long ox horns.

而这次吹的却是像铜管子，细细长长的，似长号。

This time, however, the instruments resembled long, slender brass tubes, rather like trombones.

只见半空中有人来，而且觉很庄严，但我看不到任何相。

I sensed someone approaching through the sky. The presence felt very solemn and majestic, yet I could not see any visible form.

有声音自半空响起：“我是密勒日巴尊者，我从无喜国来。”

A voice rang out from the sky: “I am Venerable Milarepa. I have come from the Land of No Joy.”

我问：“无喜国在哪儿。”

I asked, “Where is the Land of No Joy?”

尊者说：“不在娑婆世界。”

The Venerable replied, “It is not in the Saha World.”

随之，空中出现许多尊者化生人间的幻相。

After that, many visions appeared in the sky, depicting the Venerable manifesting in human form in the world.

那些幻相唱道：“一切供养皆虚幻，菩萨不着不住不眷恋……菩萨心如虚空照……”（有的语句我记不起来）。

Those visions sang, “All offerings are illusory. A Bodhisattva neither clings, abides, nor becomes attached… The Bodhisattva's mind shines like the vastness of space…” (I cannot remember some of the lines.)

等所有幻相消失，有俩人（人身大象头）抬一大鼎而来。

After all the visions had disappeared, two figures with human bodies and elephant heads appeared, carrying a huge cauldron.

声音又说：“此鼎是我专门仿照娑婆世界的鼎而造，声音响起，震动三千世界。”

The voice spoke again: “I specially made this cauldron in the likeness of one from the Saha World. When its sound rings out, it will shake the great three-thousandfold world system.”

随说，有几个手指轻轻从鼎上抚过，只听雄宏悦耳悠扬的钟声随之而起，大地、山峦、天空同时震动，海水就像沸腾了一样，空中有光晃动，我也震动了几下。

As the voice spoke, several fingers gently brushed across the cauldron. A majestic, melodious, and resonant bell-like sound arose. The earth, mountains, and sky all trembled at once, the ocean seemed to boil, and light shimmered in the air. I, too, felt myself shake several times.

密勒日巴尊者又用神力护持，重新开始敲鼎三下。

Venerable Milarepa then used his spiritual power to protect and support me, and struck the cauldron three more times.

这三次，一切都未震动，边敲边说：“希望菩萨将来广弘大道，法音远播。”

This time, nothing trembled. As he struck the cauldron, he said, “May the Bodhisattva widely propagate the Great Way in the future, and may the Dharma resound far and wide.”

又说：“听说阿底峡尊者已邀请菩萨去西藏，而且大日如来也为此做了盛大的法事，我今也送些助道品给菩萨”。

He continued, “I hear that Venerable Atisha has invited the Bodhisattva to Tibet, and that Mahavairocana Buddha has also conducted a grand Dharma ceremony for this purpose. I, too, shall offer the Bodhisattva some items to support the path.”

随说，我面前便出现了十多种法器。

As he spoke, more than ten kinds of ritual instruments appeared before me.

尊者说：“这是藏地的十种法器，菩萨入乡随俗，以后当会用。”

The Venerable said, “These are ten kinds of ritual instruments from Tibet. When the Bodhisattva visits that land, it will be appropriate to follow its customs, and these will come in handy.”

随后逐渐隐去。

Then he gradually faded from view.

随之，空中出现文殊骑青狮而来。

Next, Manjushri appeared in the sky, riding a blue lion.

文殊只在空中，吹起横笛，随着笛音，空中幻化出种种奇珍异宝、鲜花、彩蝶、珍禽异兽、百鸟奇花等等绚丽多彩的图画，我似置身画中，被种种美景围绕，心旷神怡。

Manjushri remained in the sky and began to play a transverse flute. As its melody flowed, the air filled with brilliant visions of rare treasures, fresh flowers, colorful butterflies, exotic birds and animals, and countless other wondrous blossoms and creatures. I felt as though I had entered a painting, surrounded by magnificent scenery, my heart opening wide with joy and ease.

忽然，笛音停了，种种景观离开我，在空中似显示在一透明的光球中，逐渐消失。

Suddenly, the flute fell silent. The various scenes withdrew from around me and seemed to appear inside a transparent sphere of light in the sky, where they gradually disappeared.

文殊说：“世界所有佛事皆如此。”

Manjushri said, “All Buddha-related activities in the world are like this.”

说完，不再说任何话，回身乘青狮而去。

Having said this, he spoke no further, turned around, mounted the blue lion, and departed.

自己笑着目送菩萨隐去，觉心中还有一丝粘连的情感，希望再与文殊说点什么，但文殊果断离去，像一种洁净透明的光刹那的化现，令自己静静反省。

I smiled as I watched the Bodhisattva disappear. I sensed a lingering thread of attachment in my heart, a wish to say something more to Manjushri. But Manjushri departed decisively, like a momentary manifestation of pure, transparent light, leaving me to reflect quietly on myself.

忽空中又出现巨大的光影，说：“我为普贤如来。”

Suddenly, another enormous figure of light appeared in the sky and said, “I am Samantabhadra Tathagata.”

我正在寻找声自哪一方发出。

I was trying to determine where the voice was coming from.

音又说：“菩萨在找什么？”

The voice asked again, “What are you looking for, Bodhisattva?”

闻此音，我忽回光返照，只见在自己的每个毛孔里，都有自己和普贤菩萨在倾谈交流，而且普贤菩萨在一一毛孔中显不同的相。

Hearing these words, I suddenly turned my awareness inward. I saw that within every pore of my body, I was conversing and exchanging thoughts with Samantabhadra Bodhisattva, who manifested a different appearance in each pore.

在毛孔中，看到普贤如来送给自己一柄玉如意，祝自己事事如意。

Within these visions in my pores, I saw Samantabhadra Tathagata give me a jade ruyi scepter, wishing that everything would go smoothly for me.

然后，普贤如来告辞时，又送一柄伞给我，那伞从空中飞来，立即满屋香气扑鼻，原来伞柄是用香木做的。

Then, as Samantabhadra Tathagata took his leave, he gave me an umbrella as well. It flew through the air toward me, and at once the entire room filled with a rich fragrance. I discovered that its handle was made of fragrant wood.

伞面像蘑菇，发出白色光芒。

The canopy resembled a mushroom and radiated white light.

我看到自己忽化成千手千眼，有一只手接住伞，把伞合拢拿在手中。

I saw myself suddenly transform into a thousand-armed, thousand-eyed form. One of my hands caught the umbrella, folded it closed, and held it.

这时，院子中央忽然涌出莲花座，一道光柱像蘑菇形一样腾上天空，又从天空慢慢下降，从光中化出一青色的小动物谛听，还有地藏菩萨，法相庄严，手拿禅杖，站在我面前，未说一句话，便一手竖在胸前，开始念咒。

At that moment, a lotus throne suddenly emerged from the center of the courtyard. A column of light, shaped like a mushroom, surged into the sky and then slowly descended. From within the light appeared Diting, a small blue creature, along with Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. His sacred form was majestic, and he held a monk’s staff. Standing before me, he said nothing, but raised one hand before his chest and began chanting a mantra.

我也双手合十，恭敬谛听。

I joined my palms and listened reverently.

地藏王用汉文在念，咒子很长，听不懂，但一雄厚的男声持咒音不停在我身心缭绕，我观到自己的肌肉、骨骼逐渐消失，最后变成空空的光筒，光也几乎快消失了。

Ksitigarbha was chanting in Chinese. The mantra was very long, and I could not understand it. Yet a deep, powerful male voice continued to reverberate throughout my body and mind. I watched as my muscles and bones gradually disappeared, until I became an empty tube of light, and even that light was almost gone.

这时，地藏停止念咒，也未发一言，回身上座，振一下禅杖，大地立即变成水晶一样透明，而且地下也是，我能透过水晶一样的地下，看到地藏回归住所，而且在其住所，光明严净，纯是净土。

At that point, Ksitigarbha stopped chanting without saying a word. He turned and returned to his seat, then shook his monk’s staff once. Immediately, the earth became transparent like crystal, and so did everything beneath it. Through the crystal-clear ground, I could see Ksitigarbha returning to his abode. His dwelling was radiant and immaculate, entirely a Pure Land.

自己非常惭愧，想地藏菩萨用此大愿力，使自己走过的地方，皆严净若此，使地狱像大梵天一样光明照耀，连污垢的土地也变得水晶一样透明。

I felt deeply ashamed. I thought that Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, through the immense power of his vows, made every place he passed through as pure and immaculate as this. He could make even the hell realms shine with a radiance like that of Great Brahma Heaven, transforming even filthy ground into something as transparent as crystal.

在此光的照射下，自己觉自己心量狭隘、心力弱小，惭愧万分。

Beneath this light, I became acutely aware of the narrowness of my mind and the weakness of my resolve, and I felt profound shame.

地藏结束咒语前，还走上前用掌摩顶加持。

Before finishing the mantra, Ksitigarbha also stepped forward and blessed me by placing his palm on the crown of my head.

修道初发心一定要常护持自己的起心动念，如履薄冰。

When first setting out on the path of cultivation, one must constantly guard every movement of the mind, as carefully as walking on thin ice.

就这样，也常是一个妄念起来，早已无数次破戒，早已造下无数业种，机缘一来，果子便熟。

Even so, a single deluded thought may arise, and one may already have broken one’s precepts countless times and planted innumerable karmic seeds. When the right conditions arrive, the fruit ripens.

自己迷在业缘里，滚来滚去，欢乐、痛苦、辛酸自己偿受，何时才是尽头？！

Deluded by karmic entanglements, I tumble about endlessly, experiencing joy, pain, and bitterness myself. When will it ever end?!

究竟等何时才准备出离？！

How long will I wait before I truly prepare to leave this cycle behind?!

常在自己身边的人，自己离成道愈近，比较起来便觉他们离道愈远。

The closer I come to realization, the farther from the path the people around me seem by comparison.

常心急想打消他们的妄念，让他们能早日回归光明清净的心性，这才算有点修道的基础。

I often grow impatient and want to dispel their deluded thoughts, hoping they will return sooner to their luminous, pure nature of mind. I feel that only then will they have some foundation for cultivation.

但他们贪著世界的欲乐享受，觉得很舒服，而且大家都有较强的名利心，不愿出离，即使佛祖再来，能有什么办法。

But they are attached to worldly pleasures and enjoy them immensely. Everyone also has strong desires for fame and gain, and they are unwilling to renounce them. Even if the Buddha himself returned, what could he do?

让他们放下一点自私执着的东西，都会像小孩玩弹子输了几颗玻璃球一样，瞪起圆圆的眼睛，暗暗盘算自己的利益得失，犹自不甘心、心疼的样子，有时还会烦躁发脾气，一定是不舒服极了。

Ask them to let go of even a little selfishness or attachment, and they react like children who have lost a few marbles in a game: their eyes widen, they secretly calculate their gains and losses, and they remain reluctant and heartbroken. Sometimes they even become irritated and lose their temper, clearly finding the experience unbearable.

欲令入佛智，先以欲勾牵。

“To lead beings into the Buddha’s wisdom, first entice them with what they desire.”

但自己总不能让他们以追求名利去求道吧？

But surely I cannot encourage them to pursue the path by chasing fame and fortune?

再说自己还没有力量向他们显示什么，即使自己神通具足，让他们因羡慕佛的神通智慧而发心修道，也已离道十万八千里。

Besides, I do not yet have the ability to demonstrate anything to them. Even if I possessed every kind of supernatural power, and they were inspired to cultivate by admiring the Buddha’s spiritual powers and wisdom, they would still be a very long way from the true path.

果如不正必遭迂曲，发心不正，即使修道途中逐渐能澄清心性放下欲望习气，也要多走许多弯路，多遭许多磨难劫数，何苦来呢。

If the cause is not right, the result will inevitably be circuitous. With an impure initial motivation, even if one gradually clarifies the mind and relinquishes desires and habitual tendencies during cultivation, one will still have to take many unnecessary detours and endure many more hardships and tribulations. Why make things so difficult?

不然，也只能成魔，不能成无上正等正觉。

Otherwise, one may become a demon rather than attain supreme, perfect enlightenment.

唉！其实，自己想得太多，他们有自己的宿缘，自己也不是在师父们的指导下猛然醒悟，历十多年才放下许多习气欲望，到现在都不敢说完全净。

Alas! In truth, I think too much. They have their own karmic connections from the past. I, too, only gradually awakened under the guidance of my teachers, and it took me more than ten years to let go of many habitual tendencies and desires. Even now, I dare not claim to be completely purified.

操这么多心干什么，自己如有能力，慢慢帮助他们好了，能修到什么样子，全凭他们自己的造化了，有什么可急可担心的。

Why worry so much? If I am able, I can help them gradually. How far they progress in cultivation depends entirely on their own causes, conditions, and fortune. What is there to be anxious or worried about?

自己得诸佛诸菩萨的加持、护念，诸天人供养，也不能有丝毫的我慢心理。

Even though I receive the blessings and protection of the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas, and offerings from heavenly beings, I must not allow even the slightest arrogance to arise.

众生都是未来佛，自己当如是想，与人说话一定要低声、柔软、随顺，就像对诸佛说话一样。

All sentient beings are future Buddhas. I should keep this firmly in mind and speak to others in a gentle, soft, and accommodating manner, as though speaking to the Buddhas themselves.

不然，这些未来佛起了嗔心、发起脾气来，万一造下地狱畜牲的业来，岂非自己的过错。

Otherwise, if these future Buddhas become angry and lose their tempers, and end up creating karma that leads to rebirth in the hell or animal realms, would that not be partly my fault?

自己从诸佛菩萨那讨来的宝贝连送的地方都没有，唉！开个玩笑而已，也是无奈！

I have collected treasures from the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas, yet I cannot even find anyone to give them to. Alas! I am only joking, of course—but there is a certain helplessness in it all!

摘录《华严经》第十七卷：

Excerpt from Volume Seventeen of the Avatamsaka Sutra:

一心不动修习初禅。

With a mind that is single and unmoving, cultivate the first dhyana.

息诸意业摄诸众生，智力勇猛喜心悦忆；修二禅。

Cease mental activity and gather sentient beings in your care; let wisdom and strength be vigorous, and let the mind be joyful and delighted. Thus cultivate the second dhyana.

思维一切众生自性，厌离生死，住涅槃乐；修三禅。

Contemplate the intrinsic nature of all sentient beings, develop revulsion toward birth and death, and abide in the bliss of nirvana. Thus cultivate the third dhyana.

悉能悉灭一切众生众苦热恼；修第四禅。

Be able to understand and extinguish all the suffering and torment of sentient beings. Thus cultivate the fourth dhyana.

增长圆满一切智愿，善巧出生诸三昧海，入诸菩萨解脱海门。

Increase and perfect all vows for omniscience, skillfully bring forth vast oceans of samadhi, and enter the gateways to the vast ocean of Bodhisattva liberation.

游戏一切菩萨神通，成就一切清净变化，以清净智普入法界。

Freely exercise all the spiritual powers of Bodhisattvas, accomplish every kind of pure transformation, and enter the entire Dharma Realm through pure wisdom.

我唯得此菩萨寂静禅定乐普遨勇猛解脱门。

I have attained only this gateway of liberation: the Bodhisattva’s joyful, tranquil meditative absorption, and the courageous freedom to roam everywhere.

晚打坐，满虚空开金色莲花，自己也坐在金莲上，心若虚空。

During evening meditation, golden lotuses blossomed throughout the vastness of space. I, too, sat upon a golden lotus, my mind as vast as the sky.

韦陀来说：“大光佛来临。”

Bodhisattva Weituo came and announced, “The Great Radiance Buddha is arriving.”

我一看，满虚空都是师父的相，师父从无色界天而来，现为天主。

I looked and saw my teacher’s form filling the entire sky. My teacher had come from the Formless Realm and appeared as a heavenly lord.

师父变成一个光圈从我头顶套下，然后有音：“孩子，一切可好？”

My teacher transformed into a ring of light that descended over my head. Then a voice asked, “Child, is everything well?”

我答：“很好。”我请师父再显一相出来。

I replied, “Very well.” I asked my teacher to manifest another form.

只见在我对面空中，显出一琉璃体的莲花座和琉璃的师父。

A crystal-like lotus throne appeared in the air before me, with my teacher seated upon it in a body of crystal.

师父说：“这次闭关成就法身，祝贺你……希望你能处处以弘扬佛法、以众生为念……”

My teacher said, “Congratulations on realizing the Dharmakaya during this retreat… I hope you will always keep the propagation of the Dharma and the welfare of sentient beings in mind…”

自己默默聆听教诲。

I listened silently to these teachings.

并说：“自己常怀惶恐，怕辜负师恩。”

I added, “I am often apprehensive, afraid that I may fail to live up to your kindness and guidance.”

师父说：“你现已得菩萨不动地，不必为此忧恼。”

My teacher said, “You have now attained the Bodhisattva’s Immovable Ground. You need not worry about this.”

我还对师父说自己颈部气脉一直不畅通，不知为何。

I also told my teacher that the energy channels in my neck had remained blocked, and I did not know why.

师父看了看，笑说：“脖子是歪的，舌根的位置都不正。”

My teacher examined me and said with a smile, “Your neck is crooked, and even the base of your tongue is misaligned.”

边说边捏我颈椎，把头矫正。

As he spoke, he manipulated my cervical spine and straightened my head.

师父矫正后，我却觉得头歪了。

After my teacher corrected it, however, my head felt crooked to me.

师父说你已习惯以前的姿势，慢慢就好。

My teacher said, “You have grown accustomed to your old posture. It will gradually feel right.”

舌头中间像打了一个结，忽然舒展开，变成广长舌相，整个舌发凉。

The middle of my tongue felt as though it had been knotted. Suddenly, it relaxed and spread out, taking on the broad, long-tongue form, and my entire tongue felt cool.

THE RETREAT JOURNAL · 50

四月三十日

April 30

今天是闭关最后一天，明早就要出关了。

Today is the last day of the retreat, and tomorrow morning I will emerge from seclusion.

自己五点半多起床，便洗漱，打扫卫生，洗了几件衣物，直到七点半多才结束。

I got up a little after five-thirty, washed and dressed, cleaned the room, and washed a few items of clothing. I did not finish until a little after seven-thirty.

便上香，供佛，开始打坐。

Then I offered incense and made offerings to the Buddha before beginning meditation.

上午，因要出关，跟朗公打了招呼，感谢他这段时间的护关。

In the morning, since I was about to leave retreat, I greeted Master Langgong and thanked him for protecting the retreat during this period.

朗公正抓住两只狮子精，便一同提来。

Master Langgong was holding two lion spirits captive, and he brought them along with him.

我让韦陀带两只狮子精去处理，让朗公休息一下。

I asked Weituo to take the two lion spirits away and deal with them, so that Master Langgong could rest.

说了感谢的话，并送他三串珠链，一串给佛图澄，另一串给他的小徒弟。

I expressed my gratitude and gave him three strands of beads: one for him, one for Fotucheng, and another for his young disciple.

朗公很高兴激动，说佛图澄去了西藏，最后跪下，说有一事相求。

Master Langgong was delighted and deeply moved. He told me that Fotucheng had gone to Tibet. Then he knelt down and said that he had a request to make.

我笑着说：“不必多礼”。

I smiled and said, “There is no need for such formalities.”

朗公便说他这小徒弟跟他很久了，想让拜在观音菩萨门下做弟子。

Master Langgong explained that his young disciple had been with him for a long time, and he hoped to have the young disciple accepted as a follower of Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva.

那小徒弟听了后，便马上跪下来哭泣。

Upon hearing this, the young disciple immediately knelt down and began to weep.

菩萨答应了，朗公便告辞，说还能再护持一天。

The Bodhisattva agreed, and Master Langgong took his leave, saying that he could continue guarding the retreat for one more day.

并说这四十九天，也全是韦陀的功劳，自己只干了一些皮毛的事，中间有段时间还不在。

He added that all the credit for these forty-nine days belonged to Weituo. He himself had done only a few minor things and had even been away for part of the time.

后广成子前来，祝我闭关圆满结束，并给他的鹤弟子带来一颗丹，说是此鹤曾自己修出来的，一直放在天山，现在他才帮它取来。

Later, Guangchengzi arrived to congratulate me on the successful completion of my retreat. He had brought an elixir for his crane disciple, explaining that the crane had cultivated it itself and that it had been kept on the Tianshan Mountains until now, when he had finally retrieved it for the crane.

只见一只白鹤忽出现在空中，向他问好，他把白色的丹抛过去，鹤张口接住吞入腹中，并在我与广成子头顶绕飞几圈才消失，广成子说有此丹，他道心可坚固。

A white crane suddenly appeared in the sky and greeted him. He tossed the white elixir toward it, and the crane opened its beak, caught it, and swallowed it. It then circled several times above Guangchengzi and me before disappearing. Guangchengzi said that with this elixir, the crane’s resolve in the Dao would be strengthened.

中午时分，空中出现天乐与光，阿弥陀佛在空中显相，大地震动，看到土地、山神、龙王等都跪伏迎接。

Around noon, celestial music and light appeared in the sky, and Amitabha Buddha manifested there. The earth trembled, and I saw local earth deities, mountain spirits, Dragon Kings, and others kneeling in reverence to welcome him.

我向阿弥陀佛问好，并行礼。

I greeted Amitabha Buddha and bowed respectfully.

阿弥陀佛给我带来几件衣服，其中一件薄如轻纱，阿弥陀佛亲自把它披在我身上，说是此衫从最寒冷的北极化生出来，可抵御一切严寒。

Amitabha Buddha brought me several garments. One was as light and sheer as fine gauze. He personally draped it over my shoulders, explaining that it had manifested from the coldest reaches of the North Pole and could protect against all severe cold.

我报身未圆满，要注意保护身体。

“My sambhogakaya has not yet been perfected, so I must take care to protect this physical body.”

并又拿出一白玉做的盒子送我，我打开一看，是无字天书，极乐世界之宝。

He then took out a box made of white jade and gave it to me. When I opened it, I found a celestial book without words, a treasure of the Land of Ultimate Bliss.

我很欢喜，谢过阿弥陀佛，阿弥陀佛又说了一些话，便隐去。

I was delighted and thanked Amitabha Buddha. He spoke a little more and then faded from view.

见一团巨大的光团随之而去，光团中，隐约有天女在飞行。

I saw an enormous sphere of light depart with him, and within it, celestial maidens could be faintly seen flying.

阿弥陀佛走后，空中大概有十多分钟还能看到一尊站立的阿弥陀佛像和金色莲座，场能太强了，一时无法散去。

After Amitabha Buddha departed, an image of him standing on a golden lotus throne remained visible in the sky for perhaps another ten minutes. The energy of the scene was so powerful that it did not dissipate immediately.

昨天师父走后，也在空中有此现象。

The same phenomenon had occurred in the sky after my teacher departed the previous day.

阿弥陀佛刚离去，释迦世尊带众多弟子而来。

As soon as Amitabha Buddha had departed, Shakyamuni World-Honored One arrived with a large assembly of disciples.

先称赞了菩萨能于末法时代乘愿而来，此时众生福薄，菩萨为了成就众生，而受种种磨难……

He first praised the Bodhisattva for coming into the world in the Dharma-ending age, driven by vows. At a time when sentient beings have little merit and good fortune, the Bodhisattva had endured all kinds of hardships for their sake…

世尊与众大弟子来时，地涌无数金莲，世尊带来无数经书，说是我需要的全带来了。

As the World-Honored One and his many great disciples arrived, countless golden lotuses emerged from the earth. The World-Honored One brought an immense number of scriptures, saying that he had brought everything I needed.

中午吃完饭，午休片刻，便开始彻底收拾东西，又洗了一些衣服，晾晒被褥，并又彻底打扫了卫生。

After lunch, I rested briefly and then began packing everything thoroughly. I washed some more clothes, aired the bedding, and cleaned the room from top to bottom once again.

看了一会儿书，已快六点钟，喝杯水，吃了一个苹果。

After reading for a while, I noticed it was nearly six o’clock. I drank a glass of water and ate an apple.

THE RETREAT JOURNAL · 51

五月一日

May 1

早六点多起床，整理床铺。

I got up a little after six in the morning and made the bed.

昨晚风大，院子里又落满了树叶，便开始洒扫。

The wind had been strong the night before, and the courtyard was once again covered with fallen leaves, so I began sweeping.

边扫，树叶边又掉下来，飘飘落落，自己心中很轻松。

As I swept, more leaves kept falling and drifting gently to the ground, and I felt completely at ease.

虽扫了好长时间，才把院子扫净，但看着又飘落下来的黄叶，心中竟很快乐，像风、树叶与自己玩捉迷藏似的，干脆不扫了。

Although it took me a long time to get the courtyard clean, I felt unexpectedly happy watching the yellow leaves drift down again. It was as though the wind and the leaves were playing hide-and-seek with me, so I simply stopped sweeping.

上香供佛后，已经八点多。

After offering incense and making offerings to the Buddha, it was already past eight.

自己坐在禅床上，喝了一杯奶，又喝了一杯水。

I sat on the meditation bed, drank a cup of milk, and then a glass of water.

并静静地看着这个自己独处了四十九天的小院，再过一小时，那闭了四十九天的门就要打开了，这小院的宁静马上就会被打破。

I quietly gazed at the little courtyard where I had spent forty-nine days in solitude. In another hour, the door that had remained closed throughout the retreat would open, and the peace of this small courtyard would soon be broken.

但我相信，自己心中那像虚空一样的湛然沉寂将永远不会消失。

Yet I believe that the clear, profound stillness within me, vast as empty space, will never disappear.

感谢所有的护关人员！

My gratitude to everyone who helped protect and support my retreat!

愿把所有功德回向给芸芸众生！

May I dedicate all the merit to the countless beings of the world!

看完第一本，已是中午了，郑美琴今天没有加班，亲自下厨准备了一桌丰盛的饭菜。

By the time he finished reading the first volume, it was already noon. Zheng Meiqin had not worked overtime that day and had personally prepared a lavish meal.

吃饭时，郑美琴说：“你一上午都在看吴爱真的日记程吗？”

During the meal, Zheng Meiqin asked, “Have you spent the whole morning reading Wu Aizhen’s cultivation diary?”

“嗯。”丁一鸣狼吞虎咽地吃着饭。

“Yes,” Ding Yiming replied, wolfing down his food.

“唉，你认为她日记中谈的修证境界是真的吗？挺神奇的，像神话一样。”

“Well, do you think the spiritual states and attainments she describes in her diary are real? They’re quite extraordinary, almost like something out of a myth.”

丁一鸣正在嚼一口菜，半天没有吱声。

Ding Yiming was chewing a mouthful of food and did not answer for a long while.

停了一会儿，他才说：“非真非假。”

After a pause, he finally said, “Neither true nor false.”

郑美琴说：“不懂。”

Zheng Meiqin said, “I don’t understand.”

“佛说，我们这个世界是虚幻不实的，你说它是吗？”

“The Buddha says that our world is illusory and lacks true reality. Do you think that’s the case?”

“我不觉得的。”

“I don’t think so.”

“禅定的境界也如此。佛说它如梦幻泡影，也许证进入其中的人不觉得的。

“The states experienced in meditation are the same. The Buddha says they are like dreams, illusions, bubbles, and shadows. Perhaps those who enter these states through realization do not experience them that way.

如果能从三界诸境界中见到空相，才算理解了佛所说。”

“Only when one can perceive emptiness within all the states of the Three Realms can one be said to understand what the Buddha taught.”

“哇！老公，你现在修学得这么高啊！”

“Wow! Honey, you’ve reached such a high level in your spiritual studies!”

“多谢夸奖，只是小悟。”

“Thank you for the compliment. It’s only a small awakening.”

“你说的佛话我有时都快听不懂了，还说是小悟。”

“Sometimes I can barely understand the Buddhist things you say, and you still call it a small awakening!”

丁一鸣笑了笑，放下碗筷，擦擦嘴，说：“我吃饱了，。有劳夫人吃完后收拾了。”

Ding Yiming smiled, put down his chopsticks, wiped his mouth, and said, “I’m full. I’ll leave the cleanup to my dear wife after you finish eating.”

便又钻进了书房。

Then he disappeared back into his study.

法界之心 · 四十九天闭关纪实
THE HEART OF THE DHARMA REALM
